description:
**JLL Supports The Whole You, Personally And Professionally.**
 Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you've got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you're looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
   

  

**What this job involves:**
 Are you the person who sees a business problem and instinctively starts looking for a data\-driven solution? This role is for a proactive owner and strategic thinker who is motivated not just by analyzing data, but by transforming it into measurable business impact. You will be empowered to audit our existing analytics portfolio, drive enhancements through automation and AI, and partner with business leaders to turn ambiguous challenges into clear, actionable insights.
   

  

 As a key member of JLL Business Services (JBS), you will help shape the organization's journey toward data\-driven operations. This role goes beyond traditional reporting, combining business acumen, analytical depth, and solution ownership to influence how decisions are made across the organization.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, analytical depth, AI fluency, stakeholder influence, and hands\-on technical capability to independently drive high\-impact analytics initiatives from concept through adoption.
   

  

**Job Title: Manager, Operational Intelligence**
**Key Responsibilities**
**End\-to\-End Solution Ownership:** 
 Operate as an autonomous analytics partner to business stakeholders, translating high\-level objectives into tangible roadmaps. Take full ownership of the solution lifecycle from strategic requirements gathering and logical data modeling to driving project implementation, stakeholder collaboration, and user adoption.
   

  

**Advanced Solution Development:** 
 Design and develop robust, scalable analytics solutions that provide actionable, prescriptive insights. This includes hands\-on ownership of the technical build: from designing data models and writing advanced SQL to creating compelling, executive\-level dashboards and data narratives in Power BI or Tableau.
   

  

**Portfolio Optimization and Enhancement:** 
 Proactively audit and own the team's existing portfolio of analytics solutions. Identify and execute opportunities for enhancement through workflow automation (e.g., Power Automate), refined analytical methodologies, improved user experience, and the strategic application of AI tools to increase efficiency and impact.
   

  

**Innovation and AI Advocacy:** 
 Champion the practical use of AI as a strategic lever for problem\-solving. Act as a thought partner by proactively experimenting with and recommending how modern tools (JLLGPT, Claude, AI\-enabled BI features) can be applied to accelerate analysis, generate deeper insights, and solve complex business challenges.
   

  

**Leadership \& Mentorship** 
 : Provide technical leadership and project guidance to 1\-2 analysts through a matrix reporting structure. Guide their work assignments and ensure delivery excellence. Administrative management responsibilities remain with their functional reporting line.
   

  

**Required Experience And Skills**
* 10\-13 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or related data\-focused roles, with a demonstrated track record of turning ambiguous business problems into practical, adopted solutions.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to connect data insights to operational, financial, and strategic business outcomes.
* Proactive, curious, and comfortable challenging existing assumptions constructively to improve business performance and decision\-making.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience engaging senior leaders and translating analytical findings into actionable business recommendations.
* Comfortably operating with a high degree of autonomy, managing multiple priorities, and navigating evolving business requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in Power BI or Tableau, with the ability to independently build intuitive, high\-impact analytics products.
* Proven expertise in designing and implementing scalable data models for analytics. Adept at translating complex business requirements into logical data structures. Hands\-on proficiency with advanced analytical SQL for data exploration and validation is essential. Experience working with enterprise data platforms like Snowflake or Databricks is highly preferred.
* A strong interest in and aptitude for leveraging AI and AI\-enabled analytics tools to accelerate analysis and support strategic thinking, coupled with strong critical thinking and business judgment.
* Experience with modern workflow automation tools including Power Automate, API integration, SharePoint, or M365 integration is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts in a clear, business\-relevant manner. Skilled at storytelling with data and presenting to executive audiences.
* Experience working in global organizations and across cross\-functional or multicultural teams is preferred.
* Estimated compensation for this position offer will vary based on applicant's education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, internal equity and alignment with market data.


**Location:** 
 Hyderabad (Hybrid with at least 2\-3 days working in office.)
   

  

**Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:**
 JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
   

  

**About JLL:**
 We're JLL, a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That's why we're committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We're using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
   

  

 Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we're honoured to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
   

  

 Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued, and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we're headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation, and succeed together.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience in operations or business management, and vendor management.
* 7 years of experience using analytics or applying project management tools to address business issues.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Project Management certifications such as PMP, Six Sigma, etc.
* Experience with managing digital advertising, Google Ads, campaign building and optimization.
* Experienced with the GCS Incentive system (Points, UAAs, Spend Bands, Offerings, etc).
* Experience in early customer lifecycle stages (i.e. Onboarding and Acquisition).
* Understanding of selling best practice and techniques (e.g., objection handling, competitive selling).
* Excellent sales performance analysis skills, along with the ability to manage sales activities and metrics, diagnose performance issues, and translate insights into recommendations.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Vendor Performance Manager (VPM), you will play a critical role on the frontlines of Google Customer Solutions (GCS) vendor sales management. You will be the principal stakeholder for your vendor management team, influencing and holding them accountable to deliver excellent sales performance and quality while enabling site\-program success with targeted support.


You will be responsible for analyzing vendor performance and presenting key insights to Google sales leadership, supporting initiatives to improve GCS vendor operations, and sharing best practices with vendor management and Google teams across global markets and lines of business.  

  

This role is aligned to the AUNZ market and will require working non standard hours.


The Global Business Organization (GBO) is the engine that powers Google’s full ecosystem of products and services to help customers and partners succeed and grow. GBO includes the commercial arms of Ads sellers, business development teams, and customer services and support, as well as overlay programs that enable coordinated engagement with Google's most complex and important customers and partners.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Build quarterly strategy in collaboration with vendor leaders, monitor weekly sales performance metrics, and share key market performance insights with Google sales leadership via weekly updates and monthly reviews.
* Ensure vendor service quality against contracted Service Level Agreement (SLA) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) by conducting regular call audits, calibration sessions, and quality reviews.
* Build influential, trusted partner relationships with vendor sales management (e.g., Senior Manager), communicating rigorous expectations for delivering against program\-specific agreement terms while providing appropriate support, best practices, and guidance.
* Provide critical on\-the\-ground feedback and support to land vendor operations improvement initiatives led by central Google teams.
* Find opportunities and execute on cross GCS collaborations to enable smooth customer outreach, graduations, and more.

description:
**Project Description:** 




 We're looking for a Senior Java Developer to design, build, and scale backend services for a high throughput, low latency platform with strict reliability and auditability requirements. You'll own end to end delivery—from design to production—collaborating closely with Product, QA, and DevOps.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Design and implement microservices and event\-driven components in Java (preferably Java 17\+).
* Model and optimize PostgreSQL schemas, queries, and transactions for performance and integrity.
* Build resilient, observable services on AWS (ECS/EKS/Lambda, S3, RDS/Aurora, MSK/Kinesis, IAM).
* Ship with strong CI/CD practices (GitHub Actions) and leverage GitHub Copilot to accelerate high quality delivery.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance (circuit breakers, retries, idempotency, backpressure).
* Implement security and compliance controls (authz/authn, secrets, IAM policies, encryption at rest/in transit).
* Own production operations: monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Contribute to architecture decisions, code reviews, and engineering standards.



  





**Mandatory Skills Description:** 



* 9\+ years of professional backend experience with Java (Core Java, Collections/Concurrency, Streams, JVM internals).
* Experience with Capital Markets, trading, market data, or financial analytics.
* Strong with Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security; understanding of Spring Cloud is a plus).
* Experience with Angular
* Exposure to Python for tooling and automation.
* Proven expertise with PostgreSQL: indexing strategies, query tuning (EXPLAIN/ANALYZE), transactions/locking, isolation levels.
* Hands on AWS experience: deploying and operating production services (at least 3 of ECS/EKS/Lambda, RDS/Aurora, S3, SQS/SNS/MSK/Kinesis, CloudWatch, IAM).
* Solid API design (REST/gRPC), versioning, pagination, and backward compatibility.
* Production grade observability (logs, metrics, tracing; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, or similar).
* CI/CD with GitHub and GitHub Actions (branching strategies, code reviews, trunk based or GitFlow).
* Practical use of GitHub Copilot (or similar AI coding assistants) to boost productivity while maintaining code quality.
* Experience building fault tolerant distributed systems (circuit breakers, bulkheads, rate limiting; resilience patterns).
* Proficiency with containerization (Docker) and infrastructure as code (Terraform/CloudFormation—at least one).
* Strong understanding of secure coding practices and common vulns (OWASP Top 10\).
* Excellent communication; ability to turn ambiguous requirements into actionable technical plans.



  





**Nice\-to\-Have Skills Description:** 



* Event streaming \& messaging: Kafka, MSK, Kinesis, RabbitMQ.
* Data modeling for auditable workflows, SLAs, and multi party approval processes.
* Experience with multi tenant architectures and row level security.
* Knowledge of domain\-driven design (DDD) and CQRS patterns.
* Experience with performance profiling (JFR, async\-profiler) and JVM tuning (GC, heap, thread pools).
* Exposure to Python and Node.js for tooling and automation.
* Familiarity with feature flags (e.g., LaunchDarkly) and blue/green or canary deployments.
* Compliance/controls mindset (audit trails, data lineage, segregation of duties).

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award\-winning culture.  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.### **Job description**


We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific. **Who we want:**  

**Dedicated Achievers \-** Individuals who excel in a fast‑paced environment and demonstrate an unwavering commitment to delivering high‑quality outcomes. You take pride in ensuring every project is completed on time, meets or exceeds expectations, and adheres to all regulatory standards.

**Curious Learners \-** Professionals who actively seek out new knowledge, technologies, and research to stay ahead of what’s next. You continuously expand your skill set and embrace innovation as a driver for better solutions.

**Self‑Directed Initiators \-** Highly accountable contributors who take full ownership of their work. You are proactive, driven, and unafraid to initiate productivity, change, and improvements—consistently ensuring projects reach successful completion.

**Inspiring Leaders \-** Relationship‑focused individuals who connect authentically and collaborate effectively. You foster an inclusive environment built on trust, enthusiasm, and shared purpose. Your ability to inspire others motivates teams, builds momentum, and positively influences outcomes.

**Champions of Talent \& Technical Excellence \-** Technical leaders who offer deep product knowledge and can step forward as subject‑matter experts. You guide teams through complex problem statements, mentor talent, and elevate the overall technical capability of the organization.  

  

**What you will do:**

* **High\-Performance C\+\+ application:** Design and build core execution engines, real\-time simulation algorithms, and performance\-critical modules using C\+\+ (6\+ years required).
* **3D Visualization \& Virtual Patient Modeling:** Render complex anatomical environments, volumetric DICOM datasets, and dynamic spatial interactions using VTK, ITK, and 3D modeling tools.
* **Modern Web UI \& Distributed Architecture:** Develop responsive, web\-based interfaces and front\-end using React and JavaScript, backed by modular architectures (SOA, microservices, Web APIs) and cloud/database platforms (AWS/Azure, SQL/NoSQL).
* **Regulatory Rigor \& Data Integrity:** Adhere to medical device SDLC standards (IEC 62304/FDA compliance) across the full stack, utilizing ALM tools for complete requirements\-to\-implementation traceability and ensuring HIPAA\-compliant patient data security.
* **Agile Planning \& Technical Problem Solving:** Contribute to high\-level architecture diagrams, sprint task estimations, and resolve production or simulation runtime defects through structured root\-cause analysis.

 **Minimum Qualifications (Required):**  

Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering/ Computer Science or related discipline \& 10\+ years of work experience  

  

**Preferred Qualifications (Strongly desired):**  

**Core Technical \& Architectural Skills:**

* **C\+\+ \& Desktop Frameworks:** 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in modern C\+\+, focusing on object\-oriented design patterns and multi\-threaded systems, etc.,
* **Full\-Stack \& Web Architecture:** Experience designing Service\-Oriented Architectures (SOA), microservices, and Web APIs using modern client\-side frameworks (Angular, React, JavaScript).
* **Medical Imaging Solutions:** Practical application of medical domain technologies such as DICOM, VTK, ITK, and 3D modeling pipelines.

**Design, Tooling \& Quality Assurance:**

* **Code Analysis \& Optimization:** Practical application of static/dynamic analysis, dynamic memory inspection, profiling, and code coverage measurement tools.
* **Integration \& CI/CD:** Hands\-on knowledge of modern software integration, build automation, and deployment pipelines.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

**Level Up Your Career!**
 At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1\.5 billion\+ downloads alongside a thriving PC \& Console division that has achieved numerous global chart\-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space.
   

  

 At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, door\-to\-door transport scheme, free food \& drinks, free game codes \& merch, LinkedIn Learning, 20 annual leave days \+ bank holidays, and 1 day extra day for each year of service capped at 5\.
   

  

**Join the team!**
 As we continue to grow, we are now looking for a
 **Senior Fullstack Developer** 
 to join our AI \& Technology team.
   

  

 As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will be responsible for building and shipping fullstack applications end to end. This role expands our senior depth to support our AI and Infrastructure work. You'll help fellow engineers get unblocked, lend a hand with DevOps and deployments, and deliver features acoss the stack that move the wider business forwatds.
   

  

 This is a permanent role based in our Bangalore studio, where our daily in\-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Design, build, and ship complete features across Python/FastAPI backends and React frontends.
* Build and maintain asynchronous APIs in Python and FastAPI, backed by sensible database design and secure server\-side logic.
* Deploy and harden containerised microservices with Docker so they hold up in production.
* Build frontends using Next.js, Vite, and TypeScript, with Tailwind CSS, Shadcn, and TanStack (React Query) for state.
* Integrate third\-party AI services such as the OpenAI APIs into live web applications.
* Make effective use of agentic coding tools like GitHub Copilot in VS Code to work faster without cutting corners on quality.
* Track down architectural issues and performance bottlenecks across the stack and fix them.
* Write and maintain tests to keep the codebase reliable as it grows.
* Review other developers' code and give clear, constructive feedback.
* Keep technical documentation up to date so the team can find what they need.
* Write clean, maintainable code that others on the team can build on.
* Work with our AI Engineers to stand up and stabilise the infrastructure behind new tools in the PCC and Mobile space.
* Support the DevOps team, helping keep our AWS environments and deployment pipelines in good shape as demand grows.
* Mentor fellow developers and share what you know as the team grows.
* Pitch in within a flat team structure, unblocking others and keeping delivery moving.
* Weigh in on decisions about scalability and how our systems should grow, without carrying formal management responsibility.
* Report to the Head of Engineering all relevant matters that affect your job and work.
* Fully comply with the companies procedures, processes, strategies and tactics as may be issued from time to time.
* Ad\-hoc other tasks which may arise from time to time and be assigned to you by the business.


**Fullstack Technical Expertise:**
* At least 5 years building asynchronous APIs with Python and FastAPI.
* A solid grasp of database design, secure server\-side logic, and keeping data intact.
* Experience deploying and running containerised microservices with Docker in production.
* Familiarity with Cloud hosting, deployment, and cloud infrastructure, AWS desirable.
* Comfortable working with Git in a collaborative, review\-based workflow.
* Hands\-on with agentic coding tools such as GitHub Copilot in VS Code as part of your day\-to\-day workflow.
* Strong React skills, specifically Next.js, Vite, and TypeScript.
* Comfortable with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn, and managing state with TanStack (React Query).
* Hands\-on experience wiring third\-party AI services like the OpenAI APIs into live applications


**Ownership \& Delivery:**
* You can dig into architectural issues and performance bottlenecks and sort them out.
* You write tests and review others' code as a matter of habit, not an afterthought.
* You deliver steadily and to a good standard while working across time zones with the rest of the team.
* You've shipped features end to end across both Python and React, not just one side of the stack.


**Mentorship and Cross\-Team Collaboration:**
* You enjoy coaching other developers and levelling up the people around you, without needing to be their manager.
* You're happy to help out with DevOps and infrastructure alongside your own work.
* You can talk through trade\-offs on scalability and design clearly, with both engineers and leadership.
* You care about clean, maintainable code and work in a way that lifts the whole team.


**Why Kwalee?**
* Generous Holiday: Start with 20 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!
* Flexible Working: We offer core hours that allow you to work flexibly around your life, and a bank of 'Work From Home' days to use when you need them.
* Health Cover: Private Medical Insurance covering you and your family
* Free Food \& Drink: Fuel your day with unlimited free snacks and drinks.
* Gaming Goodies: Receive Steam codes for all our game releases!
* Transport: Save on your commute with our budget\-friendly, door\-to\-door transport facility.
* Office Location: Work from our Bangalore office immersing yourself in the dynamic heart of India's Silicon Valley, where explosive career opportunities seamlessly blend with a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle and fantastic year\-round weather.
* Professional Development: Take advantage of our corporate LinkedIn Learning subscription to enhance your skill set
* Merch \& Events: Get exclusive Kwalee merch, enjoy fun seasonal events, and stay informed with regular town halls.


**Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion**
 At Kwalee, we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer, where we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving creativity. We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and supportive environment where everyone can thrive.
   

  

 Our culture is built on celebrating the diverse voices of our team members, fuelling innovation and strengthening our connection to our players. We are dedicated to advancing equity, diversity, and inclusion across all areas of life, including age, disability, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation.
   

  

 We recognise the importance of self\-development, career progression, and well\-being in retaining our talented team. At Kwalee, we celebrate individuality and encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**Role Summary**
 Build software that helps athenahealth solve complex healthcare business challenges at scale. The Member of Technical Staff will develop and maintain backend services and cloud\-based applications that support high\-volume claim resolution workflows, improve operational efficiency, and contribute to reliable product experiences for customers and internal teams. This role is based in

 work model. The person in this role will collaborate with engineers, product partners, and other stakeholders to deliver maintainable, scalable solutions using modern software development practices. This position reports to the

 .

 Our Collector R\&D teams are building new and evolving services for athenahealth customers. We work on solving complex business problems for a broad set of stakeholders, including customers, internal technology\-enabled services teams, and multiple BPO vendors. Much of this work involves designing and implementing workflows that manage large volumes of claim resolution activity, with a focus on improving visibility, throughput, and operational consistency.
   

  

 These systems support work that may be completed manually by operations partners or automated to improve overall productivity. That means our teams build software that helps route work, manage exceptions, connect business rules to execution paths, and create a more efficient experience across revenue cycle operations. The engineering work often involves balancing scale, reliability, maintainability, and evolving business needs across distributed systems.
   

  

 As a Member of Technical Staff, this role contributes directly to the development of backend services and microservices that power these workflows. Success in this role requires solid software engineering fundamentals, experience working with service\-based systems, and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions. The team values clear communication, practical problem solving, and thoughtful engineering that improves outcomes for customers and internal users. * Develop backend applications and services using Java to support business\-critical workflows and platform capabilities.
* Build and maintain scalable microservices that integrate with internal platforms and dependent systems.
* Implement cloud\-based solutions on AWS with attention to reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Create and enhance APIs and service integrations that support high\-volume transactional workflows.
* Troubleshoot application and service issues, identify root causes, and deliver fixes that improve system stability.

* Contribute to monitoring and alerting improvements that help detect and resolve production issues.
* Partner with adjacent teams to align on API contracts, integration points, and shared dependencies.
* Share technical knowledge through walkthroughs, documentation, and collaborative problem\-solving sessions.

* Experience developing or supporting microservices and service\-based architectures.

**Company Description**
**ABOUT IQ\-EQ**
 We’re a leading Investor Services group offering end\-to\-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide.
   

  

 We employ a global workforce of 6,500\+ people across 25 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$750 billion. We work with 13 of the world’s top 15 private equity firms.
   

  

 Our services are underpinned by a Group\-wide commitment to ESG and best\-in\-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in\-house experts.
   

  

 Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding.
   

  

 We’re driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Are you an experienced SharePoint professional with a passion for driving digital collaboration, document management, and modern workplace solutions? We’re looking for a
 **SharePoint Associate Architect** 
 to take ownership of our enterprise SharePoint landscape, shaping strategy, governance, and technical delivery across the Group. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in our digital transformation journey, leading the evolution of our SharePoint Online Document Management Solution while guiding the transition from legacy platforms to cloud\-based services.
   

  

 Working with senior stakeholders, IT teams, architects, and third\-party partners, you'll combine strong technical expertise with strategic thinking to deliver secure, scalable, and user\-focused solutions that enable business success.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* You'll define and lead the Group\-wide SharePoint strategy, architecture, governance, and standards, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, and compliance requirements.
* You'll manage and continuously enhance the SharePoint Online Document Management Solution (DMS), while supporting legacy SharePoint environments throughout cloud migration initiatives.
* You'll design and deliver custom SharePoint solutions using Microsoft 365, Power Platform, automation, integrations, and low\-code/no\-code technologies to meet business needs.
* You'll provide technical leadership by collaborating with business stakeholders, architects, support teams, and third\-party vendors to resolve complex issues and deliver successful project outcomes.
* You'll champion SharePoint best practices, drive process improvements, effectively manage priorities, and demonstrate strong collaboration, adaptability, and leadership aligned with the values of being Authentic, Bold, and Collaborative.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive Reward Package – Market\-aligned salary and benefits reflective of your experience, skills, and qualifications
* Generous Pension Scheme – Employer contributions with options to increase your own contributions
* Health \& Wellbeing Benefits – Medical insurance, life assurance, discounted gym memberships, and opportunities to support community, charity, and environmental initiatives
* Flexible Working – A supportive approach to hybrid and flexible working to help you achieve a healthy work\-life balance
* Learning \& Development – Access to training, tools, and development opportunities to support your ongoing growth and career progression


**Qualifications**
**About you**
* You hold a degree in Information Systems or a related field (or equivalent experience), with significant IT expertise and experience as a SharePoint Architect.
* You have strong hands\-on experience designing, developing, and implementing SharePoint solutions across SharePoint Online, Power Platform, APIs, and workflow automation technologies.
* You have a proven track record of delivering enterprise\-scale solutions throughout the full project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design to implementation and ongoing support.
* You possess broad technical expertise across the Microsoft technology stack, including .NET, SQL Server, Azure services, system integrations, and low\-code/no\-code platforms.
* You demonstrate excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate, influence, and deliver results effectively in complex global environments, independently or as part of a team.


**Additional Information**
**OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT**
 As a forward\-looking business, sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining meaningful, long\-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.
   

  

 There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.
   

  

 Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 5,500\+ employees \- from 94 nationalities, speaking 41 languages across 25 countries \- to each achieve their potential. Through IQ\-EQ Launchpad we support female managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.
   

  

 We’re committed to growing long\-term relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients' sustainability and success leads to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

**About Team**
 RX Global aims to create unforgettable experiences for attendees and exhibitors through organizing events. Innovation, creativity, and collaboration drive the company to offer exceptional services to clients.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Senior Quality Test Engineer I is responsible for delivering high\-quality, accessible digital experiences through an
 **automation\-first and quality\-driven approach** 
 . The role focuses on
 **UI test automation, accessibility testing, AI\-assisted quality engineering, and risk\-based testing** 
 , partnering with Product and Engineering teams to ensure reliable, scalable, and inclusive product releases. The engineer plays a key role in advancing testing practices from manual\-heavy execution to intelligent, automation\-assisted quality engineering.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* 6\+ years of Quality Engineering / QA experience with a strong focus on test automation and web application testing.
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test solutions for UI, API, and regression testing.
* Apply risk\-based testing techniques to prioritize testing efforts and improve release confidence.
* Execute automated and exploratory testing, ensuring comprehensive coverage of functional, usability, and accessibility requirements.
* Leverage AI tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT) to improve test design, test data creation, automation development, and testing efficiency.
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Developers, and Architects to ensure requirements are testable, complete, and aligned to quality objectives.
* Analyse defects, logs, monitoring data, and test results to identify risks and support root cause analysis.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of automation frameworks, quality practices, and engineering standards across teams.


**Requirements**
**Must\-Have Skills**
* Strong hands\-on experience with UI test automation frameworks such as Playwright/Selenium.
* Proven experience in Accessibility Testing, including knowledge of WCAG 2\.1/2\.2 standards, accessibility validation tools (e.g., Axe, Lighthouse), and inclusive design principles.
* Experience testing modern web applications, user journeys, responsive interfaces, and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Strong understanding of API testing, REST services, and SQL/data validation.
* Experience implementing automated tests within CI/CD pipelines.
* Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted testing tools such as GitHub Copilot or ChatGPT to accelerate quality engineering activities.
* Cloud platform experience (AWS or similar).
* Strong analytical, debugging, defect investigation, and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence quality outcomes across cross\-functional teams.


**Nice to Have**
* Performance testing experience and knowledge of observability/monitoring tools.
* Exposure to security testing concepts.
* Experience championing accessibility and automation best practices across multiple teams.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.
   

  

**Working for you**
**Benefits**
 We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
   

  

 Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
   

  

 Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
   

  

 Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
   

  

 Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
   

  

 Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work\-life balance.
   

  

 Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work\-related challenges.
   

  

 Medical Screening: Your well\-being is a top priority.
   

  

 Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
   

  

 Long\-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
   

  

 New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
   

  

 Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
   

  

 Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
   

  

**About Business**
 RX is a global leader in events and exhibitions, leveraging industry expertise, data, and technology to build businesses for individuals, communities, and organizations. With a presence in 25 countries across 41 industry sectors, RX hosts approximately 350 events annually. RX is committed to creating an inclusive work environment for all our people. **About the job** 




**Job Title:** 
 HR Onboarding Specialist
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Reports to:** 
 Manager HR
 



**About Ceres India** 




 At Ceres India Private Limited, we support initiatives that help communities recover, rebuild, and strengthen resilience. As part of the Ceres Global network of companies, we contribute to disaster recovery, infrastructure restoration, environmental services, and critical response operations through engineering, technology, innovation, and operational excellence. From India, we help enable faster decisions, stronger delivery, and meaningful outcomes where they matter most. The purpose is at the core of what we do. We are building an environment where talent can do meaningful work, take ownership, grow with the business, and be part of something larger than themselves.
 



**Driven by Purpose, Powered by People** 




 At Ceres India, we believe youre more than just an employee; you’re part of a team with a purpose and a meaningful mission. Every team member plays a vital role in restoring hope, helping communities recover and rebuild.
 



 We value initiative, respect diversity, and give our people the freedom to lead. We offer competitive pay, growth opportunities, travel, and a culture built on resilience and teamwork. If you show up with compassion, share the commitment, react with urgency, and deliver solutions, you’ll fit right in. We don’t just respond to challenges; we rise to them.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 The Onboarding Specialist – US Operations is responsible for managing end\-to\-end employee onboarding, ensuring a smooth and compliant transition for new hires using HRMS platforms such as Paycom. The role partners closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, and IT teams to deliver an excellent new\-hire experience.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage full\-cycle onboarding for US employees (exempt and non\-exempt).
* Initiate and track I\-9 verification and E\-Verify compliance
* Ensure completion of W\-4, state tax forms, direct deposit, and policy acknowledgements
* Configure and maintain onboarding workflows in HRMS tool (Paycom preferred)
* Initiate and track pre\-employment checks, documentation, drug screening vendors and compliance forms
* Coordinate with Payroll and Benefits teams for timely employee setup
* Ensure data accuracy across HR systems and employee records
* Communicate onboarding timelines and expectations to new hires and stakeholders
* Support audits, reporting, and HR metrics related to onboarding
* Troubleshoot HRMS system issues and provide user support



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* 5\-6 years of experience in US onboarding / HR operations
* Hands\-on experience with HRMS tools – Paycom (preferred)
* Strong understanding of onboarding compliance and employment documentation
* Strong knowledge of US employment compliance (I\-9, E\-Verify, W\-4, state new\-hire reporting)
* Excellent attention to detail and data management skills
* Strong communication and stakeholder coordination abilities
* Experience supporting US onboarding processes is a plus
* Flexibility to work across US Timezones


- 


**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience supporting multi\-state US onboarding
* Exposure to high\-volume or remote onboarding
* Knowledge of US payroll and benefits processes
* Experience working with background check vendors



  





**What To Expect** 




 This is a fast\-paced, detail\-oriented role focused on delivering a seamless onboarding experience for new hires across the US. You'll manage multiple onboarding activities simultaneously, ensuring compliance with employment requirements while coordinating closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, IT, and hiring managers. Success in this role requires strong organization, accuracy, and the ability to adapt to changing hiring volumes and priorities while providing excellent support to new employees and stakeholders.
 



**Why Join Ceres India?** 




 At Ceres India, you won’t just have a job, you’ll have a mission. Your work will directly impact the speed and strength of community recovery after disasters.
 



**We Offer** 



* A collaborative, mission\-driven culture.
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
* The chance to make a lasting difference for communities.

 Support the cash allocation team, ensuring payments align with customer remittances.
* **Query Resolution:** 
 Collaborate with sales and invoicing teams to resolve customer queries efficiently.
* **Credit Risk Monitoring:** 
 Monitor customer credit ratings and take necessary actions to mitigate financial risks.
* **Account Setup \& Maintenance:**

 Lead initiatives to reduce debtor days, improving cash flow and minimizing overdue receivables.

description:
****Job Summary****
 The Systems Analyst Assoc role collaborates with business partners and application development teams to deliver and maintain required technology solutions. They are responsible for updates to applications / technology platforms, responding to issues, troubleshooting and general maintenance of the systems.
   

  

 They will act as the liaison for various IT (Information Technology) infrastructure, security, and development teams. They will also be addressing any requests, inquiries, and escalations from customers, help desk, or business partners.
   

  

****Job Description****
**MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**System Analysis And Administration:**
* Collaborate with business partners and application development teams to build, refine, test, secure, and debug system capabilities as needed.
* Author and maintain system and process documentation (such as workflow charts and diagrams, and system specifications).


**Monitoring And Support:**
* Respond to any system anomalies like performance or vulnerability alerts and partner with respective teams to remediate them.
* Respond to inquiries from business partners, requests from users, support calls/tickets escalated by help desk.
* Author and maintain knowledgebase for the effective resolution of repetitive requests, inquiries, and requests.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis for system related incidents.


**Release Management:**
* Understand and adhere to IS change management policies
* Identify and execute best practices to ensure a streamlined, reliable deployment and a streamlined, reliable roll\-back process


****Education:****
**MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS:**
* A bachelor's degree in computer science or related field.


****Certification / Licensure:****
* None required.


****Work Experience:****
* Experience in analysis, configuration, and development on relevant platforms.


****Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:****
* Preferably some hands\-on development experience with desired programming languages and database tools.
* Preferably some experience in an operations role providing production support for large enterprise grade applications.
* Strong analytical skills to understand business goals and design appropriate solutions.
* Understanding of software development lifecycle, as well as agile software development methodologies.
* General awareness of web and cloud technologies, differences between SaaS, PaaS and on\-premises hosted system deployments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills.
* Ability to work independently as a self\-starter, and within a team environment.


****Education:****
**PREFERRED JOB REQUIREMENTS:**
* None


****Certification / Licensure:****
* None

Scrum Master
description:
Date live: 09/07/2026


Business Area: Global Payment Services


Area of Expertise: Technology


Contract: Permanent


Reference Code: JR\-0000116838


  
Join us as a Scrum Master at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.  

  



To be successful as a Scrum Master you should have experience with:  

  



* Strong understanding of Scrum, Kanban, and Agile delivery principles.
* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and team workshops.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working with Agile delivery tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and delivery risks.
* Experience working as a Scrum Master or Agile Delivery professional.

Some other highly valued skills may include:


* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PSM, or SAFe Scrum Master certification.
* Experience within Financial Services, Payments, Corporate Banking, or Technology delivery environments.
* Knowledge of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile engineering practices
  

  

  

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.


The role is based out of Pune.


**Purpose of the role**


To lead and manage engineering teams, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support to ensure the delivery of high\-quality software solutions, driving technical excellence, fostering a culture of innovation, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to align technical decisions with business objectives.


**Accountabilities**


* Lead engineering teams effectively, fostering a collaborative and high\-performance culture to achieve project goals and meet organizational objectives.
* Oversee timelines, team allocation, risk management and task prioritization to ensure the successful delivery of solutions within scope, time, and budget.
* Mentor and support team members' professional growth, conduct performance reviews, provide actionable feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Evaluation and enhancement of engineering processes, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency, streamline workflows, and optimize team productivity.
* Collaboration with business partners, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions and ensure a cohesive approach to product development.
* Enforcement of technology standards, facilitate peer reviews, and implement robust testing practices to ensure the delivery of high\-quality solutions.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**


* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Be an integral part of an agile team that's constantly pushing the envelope to enhance, build, and deliver top\-notch technology products.


As a Sr Lead Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Asset \& Wealth Management, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for conducting critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.




At JPMorgan Chase, we are reimagining software engineering itself – by building an AI\-Native SDLC Agent Fabric, a next generated ecosystem of autonomous, collaborative agents that transform every phase of the software delivery lifecycle. We are forming a foundational engineering team to architect, design, and build this intelligent SDLC framework levering multi\-agent systems, AI toolchains, LLM Orchestration (A2A, MCP) and innovative automation solutions. If you're passionate about shaping the future of engineering—not just building better tools, but developing a dynamic, self\-optimizing ecosystem—this is the place for you.


**Job responsibilities**




* Works closely with software engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to define requirements and deliver robust solutions.
* Designs and Implement LLM\-driven agent services for design, code generation, documentation, test creation and observability on AWS
* Develops orchestration and communication layers between agents using frameworks like A2A SDK, LangGraph, or Auto Gen
* Integrates AI agents with toolchains such as Jira, Bitbucket, Github, Terraform and monitoring platforms
* Collaborates on system design, SDK development and data pipelines supporting agent intelligence
* Provides technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers and team members.
* Drives adoption and governance of approved AI\-assisted engineering practices across teams to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI\-assisted code review/refactoring, test acceleration, release readiness, incident/root\-cause analysis), while establishing measurable validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of proven patterns and automation within the SDLC/TLM toolchain.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including approved AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation at scale.




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**




* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5\+ years applied experience.
* Experience in Software engineering using AI Technologies
* Strong hands\-on skills in Python, Pydantic, FastAPI, LangGraph, and Vector Databases for building RAG based AI agent solutions integrating with multi\-agent orchestration frameworks and deploying end\-to\-end pipelines on AWS (EKS, Lambda, S3, Terraform)
* Experience with LLMs integration, prompt/context engineering, AI Agent frameworks like Langchain/LangGraph, Autogen, MCPs, A2A.
* Solid understanding of CI/CD, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker and APIs
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset.
* Demonstrated experience leading effective use of enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security
* Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching senior engineers/leads on compliant usage patterns and controls.




**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**




* Experience with Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Familiarity with MLOps practices, including CI/CD for ML, model monitoring, automated deployment, and ML pipelines.

Post\-Sales CRM Executive / Manager

**Industry:** Retail – Premium Natural Stones, Marble, Granite \& Tiles  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Work Location:** Shamshabad, Hyderabad  
**Work Mode:** In Person

About Celestile

**Celestile** is a premium retail showroom specializing in **Natural Stones, Marble, Granite, Tiles, and Interior Surface Solutions**. We work closely with homeowners, architects, interior designers, builders, developers, and commercial clients to provide premium products and an exceptional customer experience.

Job Summary

We are looking for a **customer\-focused, proactive, and service\-oriented Post\-Sales CRM Executive / Manager** to manage customer relationships and ensure a seamless post\-sales experience.

The selected candidate will be responsible for coordinating with customers and internal departments, monitoring order execution, providing timely updates, resolving customer concerns, and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction throughout the post\-sales journey.

The role requires excellent communication, strong coordination and follow\-up skills, attention to detail, and the ability to interact professionally with premium customers, architects, interior designers, builders, and other stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

* Act as the primary point of contact for customers after order confirmation.
* Manage customer relationships throughout the complete post\-sales journey.
* Coordinate with **Sales, Warehouse, Logistics, Accounts, Procurement, and Installation teams** to ensure smooth order processing and timely execution.
* Provide customers with regular updates regarding order status, material availability, dispatch schedules, delivery timelines, and project progress.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure commitments made to customers are followed through.
* Handle customer inquiries, complaints, service requests, and escalations professionally and efficiently.
* Ensure prompt resolution of customer concerns while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.
* Build and maintain strong professional relationships with homeowners, architects, interior designers, contractors, builders, and developers.
* Maintain accurate customer records and ensure timely updating of CRM systems.
* Track pending orders, deliveries, installations, and customer requirements.
* Prepare **MIS reports, customer feedback reports, order status reports, and service performance reports**.
* Monitor customer satisfaction and identify opportunities for improving the customer experience.
* Follow up proactively with customers and internal teams until issues are resolved and orders are successfully completed.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, processes, and customer service standards.
* Escalate critical customer issues to management when required.
* Contribute to improving post\-sales processes, customer retention, and long\-term customer relationships.

Qualifications \& Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in **Business Administration, Marketing, Retail Management, or a related field**.
* MBA in Retail Management or a related discipline will be an added advantage.

**For Executive Level:**

* **2–5 years of experience** in Post\-Sales CRM, Customer Service, Retail Operations, Customer Relationship Management, or a related field.

**For Manager Level:**

* **6–10 years of relevant experience** in Post\-Sales CRM or Customer Relationship Management.
* Prior experience in team handling, customer escalation management, and process coordination will be preferred.

Industry Experience – Preferred

Experience in any of the following industries will be an advantage:

* Natural Stones
* Marble \& Granite
* Tiles
* Building Materials
* Luxury Retail
* Home Décor
* Interior Products
* Construction
* Interior Design

Experience working with **architects, interior designers, builders, contractors, or premium residential/commercial clients** will be an added advantage.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-management skills.
* Strong customer service and client\-handling abilities.
* Excellent telephonic etiquette and professional communication skills.
* Strong coordination, follow\-up, and organizational skills.
* Ability to interact confidently with premium customers, architects, and interior designers.
* Strong problem\-solving and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Ability to handle customer escalations with professionalism, patience, and empathy.
* Good working knowledge of **Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and CRM software**.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to service quality.
* Ability to multitask and manage multiple customer requirements simultaneously.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced retail environment.

Preferred Competencies

* Customer\-first mindset with a strong focus on customer satisfaction.
* Pleasant, professional, and well\-groomed personality.
* Proactive and solution\-oriented approach.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to build long\-term customer relationships.
* Strong negotiation and coordination skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with multiple departments.
* Professional maturity and ability to handle sensitive customer situations.
* Passion for delivering a premium customer experience.

Why Join Celestile?

* Opportunity to work with a premium retail brand specializing in **luxury natural stones and interior surface solutions**.
* Exposure to renowned architects, interior designers, builders, developers, and premium residential and commercial projects.
* Opportunity to work with high\-value products and premium customers.
* Professional, collaborative, and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Career development and learning opportunities.
* Competitive salary based on experience and capability.
* Performance\-based incentives, where applicable.

Benefits

* Provident Fund as per applicable statutory norms.
* Flexible schedule, as applicable to business requirements.

Important Employment Conditions

* **No cab facility is provided.**
* **Accommodation is not provided by the company.**
* Candidates must arrange their own transportation and accommodation.
* Candidates should be comfortable commuting to the **Shamshabad location**.
* This is a **full\-time, in\-person position**.

 : Project Specialist \- Global Meetings \& Events

**About The Job**
 Sanofi is an innovative global healthcare company headquartered in Paris, France with one purpose: Chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. We are dedicated to making a positive impact on the lives of the patients and families we serve, and we accomplish our goals through world\-class research and with the compassion and commitment of our employees.
   

  

 The company is focused on accelerating development to deliver breakthrough medicines and vaccines to patients, delivering excellence though Diversity.
   

  

 Sanofi operates in 90 countries with 91 000 employees worldwide, working in 59 manufacturing and 20 Research \& Development (R\&D) sites. In 2022 business net income was €10\.3 Billion, delivered by 4 Global Business Units: Specialty care, Consumer Healthcare, Vaccines \& General Medicines.
   

  

 Sanofi covers major therapeutic areas, including immunology, cardiovascular, diabetes, oncology, rare diseases, etc.
   

  

 Sanofi Business Operations (SBO) is designed to centralize processes and activities to support global medical business units and medical office.
   

  

 The Sanofi Business Operations is built to reduce reliance on external services providers and facilitate the development of internal expertise. The Sanofi Business Operations will leverage untapped combination of talent pool.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
*The overall purpose and main responsibilities are listed below:*
*Project Specialist will be responsible for processing contracts and related documents, connecting with stakeholders, and tracking ongoing work.*
* Production: Support scientific events activities \& external expert engagements. Process contract and related documents within defined timelines. Check country specificities and handle queries received from country approver and/or external experts. Timely follow\-ups with event leads, country approvers, and external experts
* Project Planning: Ensure delivery of ongoing projects as per agreed timelines. Ensure to follow defined/agreed quality parameters before sending out deliverables to the stakeholders
* Track ongoing projects on regular basis and take required actions. Support adherence to associated compliance related activities and approvals (taking accountability for compliance with internal customer)

Regular connects with event leads, project requestors, and End\-to\-End contracting leads. Mentor the team on day to day as well exceptional cases, situations. Managing complex projects and interacting with local affiliate/country approvers/BU to discuss over the hospitality. Training management on overall E2E activities (Whenever required). Driving the meetings with stakeholders and providing the project status. Manage challenges related to contracting tools (Vendor onboarding, OneCRM Profile creations (US), other technical issues in tools)
* Events: Partner directly or indirectly, through third party agencies, with transversal brand teams, creative agencies, HCOs, Associations, and exhibit vendors for the best end\-to\-end experience at every event that meets/exceeds the expectations of our internal and external stakeholders. Adhere to company policies, particularly those related to transparency and compliance. Coordinate hotel accommodations and services, transportation, communications and facilities support, program functions and related activities, either directly or indirectly through a third\-party agency. Plan and monitor different types of meetings, identify risks early in the process and set up a risk mitigation plan. Oversee all program logistics, including attendee registration and data management, food and beverage selection, speaker communications, audiovisual needs, and off\-site venues, and on occasion provide hands\-on program management. Ensure budget management, financial reconciliation and post\-meeting reporting to identify synergies and cost\-efficiencies achieved. Serve as the subject\-matter expert for the implementation \& training of technology solutions, and analysis of attendee data. Provide technical support and troubleshooting for One Sanofi platforms such as Veeva Vault CRM Events Management platform, SpotMe and CVent, as well as other meeting technology solutions.

* Experience: Post Graduate degree in any work stream with \>4 years of experience, life sciences degree is preferred
* Soft skills: Stakeholder \& Project management; communication skills; and ability to work independently and within a team environment. User and Data Management. Planning and analytical skills
* Technical skills: Proficient with Microsoft Office (i.e., Excel, Word, Access, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Experience of the Veeva Vault CRM Events Management platform, including report generation and event monitoring. Meeting planning and project management experience is an advantage.
* Language: Excellent command of English is a must.

description:
**Role Description**
 Job Description –
   

  

 Senior QA ServiceNow Analyst Focus: CMDB, CSDM, ITOM and Enterprise Service Management Testing Role Summary The candidate should have a strong background in ServiceNow Quality Assurance and test engineering, with extensive experience in validating ServiceNow platform implementations across key modules and a demonstrated ability to design, execute, and govern testing for Configuration Management Database (CMDB) and Common Service Data Model (CSDM) capabilities.
   

  

 The role requires deep knowledge of testing methodologies applied to ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, SecOps, SPM, Discovery, Service Mapping, integrations, and data governance. The Senior ServiceNow QA Analyst will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and data integrity of platform solutions that improve service visibility, configuration data quality, operational efficiency, and business\-service alignment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design, development, and execution of ServiceNow test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scripts covering functional, integration, regression, UAT, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Collaborate with business, infrastructure, security, and application stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into comprehensive test coverage and acceptance criteria.
* Perform testing across ServiceNow modules including ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, SecOps, SPM, Discovery, and Service Mapping. Own end\-to\-end validation of the CMDB implementation, including CI class design, identification and reconciliation rules, data sources, relationships, lifecycle states, normalization, and data certification outcomes.
* Validate CSDM adoption and data model integrity across foundation data, design, manage technical services, sell/consume, and service portfolio domains, in line with the organization's maturity and roadmap.
* Test and verify application services, business applications, technical services, service offerings, dynamic CI groups, and their relationships against CSDM guidance. Execute CMDB Health validation including completeness, correctness, compliance, duplicate management, orphan CI remediation, stale CI controls, and data\-quality reporting.
* Validate CMDB data ingestion from ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, cloud platforms, endpoint tools, asset systems, monitoring solutions, and third\-party data sources.
* Design and execute test coverage for business rules, Script Includes, client scripts, UI policies, data policies, Flow Designer flows, IntegrationHub spokes, and other configuration elements. Validate Service Catalog items, workflows, approvals, notifications, and request\-fulfilment processes.
* Test integrations built using REST, SOAP, MID Server, IntegrationHub, import sets, transform maps, and scripted APIs. Validate security controls, including ACLs, roles, data segregation, and secure integration practices through negative and role\-based testing.
* Design and implement Automated Test Framework (ATF) suites for regression testing, upgrade readiness, and continuous validation. Monitor and report defects, root\-cause analyses, quality metrics, and coverage dashboards; drive defect triage and closure with development teams.
* Provide QA leadership, test\-case reviews, quality assurance for design deliverables, troubleshooting support, and mentorship to junior testers.
* Partner with process owners and platform governance teams to define CMDB/CSDM data\-quality standards, ownership, stewardship, and continuous\-improvement plans.
* Support release management activities including UAT coordination, upgrade testing, and post\-deployment validation.
* Stay current with ServiceNow product releases, CMDB/CSDM guidance, testing best practices, and emerging capabilities.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in ServiceNow testing and quality assurance, including experience validating enterprise\-scale implementations.
* Strong hands\-on experience testing ServiceNow CMDB, including CI class modeling, relationships, Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE), reconciliation rules, data sources, transform maps, and CMDB Health validation.
* Practical experience validating CSDM implementations, including business applications, application services, technical services, service offerings, and supporting foundation data.
* Experience testing ServiceNow Discovery and/or Service Mapping outputs, including MID Server validation, credentials, patterns, discovery pattern debugging, and reconciliation of discovered data. In\-depth understanding of CMDB governance, data ownership, lifecycle management, certification, normalization, duplicate remediation, and data\-quality controls from a testing perspective.
* Strong proficiency in ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF), test\-case design, defect management, and QA best practices.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript, Glide APIs, HTML, CSS, XML, and ServiceNow scripting sufficient to read, debug, and validate platform code.
* Extensive testing experience across at least three ServiceNow modules such as ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, GRC/IRM, SecOps, and SPM.
* Proven experience testing scoped or custom applications on the ServiceNow platform. Experience validating ServiceNow integrations using REST, SOAP, IntegrationHub, MID Server, and other APIs (API testing tools such as Postman, SoapUI).
* Solid understanding of ITIL practices, service management processes, asset management, infrastructure domains, and application\-service dependencies.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex platform, integration, Discovery, and CMDB data issues.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA), or equivalent demonstrable platform expertise.


**Preferred Skills**
* ServiceNow CIS – Discovery, CIS – Service Mapping, CIS – ITSM, CIS – CSM, or other relevant implementation certifications.
* ISTQB (Foundation / Advanced) or equivalent QA certification.
* Hands\-on experience with CSDM adoption assessments, maturity roadmaps, data\-model remediation, and migration validation from legacy or custom service models.
* Experience validating Service Graph Connectors, Multisource CMDB, CMDB Data Manager, Data Certification, and IntegrationHub ETL.
* Knowledge of cloud and infrastructure platforms such as AWS, Azure, VMware, Kubernetes, network devices, databases, and enterprise applications for infrastructure test validation.
* Experience with test automation tools (Selenium, Cypress, Tosca) integrated with ServiceNow ATF. Experience with Agile / Scrum delivery methodologies, DevOps practices, CI/CD test integration, source control, and ServiceNow application deployment testing.
* Familiarity with defect\-tracking and test\-management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, HP ALM, qTest, or Zephyr.
* Understanding of ITIL 4, service portfolio management, enterprise architecture, and application portfolio management concepts. Experience validating ServiceNow low\-code/no\-code capabilities, including Flow Designer, App Engine Studio, UI Builder, and Workspace configuration.
* Ability to facilitate technical workshops, walkthroughs, and defect triage sessions with architects, process owners, operations teams, and senior stakeholders.


**Skills**
 ServiceNow, CMDB, Test Automation
