description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI Business Solutions –AI Engineer Manager:**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer (Manager) to lead the design and delivery of agent\-based AI solutions using Microsoft technologies. This role combines hands\-on technical expertise with team leadership to drive the adoption of AI\-driven automation and scalable enterprise solutions.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end design and implementation of AI solutions using Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and agent\-based frameworks.
* Develop and oversee intelligent agent development using Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C\#).
* Drive solution architecture, ensuring scalability, performance, and alignment with enterprise standards.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to identify AI use cases and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Mentor team members and ensure high\-quality delivery across AI initiatives.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong experience in Copilot Studio and AI agent development.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C\#).
* Hands\-on experience with Azure AI Foundry and AI/ML services.
* Strong understanding of agent\-based architectures, orchestration, and integration patterns.
* Ability to lead technical design and guide teams on best practices.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate AI solutions within enterprise systems and workflows.
* Translate business requirements into scalable AI architectures and reusable components.
* Ensure solution performance, reliability, and alignment with enterprise security and governance standards.
* Ability to work effectively in distributed, onshore–offshore delivery models.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
**The following skills are preferred and add value to the role:**
* Experience with Power Platform.
* Experience with Azure Integration Services.
* Experience supporting large transformation or digital modernization programs
* Familiarity with testing tools, deployment cycles, and release management practices
* Experience working across multiple industries or complex business environments


**What We Look For**
* Total Experience: \[8\+ Years]
* Relevant Experience (AI/Agent\-based solutions): 1\+ Years
* Prior experience in client\-facing consulting or enterprise delivery engagements.
* Degree in BE / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or equivalent with relevant industry experience.
* Microsoft AI certification is preferred.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Role Description**
 Role Summary
   

  

 The Reconciliation Analyst acts as a subject matter expert responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of custody, cash, and trade data across internal systems. The role requires strong ownership of portfolios, independent handling of complex issues, close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders, and strict adherence to SLAs and control standards. The position plays a critical role in mitigating operational risk and driving continuous process improvements.
   

  

**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
**Core Responsibilities**
* Take full ownership of assigned portfolios and manage end\-to\-end reconciliation activities.
* Maintain, validate, and reconcile internal transaction records including income, fees, and other activities.
* Monitor outstanding items, aged breaks, and high\-value discrepancies; proactively escalate risk items.
* Handle escalations efficiently and immediately escalate high\-risk issues to Team Leads/Managers.
* Coordinate with custodians, counterparties, and administrators to resolve breaks and ensure compliance.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs, operational controls, and risk management standards.


**Leadership \& Team Support**
* Act as the first point of escalation for Analysts and Junior Analysts for BAU activities.
* Guide and support team members on aged items, high\-value breaks, and complex queries.
* Conduct initial quality checks on team output to reduce errors and rework.
* Support training initiatives and actively participate in cross\-training across processes.
* Share knowledge, process updates, and best practices within the team.


**Process \& Control**
* Review, update, and enhance SOPs, procedures, and documentation.
* Suggest and implement process improvement initiatives to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
* Monitor shared mailboxes for urgent items such as overdrafts and debit interest queries and take immediate action.
* Ensure completion of all mandatory trainings within defined timelines.
* Act with integrity, transparency, and professionalism in all responsibilities.


**Must\-Have Skills \& Competencies**
**Technical / Functional**
* Strong experience in reconciliations (custody, cash, and/or trade)
* Solid understanding of investment operations, transactions, income, and fees
* Proven ability to analyze breaks, investigate discrepancies, and resolve complex issues
* Experience working with custodians, counterparties, and fund administrators
* Strong knowledge of operational risk, controls, and SLAs


**Behavioral / Professional**
* High level of ownership, accountability, and attention to detail
* Ability to work independently under tight deadlines
* Strong escalation judgment and risk awareness
* Clear and professional written and verbal communication
* Integrity, transparency, and commitment to quality


 Good\-to\-Have Skills
   

  

* Prior experience as a subject matter expert (SME) or senior team member
* Exposure to process improvement / automation initiatives
* Experience in training, mentoring, or reviewing junior team members’ work
* Knowledge of SOP documentation, audit support, or control testing
* Experience handling mailbox management, OD, and debit interest queries
* Familiarity with multiple reconciliation systems or asset classes


**Skills**
 Issue Analysis, English Communication, Attention to Detail

description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Manager, Statutory Centre of Excellence \- 4
   

  

 Manager, Statutory Centre of Excellence
   

  

**About Mastercard**
 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 Join this exciting team to build and lead the way in global statutory reporting for Mastercard. Manage a team of finance professionals supporting the external audits of Mastercard companies worldwide. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with a finance background in statutory accounting, can build relationships with cross\-functional teams, contribute to the finance team and consistently produces exceptional results.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with a finance background, the ability to build relationships with cross\-functional teams, contribute to the finance team and consistently produce exceptional results. This role is ideal for a person with a strong technical accounting background, good analytical skills and an ability to drive projects through to completion. The critical components are energy and intellect, combined with a “can do” attitude.
   

  

 Role \& Responsibilities
   

  

* Provides support for the Director, Statutory COE relating to financial and statutory reporting in the preparation of financial statements, audit requests, planning of workforce, liaising with external providers and meeting audit deadlines
* Maintains appropriate bridge files to administer and manage the differences between US GAAP and local accounting frameworks or IFRS – proactively works with the controllership and GBSC teams to update both US GAAP and local accounting records accurately and on a timely basis
* Support year end accounting and engage with various departments within Mastercard to ensure any issues are resolved.
* Supports SOX compliance and assisting with control improvements related to financial reporting
* Assists with the external audit process and proactively works with key stakeholders and partners such as the GBSC, controlling, KPMG and PWC (auditors)
* Assists with managing and resolving audit data and issues
* Supports the controllership relationship and applies a client\-service mentality towards all deliverables
* Supports the relationship with external and internal auditors as well as external advisors/ consultants e.g. KPMG


**All About You**
 The ideal candidate would have:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree preferred. Qualified Accountant (ACA, AMCA, ACCA)
* Demonstrates comprehensive knowledge of accounting principles, financial statements and financial reporting requirements and consistently delivers accurate work on a timely basis
* Experience in financial audits, working with external auditors and consultants
* Driven by innovation and making sustainable and meaningful changes to processes
* Ability to deliver results in a fast\-paced environment with a sense of urgency \& accuracy
* Ability to manage multiple activities in a condensed timeframe
* Excellent communication and presentation skills \- experience creating and delivering presentations for training events
* Advanced MS Excel skills essential
* Must have strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently through obstacles
* Experience in statutory reporting with IFRS and US GAAP experience
* Oracle/Hyperion skills beneficial


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
**Description**
 Prime Video is disrupting traditional media with an ever\-increasing selection of movies, TV shows, Emmy Award winning original content, add\-on subscriptions including HBO and Showtime, and live events like Thursday Night Football. Within this expanding ecosystem, Linear TV (24/7 Television or broadcast programming) has emerged as one of our fastest\-growing segments, with viewership hours increasing significantly year over year. This growth demonstrates that even in the streaming era, customers deeply value the lean\-back, curated experience that Linear TV provides.
   

  

 Our data shows that Linear TV viewers develop strong habitual viewing patterns, spending more time on the platform and engaging more consistently than traditional VOD\-only users. The key to supporting these viewing habits is providing seamless, personalized discovery experiences through robust and scalable services. The Linear Discovery Service (LDS) team owns the critical infrastructure that determines how Live TV content is presented to customers \- from the composition of the homepage experience to search capabilities that help customers find live programming. We decide what content collections and carousels appear on Linear pages, their ordering, and how search results are ranked and displayed across all Prime Video clients, ensuring millions of customers can easily find and enjoy their favorite live programming.
   

  

 This is your opportunity to take an active role in shaping how customers discover and interact with Live TV on Prime Video. We need your passion, innovative ideas, and creativity to help continue to deliver on our ambitious goals of creating intuitive, personalized, and responsive discovery experiences at scale.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Software Development Engineer on the Linear Discovery Service team, you will:
   

  

* Design and implement the page composition engine that determines what carousels and content collections appear on Linear pages
* Build intelligent ordering systems that optimize the placement of content sections based on customer behavior and business rules
* Develop and maintain search services specifically optimized for Linear content, including live programs, channels, and upcoming shows
* Build and maintain scalable services that integrate with recommendation systems to provide personalized content listings
* Develop robust caching and content delivery mechanisms to ensure low\-latency responses for millions of concurrent users
* Collaborate with client teams to evolve page composition and search APIs based on new feature requirements
* Work with the Linear Personalization team to integrate recommendations into page composition and search ranking
* Drive improvements in monitoring, alerting, and operational excellence
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team's technical growth


 A day in the life
   

  

 You'll work on services that directly shape how millions of customers discover and engage with Live TV content. Your day might involve analyzing the performance of a new carousel ordering algorithm, optimizing search relevance for an upcoming major linear event or designing a solution for real\-time program updates. You'll balance performance, scalability, and maintainability while ensuring our services meet the high standards our customers expect.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Linear Discovery Service team owns the end\-to\-end discovery experience for Live TV content across Prime Video. We determine what customers see when they land on Linear pages through our page composition engine, how they search for live content, and how content is presented to them. We work closely with Linear client teams and the Linear Personalization team to deliver personalized, responsive, and intuitive browsing experiences. Our services handle millions of requests per day, providing real\-time content information, search results, and page composition decisions to customers worldwide.
   

  

 Our mission is to make Live TV content discovery on Prime Video seamless and engaging, helping customers easily find the content they love while discovering new programs that match their interests. We're focused on building intelligent, scalable services that can grow with our rapidly expanding Linear TV audience while maintaining the high performance our customers expect.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

description:
We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to build the agentic systems at the core of what IG Labs delivers. Our PODs deploy AI agents into enterprise clients to run real business processes, and you are the engineer who builds them: the models, the orchestration, the agent logic, and the evaluation that make a system good enough for a client to put into production. This is backbone engineering, the work the whole organization is built around, not a function that supports it from the side.
 



  





 You take on the hardest AI problems in our client work: the agent that has to be reliable enough to trust, the retrieval that has to be accurate over messy enterprise data, the evaluation that proves the system is good before a client stakes a process on it. You own the AI that goes live in a client environment, from a rough problem to a system in production, and you are accountable for whether it actually works.
 



  





 Everything you build, you build to last beyond one client. The agents, components, and evaluation frameworks you create become Factory IP that compounds across every engagement, so each project starts ahead of the last. You are a senior engineer in our delivery organization, based in India, working within the POD model alongside the Technical Architects and the Data, UI/UX, and Technical/Field engineers who build the rest of the system.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Solving the Hardest AI Problems** 



* Take on the toughest model and agent problems in our client work: accuracy, reliability, and the behaviors a client will actually stake a process on.
* Design and build agentic workflows: LLM orchestration, multi\-agent systems, tool use and function calling, and the human\-in\-the\-loop boundaries that make autonomy safe.
* Take an open\-ended AI problem with no established pattern and prototype, measure, and prove an approach that holds up.
* Own the question of whether the system is good: design the evaluation harnesses, guardrails, and metrics that separate a demo from something production\-ready.
* Shape genuinely architectural decisions with the Technical Architect, contributing the patterns that become standard.



**Agentic \& ML Engineering** 



* Build production\-grade RAG and retrieval, prompt and context engineering, and agent runtimes, with deep, current command of the modern LLM stack.
* Make the hard model tradeoffs across selection, accuracy, latency, and cost, tuned to what the engagement actually needs.
* Fine\-tune or adapt models where it earns its keep, and know when it does not.
* Stand up the MLOps that keep agentic systems honest in production: deployment, monitoring of model and agent health, drift and regression detection.
* Build the evaluation and observability that prove value to a client with evidence, not assertion.



**Delivering in Client Engagements** 



* Own your work end to end within live client engagements, from a rough problem to an agentic system running in production.
* Bring the deep AI and agentic expertise a client engagement depends on, as a peer to the Technical Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and other engineers in the POD.
* Maintain the documentation and handoff discipline that distributed, multi\-client delivery requires, so your work is easy to pick up, extend, and reuse.
* Be available for the hard, real\-time problems that need a working session, not a write\-up.



**Building Reusable Capability** 



* Turn everything you solve into reusable capability: agent components, retrieval patterns, evaluation frameworks, and prompts that make the next engagement faster.
* Partner with the Technical Architect to abstract, validate, and document what you build for the IP library.
* Actively drive Reuse Index. The agentic building blocks you create are how the next project starts ahead of where the last one finished.
* Treat capability\-building as core, not overhead. Every hard problem solved should leave the Factory stronger.



**What This Role Is Not** 



* Not a research role. You are not here to write papers or perfect notebooks. You ship agentic systems into live client production.
* Not a prompt\-tweaker. You engineer AI systems end to end: retrieval, evaluation, orchestration, and deployment.
* Not an internal platform team. You build the systems clients pay for, not internal tooling for its own sake.
* Not the Technical/Field Engineer. They master the client's stack and prove feasibility in it; you build the AI and agentic systems that run on it. Different seats, both core.
* Not the Technical Architect. The TA sets architecture and standards across engagements; you build the systems within them and shape the patterns that become standards.



  





**Qualifications** 




**Required** 




**Strongly Preferred** 




 8\+ years building machine learning and AI systems in production, with recent, hands\-on depth in LLM and agentic systems: RAG, orchestration, multi\-agent design, and evaluation. Strong software and ML engineering in Python. A track record of taking models and agents to production and keeping them reliable (MLOps, monitoring, evaluation). Methodical about accuracy and proving a system is good. A clear written communicator who collaborates well across a distributed team.
 



 Depth with modern agent frameworks and orchestration, fine\-tuning and model adaptation, and vector stores and retrieval systems. Experience in a consulting, professional services, or client\-delivery environment. Familiarity with the data, access, and compliance constraints of regulated clients in financial services or healthcare. A history of building capability that compounds across a wider team.
 



  





**Tools \& Technology** 




**Languages \-** 
 Python
 



  





**LLM \& Agentic \-** 
 LLM orchestration, agent frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain), tool use and function calling
 



  





**Retrieval \& RAG\-** 
 Embeddings, vector stores (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector)
 



  





**Evaluation \& Guardrails\-** 
 Eval harnesses, LLM observability (LangSmith), guardrails
 



  





**ML \& MLOps \-** 
 Fine\-tuning, model deployment, monitoring, drift detection
 



  





**Cloud AI Platforms \-** 
 AWS Bedrock and SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI
 



  





**Core Competencies**

* Build, prototype, and maintain dashboards and BI products in the team’s reporting platform.

**AI \& Automation** 



* Bring AI into day\-to\-day data preparation, validation, and dashboard work to improve speed and reliability.

* Comfort using and experimenting with AI tools, and an interest in applying them to automate and improve data and reporting work.
* Experience with the digital marketing stack(e.g., Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Customer Data Platform).
* Strong attention to detail and a sense of ownership over the accuracy of what the team produces.
* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, business, or related field.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About Auric AI** 




 Auric AI is developing the world's most advanced AI\-powered vision intelligence platform for defense applications
 



 Defense and military organizations today receive overwhelming volumes of visual data from satellites and drones. Processing this manually is slow, expensive, and error\-prone. Our mission is to use AI\-powered vision systems to detect and classify high\-value military objects such as tanks, artillery, radars, and missile launchers so analysts and commanders can act faster and with greater confidence.
 



  





 We’re a fast\-moving defense technology startup, combining world\-class AI research with real\-world military applications to create intelligence platforms that can make a difference where time and trust matter most.
 



**The Role** 




 We’re hiring a Product Manager to lead the development of our Vision Intelligence Platform.
 



 This is not a traditional PM role. You will:
 


* Think from first principles to design workflows that make AI useful in mission\-critical contexts.
* Translate AI research into usable, analyst\-facing products.
* Balance speed, trust, and usability when making product decisions.
* Be AI\-native using the latest AI tools to build wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and demo flows at speed.
* You will own the end\-to\-end product experience: defining workflows, designing intuitive screens, prioritizing features, and ensuring analysts receive intelligence they can trust all within minutes of image arrival.



**What You’ll Do** 



* Vision \& Roadmap


1. Define the product vision and articulate a clear north star for the platform.
2. Build and communicate a roadmap balancing near\-term MVP delivery with long\-term platform growth.


* Workflow \& UX Design


1. Map the full analyst journey: image ingestion → preprocessing → AI detection → quality review → database → dissemination.
2. Work with engineers and designers to create intuitive, analyst\-ready screens.
3. Use AI\-powered tools (e.g., Figma plugins, AI prototyping, AI design assistants) to generate wireframes and demo flows rapidly.


* Feature Prioritization


1. Define MVP scope and ruthlessly separate must\-haves from nice\-to\-haves.
2. Make trade\-offs between speed\-to\-decision, detection accuracy, and user trust.


* Execution \& Delivery


1. Translate requirements into clear PRDs and product specs.
2. Drive collaboration between AI researchers, engineers, and domain experts.
3. Ensure reliability and quality in product releases.


* User \& Stakeholder Engagement


1. Engage with analysts, retired officers, and other stakeholders to understand workflows.
2. Synthesize fragmented feedback into coherent product direction.


* Metrics \& Success


1. Define and track success metrics: time\-to\-insight, adoption, accuracy, and trust in outputs.
2. Use feedback and data to iterate rapidly.



**What We’re Looking For** 



* AI\-native builder: highly proficient in using AI tools for prototyping, wireframing, and creating demo flows.
* First principles thinker who simplifies complex problems into clear workflows.
* Technical fluency: understand how AI and software systems work, even if you don’t code daily.
* User empathy: can design for non\-technical users working under pressure.
* Execution strength: bias for rapid prototyping, iteration, and delivery.
* Communication skills: able to align researchers, engineers, and defense users.
* Prior startup/founder experience or exposure to AI/ML products is a strong plus.



**Why Join Us** 



* Work on one of the hardest, most impactful problems in defense AI.
* Collaborate with a small, world\-class team of researchers and engineers.
* High ownership from day one shapes the platform, not just maintains it.
* Move fast, learn fast, we build, test, and iterate aggressively.
* Be part of a mission\-driven company where AI meets national security.



 Auric AI is building the future of defense intelligence. If you’re an AI\-native product builder who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment, we’d love to hear from you.

**Be the one building AI\-powered experiences where they matter most.**
 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI\-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
   

  

 Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Every sprint that ships depends on someone keeping ceremonies structured, blockers visible, and Jira data trustworthy. Without that, planning drifts, standups run long without resolving anything, and status reports stop reflecting what teams shipped. The Scrum Master owns that day\-to\-day discipline for one or more Platform teams, especially teams still building their agile habits, so the team can focus on delivery instead of process friction.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Ceremony Facilitation**
* Facilitate sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives for assigned teams, keeping sessions time\-boxed and outcome\-focused
* Support charter reviews and team kickoffs, helping new or forming teams set working agreements and delivery expectations
* Document ceremony decisions and action items so commitments carry over cleanly between sprints


**Team Support \& Impediment Removal**
* Support teams new to agile in applying Scrum mechanics day to day, resolving confusion before it slows delivery
* Identify and escalate blockers quickly enough that they don't carry over into the next sprint
* Encourage open retrospectives and follow through on improvement commitments until they're implemented


**Jira \& Delivery Tracking**
* Maintain Jira boards and backlog health for assigned teams, keeping stories current and sprints configured correctly
* Track and report team\-level delivery metrics (velocity, sprint completion rate, open impediments) using Platform\-standard Jira dashboards
* Give stakeholders concise, accurate delivery status updates based on what the team completed


**AI\-Assisted Support**
* Use AI\-assisted tools to support ceremony prep, note capture, and status reporting, cutting down manual admin work


**What You Bring**
**Required Qualifications**
* 2\+ years working as a Scrum Master or in an agile delivery support role within a technology team
* Working knowledge of Scrum principles and ceremonies, with experience running or co\-facilitating them
* Familiarity with Jira for sprint tracking, story management, and basic dashboard configuration
* Strong communication and organizational skills, with a track record of keeping teams on track and following through on commitments
* Comfort supporting teams that are still building their agile practice, adjusting approach as the team matures


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Scrum certification (CSM, PSM I, or equivalent)
* Experience supporting technology teams in Software Engineering, IT infrastructure, or enterprise environments
* Comfort with AI productivity tools or interest in applying automation to reduce repetitive work
* Experience working within an organization with established agile standards


**Key Skills**
* Scrum ceremony facilitation
* Jira sprint and backlog management
* Impediment identification and escalation
* Stakeholder communication and status reporting
* Retrospective facilitation


**BUSINESS IMPACT**
* Builds consistent delivery habits in teams new to agile, improving sprint predictability over time
* Keeps delivery moving by resolving day\-to\-day blockers before they stall a sprint
* Gives Platform leadership accurate, current delivery visibility through disciplined Jira hygiene and status reporting

description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs.
   

  

 Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”
   

  

 Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.
   

  

 The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Medical Documentation Specialist (MDS) is responsible for delivering accurate, timely, and comprehensive clinical documentation that supports healthcare professionals in providing high\-quality patient care. Working as an extension of healthcare professionals, the MDS documents patient encounters within Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems while ensuring compliance with organizational quality standards, provider preferences, and applicable healthcare regulations.
   

  

 Medical Documentation Specialists leverage Commure's Ambient AI technology and documentation workflows to reduce providers' administrative burden, enabling providers to spend more time focusing on patient care.
   

  

 This is an entry\-level opportunity designed for recent graduates and early\-career professionals. Through a structured onboarding program, comprehensive training, ongoing coaching, and continuous feedback, Medical Documentation Specialists develop expertise in clinical documentation, medical terminology, healthcare technology, provider workflows, and documentation best practices while maintaining the highest standards of quality, confidentiality, and operational excellence.
   

  

 Training \& Development
   

  

 Every Medical Documentation Specialist begins their journey with Commure's structured Training and Development Program, designed specifically for recent graduates and early\-career professionals. The program provides a strong foundation through a combination of instructor\-led learning, hands\-on practice, real\-world simulations, regular assessments, continuous coaching, and personalized feedback, enabling participants to build the knowledge, skills, and confidence required to succeed in the role.
   

  

 The program is designed to prepare participants for live documentation responsibilities while fostering professional growth, operational excellence, and a commitment to continuous learning. Upon successful completion of the training program, participants transition into the Medical Documentation Specialist role with ongoing coaching, mentorship, and quality support to further develop their expertise and advance their careers within Commure.
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

**The Medical Documentation Specialist Is Accountable For**
* Delivering accurate, complete, and timely clinical documentation that reflects healthcare professionals' intent.
* Supporting providers by reducing documentation burden and improving workflow efficiency.
* Maintaining high standards of documentation quality, compliance, and confidentiality.
* Learning and applying clinician\-specific documentation preferences, specialty workflows, and documentation standards through structured training.
* Continuously building knowledge and proficiency while contributing to operational excellence within Ambient Operations.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Clinical Documentation**
* Accurately document patient encounters within Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.
* Capture patient history, review of systems, physical examination findings, assessments, diagnoses, treatment plans, procedures, medications, and other clinically relevant information.
* Ensure documentation accurately reflects the clinician's observations, clinical assessments, and medical decision\-making.
* Review completed documentation for completeness, consistency, and accuracy prior to submission.
* Complete documentation within established turnaround time and productivity expectations.
* Apply learnings from onboarding, coaching sessions, and quality feedback to continuously improve documentation accuracy and efficiency.


**Clinician Support**
* Provide documentation support for clinicians across multiple specialties including, but not limited to:
+ Primary Care
+ Internal Medicine
+ Oncology
+ Orthopedics
+ Rheumatology
+ Other specialties as assigned.

* Learn clinician\-specific workflows, documentation preferences, and specialty requirements through structured training and practical experience.
* Adapt documentation style and workflow to individual clinician requirements.
* Communicate professionally and effectively while supporting providers and collaborating with internal stakeholders.


**Documentation Quality**
* Produce documentation that meets established organizational quality standards and clinician expectations.
* Learn and apply specialty/provider\-specific documentation guidelines and best practices.
* Identify documentation inconsistencies and seek clarification through appropriate channels when required.
* Incorporate feedback from quality reviews, coaching sessions, and audits into daily practice.
* Participate in quality improvement initiatives and calibration activities.


**Technology \& Workflow Management**
* Utilize Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and documentation platforms effectively.
* Develop proficiency in Commure's Ambient AI documentation technology and associated workflow tools through structured training and guided practice.
* Navigate multiple systems while maintaining productivity, accuracy, and quality.
* Follow established operational workflows, standard operating procedures, and documentation processes.
* Escalate workflow, technology, or system\-related issues through appropriate channels.


**Compliance \& Information Security**
* Maintain compliance with HIPAA and all applicable patient privacy, confidentiality, and information security requirements.
* Protect Protected Health Information (PHI) in accordance with organizational policies.
* Adhere to Commure's compliance, security, and documentation standards.
* Complete mandatory compliance and security training within required timelines.


**Continuous Learning \& Professional Development**
* Successfully complete onboarding, certification, and ongoing training programs.
* Continuously develop knowledge of medical terminology, specialty\-specific documentation, healthcare workflows, and emerging technologies.
* Stay current with documentation standards, organizational processes, and workflow enhancements.
* Demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, coachability, and a commitment to continuous learning and professional growth.
* Actively participate in refresher trainings, coaching sessions, quality reviews, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.


**Collaboration**
* Collaborate effectively with Operations, Quality, Training, Product, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Participate in coaching sessions, quality calibrations, workflow reviews, and operational improvement initiatives.
* Seek guidance from trainers, mentors, and quality teams to continuously improve performance.
* Escalate documentation, workflow, clinician, or operational concerns through appropriate channels.
* Support initiatives that improve documentation quality, clinician satisfaction, and operational efficiency.

description:
**Description**
 Join Amazon Pharmacy's Fulfillment Product Tech team and shape the systems that determine how medications are dispensed, verified, and shipped to patients. You will execute the product roadmap to drive performance for the 1P Warehouse Management System (WMS) — the unified platform being built on AFT (Amazon Fulfillment Technologies) primitives to orchestrate pharmacy fulfillment within the four walls.
   

  

 Pharmacy fulfillment is unlike retail: workflows span controlled substance compliance (DEA chain\-of\-custody), cold chain handling, pharmacist verification gates, and dynamic re\-routing for problem states — all under HIPAA constraints. Every system you define and measure operates within these regulatory and operational realities, across small\-format sites, regional fulfillment centers, and kiosks.
   

  

 We are looking for a dynamic, analytically rigorous Senior Product Manager – Tech to own the product execution on how Amazon Pharmacy executes fill, verify, and pack — the core dispensing workflow that turns a prescription into a shipment. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across these domains — working directly with engineers building workcell execution services, operator tooling, and the hardware abstraction layers that connect our software to pharmacy automation
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and execute the roadmap for how prescriptions are dispensed, pharmacist\-verified, and assembled into shipments across manual and automated workcells at all site formats (small\-format, regional, kiosks).
* Define and track metrics across the fill\-verify\-pack pipeline; identify bottlenecks, set targets, and partner with engineering to deliver measurable improvements in speed, accuracy, and cost\-per\-shipment.
* Work with Hardware and Software Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Clinical Excellence, Finance, and In\-Stock partners to provide solutions and drive improvements
* Influence without authority across multiple teams and organizations to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
* Master's degree
* Experience building under\-the\-roof fulfillment tools
* Experience in healthcare, pharmacy, or regulated fulfillment

**Description**
 This position sits within the Digi\-Flex organization, supporting Fire TV's global catalog content operations. The successful candidate will lead and manage a team of \~15 associates responsible for end\-to\-end provider onboarding, catalog integration testing, and content/app quality assurance — all aimed at delivering a best\-in\-class experience for Amazon Fire TV customers worldwide.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Manage stakeholder communication across different sites on operational milestones, process changes, escalations, etc.
* Own program specific goals around SLA, quality, productivity, and ensure effective resource utilization to maximize team efficiency.
* Ensure business processes are well documented and continuously updated.
* Responsible for identifying customer impacting issues, coming up with solutions and implementing them.
* Work with product and technical teams to build and improve operational tools and processes.
* Define, measure and present operating metrics to ops leaders and business partners, along with driving continuous improvements to meet operational targets and OPEX goals.
* Provide input for transition planning and potential program expansions.
* Manages people performance and support career progression.

**About The Team**
 Digi\-Flex primarily focuses on providing highest quality content experience for digital programs across the globe. We believe high\-quality content and service will help us earn the trust and loyalty of customers.
   

  

 Fire TV is one of the world's most popular streaming platforms — reaching hundreds of millions of customers across 50\+ countries, partnering with 250\+ content providers, and redefining how people discover and enjoy entertainment. Built at the intersection of devices, AI, and content, Fire TV operates with a Day 1 mentality to deliver innovative experiences — from voice\-first discovery to smart home integration — in millions of living rooms worldwide.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience leading prioritization of tasks, team scheduling, time management, and meeting deadlines
* Experience analyzing metrics to drive business improvements
* Experience identifying and solving complex problems through data analysis
* Experience leading process improvements
* Graduate with 6\+ years of experience in operations /program management, of which a minimum 2\+ years in managing people.
* Strong written and verbal communication, and be able to influence business and tech partners \- supported by the right set of information.
* Experience owning and building processes with very limited guidance.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in process improvement/quality control tools and methods
* Experience in managing process and operational escalations effectively.
* Familiarity with automation/AI tools to improve operational efficiency.

description:
Date live: 09/09/2026


Business Area: Finance


Area of Expertise: Finance


Contract: Permanent


Reference Code: JR\-0000129286


  
Join us as an Analyst \- Financial Control at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.


To be successful as an Analyst \- Financial Control, you should have experience with:


* Qualified Accountant – CA/CMA/ACCA.
* Strong academic background – 1st class honor's minimum bachelor degree from a reputable institution.
* Prior experience, if any in a month\-end or quarter\-end focused reporting role or control environment based or finance automation skillset based.
* Strong excel skills.

  

Some other highly valued skills include:


* Good stakeholder engagement skills and understanding \& executing their requirements.
* Understanding of the key accounting principles under IFRS.
* Strong interpersonal skills and excellent communicator.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job specific technical skills.

  

  

This role will be based out of Chennai.


**Purpose of the role**


To manage the financial operations of the organisation, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of financial reporting.


**Accountabilities**


* Management of the preparation and presentation of accurate and timely financial statements, and other accounting records in accordance with the relevant accounting standards, rules and regulations.
* Support in identification, assessment, and mitigation of financial risks, and report on these financial risks to senior colleagues.
* Development and maintenance of a robust system of internal controls to safeguard assets, ensure that there is no fraudulent misreporting, and ensure the accuracy of financial data, including regular assessment of the effectiveness of internal controls addressing any weaknesses or gaps. .
* Development and implementation of up\-to\-date financial policies and procedures to ensure consistent and effective financial practices across the organisation.
* Management of the selection, implementation, and maintenance of financial systems and software applications, including collaboration with IT colleagues to integrate financial systems with other enterprise systems.
* Preparation and submission of statutory and regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to other departments in their preparation and review of regulatory reports.
* Coordination with external auditors and regulatory authorities in support of audits and examinations.

**Analyst Expectations**


* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

description:
**Business Development Executive** 




  





**About Us** 




 Connect2Learn is a fast\-growing global EdTech platform dedicated to delivering high\-quality, personalized learning experiences across academic and non\-academic disciplines. Our mission is to empower students by connecting them with passionate and qualified educators from around the world.
 



 Through live one\-on\-one sessions, customized lesson plans, and student\-focused learning approaches, we help learners unlock their full potential and achieve academic success with confidence.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As a Business Development Executive (BDE), you will play a key role in introducing prospective students and parents to Connect2Learn’s learning programs. Your primary responsibility will be to engage with leads, build trust, and schedule free demo classes with our expert educators.This role is ideal for energetic individuals who enjoy communication, relationship\-building, and working in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Make outbound calls to students and parents to explain Connect2Learn’s programs and offerings..
 



 • Schedule free demo classes by engaging families in meaningful and informative conversations..
 



 • Handle inbound inquiries and provide accurate information regarding courses and learning options..
 



 • Conduct regular follow\-ups to ensure demo classes are scheduled and attended successfully..
 



 • Maintain and update CRM systems with accurate lead details and interaction status..
 



 • Coordinate with counselors and operations teams to ensure a seamless demo experience..
 



 • Achieve daily and weekly demo booking targets..
 



  





**Requirements** 




 • Freshers and interns are welcome — complete training will be provided..
 



 • Strong verbal communication and spoken English skills..
 



 • Confidence in interacting with parents and students professionally..
 



 • Goal\-oriented mindset with enthusiasm to achieve targets..
 



 • Basic knowledge of MS Office, Google Sheets, and CRM tools..
 



 • Candidates must be based in Kolkata or willing to relocate immediately..
 



  





**Perks \& Benefits** 




 • Fixed salary with attractive performance\-based incentives..
 



 • Technology allowance and travel reimbursement (where applicable)..
 



 • Excellent growth opportunities in counseling and sales domains..
 



 • Supportive, energetic, and youthful work culture..
 



 • Exposure to international markets including the UK, USA, Canada, and Australia..
 



  





**Selection Process** 




 Shortlisted candidates will receive a quick introductory call from our team.
 



 Your first job shapes your future — choose growth, learning, and opportunity with Connect2Learn.
 



 Start your professional journey with us today.

description:
**About The Company**
 Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
   

  

**Requirement:** 
 Engineering graduate or MCA
   

  

 8 hours shift, 6 days a week.
   

  

* Educational Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech. / MCA/ MSc (CS/IT)
* More than 8 years of IT experience, out of which at least 5 years in dealing with Cyber Security systems and operations
* Design and architect multi\-site DR setups with high availability, Expertise in audits, vulnerability assessments, and security frameworks, Strong communication with stakeholders and OEMs.
* Familiar with Firewall ,Load Balancer, WAF, API Security, Switches (KVM and Network), Forward Proxy ,HCI Severs ,VPN Solution, PAM and ticketing and monitoring tools.


**Certifications (Any One Of The Following)**
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) Master/Practical
* Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
* CCNP Routing \& Switching/Security or equivalent


**Primary Role \& Responsibilities:** 
 Lead in\-depth troubleshooting, configurations, and system tuning.
   

  

* Responsibilities:
* SPOC for entire project spanning all sites.
* Handle escalated incidents from L2 and perform root cause analysis.
* Design and implement policy changes on NGFW, SSLO, WAF, etc., based on IOCL requirements.
* Perform complex configurations and issues in SLB,LLB, PAM policy, VPN tunnels, etc.
* Optimize systems for performance and security posture.
* Work with OEMs for bug fixes, feature requests, or patches.
* Assist in HCI server maintenance and virtualization\-related tasks.
* Coordinate with IOCL’s Cyber Security and Network teams for policy alignment.
* Perform impact analysis for major changes, upgrades, or version migrations.
* Participate in DR drills, failover testing, and performance benchmarking.
* Engage in periodic audits, compliance checks, and security posture assessments. Drive quarterly service reviews and ensure SLAs are being met across L2/L3\.
* Conduct knowledge\-sharing sessions and train L2 teams.
* Manage L2 resources, shift operations, Knowledge up skills of the entire team.
* Maintain system documentation, change logs, and configuration backups.
* Implement SSL offloading policies with application\-specific certificates.
* Validate failover configurations for DR setup, including HCI\-level replication.
* Customize dashboards and alert rules on NMS or monitoring tools. Manage the security infrastructure at the Mumbai Data Centre on a 24/7 basis in three shifts per day and must do all the activities needed to maintain the SLA’s commitment to the customer.

 As a DevOps/CI/CD Engineer at Arrive, you will be positioned at the heart of our engineering organization. In this highly visible and central role, you will act as a bridge between the platform and Arrive’s internal development teams. We are looking for a proactive self\-starter and a natural problem solver who thrives in a self organizing environment.
   

  

 You won't just be maintaining the status quo; you will be actively involved in evolving the solution over time, exploring emerging technologies, and continuously improving the developer experience at Arrive.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Platform Management: Manage, maintain, and evolve the common CI/CD framework as a critical component of Arrive’s Global Platform.
* Automation \& Tooling: Design, build, and maintain automation scripts and tools to streamline developer workflows and improve the CI/CD pipeline's efficiency and reliability. Job Description for DevOps Engineer
* Customer Support \& Collaboration: Act as the primary technical contact for Arrive’s internal development teams. Understand their unique requirements, troubleshoot their issues, and provide timely, effective solutions.
* Independent Problem Solving: Take ownership of platform issues. Investigate root causes, propose robust solutions, and implement fixes with a high degree of autonomy.
* Cross\-Functional Teamwork: Collaborate closely with other teams within the Development Experience organization to ensure a cohesive and seamless internal developer journey.
* Documentation \& Onboarding: Create, maintain, and update high\-quality technical documentation to facilitate the smooth onboarding of developers onto the CI/CD platform.
* System Migrations: Plan and execute seamless migrations from legacy or alternative CI/CD solutions to our standardized platform.
* Continuous Improvement \& AI Integration: Work actively to evaluate new tools, including the application of Agentic AI, to continuously evolve the platform's architecture, capabilities, and overall developer productivity.


**Quality \& Operations**
* Plan and execute validation for your systems, ensuring repeatable and traceable practices while understanding common failure points.
* Plan and execute validation for systems, utilizing repeatable and traceable practices to monitor performance and mitigate potential security or operational risks.
* Understand testing coverage and common failure points, contributing to documentation to ensure the team learns from every incident.
* Identify recurring operational issues (e.g., latency, throughput bottlenecks) and propose improvements to our cloud\-native environment.


**Required Skills**
**Technical Requirements:**
* CI/CD Expertise: Strong, hands\-on experience with GitHub and building robust, scalable deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions.
* Scripting \& Automation: Proficiency in at least one scripting or high\-level programming language (e.g., Bash, Python, Go) to create automation and tooling.
* Container Orchestration: Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, administration, and deployment strategies.
* GitOps \& Continuous Delivery: Solid practical experience utilizing ArgoCD.
* Configuration Management: Proficiency in creating and managing Helm Charts (specific experience with Umbrella Charts is highly desirable).
* Security \& Secrets: Experience managing secure configurations in Kubernetes, specifically using Sealed Secrets.


**Soft Skills \& Attributes**
* Proactive Self\-Starter: Ability to work independently, manage your own time, and drive issues to resolution without needing to be micro\-managed.
* Interpersonal Communication: Excellent relationship\-building skills to effectively interact with both internal "customers" (developers) and peer teams within Development Experience.
* Written Communication: Strong writing skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical workflows into accessible, user\-friendly documentation.
* Innovative Mindset: A genuine passion for exploring new technologies, with an interest in Agentic AI and its potential to revolutionize the SDLC, and modernizing existing infrastructure.


**Desirable Extras**
* Certifications: Holding a current Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) certification will be considered a significant advantage.


**About Arrive**
 Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision\-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data\-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

**Job Description**
 Miratech is looking for a Workforce Management Product Manager to support the execution and continuous improvement of Workforce Management products and platforms. As part of a global customer\-focused organization, you'll contribute to the delivery of exceptional service experiences across customer care, finance, travel and lifestyle services, and operational support functions. Our teams combine technology, innovation, and process excellence to help customers get the most value from the products and services they use.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support the Product Manager in executing the Workforce Management product roadmap.
* Partner with Operations, Technology, Analytics, and business stakeholders to gather business requirements and translate them into user stories and product features.
* Help prioritize the product backlog and support Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and user acceptance testing.
* Coordinate delivery activities for platform enhancements, upgrades, and new functionality.
* Analyze workforce management processes and identify opportunities to improve forecasting, scheduling, staffing, and operational efficiency.
* Monitor product performance using KPIs and customer feedback to recommend enhancements.
* Assist with testing, implementation, release management, and adoption of new capabilities.
* Create process documentation, training materials, and communications to support successful product launches.
* Partner with vendors and internal teams to troubleshoot issues and support continuous platform improvements.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities for automation and process optimization.


**Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience in Product Management, Project Management, Workforce Management, Contact Center Operations, Business Analysis, or a related field.
* Exposure to Verint Workforce Management or other workforce optimization platforms.
* Familiarity with workforce management concepts such as forecasting, scheduling, capacity planning, or intraday management.
* Experience supporting contact center operations or workforce management functions.
* Experience working with Agile methodologies, including writing user stories and participating in backlog refinement and sprint planning.
* Experience gathering business requirements and collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar Agile tools.


**Nice to Have**

* Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
* Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
* Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team\-building company social events.
* Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss \& Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We’re a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.


At Levi Strauss \& Co, we are changing the apparel business and redefining the way denim is made. We are taking one of the world's most iconic brands into the next century. You will create machine learning\-powered denim finishes, using block\-chain for our factory workers' wellbeing, and building algorithms to better meet the needs of our consumers and improve our supply chain. Be a pioneer in the fashion industry by joining our global Data, Analytics \& AI “startup with assets.” Here, you will have the chance to build exciting solutions to improve our Americas business. At the same time, you will be part of a bigger, across\-continents, data community. You are someone who can use programming and analytics technologies such as SQL/NoSQL, Python to validate products, data pipelines and data deliverables. If you have experience in automation, quality engineering of data\-centric applications, especially with retail domain and excited about using your experience to catapult into hyper\-growth, this job is for you.

**Summary of the Role:**


Join our Data \& AI Platform Engineering organisation and lead the charge in transforming the fashion industry. As a Data Engineer, you will develop groundbreaking solutions that support our global business forward while being part of a dynamic, cross\-continental data community.


You will be lead an individual track within the Supply Chain \& Planning Data Domain team. This track owns delivery, from requirements analysis and solution design through development, testing, deployment, and production support. You will work on a cloud native and modern data platform, building data pipelines to building data models and transformations to delivering data products and dashboards to our partners. You will provide technical expertise and operational support to meet the data needs for our businesses. From migrating existing workloads to building advanced cloud solutions, you will help shape and accomplish strategies to increase agility, improve security, reduce costs, and meet use targets.


You bring technical leadership and deep data engineering expertise. They also have hands\-on experience with event\-driven architectures and real\-time data processing technologies, such as Kafka, Google Pub/Sub, and streaming data pipelines. You will collaborate with partners, architects, analysts, data scientists, and engineering teams across multiple geographies to deliver high\-quality, reliable, and scalable data solutions.


We ask that you have partner management skills, along with the flexibility to overlap with U.S. time zones for a few hours each day to support global collaboration and project execution.

**About the Role:**

* Lead an individual track within the Supply Chain \& Planning Data Domain, driving delivery of strategic data programmes. .
* Architect scalable batch and real\-time data pipelines supporting enterprise\-wide data products and analytics solutions.
* Develop data models, transformations, and data products that meet business and operational requirements.
* Develop event\-driven and streaming data solutions using technologies such as Kafka, Google Pub/Sub, Spark Streaming, or similar platforms.
* Collaborate with partners to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions and delivery plans.
* Establish and enforce data quality, governance, observability, and monitoring frameworks to ensure trusted and reliable data products.
* Perform root cause analysis, troubleshoot data issues, and implement preventive measures to improve platform stability and performance.
* Improve data processing solutions for scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
* Partner with teams including Data Scientists, Analysts, Software Engineers, Architects, and SREs to deliver high\-value outcomes.


Champion modern software engineering practices including Agile delivery, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and DevOps principles.
* Support global project delivery by maintaining flexibility to collaborate with teams across regions, including regular overlap with U.S. business hours.

**About You:**

* 12\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, or related disciplines, with experience delivering large\-scale data solutions.
* Experience with data warehousing concepts, dimensional modelling, data lakehouse architectures, and Extract Transform Load best practices.
* Expertise in SQL and Python for large\-scale data processing and transformation.
* Hands\-on experience with modern big data technologies such as Spark, Flink, Hive, and distributed data processing frameworks.
* Experience designing and implementing event\-driven architectures, streaming platforms, and real\-time data pipelines using technologies such as Kafka, Google Pub/Sub, Spark Streaming, or similar solutions.
* Experience working with one or more major cloud platforms. Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is good to have.
* Hands\-on experience with data transformation frameworks such as dbt, PySpark, Dataflow, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience building and maintaining data products, APIs, datasets consumed by business and reporting applications.
* Familiarity with data visualisation and analytics tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern software development practices.
* Mentor engineers and guide engineering excellence within a team.
* Flexible to work with globally distributed teams and provide regular overlap with U.S. time zones to support project delivery and partner engagement.
* Experience applying data to solve complex business problems and deliver measurable value.
* B.E. in Computer Science is good to have.

**Benefits:**

* Complimentary preventive health check\-up for you \& your spouse

 WANT TO BUILD AI SYSTEMS — NOT CARRY A PAGER?
   

  

 Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) lets sellers worldwide leverage Amazon's world\-class logistics infrastructure — storage, fulfillment, delivery, returns — as a service. Sellers from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses in 135\+ countries rely on FBA, which powers tens of billions in annual GMS across dozens of categories.
   

  

 Most engineering teams spend their best hours reacting — triaging tickets, babysitting deployments, answering the same operational questions over and over. We're building the opposite team. Our entire charter is to build the AI\-native systems that make reactive work disappear: agents that resolve operational issues before a human sees them, self\-healing pipelines that deploy without manual gates, and a knowledge foundation that lets software answer for itself. You won't be absorbing FBA's operational load — you'll be engineering it out of existence.
   

  

 This is a VP\-funded, multi\-year charter with end\-to\-end ownership and a leadership\-backed mandate. You'll work at the frontier of applied AI — LLM\-powered remediation agents, machine\-readable operational knowledge, autonomous deployment systems — and see your work adopted across 55\+ teams and 500\+ engineers. Warner Bros. Discovery, a premier global media and entertainment company, offers audiences the world's most differentiated and complete portfolio of content, brands and franchises across television, film, streaming and gaming. The new company combines Warner Media’s premium entertainment, sports and news assets with Discovery's leading non\-fiction and international entertainment and sports businesses.


For more information, please visit www.wbd.com.

We are committed to delivering innovative solutions that empower teams across the company to catalyze customer growth, amplify engagement, and execute timely, informed decisions, ensuring our continued success in an ever\-evolving digital landscape.
