You will develop predictive models and advanced analytics capabilities that help stakeholders understand audience behavior, demand signals, business performance, and content value. In this role, you will partner with Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and cross\-functional business teams to deliver data products and actionable insights that support strategic planning, reporting, optimization, and long\-term business growth.

* Develop and deploy machine learning models and data science solutions at scale.
* Perform data exploration, feature engineering, model training, validation, and evaluation.
* Build ML capabilities using recommendation systems, personalization, predictive modeling, NLP, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Develop end\-to\-end ML workflows including data preparation, feature engineering, model training, validation, deployment, monitoring, and optimization.
* Apply statistical and machine learning techniques including regression, classification, time series forecasting, recommendation systems, NLP, and deep learning where appropriate.
* Monitor model performance and contribute to continuous improvements.
* Work closely with Data Engineers, ML Engineers, Analytics Engineers, and business teams to deliver data\-driven solutions.
* Follow and promote data science best practices for model development, evaluation, and deployment.
* Leverage AI\-assisted tools to improve productivity and quality.

 **What to Bring:**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* 3\-5 years of experience in building data science models and machine learning solutions.
* Strong understanding of statistics, machine learning algorithms, probability, and data science fundamentals.
* Hands\-on experience in developing, and optimizing ML models in production environments.
* Strong programming experience with Python, R, or similar programming languages.
* Experience with ML frameworks and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn, XGBoost, Keras, and Spark ML.
* Strong knowledge of machine learning techniques, including Regression \& Classification Models, Time Series Forecasting, NLP, LLMs.
* Familiarity with the ML lifecycle including feature engineering, model training, deployment, and monitoring.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving abilities, communication skills, and cross\-functional stakeholder collaboration experience.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Business Intelligence (BI) tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker for data visualization, dashboarding, and communicating insights to stakeholders.
* Experience working on personalization, customer growth, advertising, content recommendation, or large\-scale consumer platforms.
* Exposure to cloud platforms and distributed data processing frameworks is a plus.
* Knowledge of modern AI/GenAI tools and frameworks.
* Ability to translate research concepts into practical business solutions.

 **What We Offer:**

* A Great Place to work
* Equal opportunity employer
* Fast track growth opportunities

**How We Get Things Done…**


This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about giving customers the richest, most inspiring experience in their shopping journey? Do you like to dive deep to understand how customer\-centric solutions drive measurable results? Do you enjoy working closely with the business, scientists and software engineers to build scalable products? You are in the right place! Come join our Prime \& Marketing Analytics and Science (PRIMAS) team, where your actions will have direct impact to millions of customers!
   

  

 The EU Marketing \& Prime organization is looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer. This role combines large\-scale analytics with statistical and data\-science work — causal inference, experimentation, and predictive modeling. If your background is in data science, applied statistics, or quantitative analytics, this is that work under Amazon's internal job title.
   

  

 The PRIMAS team provides a comprehensive understanding of customer segments, affinities and lifetime value. We use the latest data science tools and advanced analytical techniques to study customer purchase and engagement behaviors and generate actionable insights on where, when and how we provide products and programs to our customers to meet their needs and to delight them. We help to increase customer engagement, sales and marketing efficiency. Our systems are built entirely in\-house and on automated large\-scale analytics systems. You will generate insights, design/deliver/measure experiments and strategies across marketing channels (SEM/SEO, Affiliates, Display, Social, Mobile, Email, Onsite, etc.), engagement products and customer segments. You will improve our understanding of customer behavior and engagement, design and conduct rigorous experiments on the effectiveness and efficiency of different marketing actions, and build the causal and conversion models that value and target our marketing. You will work on the forefront of consumer analytics, tackling some of the hardest problems in the industry alongside some of the best scientists, statisticians, and software engineers in the field.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Working on complex, loosely defined analytics problems and defining the team's Business Intelligence (BI) strategy — delivering independently and influencing the organization's BI architecture.
* Providing analytics solutions for complex business problems; building analyses and solutions that are robust, extensible and scalable; communicating effectively with management audiences (narratives, inputs into Business Reviews); refining BI strategies that cross teams and making technical trade\-offs for long\- and short\-term needs.
* Designing and implementing technical solutions with an appropriate analytics strategy and data set design; understanding system limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and the reasons for technical decisions.
* Building and evaluating causal and treatment\-effect models that produce conversion and valuation signals consumed by downstream bidding and budgeting systems.
* Designing and running experiments and quasi\-experiments (A/B, geo, holdout) to measure marketing incrementality, and developing measurement frameworks that quantify the true, platform\-independent contribution of marketing over time.
* Working with first\- and third\-party data to identify and target high\-opportunity customer segments where standard platform optimization falls short.
* Providing analyses, frameworks and solutions that inform multiple teams' business decisions and highlight new opportunities.
* Driving best practices in operational excellence, data modelling, and analysis.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
* Experience in the data/BI space


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
* Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large\-scale, complex datasets

description:
**About us** 




 Launched in 2017, WeWork India is one of India’s leading premium flexible workspace operators \- GPTW certified (Nov 2024 – Nov 2025, Dec 2025 – Dec 2026\). WeWork India has been the largest operator by total revenue for the past three fiscal years. Since its inception, WeWork India has expanded across 8 cities in Chennai, New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, and Hyderabad, with 79 operational centres spanning 9\.1 million square feet. WeWork India has played a significant role in the growth of the flexible workspace sector and contributed to the evolution of its products and services, providing customised and curated solutions for various office space needs.
 



 For more information, please visit our website
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Client Solutions team is responsible for custom designed spaces solving complex problems for our customers \- setting up projects for success by ensuring what we sell is what we can deliver. Client Solutions is the bridge between our Sales function and our Supply function and is at the front\-line of technical customer interactions throughout the sales process.
 



 The ideal candidate may be an Architect with a preferred background in architecture, engineering, or construction industries and has a fair idea of industry best practices and is ready to learn and unlearn to make the process better. In addition, the candidate must enjoy interfacing with customers and understand the art of technical selling: driving urgency, consultative sales ultimately closing business with a proven ability to effectively juggle competing priorities. This individual should have good knowledge of building design, Interior fit\-out design, construction, MEP and technology implementation. The position requires a ready to learn attitude, a good understanding of our brand and an aptitude for positive and clear communication within your team. Additionally, the role requires respect for and discretion with sensitive information. Candidates must thrive at interfacing with internal stakeholders in a complex matrixed organization to develop creative solutions to customer requirements.
 



  





**Roles and Responsibilities** 



* Preliminary Due Diligence \- the candidate will perform high\-level requirement analysis without technical subject matter experts or consultants with the goal of supporting fast\-moving sales cycles without significant utilization of resources. They will work quickly to flag risks, develop solution options, and negotiate alignment with internal stakeholders.
* Be able to identify potential impacts to project budget, schedule, and quality leveraging knowledge of WeWork Product offering.
* Substantial involvement during the sales process managing due diligence, communicating the requirements to architects/designers in developing feasible layouts, understanding lease terms, optimizing estimates and initial budgets with the project manager, and support in preliminary schedule planning.
* Effectively document and convey these custom requirements to the Design team and the final design solutions to the Projects team, to ensure proper execution of the agreed client deliverables.
* Manage multiple deals \& engagements of various scales concurrently and prioritize workload within the group to ensure that the deal cycles are optimised.
* Generate and continuously maintain reporting data for respective projects, reporting to upper management as necessary.
* Responsible for maintaining a robust tracking of all the deals and their deliverables, along with clear reporting of all key deal metrics as well as the agreed KPIs of the entire process.
* Have site walk\-throughs \& tours with potential members to give insights to our standard offerings and possible solutioning.
* Be a key client\-facing member of the Client Solutions Team, working closely with our Sales, Subject Matter Experts in Supply team \& \& External Consultants/D\&B partners.
* Prioritise work at hand and offer timely inputs and solutions for custom projects.
* Support managers at deal level work which is largely tactical in nature and involves working directly or indirectly towards generating revenues
* Able to provide context on goals. Learning to discern urgency vs. importance. Learning best practices and making trade\-offs: time vs. quality.
* Operates with autonomy with some oversight regarding areas of responsibilities.
* Responsible for supporting and managing relationships on small to medium projects or projects that are part of a larger deal.



  





**Education and Desired Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree or higher in architecture, engineering, project management, building management
* **4\-7 years of AEC experience,** 
 including project management / design management experience of at least 2 years in corporate interior fit\-out works, high\-end retail, hospitality, or similar projects, as well as substantial collaboration with design and procurement teams
* Exposure to dealing with clients including participation in client meetings throughout the design and construction process, especially relating to corporate fitout space, IT, AV, Security and MEP services
* Experience working with enterprise (e.g. Fortune 500\) companies preferred
* Understanding of project budgeting and scheduling and the ability to communicate and work closely with clients and external D\&B partners
* Clear and concise communication and presentation skills, verbal and written
* Resourceful problem solver and a quick learner
* Strong time management skills and experience in contributing to multiple projects simultaneously; demonstrated ability to consistently meet deadlines
* Reliable, focused, and detail\-oriented
* Ability to work both independently and cooperatively in a fast\-paced environment
* Proficiency in Spreadsheet, excel , Airtable or other data management system



  





**Equal Opportunity Employer** 




 WeWork India is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our employees and members. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
 



 We expect all employees to embody our values and all aspects of employment including the decisions to hire and promote, are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.
 



 Our total rewards philosophy is aimed at providing compensation that is competitive, performance linked and helps us attract and retain the talent we need to drive our business forward and serve our members. As part of WeWork India, our commitment to you is that you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters collaboration, flexibility and inclusion.

description:
At ITRS, we make society's critical technology work. Our mission is to deliver automated and holistic IT observability solutions that safeguard critical applications and enable innovation. We are the only monitoring and observability platform designed for the most demanding and regulated industries — trusted by 90% of Tier 1 capital markets firms.
   





 We believe when our team thrives, so do our customers. With us, you'll find:
 


* **A culture that backs you** 
 \- We're proud to be a Great Place to Work for multiple years in a row due to our inclusive, supportive environment.
* **Work that matters** 
 \- Make a real difference with 1,000s of global customers in industries that keep the world running, including 9 out of 10 top investment banks.
* **Room to grow** 
 \- Whether you're starting your career or bringing years of experience, we're committed to your development. Just ask our team members who've been excelling here for 10\+ years.



 With headquarters in London and teams across the US, Europe, and Asia, ITRS combines the agility of a high\-impact tech business with the stability of a private equity\-backed global partner.
   




**Scope of role**

 We are looking for a Customer Success Manager based in India to join our global customer success team at ITRS.
 



 This is not a generalist Customer Success role. We are looking for someone with strong technical credibility in monitoring and observability, who can operate confidently in complex enterprise environments and build trusted relationships with both technical and senior business stakeholders.
 



 Our customers expect more than strong communication and process discipline. They need someone who understands enterprise operations, hybrid estates, adoption risk, and the practical realities of using monitoring and observability platforms in regulated, business\-critical environments.
 



 To be successful you will be able to connect technical capability to business value, guide customers through adoption and value realisation, and act as a trusted advisor across strategic accounts.
 


**As a Customer Success Manager, you will:**
* Build strong relationships with enterprise customers as their advocate, strategic advisor, and trusted partner


* Translate customer goals into adoption, value, and success strategies using ITRS products
* Monitor and analyse customer health, platform usage, and adoption to identify risks and drive proactive interventions
* Work closely with customer stakeholders across engineering, operations, architecture, and leadership teams
* Capture customer feedback and partner with Support, Product, Engineering, and Account Management to improve customer outcomes
* Document customer engagement, risks, actions, outcomes, and opportunities with clear visibility across the account base
* Contribute to the continued development of Customer Success practices as the function grows


**Requirements**
* Proven experience in Customer Success or Technical Account Management
* Hands\-on experience with monitoring and observability platforms, this is essential
* Strong understanding of enterprise\-scale environments, including complex hybrid estates spanning on\-prem and cloud
* Financial Services experience, ideally within banking, capital markets, trading, payments, or similarly regulated environments
* Strong analytical capability, with experience interpreting usage, health, and adoption metrics
* Comfort leading training, workshops, enablement sessions, and business reviews
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly from engineers through to executive stakeholders
* The confidence to work independently, proactively, and collaboratively in a growing function



**Preferred experience** 
  \- It would be beneficial to have:
 


* Experience with ITRS products, such as Geneos
* Experience with platforms such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Splunk, Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic, Moogsoft, or similar
* Exposure to high\-availability or real\-time enterprise environments
* Practical understanding of Public Cloud and AI in enterprise operations contexts



**What success looks like** 
  \- You are likely to be successful in this role if you can:
 


* Build credibility quickly with technical and senior stakeholders in large enterprise accounts
* Translate monitoring and observability capabilities into practical customer value
* Use health, usage, and adoption data to identify risk early and take action before issues escalate
* Lead value\-led conversations that go beyond relationship management and into measurable outcomes
* Operate effectively in complex, regulated, politically nuanced customer environments



 This role is unlikely to be the right fit if your experience is primarily in:
 


* Generalist SaaS Customer Success without technical product depth
* Purely commercial or quota\-carrying sales roles without post\-sales ownership
* Customer support roles without enterprise relationship management
* Enterprise technology roles without direct monitoring and observability experience


**Benefits**
* Health insurance with care
* Provident fund
* Group personal accident policy
* Generous leave entitlements
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Enhanced Parental Leave
* Referral Bonus
* Training Reimbursement



 ITRS Group is an Equal Opportunity employer and Inclusion is part of our everyday life. We celebrate diversity and pride ourselves on providing an environment where all employees can be their authentic selves and have a voice, allowing everyone to contribute equally. We remain committed to advocating inclusion, diversity, and equality into our ITRS family as we grow and enrich our business.
 



 We welcome applications from everyone in the community as we recognise that a diverse workforce is a stronger workforce.

 Full\-time

 Teceze is a global technology partner focused on operational resilience, digital transformation, and scalable growth. We simplify architectural complexity and accelerate business velocity by uniting next\-generation innovation under a highly accountable delivery model.
 



 Our enterprise offerings are deeply integrated across
 **Managed Cybersecurity, Cloud \& DevOps, Next\-Gen Data Center Infrastructure, Advanced Networking, and AI\-powered Data Platforms** 
 . Central to our global expansion strategy is our multi\-tiered partner ecosystem. We co\-innovate and co\-sell alongside leading public hyperscale's, tier\-one OEMs, technology distributors, and emerging AI platforms to deliver secure, future\-ready business outcomes for enterprise accounts globally.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 We are seeking a high\-caliber, strategically minded
 **Alliance Manager** 
 to take absolute ownership of our partner ecosystem and distribution strategy across five key technology domains:
 **Cybersecurity, Cloud, Data Center, Network, and AI** 
 .
 



 In this role, you will be responsible for defining and executing the programmatic go\-to\-market (GTM) blueprints that turn technology partnerships into high\-velocity revenue channels. You will act as the primary relationship owner and business planner between Teceze and regional distributors, tier\-one technology vendors (e.g., AWS, Microsoft, Cisco, VMware, Palo Alto, and top\-tier AI providers), and specialized software partners.  Software\-defined networking, secure edge routing, enterprise data warehouses, and intelligent process automation tools.

**Experience**

 Outstanding executive presence with a demonstrated ability to negotiate, persuade, and nurture high\-level relationships with major external vendors and distribution leads.

 Highly skilled at constructing business plans, assessing joint pipeline velocity, and translating alliance agreements into practical, revenue\-generating sales activities.
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership:** 
 Adept at aligning disparate groups—solution architects, field sales, global procurement, and marketing teams—behind a unified ecosystem strategy.

 Location : Bangalore, Whitefield (Onsite)

description:
**Business Unit:** 
 EPS Mobility
   

  

**Role:** 
 Manufacturing Line Manager \- Maintenance
   

  

 The Manufacturing Line Manager will lead daily operations of one or more EV traction motor production lines, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient manufacturing. You will manage shift teams, drive OEE/FPY, meet OTIF delivery, control scrap and costs, and collaborate cross?functionally (ME, Maintenance, SQE, Quality, EHS) to stabilize and scale production from pilot to mass manufacture.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Safety \& Compliance (EHS)**
* Enforce a zero?harm culture; lead daily safety huddles, LOTO, chemical/resin handling protocols, and HV test area controls.
* Ensure machine guarding, interlocks, ergonomics, and PPE compliance; conduct Layered Process Audits (LPA) and safety Gemba walks.
* Maintain compliance with site EHS, electrical safety for EOL testing (hipot/IR/PD), laser safety, and statutory requirements; close findings on time.


**Quality \& Regulatory**
* Own line?level FPY, PPM, and warranty escape prevention.
* Execute and sustain Control Plans, PFMEA mitigations, SPC on CTQs, and MSA (gage R\&R); ensure operator certification/recertification.
* Ensure adherence to IATF 16949/ISO 9001 procedures, APQP/PPAP deliverables (Run@Rate, capability), and traceability (serialisation/data retention).
* Drive structured problem solving (5?Why, Fishbone, 8D) and lead MRB for nonconforming product.


**Delivery, Throughput \& OEE**
* Achieve plan vs. actual output, takt adherence, OEE targets (Availability/Performance/Quality), and OTIF to customers/next process.
* Own daily/weekly S\&OE (short?interval control), bottleneck management, WIP/kanban discipline, and heijunka/level loading.
* Implement SMED for changeovers; reduce micro?stoppages; maintain Andon response and escalation rigor.


**Cost \& Resource Management**
* Manage labor planning, overtime, consumables, and scrap/rework cost; deliver Cogs and productivity (units/HC hour).
* Execute VAVE/cost?down at the line (material utilization, yield improvement, cycle?time reduction).
* Track and improve energy usage per unit; support inventory accuracy and cycle counts.


**Maintenance, TPM \& Automation Uptime**
* Partner with Maintenance to implement TPM: autonomous maintenance (CIL), preventive maintenance adherence, MTBF/MTTR improvement.
* Ensure uptime of key equipment: winding/insertion/forming, laser welding, impregnation/curing, balancing, press fits, leak testing, and EOL testers.
* Approve equipment buy?off, IQ/OQ/PQ evidences, and software/recipe controls (change management).


**Industrialization Support (NPI → Ramp)**
* Support pilot builds, line trials, and capability studies (Cp/Cpk); give DFM feedback to design/ME.
* Prepare Run Rate, facilitate PPAP with SQE/Quality, and stabilize ramp curves to rate.


**Qualifications**
* 8–12\+ years in production/operations for electro ? mechanical or automotive manufacturing; 3\+ years leading multi ? shift teams or a full production line.
* Hands ? on with motor processes: lamination stacking/interlocks, hairpin/conventional winding, forming, laser/TIG welding, impregnation/varnish/curing, rotor assembly, press fits, balancing, sealing/potting, and EOL testing.
* Strong knowledge of IATF 16949/ISO 9001, APQP/PPAP, PFMEA/Control Plans, GD\&T basics, SPC/MSA, and Lean/TPM.
* Proficiency with MES, OEE dashboards, problem solving (8D/A3\), and short ? interval control.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and decision making under ambiguity


**L\&T Company Overview / About Us**
 L\&T is a USD 30 billion Indian multinational engaged in EPC Projects, Hi\-Tech Manufacturing, and Services, operating across multiple geographies. A strong, customer–focussed approach and the constant quest for top\-class quality have enabled L\&T to attain and sustain leadership in its major lines of business for eight decades.
   

  

 Given L\&T’s capability in strategic electronics and leveraging its foray into semiconductor design and well\-established capabilities in L\&T Technology Services, the business is expanding its offerings to cover industrial electronic modules, products and systems in critical sectors of Power Electronics, Automotive Electronics, Industrial Robotics \& Automation, Communication Platforms and Electronic Systems Design \& Manufacturing (ESDM). The focus products under Automotive Electronics are ADAS, Electrification \& Connectivity related products.

This position is for a senior individual contributor who combines strong manual testing expertise with significant programming skills to deliver test planning, manual testing and automated testing coverage using JavaScript, TypeScript, Playwright, and Selenium. This role ensures the on\-time delivery of high\-quality software products through hands\-on test planning, execution, deep technical problem\-solving and rigorous quality practices. As a senior member of the QE team, this role sets a high technical bar through the quality and depth of their own work and provides guidance to other engineers when needed, without formal management or team\-leadership responsibilities.


**Responsibilities:\-**

* Creating detailed test plans and test strategies for features and releases, identifying appropriate scope and risk areas across manual and automated testing.
* Designing and executing manual testing for complex features where automation is not feasible or not yet in place, ensuring thorough coverage of functional and edge\-case scenarios.
* Developing and maintaining automated end\-to\-end (E2E) test scripts using Playwright and Selenium, applying strong programming skills to build reliable, maintainable test code.
* Building and enhancing automated solutions for functional and non\-functional testing, using existing tooling and frameworks and proposing improvements where gaps exist.
* Investigating Production issues \& incidents, performing root\-cause analysis, and documenting findings to support resolution and prevention.
* Collaborating closely with Development and Operations teams throughout the SDLC to ensure products meet requirements and quality standards, with tests integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Sharing testing knowledge and best practices with peers, and providing guidance to less experienced engineers when needed, without formal mentoring or management responsibilities.
* Continuously improving personal testing practices and contributing ideas for improving team\-wide test processes and frameworks.

**Requirements** :\-


* 8\+ years of test automation engineering experience, with deep expertise in Software Developer in Test (SDET) roles and a track record of technical leadership.
* BS in Engineering/Computer Science or equivalent experience required; advanced degree a plus.
* Expert\-level proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript for designing and building scalable, maintainable test automation frameworks.
* Deep expertise in Playwright and Selenium for E2E testing, including cross\-browser automation, API testing, and framework architecture.
* Strong command of QA methodologies, including BDD (Behavior\-Driven Development) with tools like Cucumber.
* Proven experience designing and implementing performance testing strategies, with strong expertise integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Demonstrated ability to lead continuous improvement initiatives in test frameworks and processes, with measurable impact across teams.
* Experience mentoring and coaching junior and mid\-level engineers.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across multiple agile teams.

**Work in a way that works for you**  

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. With an average length of service of 9 years, we are confident that we offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, family leave and tuition reimbursement, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and long\-term goals.
  

Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.


**Working for you**  

At Elsevier, we know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

description:
**Job Description**
 We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Reporting to the Manager – FP\&A, the Senior FP\&A Analyst will play a key role in supporting financial planning, analysis, and reporting activities for global stakeholders. This role is part of a growing global shared services function and offers an opportunity to contribute to process standardization, financial insights, and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to analyze financial performance, resolve variances, and support business decision\-making through accurate reporting and insights.
   

  

**How You Will Make An Impact**
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close and forecasting activities
* Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, and prepaid entries in line with accounting standards
* Analyze financial results against forecasts and identify key variances and insights
* Prepare reporting packs and provide data\-driven analysis to stakeholders
* Drive standardization and improvement of FP\&A processes across regions
* Support transition of new FP\&A activities into shared services and document processes
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to resolve queries and improve workflows
* Maintain KPI reports and support audit requirements
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives and efficiency enhancements


**What We Are Looking For**
* Master’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related field
* Experience working in global or shared services environments
* 4–6 years of experience in FP\&A, accounting, or shared services finance roles
* Strong understanding of general accounting principles and financial processes
* Experience in financial reporting, forecasting, and variance analysis
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (formulas, pivot tables, etc.)
* Experience working with ERP and financial systems (e.g., SAP, Power BI, TM1, EPM)
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills


**We power infinite possibilities.**
 For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere.
   

  

 We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.
   

  

 Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything.
   

  

 Wiley is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. We evaluate all qualified applicants and treat all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Wiley is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants and employees with disabilities. Applicants who require accommodation to participate in the job application process may contact tasupport@wiley.com for assistance.
   

  

 We are proud that our workplace promotes continual learning and internal mobility. We offer meeting\-free Friday afternoons allowing more time for heads down work and professional development, and through a robust body of employee programing we facilitate a wide range of opportunities to foster community, learn, and grow.
   

  

 We are committed to fair, transparent pay, and we strive to provide competitive compensation in addition to a comprehensive benefits package. It is anticipated that most qualified candidates will fall within the range, however the ultimate salary offered for this role may be higher or lower and will be set based on a variety of non\-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to, geographic location, skills, and competencies. Wiley proactively displays target base pay range for United Kingdom, Canada and USA based roles.
   

  

 When applying, please attach your resume/CV to be considered.

Job Profile | Noida (Sector 127) | Freshers & Experienced Welcome 
 Interested Candidates may call or Watsapp Directly with HR Ms. Aditi Anand -9286982377 
 Role Overview- 
We are hiring Customer Care Executives for an Inbound Voice Process that combines customer query resolution with revenue-generating upsell opportunities. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals who enjoy customer interaction and want to build a career that blends service excellence with sales acumen, in a professional, fast-paced environment.
 As a Customer Care Executive, you will handle inbound customer calls, resolve queries effectively, and identify and convert relevant upsell/cross-sell opportunities during customer interactions to enhance customer value and drive additional revenue.
 Key Responsibilities 
Handle inbound customer calls and provide prompt, effective resolutions to queries and concerns. Identify customer needs during calls and proactively pitch relevant upsell and cross-sell offers, add-ons, or upgrades. Achieve assigned upsell/revenue targets alongside query resolution and customer satisfaction goals. Maintain a positive, empathetic, and consultative approach that balances service quality with sales conversion. Follow call handling scripts and pitch guidelines for both service and upsell conversations. Accurately document customer interactions, resolutions, and upsell outcomes in the system. Ensure high customer satisfaction and follow up on unresolved queries or pending upsell conversions. Stay updated on product/service offerings to pitch the most relevant upsell options to customers. 
 Eligibility Criteria 
 Graduates (Freshers welcome). Good communication skills in Hindi and/or English. Open to both freshers and experienced candidates. Comfortable with a consultative, target-driven approach involving both service and upsell conversations 
 Note: Candidates from BTech, BCA, BPharma, LLB, or any undergraduate (non-graduate) background will not be considered 
 Salary & Benefits 
 Freshers: Up to 17,500/month in-hand Experienced: Up to 21,000/month in-hand Attractive performance-based incentives, including upsell/conversion incentives Joining bonus available 
 Free Pick & Drop Shuttle Service From Sector 59 Metro Station Sector 52 Metro Station Golf Course Metro Station Sector 37 Botanical Garden Bus Stand Okhla Bird Sanctuary Metro Station

 Working Days 
6 days a week, with 1 rotational weekly off

description:
**Company Description** 
 LearningShala is a trust\-first, data\-backed online degree platform founded in 2017 to make higher education choices clear and logical for students. The organization specializes in expert counseling and 1:1 guidance, helping learners understand their options before making critical academic and career decisions. Students can compare 55\+ top online universities on 40\+ parameters and access support across admissions, career pathway planning, and post\-admission services. With 200\+ verified mentors offering virtual sessions to students across India, LearningShala provides transparent guidance across 100\+ online programs in business, IT, healthcare, arts, and more. The team is focused on enabling confident decisions that lead to meaningful and sustainable careers.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Business Development Associate will work on\-site in Noida in a full\-time capacity, engaging with prospective students and institutional partners to grow LearningShala’s outreach and enrollments. Daily responsibilities include identifying and qualifying leads, conducting consultation calls, explaining LearningShala’s services and program offerings, and maintaining accurate records in CRM tools. The role involves collaborating with counseling and marketing teams to design and implement outreach initiatives, participating in events or webinars to promote the platform, and following up with prospects to support their decision\-making journey. The associate will also monitor market trends in online education, contribute to process improvements, and help enhance the overall student experience.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong communication and interpersonal skills, including clear spoken and written English and the ability to build trust with diverse stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess sales and business development skills, such as lead generation, pipeline management, negotiation, and closing enrollments.
* Candidates should possess customer relationship and service skills, including active listening, problem\-solving, and follow\-up to ensure a positive experience.
* Candidates should possess basic data and CRM skills, such as maintaining accurate records, using spreadsheets or CRM software, and interpreting simple reports.
* Candidates should possess collaboration and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively with counseling, marketing, and operations teams.
* Master’s degree in business, marketing or a related field is preferred; relevant experience in edtech, counseling, or inside sales is an advantage.
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment, with a proactive approach and high ethical standards in student guidance.

description:
Business Analyst
As the **Business Analyst – eCommerce**, you will play a key role in driving solution\-oriented changes across the Commercial Department and improving the overall efficiency of the eCommerce domain. You will be responsible for researching, analyzing, and developing data\-driven business cases that support process optimization, cost reduction, new business opportunities, and strategic improvements.

  

You will work closely with the Manager Commercial Projects, Lead Product Owner, Project Managers, Product Owners, and cross\-functional teams including Marketing, Content, B2B, Sales Channels, and Customer Service. You will translate business needs and opportunities into well\-defined business cases, including scope, solution options, expected impact, resource requirements, and budget considerations, enabling effective decision\-making and implementation.

 **You will:**

* **Business Case Development:** Research, analyze, and prepare solution\-oriented business cases for new initiatives, process improvements, eCommerce enhancements, and strategic changes.
* **eCommerce Optimization:** Identify opportunities to improve eCommerce efficiency through process optimization, cost reduction, technology enhancements, and identification of new business opportunities.
* **Market \& Competitor Research:** Conduct market research using available tools and resources to assess new features, industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitor approaches.
* **Data Analysis:** Gather and analyze relevant business and operational data to identify trends, opportunities, challenges, and potential solutions that support informed decision\-making.
* **Solution Identification:** Evaluate existing eCommerce technology platforms, applications, and emerging technologies to determine potential solutions and expected business outcomes.
* **Innovative Solutions:** Develop innovative solutions for operational and strategic improvements and identify the processes, systems, and capabilities required to implement proposed changes.
* **Requirements Management:** Work closely with business stakeholders and cross\-functional teams to understand, document, analyze, and validate critical business requirements.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Align and communicate new ideas, business cases, recommendations, expected benefits, risks, and potential impacts with stakeholders and senior management.
* **Business Case Communication:** Prepare reports, presentations, and business case documentation that clearly communicate proposed changes, solution options, expected outcomes, costs, risks, and business impact.
* **Performance \& Impact Assessment:** Forecast the potential impact of proposed solutions and provide regular reporting on business cases, initiatives, and project performance.
* **Project Assessment:** Conduct critical and efficient assessments of eCommerce projects to evaluate their effectiveness, business value, performance, and alignment with organizational objectives.
* **Product Owner Alignment:** Collaborate with Product Owners to assess and align the development resources, capabilities, and priorities required to deliver each proposed solution.
* **Scope \& Planning:** Define project scope, support workforce planning, forecast budgets, and assess and manage change requests associated with business cases and initiatives.
* **Testing \& Validation:** Conduct or coordinate tests, surveys, workshops, and other validation activities to assess proposed solutions and gather stakeholder feedback.
* **Decision Support:** Evaluate inputs from multiple stakeholders, analyze business situations, identify potential alternatives, and recommend the most appropriate course of action.
* **Process Management:** Design and establish new processes, systems, or operating models required to implement approved eCommerce changes and improvements.
* **Progress \& Escalation:** Align regularly with the Manager Commercial Projects and Lead Product Owner on business case progress, challenges, dependencies, and impediments, escalating issues when research or deliverables fall behind schedule.
* **Change Management:** Support and drive business change within an agile environment, ensuring proposed changes are clearly understood, assessed, communicated, and aligned with business objectives.
* **Post\-Implementation Support:** Support Project Managers in assessing the performance and effectiveness of rolled\-out projects to ensure critical and efficient evaluation of eCommerce initiatives.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with teams across the Commercial Department, including Marketing, Content, B2B, Sales Channels, and Customer Service, to ensure proposed solutions address business needs across the eCommerce ecosystem.

 **You have:**

* **Experience:** 4–7 years of relevant experience in Business Analysis, eCommerce, digital transformation, project/change management, or a related field.
* **Education:** University\-level education in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* **Business Analysis Expertise:** Strong understanding of business analysis processes, including requirements gathering, research, data analysis, solution assessment, business case development, and impact evaluation.
* **eCommerce Understanding:** Good understanding of eCommerce environments, business processes, digital platforms, technology solutions, and emerging industry trends.
* **Agile Experience:** Demonstrated track record of working in an agile organization and supporting or driving business and process changes in an agile environment.
* **Data \& Analytical Skills:** Strong data analysis, analytical, and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate data and research into actionable business recommendations.
* **Strategic Thinking:** Ability to understand business objectives, evaluate multiple solution options, identify opportunities, and develop innovative solutions that deliver measurable business value.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and communicate recommendations to senior\-level management.
* **Communication \& Reporting:** Strong ability to prepare business reports, presentations, business cases, and management updates that clearly communicate findings, recommendations, and expected business impact.
* **Decision\-Making:** Ability to assess diverse stakeholder inputs, analyze complex situations, evaluate implications, and select appropriate plans of action.
* **Project \& Change Management:** Understanding of project scope, resource planning, budget forecasting, change requests, and change management processes.
* **Technical Skills:** Ability to quickly learn and work with new systems, software, eCommerce platforms, analytical tools, and emerging technologies.
* **Research Skills:** Ability to independently conduct market research, competitor analysis, surveys, workshops, and other forms of business research.
* **Collaboration:** Strong teamwork skills with the ability to work across interdisciplinary and cross\-functional teams.
* **Independence:** Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision in a fast\-paced digital and eCommerce environment while managing multiple business cases simultaneously.
* **Language:** Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* **Key Competencies:** Problem\-solving, strategic planning, process improvement, data analysis, decision\-making, stakeholder management, teamwork, technical aptitude, reporting, and managerial capabilities.

**About The Job**
 Whether you're on a consumer product (like Gmail, Search, Maps, Chrome, Android) or a business product (Google Ads, AdSense, Google Marketing Platform, Analytics), you take part in a complete marketing experience as you lead every facet of the product's journey. From determining positioning, naming, competitive analysis, feature prioritization and external communications, you help shape the product and help it grow a consumer base. This means you work with a cross\-functional team across Sales, corporate communications, legal, webmasters, product development, engineering and more. In this role, you'll be involved with product marketing strategy from beginning to end.
   

  

 The Strategic Alliances Center of Excellence (SA CoE) is Google India Marketing’s horizontal strategic engine with a mission to transform Google’s partnership strategy from traditional, outbound commercial sponsorships into high\-leverage ecosystem alliances. Operating across all major Product Areas including Gemini, Search, YouTube, Google Pay, Pixel, Android, and Play the CoE creates defensible market moats and drives user habituation across some of the core User Segments: Youth, Premium, Merchants, and Bharat, among others.
   

  

 As the Senior Strategic Alliance Lead, you will play a role in hunting and scoping, architecting high\-impact agreements and be the strategic steward of Google India’s partnership portfolio. You will shape the overarching strategy for asset exchanges, negotiate multi\-year mega\-alliances with C\-suite executives across India’s leading conglomerates, and establish institutional governance across Google Marketing. This is a leadership role requiring strategic goal, enterprise commercial acumen, and the ability to rally matrixed leadership across cross\-product, cross\-functional but also local, regional, and global teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Transform Partner Ecosystems: Play a role in shifting Google India's marketing partnerships from transactional investments to multi\-year alliances that build strategic moats across key growth priorities (Gen Z, Premium, Bharat).
* Architect large Alliances: Lead the end\-to\-end strategy, structuring, and high\-stakes C\-suite negotiations for complex, multi\-party alliances with media, CPG, among others.
* Design Cross\-Product Proposals: Synthesize various capabilities across Google’s Product Areas (Gemini, Search, YouTube, Google Pay) into cohesive value propositions.
* Govern Portfolio and Risk: Enforce commercial discipline using Strategic Screening tools to prioritize high\-leverage agreements, define guardrails, and audit ecosystem performance.
* Drive Executive Alignment: Partner with senior Google leaders across multiple areas (Marketing, Legal, PR, Partnerships) to secure strategic commitments and upskill the broader marketing organization.

This mighty team serves the enterprise that includes sales, finance, marketing, customer success, product and more. The team serves as a core conduit and partner to operational systems that run the business including Salesforce, Workday and more.  Design, build and maintain batch or real\-time data pipelines.

* Must be skilled communicator, and demonstrate an ability to work with end users and business leaders
* Experience with engineering best practices including CI/CD, code quality, testing, documentation, monitoring and more.

description:
As a Senior Data Analyst, measurement, you will be the analytical engine behind our commercial performance tracking. Serving within the Global Verticals Marketing team, you will act as the primary point of contact for querying, analysing, and synthesizing FedEx internal transactional and customer data. Your mission is to convert complex datasets into clear, actionable vertical performance narratives that guide business planning.
   

  

 In this role, you will build executive\-ready reports, conduct ad\-hoc analyses, and provide data\-driven insights that directly support marketing, commercial strategy, and forecasting functions. Your work will directly influence how senior leadership understands vertical health, product performance, and regional business dynamics.
   

  

**Grade : T5**
**"Please note that the Job will close at 12am on Posting Close date, so please submit your application prior to the Close Date"**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Vertical Performance
   

  

* Write, optimize, and execute complex SQL queries against FedEx enterprise data warehouses to extract performance metrics across priority industry verticals (e.g., E\-commerce, Healthcare, Aerospace, Technology).
* Monitor and analyse key commercial indicators, including volume, revenue, and yield, with a specific focus on identifying regional / lane / product level insights.
* Investigate regional and product\-level performance variations, isolating root causes of growth or decline and translating findings into structured data briefs.
* Build, maintain, and automate interactive performance dashboards and scorecards to track commercial performance, vertical health, and pipeline health.


 Executive \& Leadership Reporting
   

  

* Synthesize complex performance datasets into high\-impact, visual, and narrative\-driven reports for leadership and executive\-level business updates (e.g., CEO updates and strategic reviews).
* Translate analytical findings into concise executive takeaways, ensuring executive communications clearly explain the past performance, present status, and future outlook.
* Deliver regular monthly and quarterly performance updates, highlighting competitive risks, commercial opportunities, and customer journey trends.


 Strategic \& Forecasting Support
   

  

* Partner with forecasting, strategy, finance, and marketing functions to model commercial funnels, market demand shifts, and historical volume trends.
* Apply statistical techniques and behavioural segmentation models to track, isolate, and forecast changes in specific customer cohorts and industry verticals.
* Conduct rapid\-response, ad\-hoc deep dives to answer critical, time\-sensitive business questions posed by leadership.
* Provide data backing and baseline historical trends to support annual commercial strategic planning and commercial goal setting.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

 Experience \& Background
   

  

* 6\-10 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, sales analytics, or financial/commercial measurement roles.
* Proven experience querying large\-scale, complex relational databases to extract commercial, transactional, and customer\-level insights.
* Demonstrated track record of preparing executive\-calibre presentations, briefs, and reports based on complex data analysis.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional, global stakeholders across various time zones.


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Executive Storytelling \& Visualization: The ability to translate numbers into a cohesive, executive\-ready story that leaders can grasp and act on instantly.
* Statistical Thinking \& Pattern Discovery: Strong capability to utilize business statistics (e.g., correlation, significance testing, regression, trend analysis) to


 robustly identify patterns, validate data anomalies, and extract high\-integrity insights from raw corporate data.
   

  

* Analytical Rigor \& Structured Problem Solving: High attention to data accuracy, methodological soundness, and the ability to formulate logical business hypotheses.
* Agility \& Proactiveness: Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment, managing competing priorities, and delivering quick\-turnaround ad\-hoc analyses.


**Professional Expertise \& Technical Skills**
* Analytics \& BI: High proficiency in SQL (required) and experience working with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Teradata, or BigQuery).
* Applied Business Statistics: Practical knowledge of statistical methods to perform cohort analysis, customer segmentation, and behavioural pattern recognition to discover performance anomalies.
* Business AI \& Machine Learning Application: Understanding of how to leverage predictive models, clustering algorithms (e.g., for cohort refinement), and NLP/text mining to automate industry vertical tracking, spot micro\-trends, and optimize customer group definitions.
* Data Visualization: Proficiency in building dashboards in Power BI or similar BI tools
* Programming \& Automation: Comfortable using Python or R for statistical modelling, data manipulation, and analytical process automation is a must.
* Productivity \& Reporting: Expert\-level skills in MS Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables) and PowerPoint (to draft polished, executive\-ready presentations).


 Sector Familiarity: Prior experience analysing commercial performance within B2B verticals (e.g., Retail/E\-commerce, Healthcare \& Life Sciences, Industrial, Technology) is highly valued.
   

  

* Exposure to CRM/sales enablement tools (e.g., Salesforce)


 Certifications (nice to have)
   

  

* CFA, FRM, PMP, Six Sigma (or equivalent).


 FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
   

  

 Our Company
   

  

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
   

  

 Our Philosophy
   

  

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region .
   

  

 What you have
   

  

 The SAMDA Investment Data Domain Tech Lead is the hands on technical leader responsible for the design, implementation, and technical quality of investment data products and Data APIs delivered on the SAMDA platform.
   

  

 This role owns the day to day technical execution of investment domain data pipelines, operational data stores, domain models, and data service interfaces, ensuring solutions are production ready, compliant, and aligned with platform standards. The Tech Lead works closely with domain platform leads, platform engineering, governance, and consumer teams to translate investment, regulatory, and operational requirements into scalable data foundations and reliable data services.
   

  

 In addition to domain execution, the Tech Lead proposes, designs, and helps create reusable data platform capabilities that scale across the broader SAM data platform, enabling consistent reuse across multiple investment domains.
   

  

 This role is deeply hands on, with accountability for data correctness, domain fidelity, API reliability, and operational readiness, rather than overall program or platform ownership.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Investment Data Foundations**
* Lead the design and implementation of investment data models and operational data stores, built from the ground up to support regulatory, operational, and analytical use cases.
* Design foundational operational data stores (e.g., source aligned stores, connected data stores, and domain level aggregates) that enable consistent and scalable data consumption across investment workflows.
* Define and own investment data taxonomy, including canonical definitions, naming standards, entity relationships, and domain semantics across holdings, positions, transactions, accounting, and reference data.
* Apply deep investment domain knowledge (e.g., IBOR, ABOR, custody, holdings, positions, transactions, security and product reference data) to ensure models accurately represent real world investment behavior and lifecycle events.
* Ensure data models are designed for long term extensibility, supporting new products, strategies, custodians, and regulatory requirements without re architecture.
* Partner with Data Governance and Architecture teams to align domain models with enterprise data standards, classification, lineage, and quality expectations.
* Balance domain specific fidelity with platform wide consistency, avoiding bespoke or siloed designs.
* Review and approve data design artifacts to ensure clarity, correctness, and operational usability prior to production release.


**Data API Design \& Delivery (API Focused)**
* Lead the design and delivery of Data APIs that expose investment domain data as reliable, well defined services for downstream consumers.
* Define and enforce API best practices, including contract clarity, schema discipline, versioning, and backward compatibility, enabling safe evolution over time.
* Ensure APIs meet expectations for availability, performance, security, and operational supportability.
* Drive API documentation, discoverability, and onboarding for internal consumers.
* Partner with platform teams to ensure APIs integrate cleanly into the broader SAMDA ecosystem.
* Contribute to the development and standardization of shared API patterns and reusable components.


**Scalable Data Capabilities \& Platform Leverage**
* Propose and design reusable data capabilities that address investment domain needs while scaling across the broader SAMDA platform.
* Identify patterns and abstractions from domain implementations that can be generalized and reused across multiple SAM data domains.
* Partner with Platform Engineering and Architecture to:
* Validate scalability and reusability
* Align solutions with long term platform direction
* Avoid domain specific point solutions where shared capabilities are appropriate
* Contribute domain driven enhancements back into shared data frameworks, models, and APIs.
* Escalate design trade offs when domain requirements conflict with platform consistency.


**Platform Alignment, Security \& Governance**
* Ensure all investment data and Data APIs comply with platform standards, data classification rules, information barriers, and governance expectations.
* Support architecture, risk, and governance reviews by providing clear data models, taxonomy definitions, lineage explanations, and API contracts.
* Identify gaps in platform data or API capabilities and recommend improvements.


**Operational Readiness \& Production Support**
* Own technical production readiness for investment domain data assets and APIs, including: Monitoring and alerting readiness SLA alignment Incident triage and root cause analysis
* Ensure runbooks, dashboards, and operational documentation are accurate and current.
* Partner with Platform Engineering and SRE teams to continuously improve stability, observability, and resilience.


**Delivery Leadership \& Team Enablement**
* Provide hands on technical leadership to engineers delivering investment domain data and APIs.
* Break down complex domain requirements into clear, actionable technical work.
* Mentor engineers on data modeling discipline, taxonomy, and service quality.
* Maintain high engineering standards through design reviews and code walkthroughs.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify opportunities to improve data quality, model clarity, performance, and operational robustness.
* Reduce technical debt and operational risk across the investment data domain.
* Proactively improve alignment between domain delivery and platform evolution.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8–12\+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or platform aligned engineering roles.
* Strong understanding of investment data domains including holdings, positions, transactions, IBOR, ABOR, and reference data.
* Deep experience building Data platforms in cloud native data platform like Snowflake / Databricks and leveraging cloud native (AWS/GCP) stacks.
* Proven ability to design operational data stores and domain models from scratch in enterprise environments.
* Deep experience delivering investment, accounting, custody, or regulatory data on shared data platforms.
* Hands on experience designing and operating Data APIs in production environments.
* Experience working in regulated, enterprise environments with strong governance and risk controls.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with cross product investment data models and federated data ownership.
* Strong familiarity with enterprise data taxonomy, lineage, and governance practices.
* Experience supporting operational and regulatory investment use cases at scale.
* Synthesizes complex data, manages resources, and develops strategic insights
* Establishes communication processes for smooth information flow with others involved in a project or effort
* Provides thought leadership in the business area and independently drives strategic initiatives.
* Enables stakeholders to align decisions with business goals
* Influences best practices to plan to prepare for opportunities or challenges
* Champions innovative solutions to improve efficiency
* Influences decisions that drive functional success and operational improvements
* Verbally articulates ideas impactfully, fostering open dialogue
* Inspires confidence with proven expertise, integrity, and accurate communication
* Presents compelling arguments to inspire action
* Sets performance\-driven goals across groups and drives continuous improvement
* Leverages diverse expertise to develop strategies in cross\-functional projects or programs
* Sets and upholds high\-quality standards while empowering teams to to strive for excellence in their work
* Creates clear, persuasive, and professional written documents that meet business standards.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.
   

  

**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**
* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Education assistance for continued learning to help you grow
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check\-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day\-to\-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

****Position Purpose****
 The Business Technology Manager is a pivotal role, sitting at the intersection of business strategy, process innovation, and technology delivery. The role serves as the business\-facing representative of the Digital team, responsible for discovering, designing, and delivering Digital, Automation, AI, and Agentic AI solutions that drive measurable business value across PI Industries’ operations.
   

  

 Acting as a Business Analyst, Project Manager, and Technology Manager in one integrated capacity, the role bridges gaps between enterprise applications, automates business processes, and improves organisational productivity and decision\-making. The incumbent will partner closely with internal business stakeholders across functions — including Manufacturing, Supply Chain, R\&D, Finance, and Sales as well as external partners like Farmers, Retailers and Distributors — to translate business challenges into technology\-enabled solutions leveraging cutting\-edge Digital and AI capabilities.
   

  

 The role requires end\-to\-end ownership of digital initiatives — from use case identification and requirements elicitation through architecture design, POC/pilot execution, and project delivery — ensuring solutions are scalable, integrated, and aligned to PI Industries’ enterprise architecture and business objectives.

* Develop business cases and present recommendations to senior leadership for investment approval and prioritization.
* Design solution blueprints, process architectures, and data flow models aligned with business and enterprise architecture objectives.
* Define high\-level functional and technical solution architectures in collaboration with technology teams.
* Establish integration strategies across enterprise systems such as SAP, MES, CRM, Data Platforms, and other core applications.
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard technology vendors, system integrators, and solution partners; lead RFI/RFP processes and support commercial evaluations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with business leaders, process owners, and key stakeholders to drive digital transformation initiatives.
* Contribute to the Digital COE agenda by promoting innovation, sharing best practices, and fostering a digital\-first culture across the organization.


****Operational Responsibilities****

* Translate business and functional requirements into detailed technical specifications and maintain end\-to\-end requirements traceability.
* Lead execution of POCs, pilots, and digital projects from planning through deployment and hypercare.
* Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones.
* Define and implement project governance mechanisms and provide regular status updates to stakeholders and leadership.
* Coordinate with architects, developers, business users, and vendors throughout the solution lifecycle.

* Manage stakeholder engagement throughout project execution to ensure alignment, adoption, and successful delivery of digital solutions.

description:
**Description**
 Are you interested in shaping the future of live sports broadcasting? Do you want to set high standards on how Amazon customers are watching live sports?
   

  

 If so, you might be the right person for the Content Associate role on the Prime Video Live Events team, which brings new sports leagues and other live broadcast events to Prime Video customers around the world.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The primary responsibility of the role is to perform quality checks on web pages and digital content for Prime Video Sports and execute test case instructions and report discrepancies on new PV Sports features.
   

  

* The associate needs to perform QA checks on Sports detail pages to ensure the best streaming experience for Sports fans.
* The associate has to perform test case execution and report bugs accurately
* The associate needs to continuously adapt and learn new features on the tools and follow the QA SOP to spot/catch errors in the detail pages.
* The associate needs to understand testing procedures and guidelines and perform regression and repetitive testing exercises to qualify new PV feature without compromising on quality.
* The associate will need to be aware of the operations metrics like productivity (Number of titles processed per hour), quality (defect %age) and delivery/latency SLA. The associate will be measured on his/her compliance to these Metrics, SLA requirements, QA guidelines, team and personal goals.
* The associate should be a team player and come up with improvement ideas to improve the QA process.
* The role is an individual contributor role.
* A passion for sports is mandatory.


 A day in the life

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 The Amazon Data Services (India) Pvt. Ltd. (ADSIPL) Data Center Security Group is seeking a highly talented and motivated Security Systems Project Manager to join our team. The team is responsible for the design, installation and integration of security systems equipment including, but not limited to, Access Control/Intrusion Detection and CCTV Surveillance systems.
   

  

 You will also be responsible for the continuous review of existing standards and to stay abreast of developments in new technology that will enhance the physical security of ADSIPL data centers and co\-locations. You will work directly with the Cluster Security Manager, the Infrastructure Operations and Construction teams, and other customers, both internal and external, to integrate the business' requirements into physical security systems design and implementation. Your work will include supporting the construction and deployment of physical security packages for all ADSIPL data centers and co\-locations in the cluster. You will also work closely with contractors and vendors to ensure compliance with all security standards during the construction, testing and acceptance phases of the projects.
   

  

 The ideal candidate for the role will have demonstrated the ability to work in all disciplines, at all levels; from technology research to system design and layout, oversight of construction and implementation, as well as maintenance and upgrades over the life of the system. You will have an in\-depth knowledge of security technology, be innovative, highly organized, and will have demonstrated the ability to deliver results on time and within budget.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic Project Leadership: Spearhead physical security design and system installation for new data centers, expansions, and special projects.
   

  

 Financial Management: Direct multi\-million\-dollar security project lifecycles including bid packages, specifications, drawings, code compliance, vendor management, budgeting, change orders, and documentation.

 Operational Excellence: Prioritize tasks effectively and operate seamlessly across organizational boundaries
   

  

 Maintenance Oversight: Execute and coordinate preventative maintenance and repairs for security system equipment
   

  

 Compliance Assurance: Ensure adherence to physical security standards, project scopes, budgets, and timelines

 Quality Control: Support security system commissioning, testing, acceptance, and project handoff
   

  

 Knowledge Transfer: Develop and deploy comprehensive training programs for all physical security system users.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Mission: Deliver physical security infrastructure by working vigorously and collaborating with various stakeholders to earn and keep customer trust; providing a safe and secure environment for our people, assets, and customer data.
   

  

 Vision: Develop exceptional security infrastructure delivery professionals, consistently apply security processes, and pioneer new technologies that effectively balance security requirements with operational needs.
