**Job Description**
 As CohnReznick grows, so do our career opportunities. As one of the world’s top professional services firms, and in support of our global workforce strategy, we’re growing our operations in India! We create rewarding careers in advisory, assurance, and tax with team members who value innovation and collaboration in everything they do!
   

  

 CohnReznick helps organizations optimize performance, manage risk, and maximize value through CohnReznick LLP (assurance services) and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (advisory and tax services). Together, the firm provides leaders with deep industry knowledge and relationships, solutions to address clients’ unique business goals and risks, and insight on how emerging market forces can drive opportunity. With offices worldwide, the firm serves organizations around the world as an independent member of Nexia.
   

  

 We currently have an exciting career opportunity for an
 **Associate/ Senior Associate** 
 to join the
 **CAS** 
 team in our
 **Advisory** 
 practice \-
 **Chennai** 
 office.
   

  

 CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered hybrid which means team members are expected to be thoughtful and intentional in how they create opportunities for in\-person collaboration. While the cadence of in\-office presence is determined at the team level, our professionals are encouraged to be in the office/together in person on average 3 days a week.
   

  

**YOUR TEAM.**
 This position will support our CAS team. We are seeking a detail oriented and experienced individuals to join our team. This role involves managing day\-to\-day accounting operations for U.S. based clients operating in real estate, hospitality, renewable energy and not for profit.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have experience in U.S. accounting, particularly in accounting workflows, POS systems, AP/AR, credit card and third\-party reconciliations. The Client Advisory Services team is a rapidly growing team, where we partner with our clients to perform accounting and technology services. Our goal is to leverage the best staff, cutting edge technology, and efficient processes to exceed our clients’ expectations. Some of our services include outsourced accounting, financial statement close assistance, virtual controller/CFO services, and accounting technology solution development.
   

  

**WHY COHNREZNICK?**
 At CohnReznick, we’re united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it’s working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your “why” at the firm.
   

  

 We believe it’s important to balance work with everyday life – and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning \& development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer.
   

  

**YOUR ROLE.**
**Responsibilities Include But Not Limited To**
* Manage full\-cycle accounting for clients including AP, AR, and general ledger.
* Reconcile daily sales from POS systems with bank deposits and accounting records.
* Perform credit card reconciliations and third\-party platform reconciliations.
* Prepare monthly financial statements, variance analysis, and management reports.
* Preparing and/or assisting with the reconciliation of accounts (bank, credit card, prepaids, liabilities, payroll, etc.)
* Track and reconcile payroll, tips, and gratuities in compliance with U.S. standards.
* Monitor cost accounting, inventory adjustments, etc.
* Assist in budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow management.
* Support audit and tax teams with documentation and schedules.
* Collaborate with U.S. client teams to resolve queries and ensure timely deliverables.
* Review work of junior associates and provide mentorship.
* Calculating accruals, prepaid expenses, deferred revenues, etc.
* Recording journal entries \& performs thorough self\-review of all work prior to submission for final review.
* Ensures quality control procedures are being followed and executed.
* Maintains positive client and colleague relationships.
* Positively represents and actively promotes the Firm.
* Proactively seeks knowledge, new tasks, and responsibilities.


**Your Experience.**
**The successful candidate will have:**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in accounting or finance with 3\+ years of experience in US Accounting.
* Ability to work on the corporate accounting processes and procedures such as cash management, AR/AP, month end close, payroll and benefits.
* Experience in U.S. accounting, specifically in hospitality, real estate, renewable energy and not for profit \-based environments.
* Hands\-on experience with POS systems and accounting platforms (QuickBooks, Sage Intacct, M3\).
* Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and Industry\-specific accounting practices.
* Experience with credit card and third\-party reconciliations.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Action\-oriented (self\-starter, team player, detail\-oriented).
* Must be able to handle multiple priorities and effectively meet critical deadlines.
* Understanding of financial statement preparation and analysis


 In addition, please take a moment to review our
 **Universal Job Standards.**
 Studies have shown that we are less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. At CohnReznick, we are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or one of our other roles.
   

  

 "CohnReznick" is the brand name under which CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC and their respective subsidiaries provide professional services. CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiaries) practice in an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable law, regulations, and professional standards. CohnReznick LLP is a licensed CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. CohnReznick Advisory LLC provides tax and business consulting services to its clients. CohnReznick Advisory LLC and its subsidiaries are not licensed CPA firms.
   

  

 CohnReznick is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive team to drive business results and create a better future every day for our team members, clients, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

**Job Title: Analyst II – Finance Shared Services**
**Location: Vikhroli, Mumbai**
**Role Purpose** 
 : As Analyst II – Finance Shared Services Treasury, you will be responsible for managing an organization's /client’s cash, liquidity, investments and financial risks, focusing on daily cash positioning, forecasting, bank relations, payment processing and ensuring sufficient funds available for operations, ensuring regulatory compliance, requiring analytical skills and proficiency with MS Office, ERP financials e.g. MS Dynamics, SAP, Oracle etc. and reporting.
   

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Cash \& Liquidity Management: Monitor daily cash, cash flow, manage bank accounts and ensure adequate funds are available for operational needs.
* Financial Reporting: Preparing daily, weekly and monthly reports on cash flow and investments for senior management and conducting variance analysis between forecasts and actual results, bank reconciliations and support audit processes.
* Risk Management: Helping to identify, monitor and mitigate financial risks, including foreign exchange (FX) and interest rate exposures and supporting the execution of hedging strategies.
* Investment Management: Manage and invest surplus cash, prioritizing liquidity and return.
* Bank \& Relationship Management: Assisting with managing bank accounts (openings, closings, signatory updates, KYC), reconciling bank statements and coordinating with banks to resolve issues.
* Receipts and Payment Processing: Apply customer collections and vendor payments to accounts Execute and manage electronic payments (ACH, Wires) and collections.
* Compliance and Audits: Ensuring all treasury activities comply with internal controls, policies, and external regulations, mainly FEMA compliance with respect to Softex filing etc. and preparing documentation for internal and external auditors.
* Process Improvement: Utilizing ERP Accounting and other financial software to enhance efficiency and automate processes.


**Knowledge, Experience \& Skills**
* Education: B.Com., M.Com., MBA Finance, CA (Inter)
* Skills: Analytical, mathematical, communication, Proficiency in financial software, ERP systems (like SAP, Oracle, Dynamics) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills are critical.
* Attributes: Integrity, ability to work under deadlines, focus, collaborative spirit.


**Preferred Experience \& Skills**
* Experience in a multinational or shared services environment.
* Knowledge of FEMA regulations and Softex filing requirements.
* Exposure to treasury management systems and financial process automation initiatives.
* Understanding of investment management and short\-term cash investment practices.
* Experience supporting internal and external audits.


**What do we offer?**
* Open culture and challenging opportunity to satisfy intellectual needs
* Flexible working hours
* Work\-life balance
* Excellent, dynamic and multicultural environment

*The company´s passenger, cargo, and industry platforms support airline retailing from offer to settlement, both above and below the wing. Accelya are proud to deliver leading\-edge technologies to our customers including through our partnership with AWS and through the pioneering NDC expertise of our Global Product teams.*
*We are proud to enable innovation\-led growth for the airline industry and put control back in the hands of airlines.*

Our Company
   

  

 We're Hitachi Digital, a company at the forefront of digital transformation and the fastest growing division of Hitachi Group. We're crucial to the company's strategy and ambition to become a premier global player in the massive and fast\-moving digital transformation market.
   

  

 Our group companies, including GlobalLogic, Hitachi Digital Services, Hitachi Vantara and more, offer comprehensive services that span the entire digital lifecycle, from initial idea to full\-scale operation and the infrastructure to run it on. Hitachi Digital represents One Hitachi, integrating domain knowledge and digital capabilities, and harnessing the power of the entire portfolio of services, technologies, and partnerships, to accelerate synergy creation and make real\-world impact for our customers and society as a whole.
   

  

 Imagine the sheer breadth of talent it takes to unleash a digital future. We don't expect you to 'fit' every requirement – your life experience, character, perspective, and passion for achieving great things in the world are equally as important to us.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Summary\*\*
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced IT Project Manager with a strong background in governance to join our team at Hitachi Digital Global India Private Limited. This role will be responsible for leading and managing IT projects with a focus on establishing and maintaining robust governance frameworks, ensuring compliance, and driving efficient project execution within a global context.
   

  

 Responsibilities\*\*
   

  

* Lead and manage the full lifecycle of IT projects, from initiation and planning to execution, monitoring, control, and closure, with a particular emphasis on governance aspects.
* Develop, implement, and maintain project governance frameworks, policies, and procedures to ensure project alignment with organizational goals, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Define and establish clear project roles, responsibilities, and decision\-making processes.
* Facilitate and lead governance meetings, including preparing agendas, documenting minutes, and tracking action items.
* Identify, assess, and manage project risks and issues, developing mitigation strategies and escalation paths within the governance framework.
* Monitor project progress, budget, and resource utilization, and report regularly to stakeholders on performance against established governance metrics.
* Ensure adherence to internal and external compliance standards, including data privacy, security, and quality assurance.
* Collaborate with various internal and external stakeholders, including business units, IT teams, vendors, and auditors, to ensure effective project delivery and governance.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives for project management and governance processes.
* Manage project documentation, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to governance requirements.


 Qualifications\*\*
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. PMP, PRINCE2, or other relevant project management certification is highly desirable.
* Minimum of 5\-8 years of experience in IT project management
* Proven track record of successfully managing complex IT projects from conception to completion within a structured governance framework.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) and best practices.
* In\-depth knowledge of IT governance frameworks (e.g., COBIT, ITIL) and regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001\).
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a keen eye for detail and process improvement.
* Proficiency in project management software (e.g., Jira, Asana, Microsoft Project) and governance tools.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a global team in a fast\-paced environment.


**About Us**
 We're a global, 1000\-strong, diverse team of professional experts, promoting and delivering Social Innovation through our One Hitachi initiative (OT x IT x Product) and working on projects that have a real\-world impact. We're curious, passionate and empowered, blending our legacy of 110 years of innovation with our shaping our future. Here you're not just another employee; you're part of a tradition of excellence and a community working towards creating a digital future.
   

  

 Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives
   

  

 Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
   

  

 We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit\-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
   

  

 How we look after you
   

  

 We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry\-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.
   

  

*We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic.* 
 Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

 uhomes.com is a global student accommodation platform that helps international students find and book safe, verified, and convenient housing near universities across different countries. * Identify and generate new sales opportunities through calls, meetings, follow\-ups, and other outreach channels.

* Stay updated on student accommodation markets, university locations, competitor activities, and industry trends.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 2–6 months of experience in the student accommodation or a closely related industry is preferred.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field is preferred.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and relationship\-building abilities.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and recommend suitable solutions.
* Strong sales orientation with the ability to follow up, negotiate, and close opportunities.
* Target\-driven, proactive, and self\-motivated approach.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, international, and customer\-focused environment.
* Basic proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools is an added advantage.


**What We’re Looking For**
 We are specifically looking for candidates who have
 **recent hands\-on experience working in the same or a closely related industry for around 2–6 months** 
 and already have a basic understanding of the
 **international student, overseas education, or student accommodation ecosystem** 
 .
   

  

**Industry Experience Is Highly Preferred Over Generic Sales Experience.**

title: Senior IT Developer
description:
At Medtronic you can begin a life\-long career of exploration and innovation, while helping champion healthcare access and equity for all. You’ll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation in a more connected, compassionate world.
   

  

**A Day in the Life**
 The Global Pricing and Contracting IT team at Medtronic partners with commercial groups to develop AI and analytics\-driven systems that improve pricing and contracting strategies. These tools generate insights to help maximize revenue, expand market share, and support global go\-to\-market efforts. The role offers strong exposure to Medtronic’s products, data, and commercial operations, along with opportunities for career growth in a diverse and inclusive environment focused on advancing healthcare.
   

  

 The Sr. IT Developer designs, builds, and supports internal CPQ/CLM applications that enable U.S. P\&C capabilities. The role translates business needs into technical solutions, leads design discussions, develops and tests code, and improves system performance, reliability, and scalability. It also promotes development best practices such as CI/CD, automated testing, and strong architecture patterns while troubleshooting issues and supporting upgrades and integrations. The position collaborates closely with business stakeholders, acting as a bridge between P\&C and IT to ensure technology and data support business decisions. Responsibilities include gathering requirements, documenting solutions, mentoring developers, improving development processes, and contributing to architectural direction while working in agile teams to deliver technology solutions that support business outcomes and patient impact.
   

  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**
* Application Development and Support
+ Design, develop, maintain, and enhance software applications supporting internal business function.
+ Analyze systems and implement new applications or enhancements.
+ Write, test, and debug code following development standards.
+ Maintain system documentation and build integrations or specialized programs.
+ Support maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshoot system issues.

* Systems Analysis and Implementation
+ Analyze system capabilities, data inputs/outputs, and processing requirements.
+ Develop implementation plans and prepare operating and support documentation.
+ Recommend improvements to development standards and system processes.

* Business Collaboration
+ Partner with business teams to gather and document requirements.
+ Lead discovery sessions and translate technical solutions for business users.
+ Provide user support and training.

* Project Delivery and Team Collaboration
+ Participate in or lead projects from design through implementation.
+ Collaborate across IT and business teams and mentor junior developers when applicable.

* Process Improvement and Compliance
+ Identify opportunities to improve processes and system efficiency.
+ Monitor integrations and data synchronization.
+ Ensure compliance with regulatory, privacy, and corporate IT standards.

 In the role of Chapter Member, the individual executes day\-to\-day activities within their assigned Value Team, with responsibilities that may vary according to the team’s mandate. Within the Value Team, the Chapter Member focuses on resolving specific business challenges for the organization. Value Teams are established and evolve in response to changing business objectives, and Chapter Members serve as key business partners, applying their expertise to drive organizational results.

 Drive analytical capability innovation through development of new methodologies/analytic techniques.

**Vanguard India**
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced technology leader to build, scale, and lead multiple engineering teams responsible for developing enterprise data services and API\-driven platforms that power critical business capabilities.
   

  

 This role combines engineering leadership, technology strategy, and large\-scale delivery accountability. The successful candidate will partner with business and technology stakeholders to drive platform modernization, establish engineering best practices, and deliver secure, scalable, and high\-performing solutions. The position requires a strong blend of people leadership, technical expertise, stakeholder management, and program execution within a complex and highly regulated environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and develop multiple software engineering teams, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning.
* Drive the design, development, delivery, and operational support of enterprise data services, APIs, and business\-critical technology platforms.
* Partner with business leaders, product teams, and architects to define technology strategy, roadmaps, and long\-term engineering direction.
* Lead large\-scale platform modernization and API transformation initiatives aimed at improving scalability, reliability, maintainability, and speed of delivery.
* Establish engineering standards, best practices, governance models, and quality frameworks across teams.

* Build and manage high\-performing teams, including hiring, coaching, succession planning, performance management, and workforce planning.
* Develop strong relationships with global stakeholders and drive alignment across geographically distributed teams.
* Monitor delivery performance through meaningful operational and engineering metrics, ensuring business commitments and service objectives are met.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate delivery, operational, and technology risks across complex initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that improve engineering effectiveness and business outcomes.
* Oversee vendor and partner relationships where required and ensure successful delivery against agreed objectives.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Minimum 10 years of experience in IT delivery, project management, or technology leadership roles, with expertise in software implementation and team management.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field; Master’s degree in Technology, Business Administration, or equivalent preferred.
* Proven experience leading large engineering organizations and managing multiple software development teams.
* Strong program management, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and organizational leadership capabilities.
* Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise APIs, service\-oriented architectures, microservices, or large\-scale integration platforms.

* Experience leading platform modernization, cloud transformation, or enterprise technology initiatives.
* Experience working within Banking, Financial Services, Investment Management, Insurance, or other regulated industries is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of cloud technologies, modern software architecture patterns, API platforms, data services, and distributed systems.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with experience collaborating across global teams.
* Demonstrated ability to build high\-performing teams and deliver complex technology programs in fast\-paced enterprise environments.


**Location**
 This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.

 Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
   

  

**Our commitment to you**

**Financial wellness**

**Physical wellness**

**Personal wellness**

We believe our mission\-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long\-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

 The
 **Zonal Manager – Sales Planning \& Business Excellence** 
 will play a critical role in transforming sales planning, forecasting, sales performance management, and GTN governance into a
 **ROI\-driven, insight\-led execution engine** 
 .
   

  

 Reporting to the
 **GM – Business Effectiveness** 
 , this role will work closely with Sales Leadership, ABMs, and ZBMs to convert business growth ambitions into executable plans, monitor sales performance, drive forecasting excellence, and ensure disciplined execution of commercial priorities.
   

  

 The role is responsible for orchestrating decision\-making and ensuring timely closure across sales planning, forecasting, and GTN processes, even when final approval authority resides elsewhere.

* Sales Planning \& Target Architecture
* Own the end\-to\-end sales planning process, translating Commercial Unit (CU) ambitions and Annual Operating Plan (AOP) commitments into actionable execution plans.

* Proactively identify deviations and work with ABMs and the GM\-BE to implement corrective actions.

* Coordinate GTN planning architecture, governance frameworks, and operating calendars.
* Consolidate and normalize GTN inputs across regions and portfolios.

* Facilitate commercial decision\-making by presenting data\-driven recommendations and trade\-offs.

+ FAQ development
+ Training materials
+ Tracking and reporting mechanisms

+ Pricing strategies

+ Past dues management
+ Demand forecasting
+ Retail placements
+ Distributor analysis
+ Channel and customer strategies

* Deliver performance reporting focused on:
+ Performance versus plan
+ Root cause analysis
+ Corrective action plans
+ Accountability and ownership

* Lead governance rhythms and performance review forums at zonal and regional levels.
* Monitor productivity and resource utilization across commercial teams.
* Track budgets against plans and ensure SOP compliance.
* Highlight spending risks and recommend mitigation actions.

* Leverage commercial, customer, and performance data to generate actionable insights.
* Analyze GTN effectiveness and business performance trends.
* Identify productivity gaps, execution bottlenecks, and structural business constraints.
* Support leadership teams with decision\-ready analysis on business risks, opportunities, and trade\-offs.
* Provide fact\-based recommendations to improve execution and commercial outcomes.

* Continuously improve sales planning, forecasting, GTN governance, and execution processes.
* Drive adoption of new ways of working through structured governance, capability building, and stakeholder engagement.
* Champion operational excellence and process simplification initiatives.
* Support business transformation efforts in partnership with ABMs and the GM\-BE.

* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment without relying on formal reporting relationships.

* Uses data, analytics, governance mechanisms, and structured frameworks to support decisions and drive accountability.
* Brings objectivity and commercial rigor to business discussions.

description:
**Job Description \- Head of Growth** 




  





**About Us** 




 Zylu is a fast\-growing SaaS startup helping salons and beauty businesses simplify appointments, customer engagement, marketing, and business operations through technology.
 



 With a growing presence across India and expanding traction in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Southeast Asia, we're building the operating system for the beauty and wellness industry.
 



 If you're excited about building growth engines, scaling businesses, and working closely with founders, Zylu offers a high\-impact opportunity to make a real difference.
 



  





**Job Role:** 
 Head of Growth
 



**Experience Level:** 
 3 to 6 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore (Work From Office)
 



**Qualification:** 
 Graduation is a must.
 



  





**Job Overview** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on growth marketing manager who has experience contributing to the growth of a SaaS company from approximately
 **$100K ARR to $3M ARR** 
 .
 



 You will own the growth funnel across customer acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion while working directly with leadership to build scalable growth systems.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who combines strategy with execution and is comfortable working across multiple growth channels.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  




* Own and drive growth across the entire customer journey from lead generation to retention and expansion.
* Build and optimise conversion funnels across website visitors, leads, demos, trials, and customers.
* Plan and execute growth experiments across landing pages, email campaigns, ads, onboarding, and product messaging.
* Scale customer acquisition through channels such as SEO, content, paid marketing, partnerships, referrals, webinars, and communities.
* Work closely with Product, Sales, and Customer Success teams to improve activation and retention metrics.
* Track and improve key SaaS metrics, including CAC, LTV, conversion rates, retention, and ARR growth.
* Build dashboards and reports to measure marketing performance and growth initiatives.
* Identify new growth opportunities and launch initiatives to improve revenue efficiency.
* Collaborate with founders and leadership on go\-to\-market strategy and expansion plans.
* Support hiring and scaling of the future growth team as the company grows.



  





**Role Requirements** 




  




* 3\-6 years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation, or revenue marketing roles within B2B SaaS companies.
* Experience working in a startup environment with high ownership and fast execution cycles.
* Experience contributing to the growth of a SaaS company from approximately
 **$100K ARR to $3M\-$5M ARR** 
 is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of SaaS metrics, including ARR, MRR, CAC, LTV, churn, retention, and payback period.
* Proven experience running growth experiments and improving conversion funnels.
* Hands\-on experience with CRM, marketing automation, analytics, and attribution tools.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to make data\-driven decisions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in vertical SaaS, SMB SaaS, or multi\-location businesses is a plus.
* Experience in beauty, wellness, healthcare, or similar industries is an added advantage.



  





**Hiring Process** 




  




* Initial discussion with the hiring team.
* Growth strategy or case study discussion.
* Leadership interview focused on growth achievements and business impact.
* Final discussion with founders and leadership team.

**Job Description**
 As an SAP UI5 / Fiori Consultant, you will be responsible for creating innovative and responsive applications. Your expertise will bridge the gap between functional requirements and technical implementation, resulting in efficient and user\-friendly solutions. You will collaborate closely with a diverse range of teams, including functional, ABAP, and business stakeholders, to deliver exceptional SAP Fiori experiences.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and develop SAP Fiori applications using SAPUI5, ensuring adherence to SAP standards and best practices.
* Collaborate with functional and business teams to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
* Create responsive and user\-friendly interfaces, enhancing the overall user experience.
* Work closely with ABAP developers to integrate SAPUI5 applications with SAP backend systems.
* Conduct thorough testing and debugging of SAP Fiori applications to ensure optimal performance and functionality.
* Provide ongoing support and maintenance for deployed SAP Fiori applications, addressing any issues or enhancements.
* Stay updated with the latest SAPUI5 technologies and trends, incorporating them into your development practices.
* Document and communicate development processes, ensuring knowledge transfer within the team.
* Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to improve the quality of SAPUI5 code.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in SAP UI5 / Fiori development, with a strong understanding of SAPUI5 framework.
* Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 for building SAP Fiori applications.
* Experience with SAP Fiori tools and technologies, including SAP Web IDE and SAP Gateway.
* Knowledge of SAP HANA database and its integration with SAPUI5 applications is preferred.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a customer\-centric approach.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new SAP technologies and industry trends.
* Experience in Agile development methodologies is an added advantage.

 Bristlecone is the leading provider of AI\-powered application transformation services for the connected supply chain. We empower our customers with speed, visibility, automation, and resiliency – to thrive on change.

description:
If you are looking for a meaningful career where people work and act with passion, rethink the existing and always strive to find the best solution \- you have come to the right place. We develop future technologies to relentlessly make supply chains better.
   

  

 We are a leader in supply chain software solutions, helping organizations streamline operations, reduce costs, and improve efficiency.
   

  

 As an OMS Technical Consultant, you will design, configure, integrate, and deploy Infios OMS solutions for global retail and eCommerce clients. Working from Bangalore within an offshore delivery model, you will contribute strong Java engineering expertise to scalable backend services, APIs, microservices, and order orchestration workflows. You will collaborate with enterprise architects and stakeholders across the US and EMEA to connect OMS capabilities with eCommerce, ERP, WMS, payment, and other external systems. Your work will span technical design, development, testing, cloud deployment, production readiness, and post\-deployment support across distributed enterprise environments.
   

  

**What a Day In The Life Looks Like**
* Design scalable Infios OMS solutions, integration patterns, system data flows, and Java\-based microservices architectures.
* Configure and extend OMS components, pipelines, orchestration logic, business rules, workflows, and data models.
* Develop reusable Java services, REST APIs, and custom extensions using Spring Boot and related Java frameworks.
* Build and support integrations with eCommerce, ERP, WMS, payment, messaging, and other external systems.
* Deploy and test OMS services using AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and, where applicable, Docker and Kubernetes.
* Resolve technical issues, support SIT and UAT, and contribute to production deployments, hypercare, documentation, and effective handovers.


**What You Bring To The Team**
* At least five years of experience working with OMS or distributed commerce systems.
* Hands\-on experience with Infios, formerly Körber, OMS or a similar OMS platform.
* Strong Java development expertise, including Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices.
* Experience building scalable backend systems and working with event\-driven architectures.
* Experience with cloud platforms, with AWS preferred, and familiarity with CI/CD practices.
* Knowledge of messaging frameworks such as Kafka or RabbitMQ and container technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes is preferred.

description:
**WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING**
 At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next\-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.
 **Together, we advance your career.**
**MTS Power and Performance Engineer**
  

  

**The Role**
 AMD’s Computing and Graphics business unit is seeking a technical leader to drive next‑generation power architecture, firmware, algorithms, and software interfaces across AMD client and handheld SoCs. In this highly influential role, you will help define the power‑management architecture for future AMD platforms—driving innovation from early concept and definition, through design execution, and into post‑silicon validation.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with SoC and platform architects, IP and physical design teams, software and firmware engineering, silicon validation, and packaging teams to deliver breakthrough improvements in power efficiency, performance‑per‑watt, and battery life. This is an opportunity to have a direct and visible impact on AMD’s most advanced products. This senior role will stretch you as you lead architecture teams in new directions, network with our world\-class, patent\-holding think\-tank, and negotiate amongst design teams, marketing, and business unit executives.
   

  

**The Person**
 You are a deep technical thinker with strong problem‑solving and communication skills. You excel at explaining complex concepts through publications, presentations, or executive briefings.
   

  

 You thrive in highly collaborative environments, mentor others naturally, and raise the collective expertise of the teams around you. You combine practical hands‑on skills with system‑level vision, and you are energized by building algorithms and firmware that shape silicon behavior.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Algorithm, Firmware \& Software Interface Architecture
   

  

* Develop and architect new power algorithms and software features using state‑of‑the‑art techniques, including classfiers, regression models, machine learning approches for CPU/GPU power and performance optimization.
* Define and implement software interfaces that influence and optimize hardware behavior across the SoC.
* Prototype and develop new firmware for complex power‑control algorithms throughout the SoC roadmap.


**Performance \& Workload Optimization**
* Profile emerging NN and LLM (Agentic) workloads on client platforms; tune algorithms to optimize power during active, high‑load, and interactive usage scenarios.
* Analyze power and performance benchmarks to identify opportunities for efficiency improvements.


**System‑Level Power Architecture**
* Architect, implement, and optimize control software and firmware features to achieve product‑level power targets.
* Drive cross‑organization alignment for innovative power‑reduction methodologies and ensure convergence across design teams.
* Collaborate with global architecture and design teams to implement and validate SoC power‑management solutions.
* Optimize real PC use cases for both absolute power and performance‑per‑watt.


**Hands‑On Engineering**
* Work directly with development boards to prototype new features and evaluate new power features.
* Conduct software tracing, firmware debugging, and activity profiling to diagnose issues and drive improvements.


**Preferred Experience**
* Prefer 8\+ years of industry experience
* Experience profiling software workloads on CPUs and GPUs.
* Knowledge of defining low‑level software interfaces to influence hardware performance and power behavior.
* Background in SOC hardware design, clock distribution, power delivery and performance
* Experience profiling and tuning hardware/software stacks to achieve power and performance efficiency on benchmark workloads.
* Prior algorithm development in C or Python; MATLAB experience preferred.
* Expertise in algorithm development for predictive systems using regression and classification frameworks for complex datasets.
* Experience with system and SoC control firmware, including RTOS and bare‑metal development.
* Familiarity with ACPI, UEFI, and platform‑level power management frameworks.
* Demonstrated expertise in system and SoC power optimization techniques.
* Experience with software tracing, firmware debugging, and activity profiling tools.
* Windows OS and kernel‑level knowledge, including power frameworks, drivers, and system activity tracing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to lead and influence teams across geographies.
* Clear, methodical problem solver comfortable driving complex initiatives independently.


**Academic Credentials**
 PhD or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related technical field.
   

  

*Benefits offered are described:*

 An overview of this role
   

  

 The Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations team manages observability, monitoring, and detection for systems that support customer purchasing and use of GitLab. As a Staff Backend Engineer on the Fulfillment Workflow Monitoring (Catch All) team, you'll set the technical direction for the telemetry, detection, and reconciliation tooling that identifies billing, data, and event anomalies across CustomersDot, Salesforce, and Zuora before they can affect revenue or the customer experience.
   

  

 This is a greenfield team. You'll help build it from the ground up, shaping its operating rhythm, incident response model, and quality bar. You'll use telemetry and machine learning to identify issues early and help resolve them. Because Monetization changes can directly affect revenue and often involve confidential or financial information, you'll use strong judgment, careful rollout practices, and a high bar for reliability. This role is opening at the Staff Backend Engineer level (grade 8\).
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Design, build, and operate observability across the Monetization stack, including metrics, logs, and traces, using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
* Implement automated detection for billing, data, and event anomalies, and route alerts to the responsible feature teams.
* Develop reconciliation and data integrity checks across usage and billing pipelines.
* Define and track service level objectives and service level indicators, write runbooks, and take part in incident response to measure and improve Monetization system reliability.
* Explore artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques to predict system anomalies and accelerate resolution.
* Review and offer feedback on merge requests from other Monetization engineers.
* Collaborate with Product, Finance, Support, and other partners to turn operational needs into reliable tooling.


 What you’ll bring
   

  

* Professional experience with Ruby on Rails, including building and operating applications such as CustomersDot.
* Experience in site reliability or observability engineering, including monitoring, alerting, service level objectives and indicators, runbooks, and incident response.
* Experience setting technical direction for observability, reliability, or detection work and bringing other engineers along.
* Experience building anomaly detection, monitoring, or risk management tooling.
* Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.
* Exposure to analytical data stores such as ClickHouse and the change data capture and event\-streaming pipelines that feed them, including NATS JetStream.
* Experience owning projects from concept through production, communicating clearly about complex technical and organizational problems, and proposing iterative solutions.
* Working knowledge of Python for anomaly detection and data work, or experience with billing, financial, or other business\-critical systems, including Zuora or Salesforce, is a plus.


**About The Team**
 The Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations team is part of GitLab's Monetization section, a highly cross\-functional group that partners with Sales, Finance, IT, and Support to deliver secure and reliable purchasing, billing, provisioning, and utilization workflows. The Monetization section includes the Purchase, Subscription Lifecycle, Billing Engine, Platform and Infrastructure, Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations, and Compliance teams.
   

  

 This role is on the Fulfillment Workflow Monitoring (Catch All) team and reports to the Engineering Manager, Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations. We work asynchronously, plan and reflect regularly, and share responsibility for deployments, incident management, testing, and safe rollouts. We're increasingly focused on how artificial intelligence and machine learning can improve our Monetization infrastructure and provide predictive insights.

 More about

**Here’s how you’ll be contributing to Card Disputes team:**
 As a Card Disputes Associate Specialist, you are a frontline expert responsible for the heartbeat of our daily operations and are the executor of the workload directly contributing to SLAs.
   

  

* Maintaining consistent and high\-level execution of daily tasks and recurring responsibilities within Card Disputes;

* Following Operational procedures and keeping track of critical updates.
* Execute the end\-to\-end investigation and resolution of complex Card Fraud (CF) and Non\-Fraud (NF) disputes, ensuring every decision is strictly compliant with card scheme rules and regulatory requirements.
* Actively identify weaknesses or "friction points" in daily workflows, proposing and helping implement practical solutions that make our operations more scalable and efficient.
* Maintain a high bar for accuracy and security in every case handled, upholding detailed records and ensuring all reporting responsibilities are met with factual precision.
* Work closely with Customer Support, Compliance, and Product teams to gather evidence, resolve high\-priority escalations, and provide frontline insights into emerging fraud trends.

* You are a self\-starter, capable of managing daily workload and prioritizing effectively to meet deadlines.

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**GLOBAL COMPLIANCE AT GOLDMAN SACHS**
 At Goldman Sachs, the mandate of Global Compliance is to prevent, detect and mitigate compliance, regulatory, and reputational risk across the firm and help to strengthen the firm’s culture of compliance. Compliance accomplishes this mandate through the firm’s enterprise\-wide compliance risk management program. As an independent control function and part of the firm’s second line of defense, Compliance assesses the firm’s compliance, regulatory and reputational risk; monitors for compliance with new or amended laws, rules and regulations; designs and implements controls, policies, procedures and training; conducts independent testing; investigates, surveils and monitors for compliance risks and breaches; and leads the firm’s responses to regulatory examinations, audits and inquiries. Compliance provides advice on how to conduct the firm’s business in a manner that complies with the vast array of rules, regulations and regulatory expectations around the globe. Importantly, Compliance plays a key role in reviewing and effectively challenging transactions presenting compliance or reputational risks.
   

  

**Business Unit And Role Overview**
 Compliance provides compliance coverage to the Operations, Engineering, Controllers, Corporate Treasury, Corporate and Workplace Solutions, Executive Office, Corporate Planning Management, Risk, Tax and Human Capital Management divisions.
   

  

**This Includes**
* Conducting risk identification, measurement and assessment
* Monitoring for compliance with laws, rules, regulations and policies, including the identification and investigation of conduct related issues
* Participating in firm responses to regulatory examinations, audits and inquiries
* Performing surveillance and investigations of business activities of the above\-referenced divisions
* Testing the effectiveness of controls
* Writing policies and procedures
* Communicating regulatory requirements and firm policy expectations to educate others both one\-on\-one and through compliance learning initiative


**Responsibilities And Qualifications**
**ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
**Responsibilities**
 As part of the India \- The Core Compliance team, you will provide compliance support and coverage for the firm’s Engineering Division, Risk Division and Third\-Party Risk Management (TPRM) team. You will also participate in region\-wide and global initiatives to enact the Global Compliance mandate and Business Unit priorities. To fulfill this role and responsibilities, you will need to:
   

  

* Advise, challenge, and influence the Engineering Division, Risk Division and TPRM team regarding financial regulation implementation, firmwide and divisional policies, and reputational risk
* Brief senior leadership on risks identified and ensure stakeholder engagement
* Analyze and conduct ongoing reviews of regulations, rule trends and enforcement actions to assess impact and identify potential gaps

description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 We believe collective knowledge drives exceptional support. While our content currently serves a functional purpose, we are ready to elevate it into a true strategic asset. Nutanix is committed to delivering a proactive, customer\-first experience by "shifting left"—empowering our customers with the right answers at the exact moment of need.
   

  

 We are seeking experienced Content and Knowledge Manager(s) to lead this evolution. In this role, you will align cross\-functional teams, leverage your technical expertise, and execute a knowledge strategy that turns our ecosystem into a powerful, customer\-enablement engine.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You will be a key player in our global Support organization, reporting directly to the head of the Support Project Management Office (PMO) responsible for Strategy and Innovation. Our mission is to scale operational efficiency and elevate customer satisfaction in every interaction. We value action and collaboration, giving you the runway to lead knowledge strategies that make a tangible impact.
   

  

 Your Role
   

  

 As the Content \& Knowledge Manager, you will transform how technical information flows across the organization. Treating knowledge as a strategic asset, you will partner with our Support Engineers and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to build best\-in\-class knowledge programs.
   

  

 By championing AI and automation, governing the documentation lifecycle, and optimizing relevance and findability, you will scale our knowledge operations. Ultimately, your work will directly empower support teams, drive self\-service, and enhance the overall Nutanix customer experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Knowledge \& Program Strategy: Design and automate workflows that improve content accessibility, Knowledge Base (KB) performance, and scale support delivery. Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on data\-driven insights, user feedback, and modern KM frameworks (e.g. Knowledge\-Centered Success (KCS)).
* Content Lifecycle Management: Oversee the end\-to\-end lifecycle of technical documentation, KB articles, and interactive assets. Empower and educate Support Engineers and SMEs to capture knowledge seamlessly, ensuring all assets align with global Support goals and compliance standards.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Act as the primary bridge between Support, IT, Product Management, and Engineering teams. Lead knowledge readiness and facilitate communication around content roadmaps to ensure seamless collaboration and frictionless knowledge sharing.
* Metrics \& Analytics: Develop reporting frameworks to analyze KB utilization, content value, and effectiveness. Quantify the impact of your programs on scaling Assisted Support, driving self\-service success, and improving overall Nutanix Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) and Net Promoter Score (NPS).
* Optimization: Continually optimize knowledge architecture and searchability. Implement industry best practices and leverage AI\-driven search and chat capabilities to ensure the right information reaches the right user at the exact moment of need.


 What You Will Bring
   

  

* Experience: 5\+ years of combined experience in Knowledge Management, Technical Program Management, or Technical Writing within a complex enterprise software, SaaS, or global Technical Support environment.
* Technical Acumen: Exceptional ability to distill complex technical concepts into clear, actionable project plans. Proven experience partnering with engineering and IT/SaaS teams and subject matter experts (SMEs) to scale operations and deliver results.
* Tool Proficiency: Hands\-on experience with enterprise KM systems, CRM platforms (ex: Salesforce, ServiceNow), and collaborative tools (e.g. Slack, Confluence, Jira). Familiarity with CMS platforms and enterprise search or AI\-driven KM technologies/techniques.
* Operational Excellence: Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a focus on scaling operations. Familiarity with industry KM frameworks, ITIL, or continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma).
* Project \& Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to drive alignment and influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority. Excellent organizational skills to manage competing priorities and drive programmatic initiatives from conception to execution.
* Education \& Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Technical Communications, or a related field. Certifications in KCSv6, PMP, or Agile Scrum are highly preferred.


 Work Arrangement
   

  

 Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

**IPE Global** 
 is an international development consulting company providing expert technical assistance and solutions for equitable development and sustainable growth in developing countries.

 The Associate Manager, Medical Communications and Content Solutions, within the Global Medical Communications and Content Solutions (MCCS) team in the Global \& US Medical Communications and Content (MCC) Organization is responsible for , developing global medical content including abstracts, manuscripts, congress posters/presentations, graphical abstracts, systematic literature reviews, plain language summaries, slide decks, medical education resources, social media, infographics, video, multi\-media and other types of external\-facing medical content under supervision.
   

  

**Role Responsibilities**
* The Associate Manager will develop with support and supervision, relevant medical affairs content, including abstracts, manuscripts, congress posters/presentations, graphical abstracts, systematic literature reviews, plain language summaries, slide decks, medical education resources, social media, infographics, video, multi\-media and other types of external\-facing medical content.
* Responsibilities may include researching, organizing, compiling, interpreting, and quality check of various types of technical and/or medical content.
* Provide solutions to stakeholders in alignment with manager for all projects and collaborate with other teams to drive these solutions (Graphics, Compliance agency, Statistics teams, etc.).
* Ensure execution of all projects within expected timelines while adhering to all quality and compliance requirements for medical content.
* Ensure training on relevant tools and processes, including new generative AI technology platforms, that ensure efficient and compliant execution of all medical affairs content.
* Track the progress of projects and resolve any issues/problems with guidance from manager.
* Identify and train to become an expert on one new tool/skill for content creation representing the latest trends in the industry.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Advanced scientific degree, (eg, MS, MRes, MPharm, PhD, PharmD, MBBS/MD) 2\+ years experience in pharmaceutical medicine, including medical affairs, medical compliance. Proven ability to take ownership of individual work and align with more experienced colleagues on scope, timelines, quality expectations, etc. Strong interpersonal skills to quickly build rapport and credibility with colleagues and key external stakeholders cross culturally/regionally. Experience in medical content writing /writing in academic settings/ communications experience within an agency, CRO, Pharma / Biotech Company. Effective English verbal and written communication with flexibility to be clear, consistent, compliant, and appropriate for a variety of settings Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team and understand the applications of technology to medical content development


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Expertise in assigned therapeutic areas Experience in medical content creation Multimedia and omnichannel experience Rapid adoption of new digital content, technology, and resources Global / international work or educational experience


 Work Location Assignment: Remote

description:
**Job Description: Enterprise AI Sales Manager** 




**About DotKonnekt** 




 DotKonnekt is a full\-stack Enterprise AI company. We combine domain ontology, a proprietary agentic AI platform, and embedded delivery pods to take enterprises from AI strategy through production deployment. We serve retailers, consumer brands, manufacturing and distribution enterprises in the US and globally.
 



 We are a Google Cloud AI Partner, Enterprise AI Knowledge Partner to Kellogg School of Management, and recognized by Constellation Research as an AI\-first firm. Our customers include 30\+ mid to large enterprises running our platform in production. We operate from India, Singapore, the UAE, and the US, with founders and senior leadership actively engaged in every deal.
 



**What we are looking for** 




 A seasoned, consultative enterprise seller who can shape and close complex AI transformation engagements with US enterprises in the target industries. You will own a new\-logo quota, co\-own close with founders, and take deals from qualified opportunity through commercial and legal close.
 



 This is a hunter role at true enterprise deal size. You sell business outcomes, not features. You land logos at $1M\+ ACV with multi\-use case footprint and architect the expansion path of the relationship from day one.
 



 You will take DotKonnekt’s full\-stack offering to market: agentic AI products, the underlying platform, and embedded delivery. That means you are equally comfortable selling a focused first use case to a CTO, framing a multi\-year transformation to a CEO, and structuring the commercial model with procurement. You think and operate as an AI\-native seller.
 



**Desired outcomes** 



* Year 1 quota: \~$2M ARR in new logo enterprise revenue, with explicit ramp in the first two quarters
* Land deals at $1M\+ ACV anchor, structured with multi\-use case scope, cross\-sell hooks, and clear expansion roadmap into year 2 and beyond
* Pipeline coverage of 3\-4x quota maintained throughout the year, sourced from your own outbound, SDR\-generated leads, partner introductions, and inbound
* Sell the full DotKonnekt stack as a single transformation arc: lead with the highest conviction use case, structure the platform deal underneath, and build the expansion roadmap into the commercials
* Co\-own deals with founders: you run the process, sequence stakeholders, build the business case, negotiate commercials, and close. Founders engage at CXO meetings, technical depth conversations, and final terms
* Frame every opportunity as a transformation outcome with a measurable business case, not a product purchase
* Forecast accuracy within 15% on a rolling 90\-day basis
* Account plans for top 10 target accounts, refreshed quarterly, with named expansion paths within each logo



**What you will gain with us** 



* Direct co\-selling with founders on real enterprise deals, not coaching from the sidelines
* A platform with named enterprise references in production, including household\-name retailers
* Compensation structured for outsized outcomes: competitive base, accelerators on overachievement, ESOPs for the right candidate
* A category\-defining position in Enterprise AI as it becomes the largest tech shift of the decade
* Learn from seasoned global executives who have built and scaled enterprise businesses before



**Qualification requirements** 



* **US enterprise track record:** 
 8\+ years of enterprise B2B sales, with the majority spent selling to US enterprise accounts (Fortune 1000 or equivalent). SMB\-only profiles will not be a fit.
* **$1M ACV closing track record:** 
 Personally closed multiple new logo deals at $1M\+ ACV in the US enterprise market. References and deal\-level detail will be reviewed.
* **Consultative, outcome\-led selling:** 
 Track record of selling business transformation. You build the business case, quantify outcomes with the customer, and tie commercials to value. Background in management consulting, transformation programs, or solution consulting before or alongside sales is a strong plus.
* **Deal shaping and expansion design:** 
 Demonstrable experience landing enterprise deals with multi\-use case scope and architecting the expansion path. You sell the platform, not the feature.
* **Process discipline:** 
 Navigated full enterprise sales cycles with procurement, legal, security, and infosec reviews end to end. You know how to build consensus and drive the close.
* **AI\-native operator:** 
 You don’t just sell AI, you live in it. AI is core to how you research accounts, write outreach, build proposals, run discovery, and prepare for meetings. Expert daily use of AI in your own workflow. You will demo your AI stack live during evaluation. This is non\-negotiable.
* **Communication:** 
 Enterprise\-grade written and verbal communication. Can write a business case a CFO would read and run a discovery a CTO would respect.
* **Mindset:** 
 Self\-starter with a startup operator mindset. Founding or early\-stage experience is a strong plus. If you are looking for a comfortable, predictable role with a fully built playbook, don’t apply here.
* **Location:** 
 Based in India (Bengaluru), full\-time. Travel to the US as deals require.

description:
**About Us**




 Exotel is the emerging market’s leading full\-stack customer engagement platform and business\-focused virtual telecom operator. Founded in 2011, our cloud\-based product suite powers over 50 million daily engagements across voice, video, and messaging channels.
 



 Trusted by 6,000\+ companies across 60\+ countries—including India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa—Exotel enables unified customer engagement for leading businesses such as Ola, Swiggy, Flipkart, GoJek, Byju’s, HDFC Bank, Zomato, and Urban Company. Our offerings include communication APIs, a modern omnichannel contact centre, and a conversational AI platform hosted on the cloud. We are a Series D company valued at $100 million with $60 million in ARR.
 



  





**About the Pod**




 This role sits directly within our product pod, managing the end\-to\-end technical delivery of Conversational Quality Assurance (CQA) products. Unlike broader corporate delivery tracks, this position has direct ownership of enterprise implementations from initiation to completion, serving as the bridge between cutting\-edge AI product performance and enterprise execution.
 



  





**About the Role**




 We are seeking an Technical Project Manager to fully own the end\-to\-end execution, delivery processes, and client communication for our CQA product line. In this role, you will step into a key leadership position within the pod, managing all technical communication with incoming enterprise customers, translating their expectations into functional workflows, and driving internal execution.
 



 As the delivery lead, you will have direct ownership of the project lifecycle. You will balance high\-stakes stakeholder management with a deep technical understanding of cloud telecom ecosystems and frontier AI.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**1\. Delivery Ownership \& Team Leadership** 



* Take absolute end\-to\-end ownership of the CQA product delivery process, relieving leadership from daily execution tasks.
* Establish, optimize, and enforce robust project management processes tailored for large, complex enterprise clients.



**2\. Client \& Technical Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as the primary, front\-facing technical interface for onboarding enterprise clients.
* Lead client discover sessions to extract, understand, and document technical requirements from a product standpoint.
* Drive alignment and manage timelines across multiple external and internal stakeholders, ensuring projects move forward without bottlenecks.



**3\. Technical Project Execution** 



* Oversee the complex integration of CQA products into Exotel’s existing telecom/API ecosystem.
* Ensure smooth deployment and operational validation of frontier GenAI and LLM applications within the clients' environments.
* Coordinate daily with engineering, pre\-sales, and delivery teams, facilitating a seamless post\-delivery handover to Support Engineers.



  





**What We’re Looking For**




**Experience \& Core Competencies** 



* 5 to 8 years of solid project management experience, explicitly within software, SaaS, or deep technical product delivery.
* Proven track record of managing and delivery implementations for large enterprise customers.



**Technical Skillset** 



* AI \& Frontier Tech: Strong familiarity with AI/ML, NLP, conversational AI concepts, and hands\-on exposure to GenAI (prompt engineering, LLM applications).
* Integrations \& Infrastructure: Deep understanding of integration methods for CRMs, APIs, cloud systems, architecture, and deployment methodologies.
* Systems Knowledge: Comfortable understanding what works and what doesn't across Linux, networking, databases, message queues, and caching.



**Soft Skills \& Process Drive** 



* Exceptional communication and negotiation skills—capable of driving technical discussions with enterprise executives and internal engineers alike.
* High level of accountability, organizational rigor, and time management.
* A proactive, customer\-focused approach to problem\-solving and risk mitigation.

**About Frido** 




 Frido is a Pune\-based mobility and wellness brand dedicated to improving the way people move, sit, walk, and live. Our product portfolio includes ergonomic chairs, electric wheelchairs, mobility scooters, cushions, pillows, footwear, and other wellness solutions. As we continue our growth journey, we are looking for a dynamic professional to lead our international business expansion.

 , establishing international distribution networks, and building strategic partnerships. This role requires strong commercial acumen, market entry expertise, and the ability to scale business across international markets.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and execute Frido's international expansion strategy.
* Identify high\-potential countries, market opportunities, and growth segments.
* Build and manage relationships with distributors, dealers, importers, and channel partners.
* Drive export sales for Frido's mobility, ergonomic, and wellness product portfolio.
* Develop go\-to\-market strategies for new international markets.
* Manage partnerships with global distributors and healthcare channels.
* Coordinate with regulatory and compliance teams to ensure smooth market entry.
* Work closely with Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, and Marketing for international business execution.
* Lead pricing strategy, product positioning, and competitive benchmarking across markets.
* Explore opportunities on international B2B and B2C marketplaces such as Amazon Global, Noon, Walmart Marketplace, etc.
* Participate in international trade fairs, exhibitions, and networking events.
* Track market trends, customer insights, competitor activities, and business performance.

* International Business Development

* Strategic Partnerships

* Advanced Excel \& CRM Tools

* 7–10 years of experience in International Business Development, Export Sales, or Global Expansion.
* Experience in consumer products, healthcare, medical devices, ergonomic furniture, wellness products, or mobility solutions.
* Proven experience in expanding business across regions such as the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Europe, North America, or Africa.
* Experience managing distributors and international channel partners.
* Knowledge of export regulations, logistics, and international trade practices.



**Qualification** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Healthcare, or a related field.
* MBA in International Business, Marketing, or Sales preferred.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* International revenue growth
* New countries launched

* Export order value
* Market expansion projects completed

* Opportunity to build Frido's global presence from India.

description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. AI is changing how customers find brands, and Yext gives enterprises the infrastructure to compete: Scout analyzes 10 billion signals monthly across four AI models to surface where you're losing and why, the Knowledge Graph maintains the verified data AI cites, and content generation and distribution agents syndicate brand content across LLMs, listings, social platforms, and review sites in real time. Thousands of brands in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to win across AI and traditional search. Join us and experience firsthand why we are consistently recognized as a Best Place to Work globally by Built In, Fortune, and Great Place To Work®.
   

  

 Yext is seeking an experienced and business\-focused Billing and Revenue Systems Manager to support our core subscription management platforms. Reporting to the Director of Billing and Revenue Systems, this role focuses heavily on functional expertise, business process design, and the optimization of our Order\-to\-Cash lifecycle. You will serve as a key functional leader for the Zuora Billing platform, translating complex accounting and commercial business cases into scalable system configurations. The ideal candidate blends deep, practical knowledge of SaaS billing workflows with strong stakeholder and project management capabilities to bridge the gap between financial requirements and technical execution.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Functional Platform Ownership: Serve as a key internal administrator and functional lead for the Zuora Billing and Revenue platform, ensuring high performance, proper customization, and alignment with industry best practices.
* Solution Architecture \& Design: Design and architect subscription billing solutions, configuring business rules, advanced workflows, and pricing models within Zuora to meet evolving company requirements.
* Business Requirement Translation: Partner closely with Finance, Accounting, and Revenue teams to gather, document, and analyze complex requirements related to automated billing and revenue management.
* System Connectivity \& Logic: Bridge business processes with technical teams, translating enterprise business cases into actionable configuration changes and technical solutions utilizing Zuora's API capabilities.
* Data Integration Support: Collaborate with technical teams to optimize and maintain automated data synchronization and workflows between Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue, Salesforce, and General Ledger platforms.
* Operational Excellence: Proactively monitor platform health, troubleshoot functional billing issues, and spearhead the implementation of system updates and patch enhancements.
* Continuous Improvement: Actively evaluate the latest Zuora platform features and industry trends to continuously optimize system performance and automate manual accounting workstreams.


**What You Have**
* 7\+ years of experience in subscription management and financial systems, with a strong track record of hands\-on platform implementation and team leadership.
* Zuora Functional Expertise: Deep functional knowledge of Zuora Billing (required) and Zuora Revenue (RevPro) architecture.
* Order\-to\-Cash Proficiency: Strong analytical understanding of SaaS workflows, including quoting, invoicing, complex subscription models, and revenue recognition.
* Tech Stack Familiarity: Hands\-on experience navigating interconnected ecosystems including Salesforce and Enterprise General Ledger systems like NetSuite.
* Technical Literacy: Solid foundation understanding XML/JSON or scripting languages (like Python) to effectively collaborate with IT developer resources on API integrations.
* Adaptability \& Leadership: Demonstrated capability to lead projects through ambiguous situations, manage shifting priorities, and seamlessly adopt new financial technologies.
* Communication Skills: Excellent oral and written communication skills with a proven ability to translate accounting needs into clear functional specifications.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management Information Systems (MIS), IT, or an equivalent field.
