Role Overview
 



 We're looking for a
 **Senior Project Manager** 
 to drive global marketing execution with absolute precision, speed, and total clarity.
 



 This isn't a passive tracking role—we're looking for an obsessively detail\-oriented operator with an uncompromising work ethic who sets the operational tempo for the entire organization. You thrive on structure, sweat every minor detail, and hold Directly Responsible Individuals (DRIs) relentlessly accountable across global functions and time zones.
 



 Crucially, you don't just rely on legacy project management habits. You actively leverage AI tools and automation to eliminate friction, optimize workflows, predict bottlenecks, and keep our marketing machine running at full velocity. You own the timelines, the tools, and the operating rhythm, constantly refining them to set a new standard of operational excellence.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 



 Operational Rigor \& Accountability
 


* **Set the Tempo \& Own DRIs:** 
 Establish a clear, high\-velocity operational rhythm. Track every action item to its owner and hold DRIs accountable for milestones and deliverables across global marketing functions, including Creative, Social, PR, Retail, Influencer, Digital, and Regional teams.
* **Obsessive Precision \& Execution:** 
 Build and maintain comprehensive launch calendars, detailed workback plans, status trackers, and dependency maps to ensure flawless execution.
* **Lead High\-Efficiency IMC Syncs:** 
 Facilitate structured, action\-oriented Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC) meetings with clear outcomes, strong accountability, and cross\-functional alignment.
* **Proactive Risk Mitigation:** 
 Identify bottlenecks, dependencies, and execution risks early, taking corrective actions before they impact launch timelines.



 AI \& Workflow Optimization
 


* **AI\-Powered Operations:** 
 Identify, implement, and scale AI\-powered solutions for automated reporting, meeting summaries, predictive scheduling, task routing, and workflow optimization to improve operational efficiency.
* **Systems \& Process Architecture:** 
 Develop standardized ways of working, reusable frameworks, and comprehensive documentation, including project kickoffs, scope documents, execution playbooks, and post\-launch reviews.
* **Tool Mastery:** 
 Serve as the subject matter expert for project management platforms such as Notion, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, and Gantt tools, while driving adoption and best practices across teams.



 Global Alignment \& Continuous Improvement
 


* **Global\-Local Coordination:** 
 Partner closely with regional teams to ensure launch readiness, local market adaptation, and seamless execution across multiple geographies and time zones.
* **Post\-Mortems \& Optimization:** 
 Lead launch retrospectives, document key learnings, refine operational playbooks, and continuously improve future execution standards.



  





 What We're Looking For
 


* **7\+ years** 
 of experience managing large\-scale, cross\-functional marketing projects or complex product launches, preferably within technology, mobile, consumer electronics, or other fast\-paced consumer brands.
* Exceptional attention to detail with a relentless commitment to accuracy, consistency, ownership, and execution excellence.
* Demonstrated ability to lead with urgency, discipline, and a strong work ethic while driving operational excellence across teams.
* Hands\-on experience using
 **AI tools and prompt engineering** 
 to automate project management activities, streamline documentation, summarize meetings, identify risks, and improve operational efficiency.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to drive accountability across cross\-functional teams without creating unnecessary friction.
* Advanced proficiency with modern project management platforms such as
 **Notion, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Jira** 
 , and workflow automation tools such as
 **Zapier** 
 and
 **Make** 
 .
* Proven experience managing global stakeholders and coordinating projects across multiple regions and time zones.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate clearly, concisely, and effectively in a fast\-paced global environment.

**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


The Senior Manager, Business Analyst partners with stakeholders to understand business needs, identify improvement opportunities, and support transformation initiatives through process optimization, automation, and digital capabilities. The role requires good process discovery, transformation consulting, stakeholder management, GenAI use case development, and execution discipline. They will lead completion of cost\-benefit analysis and support design of future state.**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Discovery, Client Management \& Stakeholder Consulting  

Partner with business leaders, clients, and cross\-functional stakeholders to understand strategic priorities, business challenges, operational pain points, and growth opportunities. Build trusted relationships across teams, facilitate discovery discussions, and proactively identify opportunities to improve business performance, customer experience, and operational effectiveness through process improvements, automation, and digital capabilities.
* Process Analysis \& Opportunity Identification  

Lead current\-state assessments through stakeholder interviews, workshops, process walkthroughs, data analysis, and journey mapping to identify inefficiencies, control gaps, risks, and root causes. Evaluate and prioritize AI based improvement opportunities, develop problem statements, and recommend transformation initiatives based on business value, feasibility, strategic alignment, and expected outcomes.
* Automation \& Digital Capability Assessment  

Assess business processes and operational workflows to identify opportunities where AI based automation, digital tools, analytics, and emerging technologies can improve efficiency, scalability, quality, and user experience. Partner with business and technology teams to evaluate solution options, define requirements, assess impacts, and support future\-state process and capability design.
* Business Case Development \& Benefit Realization  

Develop business cases, value assessments, success metrics, and outcome measurement frameworks to support investment decisions and transformation initiatives. Establish benefit realization plans, monitor performance against objectives, and provide leadership with actionable insights on business impact, adoption, operational improvements, and value delivery.
* Stay current on GenAI trends, responsible AI, data privacy, model risk, information security, compliance, and governance expectations. Contribute reusable frameworks and playbooks.  

Facilitate alignment across business, operations, and technology teams while promoting best practices, continuous improvement, and sustainable business outcomes.

 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree / Master's Degree with 10 \- 15 years of total experience
* Extensive Experience in Gen AI: A deep understanding of Gen AI processes and operations is crucial. Practical exposure to GenAI use cases such as knowledge assistants, document summarization, research assistants, workflow copilots, content generation, insight extraction, or decision support.
* Intelligent Automation Knowledge: Familiarity with Intelligent Automation and its application in asset management, process mining, AI\-enabled decisioning, and low\-code/no\-code automation.  

Awareness of responsible AI, data privacy, model limitations, prompt design, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and AI governance.
* Documentation and Template Creation: Strong skills in creating comprehensive documentation and templates.
* Process Simplification: Ability to simplify complex processes and communicate them effectively.
* Collaboration and Communication: Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work with cross\-functional teams.
* Continuous Improvement: Aptitude for identifying opportunities for process improvements and implementing changes.  

Industry Trends Awareness: Staying updated with industry trends and incorporating best practices into asset management processes.

**In\-Office Collaboration**


We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3\) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2\) days per week. description:
**Job Description** 




 Lead and manage end\-to\-end silicon validation activities spanning pre\-silicon correlation, post\-silicon functional validation, system validation, bench characterization, wafer probe evaluation, and ATE test development. Drive silicon quality, yield improvement, characterization, and production readiness while collaborating with Design, DV, DFT, Product Engineering, ATE, Applications, Firmware, and Quality teams. This enhancement aligns with responsibilities reflected in internal validation and evaluation materials.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Post\-Silicon \& System Validation** 



* Lead silicon bring\-up and debug activities for complex SoCs.
* Own functional, subsystem, and system\-level validation.
* Develop validation plans, test specifications, and coverage strategies.
* Drive customer use\-case and scenario validation.
* Perform stress, reliability, concurrency, and corner\-case validation.



**Bench Characterization** 



* Define and execute silicon characterization plans across PVT (Process, Voltage, Temperature) corners.
* Characterize timing, performance, power, thermal, and analog parameters.
* Correlate silicon measurements against simulation models and specifications.
* Analyze silicon variation and identify design/process\-related issues.
* Generate characterization reports for product release and datasheet validation.



**Wafer Probe / CP Evaluation** 



* Manage wafer\-level electrical characterization and evaluation.
* Drive correlation between wafer probe, package test, and system validation results.
* Analyze yield excursions and process\-related failures.
* Support DFT and Product Engineering teams in test coverage improvement.
* Develop screening methodologies and guard\-band recommendations.



**ATE Validation** 



* Collaborate with DFT and Product Engineering teams on ATE strategies.
* Review and optimize wafer sort and final test coverage.
* Validate production test programs and characterization limits.
* Drive ATE correlation with bench and system\-level measurements.
* Support yield ramp, test time optimization, and cost reduction initiatives.



**Leadership \& Program Management** 



* Lead global validation teams and vendor resources.
* Manage schedules, resource planning, risk assessment, and execution.
* Mentor engineers in debug, characterization, and validation methodologies.
* Drive root\-cause analysis and cross\-functional issue resolution.



  





**Qualifications** 




**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 18\+ years in SoC/System Validation, Characterization, Product Engineering, or ATE domains.
* Experience across the complete silicon lifecycle:
* Wafer Probe (CP)
* Package Test / Final Test
* Bench Characterization
* Post\-Silicon Functional Validation
* System Validation
* Customer Support \& Failure Analysis



**SoC Validation Expertise** 



* SoC bring\-up and silicon debug
* Functional and system validation
* Use\-case and scenario validation
* Subsystem validation
* Stress and reliability testing
* Coverage planning and closure



**Bench Characterization** 



* PVT characterization
* Timing and performance measurements
* Power and thermal characterization
* Analog and mixed\-signal evaluation
* Datasheet parameter validation
* Correlation analysis



**Wafer Probe \& Product Engineering** 



* Wafer sort (CP) methodologies
* Yield analysis and yield improvement
* Parametric characterization
* DFT fundamentals
* Screening and guard\-banding techniques
* Failure analysis flow



**ATE Expertise** 



* Advantest / Teradyne platforms
* Wafer sort and final test programs
* Test coverage analysis
* Correlation between ATE, Bench, and System results
* Characterization limit setting
* Production qualification support



**Protocol \& Interface Validation** 



* I3C, I2C, SPI, UART
* CAN/CAN\-FD, LIN, FlexRay
* Ethernet, PCIe, USB
* DDR, LPDDR
* MIPI CSI/DSI



**Debug \& Lab Equipment** 



* JTAG / Lauterbach
* Oscilloscope
* Logic Analyzer
* Protocol Analyzers
* Thermal Chambers
* Power Analyzers
* High\-speed measurement equipment



**Software \& Automation** 



* Python
* C/C\+\+
* Shell scripting
* Test automation frameworks
* Data analytics and visualization tools

 About the role
 


* The Senior Technical Support Engineer represents the highest level of technical expertise Operating from the Bangalore Center of Excellence this role is responsible for resolving the most complex product issues, leading deep technical investigations, and serving as the internal escalation point for the broader support team. title: Expert Technical Support Engineer
description:
Technical Support Engineer
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 We are seeking a skilled Technical Support Engineer to act as the critical link between Level 2 Support and Development teams. The role involves investigating, diagnosing, and resolving complex technical escalations across enterprise healthcare applications and secure messaging solutions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Windows Server environments, SQL Server, HL7 interfaces, and application troubleshooting. This role requires excellent analytical skills, root cause analysis capabilities, and experience managing escalations through to resolution while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Infrastructure \& Database Support
   

  

* Troubleshoot issues within Windows Server environments.
* Utilize PowerShell for connectivity validation, service management, process monitoring, and system diagnostics.
* Manage certificates, security configurations, and Event Viewer analysis.
* Interpret and troubleshoot SQL Server and ODBC\-related errors.
* Monitor, execute, and support SQL Agent jobs.
* Perform SQL\-based troubleshooting and data integrity validations.


 Application \& Integration Support
   

  

* Trace and troubleshoot HL7 message flows and interface\-related issues.
* Investigate message queue backlogs and integration failures.
* Support secure messaging solutions and endpoint connectivity.
* Troubleshoot IIS, ASP.NET, and application\-layer issues.
* Review application configurations and identify root causes across the technology stack.


 Escalation Management
   

  

* Reproduce issues in test and production environments.
* Analyze and classify defects based on severity, frequency, and software versions.
* Gather diagnostic evidence including application logs, SQL traces, network traces, and user recordings.
* Document findings, workarounds, root cause hypotheses, and reproduction steps.
* Coordinate escalations between Support, Engineering, and Development teams.
* Manage incidents through ITSM platforms and track PRBs and defect tickets.


 Documentation \& Client Communication
   

  

* Communicate technical findings effectively to customers and stakeholders.
* Create and maintain Knowledge Base (KB) articles.
* Provide detailed troubleshooting documentation and escalation summaries.


**Required Skills**
 Operating Systems \& Infrastructure
   

  

* Windows Server
* PowerShell
* Windows Services
* Event Viewer
* Certificate Management
* Citrix and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI)


 Web \& Application Technologies
   

  

* IIS
* ASP.NET / .NET Framework
* Application Configuration Management
* Stack Trace Analysis
* Authentication and Security Tokens


 Database Technologies
   

  

* Microsoft SQL Server
* SQL Agent Jobs
* ODBC
* SQL Extended Events
* SQL Troubleshooting and Query Development


 Integration Technologies
   

  

* HL7
* Enterprise Interface Engines
* Secure Messaging Solutions
* Identity \& Access Management Systems
* EHR Integrations


 Networking
   

  

* TCP/IP
* DNS
* Firewalls
* Network Ports
* PKI and Certificate Management


 Tools \& Platforms
   

  

* Azure DevOps
* GitHub
* ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms
* Log Analysis and Diagnostic Tools
* AI\-enabled troubleshooting and automation tools


**Preferred Skills**
* Browser Developer Tools
* Fiddler
* Wireshark
* Linux
* Docker
* Container Technologies
* Microsoft Azure
* Amazon Web Services (AWS)


**Preferred Domain Experience**
 Experience within Healthcare IT environments is highly desirable, including knowledge of:
   

  

* HL7 Workflows
* ADT (Admission, Discharge, Transfer)
* Patient Matching
* EHR Systems
* EDMS/DMR Platforms
* Clinical Workflows and Healthcare Integrations


 Key Competencies
   

  

* Advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis
* Environment isolation and issue reproduction
* Escalation and incident management
* Defect classification and release mapping
* Strong customer communication skills
* Technical documentation and knowledge management
* Cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder management

**Company Description** 
 Wowsly, established in 2017 under parent company WT Technologies, provides technology solutions tailored to the event industry. The platform is designed to make high\-quality event management tools accessible to events of all scales and to organizations of all sizes. Wowsly serves a wide range of users, including individuals, companies, NGOs, government bodies, educational institutions, and corporate offices. By focusing on usability and scalability, Wowsly aims to transform how events are planned and experienced, helping customers deliver more organized and engaging events.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Sales Executive will work on\-site in Ahmedabad in a full\-time capacity, focusing on identifying and pursuing new business opportunities for Wowsly’s event technology platform. Daily responsibilities include prospecting potential clients, conducting product presentations and demos, and managing the end\-to\-end sales cycle from lead generation to closing deals. The role involves maintaining regular communication with existing and prospective customers, understanding their event management needs, and recommending suitable solutions. The Sales Executive will also collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding of clients, track sales metrics, prepare reports, and participate in local marketing and networking activities to strengthen Wowsly’s market presence.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong skills in client communication, relationship building, and negotiation, with the ability to handle objections and close sales.
* Experience in lead generation, pipeline management, and business development, preferably in SaaS, technology, or event\-related services.
* Ability to conduct effective product demos and presentations, both in\-person and via digital channels.
* Comfort with using CRM tools, sales reporting, and basic data analysis to monitor performance and forecast revenue.
* Solid understanding of the event industry or interest in learning how event technology supports different types of organizations.
* Self\-motivated, target\-driven approach with strong organizational and time management skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred; relevant sales experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.
* Proficiency in English and local languages used in Ahmedabad; ability to travel locally for client meetings as needed.

description:
****Entity:****
 Technology
   

  

****Job Family Group:****
 IT\&S Group
   

  

****Job Description:****
**You will work with**
 Trading operations is integral to the success of BP's Trading \& Shipping organization. The operations team coordinates the safe, efficient, and reliable execution of the physical movements into and out of supply chain networks supporting our refineries, branded customer network, and trading business. We play a vital role in moving product between suppliers, refineries, terminals, and customers across all modes of transportation including pipelines, rail, truck, intra terminal movements, barges, and vessels.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to partner with our commodities trading business, to deliver creative technology solutions, adding commercial value as well as achieving our carbon net\-zero goals.
   

  

 We have an exciting and challenging, digital vision to support business growth while redefining the day\-to\-day activities of operators through increased automation.
   

  

 As an engineer on this project, you will collaborate with Product Managers and partners to design, develop and maintain enterprise scale software systems and tools.
   

  

 As part of a global team working on a global product, you will lead one of the squads. This role offers the opportunity to apply your technical expertise to build new features, enhance existing functionality, and ensure the product remains highly reliable. You will be able to share your technical expertise within and externally to your squad.
   

  

 We follow an agile methodology. Multiple squads contribute to the product, and we continuously refine and prioritize requirements to deliver the greatest value to our clients as quickly as possible. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the direction of the product and the technology as the products are adopted by new markets over the coming months and years.
   

  

**The role**
 As Senior Software Engineer, you will be a technical specialist, working within a highly effective team. You will input into project and squad goals, prioritize and complete initiatives, and deliver results in a product\-led environment. You will help create and maintain, a safe and collaborative culture, in which your software development and engineering experience will be important for success in this role.
   

  

****What You Will Deliver****
* Collaborate with the product leads and other technical leads to understand requirements, estimation and help refine roadmap.
* Help maintain a high technical bar for the team both in code quality as well as testing coverage, monitoring and observability.
* Deliver customer value iteratively, serve as a technical lead, and own projects end\-to\-end. Communicating status and changes to partners, designing test automation, and collaborating with internal and external teams to bring new platforms to market are key responsibilities.
* Maintain and enhance software frameworks and participate in code reviews, and resolve platform\-related issues.
* Support and assist during production issues.
* Support audit teams for security, software licensing, and regulatory audits, and implement new controls and procedures to address compliance gaps or risks.


**What you will need to be successful (experience and qualifications)**
* Self\-starter with excellent communication skills, adept at handling ambiguity, navigating uncertainty, and influencing peers through to senior leadership.
* Strong experience working on the backend of a technology product.
* Strong experience in Java, Spring Boot Microservices including: writing unit tests (JUnit/Mockito), working with JPA/Hibernate, and debugging distributed applications.
* Some experience with React or another modern frontend framework.
* Solid understanding of SQL and relational database design.
* Ideally experience with Kubernetes and AWS, including containerised deployment of JEE applications.
* Experience working within a full stack team using agile delivery practices.
* Skilled in troubleshooting large\-scale distributed production systems.
* Product\-centric mindset with the ability to understand business needs and design scalable, resilient systems and solutions.
* Strong empathy and curiosity to create exceptional user experiences.


****Skills:****
**Core Technical Skills**
* Java (8\+) and JEE — advanced proficiency including concurrency, design patterns, and performance tuning
* RESTful API design and development
* Microservices architecture and design
* PostgreSQL — query optimisation, indexing, schema design, and stored procedures
* Relational data modelling and database design
* Unit testing, integration testing, and TDD (JUnit, Mockito)
* Object\-oriented design and SOLID principles


**Cloud \& Infrastructure**
* AWS cloud services — EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, S3, Lambda, IAM
* Kubernetes and container orchestration (Docker, Helm)
* CI/CD pipeline design and management (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent)
* Configuration management and release management
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation — desirable)


**Software Engineering Practices**
* Secure development and OWASP best practices
* Source control and code management (Git, branching strategies)
* Software design and development (clean code, code reviews)
* Service operations and resiliency (fault tolerance, circuit breakers, observability)
* Metrics definition, instrumentation, and monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent)
* Scripting (Bash, Python — for automation and tooling)


**Architecture \& Solution Design**
* Distributed systems design and architecture
* Architectural awareness and contribution to solution design
* NoSQL data modelling (desirable — DynamoDB or similar AWS\-native services)
* Risk identification and technical risk management
* Emerging technology awareness relevant to trading and data platforms


**Collaboration \& Leadership**
* Mentoring and coaching junior and mid\-level engineers
* Agile and Scrum delivery practices
* Documentation and knowledge sharing
* Communication and stakeholder engagement across business and technology
* Product\-centric mindset — translating business needs into scalable technical solutions
* Self\-starter, comfortable navigating ambiguity and influencing across seniority levels


**Domain Knowledge (Desirable)**
* Understanding of physical commodity trading, planning, or scheduling workflows
* Familiarity with trade lifecycle, contractual obligations, or supply chain operations
* Experience working in regulated or enterprise financial/energy trading environments

We do not discriminate on the basis of protected characteristics like race, religion, colour, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to bp’s recruiting process (e.g., accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc.). If you would like to request an adjustment/accommodation related to the recruitment process, please contact us.
   

  

 If you are selected for a position and depending upon your role, your employment may be contingent upon adherence to local policy. This may include pre\-placement drug screening, medical review of physical fitness for the role, and background checks.
   

  

**About Bp**

Company Description Blend is a premier AI services provider, committed to co-creating meaningful impact for its clients through the power of data science, AI, technology, and people. With a mission to fuel bold visions, Blend tackles significant challenges by seamlessly aligning human expertise with artificial intelligence. The company is dedicated to unlocking value and fostering innovation for its clients by harnessing world-class people and data-driven strategy. We believe that the power of people and AI can have a meaningful impact on your world, creating more fulfilling work and projects for our people and clients. For more information, visit  www.blend360.com . 
 Job Description We are looking for a  Lead AI Engineer  to help shape and build the next generation of  Agentic AI and AI-powered engineering systems  at Blend360. This is  not a traditional GenAI or chatbot development role . We are looking for an experienced software/AI engineer who understands how to build  production-grade agentic systems  and, importantly, how to leverage  Agentic Engineering as part of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) . You will work across AI engineering, software architecture, agent orchestration, LLM applications, developer productivity, and AI-assisted software development. You will help establish engineering practices around  AI agents, context engineering, tool use, evaluations, autonomous task execution, and AI-augmented development workflows . The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building and operating real-world Agentic AI systems. 
 What You'll Do Agentic Engineering & AI-Augmented SDLC Drive the adoption of  Agentic Engineering practices across the software development lifecycle , using AI agents to augment and automate engineering workflows. Leverage tools and approaches such as  Claude Code, Claude Code Skills, PI, Hermes Agent , and comparable AI coding/engineering agents as part of day-to-day software development. Build AI-assisted workflows covering  requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, refactoring, testing, debugging, documentation, code review, and deployment . Design agent workflows capable of understanding large codebases, managing context, using tools, executing multi-step engineering tasks, and recovering from failures. Establish best practices around  context management, context engineering, tool calling, agent orchestration, guardrails, human-in-the-loop workflows, and autonomous task execution . Design and implement  Evals  to measure agent correctness, reliability, code quality, task completion, regression, and overall effectiveness. Continuously evaluate emerging agentic coding tools and techniques and identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and software quality. Production-Grade Agentic AI Architect and develop  multi-agent and agentic systems  capable of performing complex, multi-step tasks in production environments. Design agent architectures involving  planning, reasoning, tool use, memory/context, execution, reflection, validation, and error recovery . Build agents that integrate with APIs, databases, enterprise systems, developer tools, and other external services. Develop reliable  tool-use and MCP-based integrations  where appropriate. Build production-grade LLM applications using frameworks such as  LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent orchestration frameworks . Implement RAG, semantic search, vector retrieval, structured outputs, and other LLM application patterns where required. Establish appropriate  observability, evaluation, monitoring, security, and guardrails  for agentic applications. Software Engineering & Architecture Provide technical leadership across the design and development of AI-powered software products and platforms. Apply strong software engineering principles including  system design, modular architecture, API design, scalability, reliability, testing, CI/CD, and maintainability . Build production-quality services and APIs using technologies such as  Python, FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms . Work closely with engineering, product, data, and client teams to translate complex business problems into scalable technical solutions. Conduct technical design reviews and provide mentorship to other AI/software engineers. Establish engineering standards and best practices for building AI and agentic applications. Leadership & Innovation Act as a technical leader for Agentic AI initiatives and influence architecture and engineering decisions across teams. Mentor engineers on  AI engineering, agentic architectures, software engineering practices, and AI-assisted development . Stay current with rapidly evolving AI coding agents, agent frameworks, LLM capabilities, evaluation methodologies, and engineering practices. Prototype emerging technologies and transition successful approaches into reliable production solutions. Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities where Agentic AI can deliver measurable business and engineering value. 
 Qualifications Must Have 6+ years of software engineering / AI engineering experience , with strong hands-on development experience. Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience building  production-grade applications and services . Demonstrable experience building  production-grade Agentic AI systems , beyond simple chatbots or basic RAG applications. Strong understanding of  Agentic Evaluation / Agent Evals , including designing evaluation frameworks for autonomous and multi-agent systems. Experience creating  evaluation datasets, test scenarios, metrics, automated regression tests, and quality gates  for agentic applications. Ability to evaluate agents beyond final-answer accuracy, including  planning, tool use, reasoning trajectory, context handling, reliability, safety, latency, cost, and task completion . Strong hands-on experience with  Python  and modern backend/API development. Experience with  LLMs, GenAI, agent orchestration, tool calling, and RAG . Experience with agent frameworks such as  LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Google ADK, or equivalent . Strong understanding of  multi-agent architectures, planning, reasoning, context management, tool use, memory, and agent execution . Experience working with  Evals / evaluation frameworks  to measure and improve AI/agent performance. Experience with  cloud, containers, CI/CD, APIs, databases, and production deployments . Strong understanding of software architecture, debugging, testing, scalability, and production engineering practices. Agentic Engineering Critical Requirement The candidate should have practical exposure to  using AI agents as engineering tools within the SDLC , not simply developing AI applications. Experience with tools such as: Claude Code / Claude Code Skills PI Hermes Agent AI coding agents or comparable agentic development platforms is highly valuable. Candidates should understand how to use these tools for activities such as: Context management code generation repository understanding implementation testing debugging code review evaluation iteration 
 Nice to Have Experience with  MCP (Model Context Protocol)  and building MCP servers/tools. Experience with  Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama, or other frontier models . Experience with  AWS, Azure, or GCP . Experience with  Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, and cloud-native architectures . Experience with  LLM observability and tracing . Experience with tools such as  Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, or similar . Experience implementing  automated agent evaluations, regression testing, and quality gates . Experience with distributed systems and scalable AI inference. Experience working in consulting/client-facing environments. 
 Additional Information What Success Looks Like In this role, you will: Build and scale  production-grade Agentic AI systems , not just prototypes or chatbots. Help Blend360 adopt  Agentic Engineering across the SDLC . Improve developer productivity through AI-assisted engineering workflows. Establish repeatable approaches for  context engineering, agent orchestration, tool use, and Evals . Help teams safely adopt AI coding agents such as  Claude Code, PI, Hermes Agent, and emerging equivalents . Raise the engineering quality, reliability, and scalability of AI solutions delivered to clients. Mentor engineers and become a technical authority in  Agentic AI Engineering .

description:
**Description**
 Trintech is the leader in AI Financial Close Management, helping finance and accounting teams transform the way they work by eliminating manual burdens, strengthening controls, and empowering strategic decision\-making.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Software Architect** 
 to own the technical architecture of the
 **Platform Team** 
 at Trintech’s AI Platform. The Platform Team builds the foundational capabilities that all AI agents depend on — security and IAM infrastructure, multi\-tenant architecture, cross\-agent workflow orchestration, governance framework, billing and metering engine, and the agent marketplace. You report to the Director of Engineering and are the senior technical IC for the Platform Team. Your design decisions define the security posture, tenancy boundaries, API contracts, and event\-driven backbone of the entire platform. The right person reasons from first principles on security architecture, system design, and multi\-tenant SaaS patterns. Cloud\-native production experience required; Azure preferred. This is a
 **hands\-on delivery role, not an advisory one** 
 .
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Platform Architecture Ownership**
* Own the end\-to\-end technical architecture of the Platform Team — security and IAM layer, multi\-tenant data architecture, event\-driven backbone, API gateway design, and compliance framework.
* Design the security architecture — defence\-in\-depth, federated authentication, OAuth 2\.0 flows, token management, and identity propagation across the platform. Own the security posture of the platform layer.
* Own the multi\-tenant data architecture — tenant isolation strategy, data partitioning, shared vs. dedicated resource models, and cross\-tenant security boundaries.
* Design the event\-driven backbone — message ordering guarantees, delivery semantics, workflow orchestration patterns, and cross\-agent handover contracts. Own immutable data and append\-only event design as the engineering foundation for audit and compliance.
* Define the API gateway architecture — gateway policies, API\-first design principles, API maturity model, and how platform capabilities are exposed to agent consumers.


**Hands\-On Technical Delivery**
* Commit to code — build foundational platform components, review critical PRs, lead design sessions, and set the engineering quality bar through example.
* Collaborate with the Agent Stream Architect on boundaries — what the platform provides, what events agents must emit, and how platform capabilities are consumed.
* Ensure platform capabilities are designed for resilience — failure isolation, retry strategies, bulkhead patterns, and graceful degradation.


**Standards \& Quality**
* Define platform engineering standards — API contract design, event schema governance, security control implementation, and compliance\-grade system design.
* Define code quality standards for the Platform Team — what well\-structured, testable, and observable platform code looks like. Platform EM enforces; Architect defines.
* Identify architectural risks proactively — security gaps, scalability bottlenecks, and dependency failures that could affect agent squads.


**Who You Are**
**Security Architecture — Primary Gate**
* Security architecture from first principles — defence\-in\-depth design, OAuth 2\.0, federated authentication, token lifecycle, and identity propagation across a multi\-tenant platform. Understands attack surfaces and defence patterns from engineering fundamentals, not just tool configuration. Owns the security posture of the platform layer.


**Multi\-Tenant SaaS \& System Design — Primary Gate**
* Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture at production scale — tenant isolation strategy, data partitioning, shared vs. dedicated resource models, and cross\-tenant security boundaries. Has designed and operated multi\-tenant systems in production.
* System design at high and low level — owns all Platform Team architecture decisions. Component boundaries, data contracts, failure modes, resilience patterns, and scalability trade\-offs.


**Experience**
* Event\-driven architecture and workflow orchestration — production experience with at least one orchestration tool (Temporal, Azure Service Bus, Kafka, or equivalent). Message ordering guarantees, delivery semantics, and cross\-agent handover contract design.
* Immutable data design and append\-only event patterns — designing systems where every action is traceable, tamper\-evident, and queryable. The engineering foundation for audit and compliance.
* API gateway in depth — one tool in production. API\-first design, API maturity model, gateway policies, rate limiting, and how platform capabilities are exposed to agent consumers.
* Cloud\-native on at least one public cloud — Azure preferred: Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, CI/CD, and continuous release practices. SQL and NoSQL databases at production scale: data modelling, schema design, and query optimisation.


**Awareness**
* Agent orchestration patterns — Agent Stream Architect owns this layer; sufficient awareness to design platform capabilities that agents can consume correctly. Distributed systems at working depth: enough to design platform services that scale and fail gracefully.
* LLM tooling concepts — what the platform must support for agents to operate on it.


**Nice to Have**
* Azure certification — AZ\-305 or equivalent, given Azure is the preferred cloud. Prior experience building audit or billing capabilities — a differentiator, not a gate.
* AI\-native SDLC — familiarity with Human\-led Agentic SDLC practices. Production experience in Python — enables deeper code review and contribution. Not a gate for this role.
* Financial close or R2R domain experience to accelerate ramp\-up on the business context the platform serves.


**What You’ll Learn \& Gain**
* End\-to\-end ownership of the platform architecture layer on a live enterprise financial product — your design decisions define the security posture, tenancy model, and event\-driven backbone that every AI agent team builds on.
* Deep hands\-on experience applying security architecture and multi\-tenant SaaS design from first principles in a production context where correctness under adversarial conditions, compliance, and scalability are all non\-negotiable.
* Exposure to building governance, billing, and marketplace infrastructure for an enterprise AI platform — foundational engineering challenges with direct impact on product commercialisation and compliance.
* Close collaboration with the Agent Stream Architect, Engineering Manager, and Platform Tech Leads in a delivery model where your architectural choices are implemented rapidly, with direct visibility into how platform design decisions shape the product.


 If you are an architect who reasons from first principles on security and system design, has built multi\-tenant SaaS platforms at production scale, and is ready to own the architectural foundation that an enterprise AI product is built on — we encourage you to apply.
   

  

*At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values – Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.*

Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.
   

  





 Join us to transform the way the world works.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 LinkedIn Learning Solutions Engineering India is a ground\-up, AI\-first org building scalable systems and consumer\-grade experiences that connect skills, learning, career growth, and internal mobility across LinkedIn Learning and the enterprise Career Hub. Engineers own end\-to\-end delivery across web, mobile, backend, data, and AI \- designing architectures for skills intelligence, skill\-gap detection, personalized recommendations, workforce transformation, and internal mobility—while shaping engineering standards, culture, and hiring in a greenfield environment with LinkedIn’s scale.

What started as a learning platform has evolved into a much broader vision: helping organizations understand, develop, and transform workforce capabilities at scale. Our new Learning Solutions Engineering charter is going to be built ground\-up from India exclusively and is building AI\-powered experiences that connect skills, learning, career growth, and internal mobility.
   

  





 The Learning Solutions Engineering team is being built to drive this next chapter. This is a rare opportunity to join a business that already serves millions of professionals globally while helping shape the future of AI\-powered workforce transformation.
   

  





 This role will be based in Bengaluru, India.
   

  





 At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

**About the role:** 
  

  

 A Software Engineer III is an individual contributor who delivers production\-quality software for well\-defined components or features within a product or service. They work with guidance from senior engineers to translate requirements into maintainable, secure, and reliable systems that support customer and business outcomes. They are developing deeper knowledge of the systems within their team and contribute to engineering quality, operational health, and team collaboration while continuing to build their technical expertise.
   

  

**Requirements**

* Experience translating ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions

* Understanding of system design and domain modelling (SOLID, design patterns, API design)

**Technical Excellence**

* Builds software with foundations in performance, resilience, extensibility, and security following the Secure SDLC
* Applies testing strategies that support deployment confidence and align with the Service \& Operational Level Agreements
* Contributes to incremental improvements to code quality, testing, or development workflows.
* Writes clean, maintainable code and participates actively in peer code reviews
* Learns and applies team standards, design patterns, and engineering practices.
* Solves well\-defined technical problems with support from more experienced engineers.

**Operational Excellence**
* Supports the operational health of services and components within their team.
* Uses logs, monitoring, and metrics to help diagnose issues.
* Builds systems with operational considerations in mind, including reliability and recoverability.
* Participates in incident response and post\-incident reviews with guidance.

* Contributes to reducing technical debt and improving maintainability in assigned areas.

**Product Delivery \& Business Impact**
* Implements well\-defined requirements into working software features.
* Works with senior engineers to break down tasks and deliver incremental improvements.
* Delivers high\-quality software with predictable cycle times and low change failure rates under guidance.
* Collaborates with Product and Engineering to ensure solutions align with user and business outcomes.
* Raises delivery risks early and seeks guidance to resolve them.
* Contributes to simplifying implementation and improving code maintainability.
* Contributions support team delivery goals and product reliability


**Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Takes ownership of components or small features within a product or platform team.
* Communicates progress and technical topics clearly within the team.
* Seeks feedback and incorporates guidance from senior engineers and technical leads.
* Builds strong working relationships within the team and with close cross\-team partners.
* Demonstrates accountability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.
* Begins mentoring more junior engineers or new team members where appropriate.


**Why join us?**

title: Senior Software Engineer - Golang
description:
**Job Type**
 Full\-time
   

  

**Description**
**About CloudBees**
 CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.
   

  

 Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.
   

  

 CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control\-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.
   

  

 Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta\-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
   

  

 Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Work with your team to design, develop, and deploy secure, scalable and reliable server\-side applications and services.
   

  

* Develop and own microservices using Golang, ensuring they are performant, observable, and built for long\-term maintainability.
* Ensure high test coverage for all code, including unit and integration tests.

* Ability to leverage the expertise of others to facilitate professional growth and know when to seek assistance.
* Strong experience with LLM for coding.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

 Electronic Arts creates next\-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

 We are hiring a Sr Software Engineer, AI\-Native Operations Platform to technically own and scale GameKit Assistant and the broader AI operations platform.
   

  

 This is a global technical leadership role based in India.
   

  

 The Sr Software Engineer will lead architecture, engineering standards, roadmap sequencing, technical delivery outcomes, and mentorship across globally distributed teams.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced hands\-on technical lead with a background in architecting high\-scale backend environments and complex distributed systems. You have direct production experience with Generative AI and understand that an assistant must be performant, user\-centric, secure, and built upon a foundation of operational trust.
   

  

 You will report to Sr. Manager, Software Engineering and will be an individual contributor.
   

  

 Important Responsibilities
   

  

 You will lead the architecture and technical roadmap for GameKit Assistant and EA's AI\-native operations platform.
   

  

 You will build scalable platform capabilities across conversational support, knowledge operations, workflow automation, incident orchestration, evaluation, and service intelligence.
   

  

 You will improve the assistant experience so responses are concise, contextual, relevant, and low\-noise.
   

  

 You will lead production AI capabilities including RAG, hybrid search, LLM evaluation, prompt/version management, guardrails, observability, and hallucination detection.
   

  

 You will design reliable backend systems and integrations across Jira, PagerDuty, GitLab, Perforce, Shift, JaaS, TestRail, Grafana, AKS, PostgreSQL, and Azure AI services.
   

  

 You will establish engineering standards for architecture, service reliability, action safety, observability, release quality, and incident readiness.
   

  

 You will mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, technical guidance, and hands\-on leadership.
   

  

 You will convert operational friction, support patterns, and platform signals into reusable automation and intelligence capabilities.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* 12\+ years building and operating large\-scale backend, distributed, developer, automation, or enterprise platforms.
* Hands\-on proficiency in Python, Java, Go, Scala, or similar backend languages.
* Production work with Generative AI, RAG, LLM integrations, vector search, evaluation, guardrails, observability, and AI\-enabled automation.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, APIs, event\-driven systems, databases, queues, caching, CI/CD, telemetry, and distributed tracing.
* Apply reliability patterns including retries, idempotency, rate limits, circuit breakers, async processing, rollout safety, and incident response.
* Design secure enterprise integrations with identity, permissions, auditability, and operational safety.
* 5\+ years of experience setting technical direction, reviewing complex designs, mentoring engineers, and leading delivery across distributed teams.
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.


**Additional Qualifications**
* Background in platform engineering, SRE, cloud infrastructure, developer productivity, enterprise automation, SaaS, or similar environments.
* Built or contributed to AI\-enabled support, orchestration, incident, knowledge, service intelligence, or developer assistant platforms.
* Familiarity with conversational UX, support automation, ticketing, incident workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop systems, or action\-based assistants.
* Familiarity with Azure, AKS, Azure OpenAI, PostgreSQL, Grafana, ArgoCD, GitLab, PagerDuty, or comparable technologies.
* Work with distributed teams and simplify complex systems while allowing others to deliver.


**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

title: Senior AI Engineer, KYC Operations - Vice President
description:
**Position Overview**
 We are seeking a Senior Experienced AI Engineer to lead the design, prototyping, and delivery of GenAI\-enabled automation solutions across banking operations. This role is intended for a hands\-on engineering leader who can translate complex operational workflows into secure, scalable, and auditable AI solutions while operating with the maturity expected of a Vice President\-equivalent role in a banking environment.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine deep software engineering capability, practical LLM implementation experience, strong stakeholder management, and sound judgment around risk, compliance, data privacy, and model governance. The role requires ownership beyond coding: the engineer will define solution approaches, Operations team, influence business stakeholders, establish engineering standards, and help move high\-value prototypes toward pilot and production readiness.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* AI solution ownership — Own the end\-to\-end engineering lifecycle for GenAI and automation initiatives, from process discovery and feasibility assessment through prototype, pilot, production handover, and operational support.
* Banking process automation — Analyse complex banking workflows across operations, compliance, risk, servicing, KYC and reporting to identify high\-impact automation opportunities.
* GenAI and agentic system design — Design LLM\-powered workflows, RAG\-based solutions, autonomous or semi\-autonomous agents, prompt chains, tool\-calling patterns, and human\-in\-the\-loop review mechanisms.
* Rapid prototyping and MVP delivery — Build functional prototypes and MVPs using leading LLM platforms such as Claude, Gemini, Copilot, OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, or equivalent enterprise AI services.
* Secure integration — Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise systems, APIs, workflow platforms, data repositories, document management systems, and mock or production\-like banking data environments.
* Engineering standards — Establish coding, testing, documentation, version control, evaluation, deployment, and observability practices for AI\-enabled solutions.
* Responsible AI and governance — Implement guardrails for data privacy, PII handling, hallucination control, bias mitigation, explainability, auditability, cost management, and regulatory compliance.
* Model and prompt evaluation — Define evaluation datasets, success metrics, regression tests, prompt scorecards, failure\-mode analysis, and quality thresholds before scaling prototypes.
* Stakeholder leadership — Partner with business, operations, technology, risk, compliance, information security, architecture, and data teams to align solution design with business value and control expectations.
* Mentorship and technical coaching — Guide junior engineers and analysts on prompt engineering, API development, AI implementation patterns, secure coding, and banking\-domain solution design.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 8\-10\+ years of software engineering, AI engineering, data engineering, platform engineering, or automation delivery experience.
* Hands\-on experience building GenAI, LLM, NLP, machine learning, or intelligent automation solutions in enterprise environments.
* Strong programming capability in Python; experience with Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or similar enterprise development languages is an advantage.
* Practical experience working with LLM platforms such as Claude, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent models and AI services.
* Experience designing and integrating REST APIs, SDKs, backend services, microservices, and event\-driven or workflow\-based architectures.
* Understanding of RAG patterns, vector databases, embeddings, prompt engineering, tool calling, agent orchestration, and LLM evaluation methods.
* Ability to design secure, scalable, auditable, and maintainable solutions suitable for regulated banking or financial services environments.
* Working knowledge of DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, source control, deployment automation, monitoring, and incident management.
* Strong understanding of data privacy, PII protection, encryption, access control, audit logging, and model risk considerations.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade\-offs, risks, and architecture decisions to senior business and technology stakeholders.


**Preferred \& Value\-Add Skills**
* Prior experience in banking, capital markets, lending, payments, financial operations, compliance, KYC, AML, risk, or regulatory reporting.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or AWS, including secure deployment of AI or data workloads.
* Exposure to Lang Chain, Llama Index, Semantic Kernel, agent frameworks, orchestration tools, vector stores, and enterprise knowledge search patterns.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, environment provisioning, observability tools, and production support practices.
* Knowledge of model governance, responsible AI policies, human\-in\-the\-loop design, AI risk reviews, and financial audit expectations.
* Ability to create solution design documents, architecture diagrams, risk assessments, operating models, runbooks, and executive\-ready updates.
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders, leading workshops, facilitating discovery sessions, and translating ambiguous business problems into actionable solution backlogs.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Systems, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise\-grade technology solutions, preferably in banking, financial services, insurance, fintech, or another regulated environment.
* Evidence of hands\-on AI or automation delivery through prototypes, production solutions, repositories, architecture artifacts, case studies, or demos.
* Ability to operate independently with limited supervision, manage competing priorities, and take accountability for solution quality, risk, and delivery outcomes.


**Leadership Expectations**
 This is not a purely individual contributor role. The candidate is expected to demonstrate VP\-equivalent ownership by managing ambiguity, influencing senior stakeholders, guiding technical decisions, mentoring junior resources, and ensuring every AI solution is aligned to business value, engineering discipline, operational resilience, and regulatory expectations.

 Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3\.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5\.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
   

  

 Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy\-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
   

  

 Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9\.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2\.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
   

  

 With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
   

  

**Staff Software Engineer — AI\-SRE**
**About AI SRE**
 AI is fundamentally changing how engineers build and operate software. At Harness, we're building an AI\-native SRE platform that helps engineering teams understand production incidents faster, identify what changed, and automate repetitive operational work.
   

  

 Our Vision Goes Beyond Traditional Incident Management. We're Building AI Investigators That Can Reason Across Deployments, Source Code, Pull Requests, Production Telemetry, Alerts, Documentation, Runbooks, And Organizational Knowledge To Help Engineers Answer Questions Like
   

  

* What changed?
* Why did this incident happen?
* What evidence supports that conclusion?
* What should we do next?


 This role is an opportunity to help define the next generation of AI\-powered developer and production operations tooling while solving challenging distributed systems, backend infrastructure, and AI engineering problems.
   

  

**Why This Role Is Different**
 Most AI applications today are built around answering questions. We're building systems that investigate, reason, and take action.
   

  

 Imagine an AI investigator that understands an incident the way a seasoned SRE would — correlating deployments, code changes, feature flags, production telemetry, documentation, previous incidents, and organizational knowledge to determine what likely happened, explain why it happened, and help engineers resolve issues faster.
   

  

 Building that requires much more than prompting an LLM. It requires designing scalable distributed systems, building intelligent retrieval pipelines, reasoning over complex software delivery data, and creating intuitive developer experiences that engineers trust during high\-pressure production incidents.
   

  

 We're also rethinking how software itself is built. We believe AI will fundamentally change software engineering, and we're looking for engineers who actively experiment with new tools, challenge existing workflows, and help define what an AI\-native engineering organization looks like.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Staff Software Engineer on the AI\-SRE team, you will design and build intelligent, scalable platforms that improve service reliability, incident response, and operational efficiency. You will provide technical leadership across the team, own critical components, influence architecture, and collaborate with Site Reliability Engineers and cross\-functional teams to solve complex production challenges.
   

  

 Harness is building an AI\-native SRE platform designed to help engineering teams understand production incidents faster by reasoning across deployments, source code, production telemetry, and organizational knowledge. This role is critical for scaling these systems to handle high volumes of alerts and complex production Java problems for large enterprise clients.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, highly available AI\-SRE platform services.
* Define technical architecture and author functional specifications and design documents.
* Own critical system components from design through production operation.
* Diagnose complex issues across distributed systems and production environments, particularly involving multi\-source event processing.
* Build AI\-assisted capabilities for incident detection, diagnosis, remediation, and automation.
* Establish engineering standards for quality, scalability, security, performance, and reliability.
* Identify technical debt and scaling risks, then drive improvements across the platform.
* Design and develop REST, gRPC, GraphQL, and event\-driven APIs.
* Partner with SRE, platform, product, and infrastructure teams during incident investigation.
* Define observability strategies using metrics, logs, traces, and actionable alerts.
* Lead technical reviews of architecture, specifications, designs, and code.
* Mentor Software Engineers and Senior Software Engineers through design reviews and architectural guidance.
* Influence technical direction across teams while balancing delivery and long\-term maintainability.
* Evaluate emerging AI and platform technologies and apply them to practical reliability problems.


**About You**
* Experience: 7 to 10 years of professional software development experience building scalable, distributed applications or platforms.
* Core Proficiency: Strong experience with Java
* Leadership: Proven experience leading the architecture and delivery of complex, production\-critical systems without relying on direct authority.
* Technical Depth: Deep understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, resiliency, failure handling, data structures, and algorithms.
* System Design: Experience designing REST, gRPC, GraphQL, and asynchronous service integrations.

* Operations Mindset: Experience with observability, incident management, and participating in on\-call rotations to resolve complex production issues.
* Execution: A strong bias for execution while maintaining high standards for quality and reliability.


**Product Thinking**
 We value engineers who think beyond implementation.
   

  

**You Should Enjoy**

* Challenging assumptions and exploring creative solutions
* Collaborating closely with Product to shape what gets built — not just how it's built
* Building products that engineers genuinely love using


**AI\-SRE Specialization**
 Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly preferred:
   

  

* AIOps \& Intelligent Observability: Automated incident response or using telemetry data to detect anomalies and identify root causes.
* Generative AI: Working with Large Language Models (LLMs), agents, or Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG).

description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365, all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors, including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil, and Goldman Sachs, and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

**We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @rippling.com addresses.**
**About Monetization Platform**
 The Monetization Platform team owns the systems behind how Rippling
 ****sells, contracts, bills, collects, and recognizes revenue****
 across products and countries.
   

  

 The team owns the platform behind the complete monetization lifecycle:
   

  

****Quote → Contract → Entitlement → Subscription → Usage → Bill → Revenue****
 These systems support a
 ****$1B\+ sales base****
 , manage entitlements, metering, and usage\-based billing rules, and enable localized billing as Rippling launches into new countries.
   

  

 As Rippling continues to introduce new products, pricing models, packaging structures, and markets, the Monetization Platform provides the common infrastructure that allows teams to move quickly without rebuilding monetization logic each time.
   

  

 Our vision is simple:
   

  

*****Let any team monetize any product, anywhere, without writing code.*****
 This is a platform for engineers who enjoy solving foundational problems where correctness matters, abstractions need to last, and the impact extends far beyond a single product or team.
   

  

****The opportunity****
* Rippling's product portfolio is expanding rapidly across HR, IT, Finance, and new product categories.
* Every new product introduces monetization complexity: what a customer purchased, what they are entitled to use, how their subscription evolves, how usage should be measured, what they should be charged, how payments are collected, and how that activity is ultimately reflected in financial systems.
* We are hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer to provide technical leadership for the next generation of Rippling's Monetization Platform.
* You will own broad, ambiguous, multi\-team technical charters spanning contracts, entitlements, subscriptions, usage metering, billing, invoicing, payments, tax, compliance, and revenue workflows.
* You will work on systems where errors are expensive. Incorrect contract state, entitlement state, usage calculations, invoices, payments, taxes, or revenue records can directly affect customers, financial accuracy, and trust.
* This role combines:
* 
+ Hands\-on backend and platform engineering
+ Org\-level architectural leadership
+ Technical leadership and mentorship
+ Cross\-functional influence across Engineering, Product, Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Payments, Security, and Data

* You will define architecture, make difficult technical tradeoffs, align teams around durable solutions, mentor technical leaders, and help build a platform that allows Rippling to monetize new products and markets faster and with greater confidence.
* This is not an architecture\-only role. You will stay close to execution through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, prototyping, production investigations, and implementation\-level technical decisions.


**What You'll Own**
* Own major technical charters across CPQ, contracts, entitlements, subscriptions, usage metering, billing, invoicing, payments, tax, compliance, and revenue workflows.
* Define architecture for systems requiring strong guarantees around data integrity, auditability, reliability, recoverability, and clear ownership across service boundaries.
* Design durable platform abstractions that allow product teams to introduce new packaging, pricing, entitlement, metered billing, subscription, and contract models without building custom one\-off solutions.
* Lead multi\-team initiatives from problem definition and architecture through technical design, execution, migration, launch, and long\-term operational ownership.
* Define clear service boundaries, APIs, data models, ownership models, and failure\-handling strategies across interconnected monetization systems.
* Make high\-quality technical tradeoffs across correctness, scalability, performance, cost, compliance, maintainability, and delivery speed.
* Stay hands\-on through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, prototyping, production investigations, and implementation\-level decisions.
* Partner closely with Product, Revenue Operations, Finance, Accounting, Payments, Platform, Security, Data, and product engineering teams.
* Identify systemic technical risks early and drive alignment on durable solutions, particularly where customer trust or financial accuracy is at stake.
* Establish engineering standards for critical monetization systems, including testing, observability, incident learning, migration safety, rollout mechanisms, and operational readiness.
* Mentor Staff, Senior, and mid\-level engineers and help grow technical leadership across the organization.
* Raise the engineering bar through strong technical judgment, thoughtful design reviews, clear technical writing, and operational excellence.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Platform leverage: Product teams can launch new products, pricing structures, packaging models, entitlement models, and usage\-based offerings without rebuilding core monetization infrastructure.
* Correctness and trust: Critical contract, entitlement, subscription, billing, payment, tax, and revenue workflows maintain a high standard of data integrity, auditability, and reliability.
* Clear architectural boundaries: Monetization capabilities have well\-defined ownership, APIs, data contracts, and service boundaries, reducing coupling and one\-off implementations.
* Faster product and market expansion: New products and country launches can adopt common monetization capabilities rather than creating bespoke billing and entitlement systems.
* Operational excellence: Critical monetization systems have strong observability, safe migration patterns, effective incident learning, and clear operational ownership.
* Technical leadership: Engineers across teams look to you for architectural guidance, difficult technical decisions, and direction on complex cross\-system problems.
* Stronger technical leaders: Staff, Senior, and mid\-level engineers around you develop greater technical judgment, ownership, and ability to lead increasingly complex initiatives.


**What We're Looking For**
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience, preferably across backend engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure, distributed systems, product engineering, or systems engineering.
* Proven experience operating at Senior Staff, Principal Engineer, or equivalent Staff\+ scope.
* Deep hands\-on engineering foundation with strong coding, debugging, system design, and production ownership experience.
* Experience building and operating large\-scale distributed systems with demanding reliability, observability, and data correctness requirements.
* Strong architecture depth across APIs, databases, data modeling, concurrency, event\-driven systems, service boundaries, reliability, performance, failure modes, and long\-term maintainability.
* Demonstrated ability to own ambiguous, cross\-functional, multi\-team technical initiatives from definition through production ownership.
* Strong technical judgment and the ability to make tradeoffs across product needs, business constraints, engineering quality, and long\-term platform direction.
* Ability to influence senior engineers, product leaders, and cross\-functional stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* Strong mentorship record and a track record of raising the technical bar for engineers around you.
* Clear written and verbal communication, especially when explaining complex technical decisions to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Comfort operating in fast\-paced, high\-ambiguity environments.
* Deep backend programming experience in one or more languages. Python and Django experience is a strong plus.


****Bonus points****
* Experience building monetization, entitlement, metered or usage\-based billing, subscription, pricing, payments, accounting, revenue, tax, or fintech systems.
* Experience building internal platforms used by multiple product engineering teams.
* Experience working in SaaS, enterprise software, HR technology, payroll, compliance, workflow\-heavy domains, or high\-growth product companies.
* Experience with MongoDB or similar NoSQL databases.
* Experience with reliability engineering, incident response, performance tuning, observability, and operational excellence.
* Experience with security, permissions, auditability, compliance, or enterprise\-grade controls.
* A builder\-leader mindset: someone who can define direction, align stakeholders, establish durable architecture, and remain close to execution.
