title: Senior IBM i Administrator
description:
**ASSA ABLOY** 
 is a global leader in access solutions, dedicated to shaping the future of security and convenience. With a rich heritage spanning over 150 years, ASSA ABLOY has built a reputation for delivering innovative and reliable locking and access control solutions. Their diverse portfolio includes well\-known brands like Yale, HID Global, and Mul\-T\-Lock, offering a comprehensive range of products and services to meet the unique needs of customers worldwide. From residential and commercial buildings to critical infrastructure and healthcare facilities, ASSA ABLOY's cutting\-edge technologies ensure safety, security, and seamless user experiences. With a commitment to sustainability and customer satisfaction, ASSA ABLOY continues to drive advancements in access solutions for a safer and more connected world.
   

  

**Summary** 
 : We are seeking a highly experienced
 **Senior IBM i Administrator** 
 to manage and maintain our IBM i (AS/400, iSeries) systems. The ideal candidate will be proficient in day\-to\-day operations, monitoring, and performance tuning, with a strong secondary focus on
 **IBM i security hardening** 
 , compliance, and best practices.
   

  

 You will work as a key member of our IT infrastructure team to ensure system availability, reliability, and security in a mission\-critical environment.
   

  

**Summary Of Responsibilities**
**System Operations**
* Monitor and manage the health, performance, and availability of IBM i systems.
* Execute and maintain backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures.
* Perform IPLs, system saves, PTF installations, and license key updates.
* Schedule, monitor, and troubleshoot batch jobs and job queues.
* Perform daily system checks and log reviews to ensure optimal operation.
* Collaborate with application teams to troubleshoot issues and optimize system usage.


**Security \& Hardening**
* Conduct IBM i security audits and implement corrective actions to address vulnerabilities.
* Harden system security by configuring object\-level and user profile security, exit programs, authority collections, and audit journaling.
* Implement and maintain security policies in line with industry standards (e.g., NIST, CIS) and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, PCI).
* Manage and monitor security logs (QAUDJRN) and intrusion detection/prevention settings.
* Work with internal auditors or external consultants to ensure compliance with internal and external security requirements.
* Review and improve user access controls, password policies, and role\-based authority.


**Qualifications**
 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

**EDUCATION:**
 Preferred undergraduate degree in computer science, information systems or related field and/or equivalent work experience.
   

  

**EXPERIENCE:**
 A Minimum of 5 years related experience in a business production environment.
   

  

**Required**
**TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE and/or ABILITIES**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with IBM i operations and administration.
* Strong working knowledge of IBM i command line and system tools (e.g., WRKACTJOB, WRKSYSSTS, WRKDSKSTS).
* Experience with IBM i security features: user profile management, object authority, exit points, and audit journal.
* Proficiency in backup and recovery techniques using BRMS or equivalent.
* Experience with security auditing tools such as PowerTech, HelpSystems, or native IBM i tools.
* Excellent problem\-solving, documentation, and communication skills.


**Preferred**
* Experience implementing IBM i security best practices and frameworks.
* Familiarity with RPG\-based application environments.
* Understanding of TCP/IP networking and communication protocols on IBM i.
* IBM i certification (e.g., IBM Certified System Administrator \- IBM i) is a plus.
* Experience with high availability (HA) technologies and logical partitioning (LPAR).


**Soft Skills**
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with IBM i platform developments


**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
 Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.
   

  

 As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities.  As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: OT Cybersecurity & Network Engineer
description:
**Join a Culture That Moves Fast — and Brings You With It**
*At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn’t a slogan — it’s how we work. For over 140 years, we’ve improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions — but how we operate as a company.*
*When you join Fuller, you’re joining a team that supports your growth and values your contribution. Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You’ll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that’s actively expanding — a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business. If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it — Fuller is where that happens. Where Growth Never Stops*
**About the Department:**
 The
 **Global PlantLine Services Department** 
 at
 **Fuller Technologies** 
 is a dedicated lifecycle services organization responsible for delivering comprehensive support, optimization, maintenance, and cybersecurity services for customers operating Fuller automation and digital solutions under PlantLine Agreements (PLA). The department provides 24x7 global remote support, proactive monitoring, performance optimization, lifecycle management, and cybersecurity services to maximize system reliability, availability, performance, and business value. With service agreements spanning
 **more than 350 customer plants worldwide** 
 , the department plays a critical role in ensuring operational excellence, customer success, and long\-term sustainability of automation investments.
   

  

**About the Role:
 *OT Cybersecurity \& Network Engineer:***
 You will be part of our 24x7 Global Plantline Service Technical Support Team, responsible for securing, monitoring, and supporting Operational Technology (OT) networks and cybersecurity infrastructure for industrial automation systems deployed across global cement plants. The role includes management of cybersecurity solutions, network monitoring, endpoint protection, remote access security, firewall administration, incident response, compliance monitoring, and customer cybersecurity support activities.
   

  

 The position plays a critical role in ensuring secure and reliable operation of plant automation systems, including process control systems, servers, operator stations, engineering stations, and industrial communication networks
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**OT Network Management**
* Monitor and maintain OT network infrastructure.
* Support industrial Ethernet networks, VLANs, switches, routers, and firewalls.
* Troubleshoot network communication issues impacting automation systems.
* Monitor network availability, performance, and security events.
* Support secured remote access solutions for customer plants.
* Coordinate network changes with plant and customer IT teams.
* Maintain OT network documentation and architecture diagrams.


**Cyber Security Operations**
* Administer endpoint security platforms including Trellix ePO.
* Implement and maintain cybersecurity policies and standards.
* Monitor cybersecurity alerts and security events.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments and security reviews.
* Support implementation of defense\-in\-depth strategies for OT environments.
* Manage antivirus, application control, and endpoint protection solutions.
* Perform periodic cybersecurity health checks and compliance reviews.


**Security Monitoring \& Incident Response**
* Monitor malware detections, policy violations, communication failures, and threat events.
* Investigate cybersecurity incidents and coordinate remediation activities.
* Perform root\-cause analysis and corrective action follow\-up.
* Escalate critical cybersecurity events according to SLA requirements.
* Maintain incident reports and lessons\-learned documentation.
* Support customer audits and cybersecurity assessments.


**OT System Monitoring**
* Monitor health of automation servers and engineering workstations. Monitor Process Expert (PXP), ECS, QCX, historian, and related OT infrastructure.
* Review system alarms, communication failures, and operational events.
* Support proactive maintenance and system reliability programs.
* Coordinate with PlantLine support teams for issue resolution.


**Compliance \& Governance**
* Ensure cybersecurity compliance across managed customer systems.
* Review endpoint compliance and software update status.
* Validate policy enforcement and security configurations.
* Support cybersecurity governance meetings.
* Maintain compliance reports and management dashboards.
* Support implementation of cybersecurity best practices and standards.


**Customer Support \& Engagement**
* Provide remote cybersecurity and network support for global customers.
* Participate in customer review meetings.
* Support incident investigations and customer communications.
* Provide recommendations for cybersecurity improvements.
* Assist sales and service teams with cybersecurity solution deployment opportunities.


**What You Bring**
* A bachelor’s degree in Instrumentation Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related engineering discipline.
* You bring 3–8 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas:
* OT networking
* Industrial automation
* Cybersecurity operations
* System administration
* Industrial Control Systems (ICS)


**Technical expertise**
* OT \& Industrial Systems: Industrial Ethernet networks, OPC communications, automation system architecture, process control systems, Windows Server administration, and virtualization platforms.
* Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing and switching, VLAN configuration, firewall administration, and VPN management.
* Cybersecurity: Trellix ePO administration, endpoint security, application control and whitelisting, malware analysis, incident response, vulnerability management, and security monitoring.
* Tools \& Technologies: Trellix ePO, endpoint security platforms, industrial firewalls, remote\-access solutions, Power BI, Microsoft 365, and OT monitoring platforms.


**Preferred Certifications**
 Relevant certifications are an advantage, including Trellix Certified Professional, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Fortinet NSE, CompTIA Security\+, ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity, Microsoft Security certifications, or CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker).
   

  

*As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.*
**Build a better world**
 Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. Together in our diverse team, we collaborate in an inclusive and supportive environment to discover further ways to economic and environmental success.
   

  

 For further information on Fuller Technologies' business and services, visit https://www.fullertechnologies.com/

description:
At Thomson Reuters, our technology drives global markets and helps professionals around the world make decisions that matter. As the world's leading provider of intelligent information, we want your unique perspective to create the solutions that advance our business and your career.
   

  

**About The Role**
**In this opportunity as a Senior Endpoints Engineer, you will:**
 As a Senior Engineer Focused On JAMF Pro And JAMF Connect At Thomson Reuters, You Will Drive How The Mac Platform Is Architected, Rolled Out, Operated, And Supported. The Work Spans
   

  

* End\-to\-end JAMF leadership: Leading JAMF Pro and JAMF Connect implementations from design through rollout to BAU, including pilot\-to\-global migration programs and controlled change.
* Mac authentication architecture: Defining and implementing Mac authentication strategy — Platform SSO, SSO, MFA, and identity integration with Entra ID or Okta.
* Enrollment, lifecycle, and automation: Designing enrollment workflows (ADE and re\-enrollment), configuration profiles, compliance policies, patching, and self\-service capabilities across the macOS fleet.
* Senior technical support: Acting as L3 escalation for complex macOS issues; developing support artifacts and coaching L1/L2 engineers and the HCL service desk partner to sustain BAU quality.
* Security and IAM partnership: Driving macOS endpoint hardening (FileVault, Gatekeeper, CIS benchmarks) and partnering with Security and IAM on conditional access and identity integration.
* ServiceNow and Service Desk integration: Building workflows between JAMF Pro and ServiceNow for request fulfilment and incident routing; contributing to Now Assist workflows for macOS.


**About You**
 You're a fit for the role of Senior Engineer if you have the following required qualifications.
   

  

* 6–10 years in endpoint engineering, with strong hands\-on experience in JAMF Pro and JAMF Connect — non\-negotiable.
* Advanced macOS enterprise management: MDM enrollment, configuration profiles, PPPC, kernel and system extension policies.
* Deep troubleshooting expertise, including L3 escalation for complex macOS issues across performance, identity, compliance, and platform behavior.
* Identity integration with Entra ID (Azure AD) or Okta — SSO, MFA, conditional access.
* Strong scripting and API experience — Bash, Python, or Swift for automation and remediation; hands\-on with the JAMF Pro API for integrations and reporting.
* Proven delivery track record at scale — pilot\-to\-global rollouts and migration program execution.
* Strong communication and coaching skills for working across IT, Security, IAM, and L1/L2 support partners.
* Experience integrating Intune and JAMF in cross\-platform endpoint estates.
* Hands\-on experience with Platform SSO (PSSO) and password less authentication on macOS.
* Exposure to Nexthink for remote actions and endpoint analytics on macOS.
* Experience operating in regulated or compliance\-driven environments.
* Relevant certifications — JAMF 200/300/400 or Apple Certified IT Professional.


**What’s in it For You?**
* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2\-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office\-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real\-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills\-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI\-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company\-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award\-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work\-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro\-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real\-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.


**About Us**
 Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
   

  

 We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? title: Threat Intelligence Researcher
description:
At
 **Arctic Wolf,** 
 you will not just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you will help lead the change. Our global team is made up of people who thrive on solving complex problems, moving quickly, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We are proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights, and International Data Corporation MarketScape. What matters most is the work behind these recognitions: delivering real outcomes for customers through award\-winning innovation such as our Aurora Platform.
   

  

 If you are looking for meaningful work, smart teammates, and the opportunity to make a real impact in a high\-growth company that is redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you.
   

  

 Our mission is simple:
 **End Cyber Risk.**
 We are looking for a
 **Threat Intelligence Researcher** 
 to help achieve this mission.
   

  

 The Threat Intelligence Researcher will contribute to our Threat Intelligence organization by leading advanced cyber threat intelligence research and translating adversary insights into measurable defensive outcomes. This role focuses on deep technical analysis, adversary tracking, intelligence\-driven detection, and operational collaboration to improve threat visibility, detection coverage, and incident response effectiveness across the organization.
   

  

 As a senior technical authority, this role will shape intelligence methodologies, establish analytical standards, mentor peers, and deliver actionable intelligence that directly strengthens Arctic Wolf’s security operations and customer protection capabilities.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Lead and contribute to threat actor, malware family, and campaign tracking by correlating malware samples, infrastructure, delivery mechanisms, and adversary tradecraft
* Conduct end\-to\-end cyber threat intelligence research aligned with established frameworks such as the Cyber Threat Intelligence lifecycle, MITRE ATT\&CK, and the Diamond Model
* Perform static and dynamic malware analysis across malicious binaries, scripts, and document\-based delivery mechanisms
* Investigate malicious network infrastructure and command\-and\-control activity by pivoting across domains, Internet Protocol addresses, certificates, and related artifacts
* Translate intelligence findings into actionable detection and threat hunting logic using technologies such as YARA, Sigma, and Suricata
* Analyze Windows or macOS internals including application programming interfaces, obfuscation techniques, system calls, and execution behaviors
* Apply advanced open\-source intelligence techniques, pivoting methodologies, and enrichment across multiple intelligence platforms and data sources
* Research Deep Web ecosystems including crimeware\-as\-a\-service and ransomware\-as\-a\-service operations
* Analyze and correlate large\-scale datasets using technologies such as Structured Query Language, Python, or Excel to extract actionable intelligence insights
* Develop automation and enrichment workflows using scripting languages such as Python
* Partner closely with Security Operations Center and Managed Detection and Response teams to operationalize intelligence into detection, triage, and response workflows
* Support Request for Intelligence workflows by delivering timely and actionable intelligence to operational teams
* Provide escalation support for high\-confidence threat events, including enrichment, attribution context, and recommended response actions
* Contribute real\-time intelligence support during active incidents and investigations
* Develop intelligence\-to\-detection feedback loops that improve coverage and operational visibility
* Create scalable intelligence dissemination methods including alerts, intelligence briefs, and knowledge base updates
* Standardize analytical frameworks, intelligence validation practices, and operational research methodologies
* Publish technical research, tradecraft methodologies, blogs, whitepapers, or present at industry workshops and conferences


**You Will Be Successful In This Role If**
* You have 3\+ years of relevant experience and you are recognized as a technical authority within one or more adversary ecosystems such as ransomware, financially motivated crimeware, or nation\-state operations
* You have strong experience in cyber threat intelligence research, adversary tracking, and intelligence analysis
* You have hands\-on experience applying threat intelligence to detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response, or threat modeling
* You have experience with malware analysis tooling, host telemetry, and network telemetry analysis
* You possess strong knowledge of modern threat intelligence frameworks and methodologies
* You have experience translating intelligence into measurable operational outcomes and defensive improvements
* You are comfortable working independently within highly ambiguous and rapidly evolving threat environments
* You have strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills
* You have experience mentoring peers and shaping technical standards within research organizations
* You are passionate about improving intelligence\-driven security operations and defensive capabilities


**Nice To Have**
* Experience publishing threat research, whitepapers, or presenting at industry conferences
* Experience collaborating with external intelligence\-sharing communities or trusted industry partners
* Experience building scalable threat intelligence workflows and operational frameworks
* Familiarity with large\-scale telemetry analysis and data science methodologies
* Experience automating intelligence workflows and enrichment pipelines


**What Success Looks Like**
* Improved detection effectiveness and operational visibility across Arctic Wolf security platforms
* Actionable intelligence that directly strengthens incident response, threat hunting, and detection engineering outcomes
* Measurable improvements in detection coverage and escalation quality through intelligence\-led enhancements
* Reduced response times and increased operational efficiency for threat intelligence support workflows
* Development of scalable methodologies, analytical standards, and intelligence validation practices
* High\-confidence intelligence reporting that improves customer security outcomes and organizational threat awareness


 Do not meet all the requirements? That is okay. We still encourage you to apply. We have many opportunities and are always looking for strong talent.

Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location\-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.
   

  

 At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace United States, Best Places to Work United States, Great Place to Work Canada, Great Place to Work United Kingdom, and Kununu Top Company Germany. Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains a trusted name in the industry.
   

  

**Our Values**
 Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and value the unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. By protecting sensitive data and working to end cyber risk, we contribute to an industry that serves the greater good.

**Role Description**

* Owns the responsibility to ensure that the budget allocated to pentesting activities performed by external vendors, delivers the necessary value and results in a good return on investment.

**Security Operations Engineer 2**
**Role Summary**
 The Threat Hunter is tasked with the proactive identification, investigation, and mitigation of advanced cyber threats within PGC enterprise environments. The candidate will utilize threat intelligence, hypothesis\-driven hunting, behavior analytics, and advanced detection techniques to uncover malicious activities not addressed by traditional security controls.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Conduct proactive threat hunting across endpoints, network, cloud, identity, and email environments.
* Develop and implement threat hunting hypotheses based on emerging threats and adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Analyze security telemetry using platforms such as SIEM, EDR/XDR, Cloud Security, Data Security, EASM, email security gateways, Threat Intelligence, Dark Web monitoring, identity management, SOAR, Case Management, and various log sources.
* Investigating Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) and Indicators of Attack (IOAs).
* Align threat hunting and investigation findings with the MITRE ATT\&CK framework.
* Create and refine threat detection rules, use cases, and behavioral analytics based on threat hunting outcomes and investigations to enhance security monitoring coverage.
* Conduct digital forensic and incident analysis to determine the scope and impact of attacks.
* Produce technical reports and executive summaries detailing threat hunting activities.
* Perform triage, investigation, and response to security incidents.


**Required Skills/Qualifications**
* Comprehensive understanding of cyber\-attack lifecycles and adversary behavior.
* Expertise in the MITRE ATT\&CK framework.
* Experience with SIEM and SOAR platforms, such as CrowdStrike Falcon Next\-Gen SIEM and Palo Alto Network Cortex XSOAR.
* Hands\-on experience with EDR/XDR solutions, including Microsoft Defender and CrowdStrike Falcon.
* In\-depth knowledge of Windows, Linux, Active Directory/Entra ID, Azure Cloud Platform, and networking protocols (DNS, HTTP(s), SMTP, LDAP, TCP/IP).
* Proficiency in Kusto Query Language (KQL), SQL, and scripting languages such as Python and PowerShell.
* Understanding of malware analysis and digital forensics.
* Strong analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
* SOAR Playbook Development


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\-6 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 3 years in threat hunting.
* Relevant certifications such as GIAC Certified Threat Hunter (GCTI/GCTH), GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA/GNFA), MITRE ATT\&CK Defender (MAD – All modules) or equivalent certifications.

**Description**
 Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television? Do you want to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?
   

  

 Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows, movies and live events \- all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows including Amazon Originals and exclusive licensed content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add\-on channels which they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast\-paced, growth business \- available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.
   

  

 The Live Operations Event Support team is seeking Support Engineers to own the operation and end\-to\-end monitoring of linear TV and live streaming events on Prime Video. This role requires strong troubleshooting and networking expertise, with a passion to learn and grow in the OTT live streaming domain. You will work with internal and external partners to ensure video signals from partners are received from various venues, routed through our encoding/packaging infrastructure, and successfully delivered to customer devices. We use tools and consumer devices in fully\-equipped operations centers to monitor every stage of the signal path.
   

  

 Every Support Engineer on this team, is expected to bring an AI\-first mindset—leveraging automation to build intelligent workflows leading to best customer/support engineer experience. You will closely collaborate with engineering teams, serve as the voice of the customer within the live operations organization, and drive efficiency initiatives that measurably improve operational outcomes.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Execute multiple live streaming events concurrently, ensuring our customers have the highest quality experience
   

  

 Make in\-room decisions, organising tasks between service partners, and directing other support engineers working on live events.

 Assist in the training of new support staff as the team grows
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The Live Operations team monitors playback continuously across linear channels and live streaming events using AI\-driven automation alongside traditional broadcast monitoring techniques. Should an issue arise, Amazon has a highly skilled global team of engineers and developers whom our support engineers collaborate with to quickly mitigate and resolve issues, preventing disruption to customers.
   

  

 Support engineers leverage an AI\-first approach to suppress, correlate, and reduce noise—identifying actionable signals from vast data points and communicating these out to stakeholders with speed and precision. You will drive efficiency initiatives by building and refining automations that reduce manual toil and improve response times. Due to the nature of linear TV and live events, the team provides 24\*7 coverage and engineers work across rotational shifts.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our role is to monitor and mitigate on behalf of the customer 24x7 across linear TV and live streaming events.
   

  

 Our primary goal is to deliver a stellar streaming experience across thousands of linear channels and live events to Prime Video customers worldwide, collaborating with content providers and engineering teams to uphold the highest standards. We serve as the voice of the customer within the support engineering organization—championing reliability, driving automation, and continuously raising the bar.
   

  

 We maintain thousands of hours of content per day, measuring success by the number of hours delivered without issues and the efficiency gains achieved through intelligent automation.

* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
* Experience troubleshooting and documenting findings
* Experience with video encoding and streaming media standards
* Knowledge of system, network and OS


**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Manager - Customer Experience and Communications
description:
**About Snapmint:** 




 Snapmint is a leading fintech company redefining access to consumer credit in India. With over 10 million customers across 2,200\+ cities, our zero\-cost EMI platform enables responsible purchases without the need for a credit card across categories like fashion, electronics, and lifestyle. India has over 300 million credit eligible consumers, yet fewer than 35 million actively use credit cards. Snapmint addresses this gap by offering a trusted, transparent alternative grounded in financial inclusion and ethical lending practices.
 



  





 Founded in 2017, Snapmint is a profitable, high\-growth company doubling year\-on\-year. Our founding team, alumni of IIT Bombay and ISB, brings deep experience from companies like Oyo, Ola, Maruti Suzuki, and has successfully built and exited ventures in ad\-tech, patent analytics, and bank\-tech.We are building the future of responsible consumer finance, simple, transparent, and customer\-first.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 Snapmint’s CRM engine is analytically deep and built for measurement. We’re now adding a new layer: a dedicated owner of customer experience, narrative, and insight that complements the numbers with genuine human understanding.
 



  





 As Manager – Customer Experience \& Communications, you will be the voice of the customer inside the lifecycle team. You’ll define how we communicate across every touchpoint, run deep customer research to uncover why users behave the way they do, and translate those insights into sharper messaging, better journeys, and a more empathetic brand presence. This is not a pure analytics role — it’s a creative, research\-led, customer\-obsessed position designed to sit alongside our data\-driven CRM managers and make the whole system stronger
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 ● Customer Experience Strategy \& Journey Communications Own the communication layer across push, SMS, WhatsApp, email, and IVR. Build messaging playbooks for each lifecycle stage — from onboarding to reactivation — and ensure a consistent, human tone across all user touchpoints.
 



 ● Customer Research \& Insights Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to understand user motivations, pain points, and drop\-offs. Bring the voice of the customer into campaign design. Partner with analytics to connect behavioural data with underlying intent, and turn those insights into better messaging and experience improvements.
 



 ● Creative \& Narrative Development Translate data\-led journey maps into clear, compelling, and empathetic communication. Craft the narratives for activation, engagement, cross\-sell, win\-back, and rewards campaigns. Test messaging, tone, and creative approaches through A/B experiments, and refine based on performance and customer feedback.
 



 ● Cross\-Functional Partnership Work closely with lifecycle managers, campaign specialists, product teams, and design. Brief creative needs, review output for quality and consistency, and champion the customer perspective in every room you’re in.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




 ● 3–6 years of experience in customer experience, brand marketing, lifecycle communications, or a similar role where you shaped customer narratives.
 



 ● Strong writing and communication skills — you can craft messaging that feels human, not robotic
 



 ● Experience with CRM or engagement platforms ( CleverTap , MoEngage , WebEngage , or Similar) — you don’t need to build complex journeys, but you understand the canvas you’re working on.
 



 ● Comfort with campaign data and performance metrics — you don’t need to be an analyst, but you can read a campaign dashboard and use it to inform creative decisions.
 



 ● Hands\-on exposure to customer research or insight generation — you’ve run interviews, surveys, or usability studies, or worked closely with researchers.
 



 ● A natural empathy for users and a curiosity about what drives behaviour.
 



 ● Prior work in consumer internet or fintech is a strong plus.

* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills.

 • Strong Canva skills and understanding of digital design aesthetics

 • Photoshop / Illustrator knowledge

 Apply via LinkedIn OR

 Applications without work samples may not be considered.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Associate, Market Research and Insights**
 Do you like working with people associated with an organization that enables flow of knowledge and expertise to our client service professionals around the world? Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you. We are looking for highly motivated individuals with expertise in communications, attention to detail, positive attitude, presence, and ability to interact across many levels to support delivery of projects with Deloitte member firms around the world.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As an Associate, Market Research and Insights in the team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Conduct internal and external research to identify topic trends, support collection scope decisions, and develop insights using internal portals and third\-party research sources.
* Support content curation and repository management by organizing, tagging, publishing, updating, and maintaining content in accordance with approved taxonomy, metadata, governance, and workflow standards.
* Analyze content usage, freshness, gaps, and search performance to support archival, acquisition, and promotion recommendations for collection priorities.
* Prepare reports, dashboards, presentations, process documentation, and training materials to support project coordination and operational improvement.
* Collaborate across knowledge\-sharing channels, communities of practice, and stakeholder groups to support high\-quality content delivery and continuous process improvement.


**The team**
 The team enables Deloitte professionals to access and apply the firm’s global knowledge, capabilities, and expertise in service of clients. Through Knowledge Exchange (KX), Deloitte’s authoritative knowledge destination, the team curates, publishes, and maintains content across key business and industry topics, helping practitioners quickly find relevant knowledge and connect with subject\-matter experts. We also manage repositories and knowledge platforms, acquire proposals and client deliverables, and collaborates with Knowledge Services, Knowledge Managers, subject\-matter experts, and business stakeholders to prioritize and publish high\-quality content across Deloitte.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, Bangalore
   

  

**Shift Timings:** 
 11 AM to 8 PM
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Postgraduate degree or Master of Business Administration with 1\+ year of experience, or bachelor’s degree with 2\+ years of experience
* Degree in Business Administration, English, Mass Communication, Humanities, Library Science, Commerce, Information Systems, or a similar field
* Experience conducting secondary research using internal and external research sources
* Experience supporting content management, content curation, or repository management activities
* Experience using taxonomy, metadata, search, or content lifecycle processes
* Experience creating reports, dashboards, presentations, or process documentation using Microsoft Office applications
* Experience using GenAI tools to support research, content, or process improvement activities


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience with Factiva, Hoovers, OneSource, Thomson, or similar research databases
* Experience supporting intranet portals, collaboration platforms, or knowledge repositories
* Experience with search engine optimization, metrics reporting, or content usage analysis
* Experience with SharePoint, Tableau, Photoshop, or intranet social media tools


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Technical Writer
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 This role as a Technical Writer within the Maintenance Task Creation team, part of Siemens Energy's Wind Power division. The role will focus on two primary areas: the creation and updating of technical documentation for wind turbine maintenance tooling, and the rigorous management of the entire documentation lifecycle. This involves translating complex engineering information into clear, concise maintenance procedures and ensuring all documents adhere to strict quality and version control standards. \*Given the focus on technical content and process control, the ideal candidate will be an experienced professional with a background in technical writing using
 **Arbortext editor and Tech Pub Studio** 
 . \*Apply expertise in topic\-based authoring to produce modular, reusable, and structured content aligned with industry standards. \*Work effectively with 3D models as a key resource, extracting relevant details to enhance technical documentation with accurate and visually compelling illustrations. \*Participate in on\-site validation of maintenance tasks, capturing visuals and feedback to refine final work instructions. \*Proficiency in document management systems such as Windchill and Teamcenter, understanding of engineering change processes, and the ability to work independently are essential requirements for this position.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
 100% Technical Documentation Creation \& Maintenance
   

  

* Author, edit, and update technical documentation, including maintenance procedures, work instructions, and user manuals for wind turbine tooling.
* Translate complex technical information from engineering drawings and specifications into clear, accurate, and user\-friendly content for technicians.
* Collaborate with engineers and subject matter experts to gather information and ensure the technical accuracy and completeness of all documentation.
* Manage illustration and graphic content to support written procedures.
* Ensure all technical documentation complies with internal organizational policies, quality standards, and industry best practices.
* Identify and suggest improvements to documentation processes, templates, and standards to increase efficiency and quality.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Technical Communication, Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Technical Writer, typically 2\-5 years, within an engineering, manufacturing, or technical environment.


**Skills**
* Technical Content Creation
* Technical Writing
* Editing
* Arbortext
* Tech Pub studio
* Windchill
* Document Management Systems
* Version Control
* Change Management
* Quality Management Systems
* Process Improvement


 About Team:
   

  

 This role is a part of Maintenance and Task Creation Team within Siemens Energy Wind Power Division. The team caters directly to the Service engineers and technicians working on the wind turbines by creating maintenance processes and Work instructions for corrective and preventive maintenance. This position offers you to bring your technical writing skills to build Work instructions to be used ultimately by the service technicians in the field. This role also offers you to suggest process improvement in documentation time to technicians.
   

  

 Who is Siemens Gamesa?
   

  

 Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are always looking for dedicated individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
**Here’s a summary of the role:**
 If you enjoy solving customer problems, getting hands\-on with web applications, and digging into issues rather than simply passing them on, this could be a great fit. As a Technical Support Specialist, you’ll support customers using a large SaaS platform, troubleshoot web\-based application issues, communicate clearly over phone and email, identify and reproduce bugs, and work with escalation teams when deeper investigation is needed.
   

  

**Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do:**
* Provide responsive technical support to external customers and internal stakeholders through phone and email, helping them use the SaaS platform effectively.
* Troubleshoot web\-based application issues by understanding the customer’s problem, checking relevant settings and history, testing possible solutions, and identifying whether an issue is reproducible.
* Investigate application errors and determine when an issue should be treated as a product bug and escalated to the appropriate Tier 2 or product team.
* Build strong customer relationships by explaining technical concepts clearly to non\-technical users and keeping customers informed throughout the resolution process.
* Use product documentation, previous support cases, and available knowledge resources to investigate issues and continuously expand your product and technical knowledge.
* Work collaboratively with Tier 2, escalation, Customer Success, and other teams to resolve complex issues and provide a smooth customer experience.


**These are the essentials you’ll need to get an interview:**
* 5\+ years of relevant technical/customer support experience in a SaaS or product environment is strongly valued.
* Hands\-on experience supporting web\-based applications and troubleshooting issues for customers.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving ability, including the ability to investigate, reproduce, test, and isolate application issues before escalating.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence supporting customers over phone and email.
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical users and manage customer issues professionally through to resolution.
* Flexibility to work an EMEA\-aligned shift, currently expected to start around 1:30 PM IST, and to support occasional crossover coverage for America shifts when required.


**It would be great if you had these too, but we’ll support you if you don’t:**
* Experience supporting enterprise SaaS, GRC, governance, risk, compliance, or other complex business applications.
* Exposure to Jira or similar ticket/bug\-management tools, particularly identifying and documenting product bugs.
* Basic SQL/database query knowledge or scripting experience; these are helpful indicators of technical curiosity but are not mandatory.


**About Us**
 Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700,000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. The Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C\-Suite and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice so they can more effectively manage risk, build greater resilience and make better decisions, faster.

Curiosity is in our DNA, we look for individuals willing to ask the big questions and experiment fearlessly \- those who embrace change not as a challenge, but as an opportunity. The future belongs to those who keep learning, and we are building it together. At Diligent, you’re not just building the future \- you’re an agent of positive change, joining a global community on a mission to make an impact.
   

  

 Learn more at diligent.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook
   

  

**What Diligent Offers You**
* Creativity is ingrained in our culture. We are innovative collaborators by nature. We thrive in exploring how things can be differently both in our internal processes and to help our clients
* We care about our people. Diligent offers a flexible work environment, global days of service, comprehensive health benefits, meeting free days, generous time off policy and wellness programs to name a few
* We have teams all over the world. We may be headquartered in New York City, but we have office hubs in Washington D.C., Vancouver, London, Galway, Budapest, Munich, Bengaluru, Singapore, and Sydney.
* Diversity is important to us. Growing, maintaining and promoting a diverse team is a top priority for us. We foster and encourage diversity through our Employee Resource Groups and provide access to resources and education to support the education of our team, facilitate dialogue, and foster understanding.

Our world\-changing idea is to empower leaders with the technology, insights and connections they need to drive greater impact and accountability – to lead with purpose. Our employees are passionate, smart, and creative people who not only want to help build the software company of the future, but who want to make the world a more sustainable, equitable and better place.

If you are within a commuting distance to one of our Diligent office locations, you will be expected to

description:
**Employment Status**
 Regular
   

  

**Time Type**
 Full time
   

  

**BUILDING A WORLD CLASS TEAM STARTS WITH YOU**
 At the heart of CSA Group is a vision: making the world a better, safer, more sustainable place. It's been part of our mission for nearly one hundred years: from the first engineering standard for railway bridges developed in 1919, to more than 3,500 standards, codes \& related products today.
   

  

 Headquartered in Canada, with a global footprint of more than 30 labs and offices across Europe, Asia and North America, CSA Group tests, inspects and certifies a wide range of products \- from every day househould items to leading edge technology\-to meet exacting requirements for safety, performance and environmental impact.
   

  

 Our employees take pride in making a difference in people's lives through the work that we do. We're looking for people like you to help make it happen.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 CSA Group has an immediate opportunity for a
 **Field Evaluations Representative** 
 (f/m/d) to join our Global Field Evaluations Team and to provide services to clients in India.
   

  

 As a one\-time evaluation program, CSA Group’s field evaluation services help manufacturers get their products into the North American market when certification is not a viable option yet proof of compliance to local requirements is still needed.
   

  

**These Are Your Duties**
* Performs technical evaluations of non\-certified equipment at the manufacturing location or in the field to ensure products meet technical requirements and is free of potential for fire and shock hazards.
* Communicates with clients in a professional manner to schedule inspection appointments, review costing procedures, answer questions, and provide technical information service and direction based on the scope of the Field Evaluation program. Reviews submitted technical drawings for evaluation.
* Documents with sufficient detail, technical reports for required alterations to sub\-standard equipment. Reviews details of corrective action with client.
* Performs inspections on emerging technology and/or complex product types and has the authority to make technical and precedent setting decisions.
* Assists in quoting jobs based on technical information and time/travel considerations.


**What We Expect**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related Sciences with 3 years industry experience; or
* Engineering Technology or Associates Degree with 5 years industry related experience; or
* Journeyman Electrician with 5 years industry related experience; or related technical field with 7\+ years industry related experience
* Certification / Lab Testing experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of laboratory instrumentation, as well as general laboratory procedures.
* Knowledge of U.S. and Canadian based electrical standards and ability to apply these standards to local installation requirements and/or codes (eg. NEC, CEC, NFPA 790 \& 791, SPE\-1000, and SPE\-3000\)
* Knowledge of CE Framework, LVD, MR and Machinery Safety and related standards
* Knowledge of HAZLOC, ATEX and IECEx schemes is a plus
* Strong interpersonal skills; self\-starter; good decision\-making skills and organizational skills.
* Technically competent to evaluate all products, including new and unique products, with assistance of other technical staff as necessary
* Ability to manage multiple inspection files and changing schedules and deadlines with supervision
* Ability to use calibrated measurement instruments, high voltage test equipment, hand tools
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and test data
* Excellent communication skills (verbal and written)
* Strong conflict resolution skills to be able to handle difficult situations
* Good command in English language skill written and oral.
* Ability to travel as needed and/or with short notice (up to 75% travel)


**What We Offer**
* Flat hierarchies in a professional and intercultural corporate environment
* Opportunity to work from home and flexible working hours
* Attractive tasks, exciting projects and the opportunity to contribute your own ideas
* Fitness and health program for a relaxed balance to the daily work routine
* Corporate Benefits
* Opportunities for constant training/learning
* Permanent employment

We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on any grounds stipulated by applicable laws. description:
**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)** 
 Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry\-leading climate\-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Summary:** 
 The Technician will support the VAVE team by performing product tear\-down activities, collecting and documenting engineering data, preparing analysis reports, and maintaining technical records. The role requires hands\-on disassembly of products, accurate measurement and documentation of components, and collaboration with engineering teams to identify cost reduction and product improvement opportunities.
   

  

**Tear Down Activities**
* Perform systematic tear\-down and disassembly of products, assemblies, and components.
* Identify, classify, and organize parts for further analysis.
* Record component details including material, dimensions, manufacturing process, and part functions.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of teardown components and samples.


**Data Collection \& Analysis Support**
* Collect engineering data from tear\-down activities, drawings, specifications, and BOMs.
* Measure components using standard measuring instruments.
* Capture photographs and maintain detailed records of findings.
* Create and maintain databases of product components, materials, and costs.
* Support benchmarking and competitive product analysis activities.


**Report Preparation**
* Prepare tear\-down reports, data sheets, comparison charts, and presentation materials.
* Document observations, findings, and recommendations in a structured format.
* Generate reports highlighting component details, cost opportunities, and design differences.


**Team Collaboration**
* Work closely with VAVE Engineers, Design Engineers.
* Support engineering reviews and project discussions with collected data and documentation.


**Quality \& Safety**
* Follow laboratory/workshop safety procedures.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and confidentiality of technical data.


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**
 Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics Engineering or related discipline.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 MS Office proficiency, drawing/BOM interpretation, measurement tools knowledge, documentation and analytical skills.
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
 Experience in VAVE, cost reduction, benchmarking, reverse engineering, CAD and PLM systems.
   

  

**Primary Objective**
 Support the VAVE team through product tear\-down, detailed data collection, technical documentation, and report generation to enable cost optimization and product improvement.

title: Content Developer - Learning Management System
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a skilled content developer to support a range of training programs and digital learning initiatives. This role will assist in instructional design to enhance e\-learning content, analyze learning data, and work closely with key stakeholders to improve the effectiveness of digital learning. This position will also be responsible for managing and delivering new hire onboarding and department specific trainings to employees through the Learning Management System (LMS), ensuring a seamless and user\-friendly experience for learners, instructors, and administrators.
   

  

 This position works in the Talent Management and Learning COE and reports to the Senior LMS Team Lead who is based in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
**E\-Learning Development \& Instructional Design:**
* Design and develop end\-to\-end courseware, including interactive eLearning modules, instructor\-led training materials, simulations, videos, and assessments aligned with defined learning objectives, using tools like Articulate Storyline, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, and similar platforms.
* Create and refine clear, engaging instructional content—including scripts, storyboards, assignments, and assessments—by converting SME\-provided content and technical documentation into learner\-ready training materials aligned with established learning frameworks such as ADDIE and Bloom’s Taxonomy. Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and subject matter experts (SMEs) to develop, implement, and maintain e\-learning courses and training materials.
* Conduct rigorous quality reviews of training content to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with instructional design and industry standards.
* Maintain and manage content updates, version control, and archival processes to ensure training materials remain current and relevant.


**LMS Administration And Support**
* Administer and maintain the Learning Management System (LMS) for a large user base, ensuring smooth operation and a user\-friendly experience.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for global new hires, managing the end\-to\-end onboarding training process and implementing automation to enhance efficiency.
* Coordinate and manage Instructor\-Led Training (ILT) sessions, including scheduling, attendance tracking, learner record updates, and communication with instructors and learners.
* Provide prompt and responsive technical support to learners, instructors, and stakeholders, resolving LMS\-related issues.
* Maintain and organize learning content within the LMS, SharePoint, and content repositories and ensure alignment of content structure across sites, programs, and folders
* Monitor enrollments, completions, and system usage metrics for accuracy and to ensure data integrity within the LMS.


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Create detailed reports and dashboards to measure learner engagement, track course completions, and evaluate training effectiveness.
* Assist with compliance tracking and meet regulatory reporting obligations through accurate data analysis and documentation.
* Keep abreast of emerging trends and best practices in instructional design and e\-learning technologies.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by incorporating learner feedback and performance data to introduce creative and innovative solutions that enhance engagement and optimize the overall learning experience.


**Innovation and Continuous Improvement**
* Keep abreast of emerging trends and best practices in instructional design and e\-learning technologies.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by incorporating learner feedback and performance data to introduce creative and innovative solutions that enhance engagement and optimize the overall learning experience.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Instructional Technology, Information Systems, or a closely related discipline.
* 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in training, instructional design, learning experience design, or content development, ideally in a global or multicultural work environment.
* Proficient in using eLearning development tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise, Camtasia, Adobe Creative Suite, Vyond, or other instructional technologies.
* Strong understanding of adult learning theories and instructional design principles.
* Familiarity with e\-learning standards including SCORM and xAPI.
* Proficient in data analysis and report generation using Microsoft Excel.
* Experience working with enterprise learning management systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms (i.e. Cornerstone, Docebo).
* Strong graphic design and multimedia development skills, supported by hands\-on proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and video editing tools, are highly desirable.
* Proficient in writing clear and engaging instructional content, including copy, video/audio scripts, and learning materials.
* Ability to develop storyboards and design visual layouts for instructional content and user interfaces.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders across the globe.


**Key Competencies**
* Innovation: Creative and innovative mindset, capable of designing engaging and impactful learning solutions.
* Adaptability: Adaptable and responsive to evolving priorities and constructive feedback in a fast\-paced environment.
* Problem Solving: Strong problem\-solving abilities with an analytical approach to identifying and addressing learning challenges.
* Planning and Organizing: Effective time management and organizational skills, with the ability to handle multiple projects and meet tight deadlines.
* Work Standards / Details Quality: High attention to detail in reviewing content for quality, accuracy, and alignment with learning goals.


**Working Conditions**
* The role may require attendance in meetings outside the site's standard business hours, as stakeholders and business representatives are located across multiple time zones.
* This is a hybrid position which requires working in the office 3 days a week.


**About Us**
 Coherent is a global leader in lasers, engineered materials and networking components. We are a vertically integrated manufacturing company that develops innovative products for diversified applications in the industrial, optical communications, military, life sciences, semiconductor equipment, and consumer markets. Coherent provides a comprehensive career development platform within an environment that challenges employees to perform at their best, while rewarding excellence and hard\-work through a competitive compensation program. It's an exciting opportunity to work for a company that offers stability, longevity and growth. Come Join Us!

 We will not pay for unsolicited resumes from recruiters and employment agencies unless we have a signed agreement and have required assistance, in writing, for a specific opening.

 is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100\+ countries make better decisions. Join our world\-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Customer Engineer is our entry point into technical customer success — a hands\-on executor who learns by doing, builds foundational platform knowledge, and contributes to reliable, well\-documented customer solutions. This role works in structured environments under clear guidance, following patterns set by more senior roles. Success here is about learning deeply, executing reliably, and building the habits of quality and repeatability that define great Customer Engineers at every level.
   

  

**What You'll Contribute**
* Analyze recurring and complex customer\-impacting engineering issues and identify opportunities for AI\-driven automation.
* Build AI\-powered tools and workflows that help engineers diagnose, troubleshoot, remediate, and prevent customer issues.
* Develop prompt harnesses and evaluation frameworks to systematically test LLM solutions against real\-world engineering scenarios.
* Work with code, logs, configurations, documentation, tickets, incidents, and other engineering context to build grounded AI solutions.
* Design agentic workflows where LLMs can reason over context, use tools, perform actions, validate results, and iterate.
* Understand and optimize the complete LLM loop: Context → Prompt → Model → Tool → Observation → Validation → Iteration
* Investigate AI failures methodically and improve prompts, context, tools, model selection, and workflows.
* Build prototypes quickly and turn successful experiments into reliable, reusable engineering capabilities.
* Develop automation that can identify patterns across customer issues and surface potential root causes or recommended actions.
* Measure solutions using meaningful engineering metrics such as accuracy, resolution time, automation rate, reliability, latency, and cost.
* Partner with internal engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing tools and workflows.
* Help establish reusable patterns for applying AI to customer engineering problems at scale.


**What We're Seeking**
* Early\-career experience in a technical implementation or customer\-facing role, with a demonstrated ability to translate well\-defined requirements into concrete technical tasks across configuration, integration, and deployment scenarios.
* 4\+ years of experience
* Experience in LLM Application Development: Hands\-on experience building production applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, and function/tool calling.
* Experience in AI Agents \& Orchestration: Experience building agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent, including MCP/tool integrations.
* Experience in Production AI Engineering: Strong Python/software engineering skills with experience deploying, monitoring, evaluating, and optimizing AI workloads for reliability, latency, cost, and security
* Basic working knowledge of enterprise software platforms, APIs, and integrations, with a willingness to develop fluency in FICO Platform, decision management, and related analytics and fraud capabilities.
* Ability to document solutions, runbooks, and support procedures to ensure long\-term maintainability, and to flag early\-stage risks such as data gaps and environment constraints to senior team members.
* Comfortable working within structured team environments under guidance, with clear communication of technical progress and issues to both customer and internal teams.

* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
* An engaging, people\-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

 At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest\-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
   

  

 FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
   

  

* Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
* Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
* Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.


 Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

**Job Description**
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
* Build and expand Emerson’s preferred or exclusive specification status across assigned GECs and product lines.
* Lead early engagement with engineering teams and stakeholders to influence specifications and project outcomes.
* Develop and execute structured account strategies, including playbooks, pipeline visibility, and opportunity mapping.
* Collaborate with global and regional teams to align pursuit strategies, share insights, and ensure consistent customer engagement.
* Guide commercial awareness by supporting frame agreements and tracking specification\-to\-order conversion performance.
* Design and deliver technical training programs to enhance customer engagement and support specification adoption.
* Lead, coach, and develop a geographically distributed team, fostering collaboration and accountability.
* Maintain accurate CRM data, provide regular reporting, and use insights to drive decision\-making and continuous improvement.
* Build strong, trusted relationships with stakeholders across multiple engineering and project functions.
* Develop and maintain a multi\-level training plan per assigned Global Engineering Center, including awareness sessions, product application training, and advanced technical workshops; position training as a strategic specification and preference tool. Review equivalent plans developed and maintained by the Project Pursuit Senior Managers.
* Partner with Global Strategic Account Managers and Global Strategic Accounts \& Specification Managers to align pursuit strategies and deliver consistent stakeholder messaging for Global Engineering Centers.
* Share account intelligence, specification activity, and project pipeline updates with Global Strategic Account counterparts; support and oversee approved vendor list qualification, Global Frame Agreement utilization, and licensor engagement activities at the Global Engineering Center level, serving as the in\-country leadership interface between global programs and the national field team.


**Who You Are:**
 You build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives, while balancing multiple priorities to achieve results aligned with organizational goals. You proactively identify opportunities and take action to address challenges, using data and insights to guide decisions and continuously improve outcomes. You communicate effectively across diverse audiences, adapting your approach to influence and build trust, and you develop people through coaching, feedback, and creating opportunities that enable growth and performance.
   

  

**For This Role, You Will Need:**
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering or a relevant technical field (such as instrumentation, electrical, mechanical, or chemical engineering).
* A minimum of 10 years of related experience required; 12\+ years preferred.
* Experience engaging with engineering teams, EPC contractors, or owner\-operators in industrial automation, instrumentation, or related fields.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical specifications, vendor qualification processes, or project outcomes.
* Experience leading or mentoring individuals or teams, with a focus on collaboration and development.
* Understanding of the project lifecycle from early design through procurement and execution.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, priorities, and projects in a dynamic environment.
* Familiarity with customer relationship management (CRM) systems and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver technical training or product capability sessions to engineering audiences, including drafting structured, multi\-level training plans.
* Experience engaging or coordinating with global or strategic account management teams on shared accounts including aligning pursuit strategies and sharing structured account intelligence.
* Willingness and ability to travel as needed to support customers and team collaboration (approximately 25–30%).


**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**
* Experience working with global or strategic accounts and collaborating across regions or functions.
* Background in managing distributed or cross\-functional teams.
* Exposure to industries such as energy, oil and gas, chemicals, power, data centers, or similar sectors.
* Familiarity with engineering design or specification tools and platforms.
* Advanced education or professional development in business, engineering, or leadership (or equivalent practical experience).
* Experience supervising team members located in diverse locations.
* Experience supporting or executing global Approved Vendor List qualification efforts, Global Frame Agreement utilization, and licensor engagement programs at a local or regional level.


**Our Culture \& Commitment to You:**
 At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
