**Job Role:** 
 Lead \- YT Operations
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai / Kolkata
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  





**About SVF** 




 SVF is Eastern India's largest media \& entertainment company, spanning film production and distribution, music, television, and cinema exhibition — alongside hoichoi, its OTT platform reaching roughly 250 million Bengalis worldwide. SVF's YouTube presence is one of the largest and most active Bengali media footprints on the platform, spanning film, music, and entertainment content watched by audiences across the world.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 SVF is looking for someone to take end\-to\-end ownership of its YouTube operations — how content gets scheduled, optimised, monetised, and protected across a high\-volume, multi\-channel portfolio. This is a role for someone who thinks natively in watch time, retention curves, and metadata, and who can turn a channel's raw content strength into consistent, compounding growth. You'll be the person who knows why a video underperformed before anyone else asks the question — and already has three fixes ready.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own end\-to\-end YouTube operations across SVF's channel portfolio — upload scheduling, metadata, thumbnails, and publishing cadence.
* Lead channel growth strategy, using analytics to drive programming, format, and content\-mix decisions.
* Manage Content ID, copyright claims, and rights\-related issues across the channel portfolio.
* Optimise videos for discoverability — titles, descriptions, tags, thumbnails, and end screens.
* Track and report on channel performance (views, watch time, subscriber growth, RPM) and translate insights into action.
* Coordinate with content, marketing, and rights teams to plan release calendars and campaign tie\-ins.
* Manage monetisation health across channels — YouTube Partner Program compliance, ad formats, and revenue optimisation.
* Oversee community management — comments, community posts, and audience engagement signals.
* Support live\-streaming operations for key premieres, launches, and events.



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications** 



* 5–8 years of experience in YouTube channel management, digital video operations, or OTT/media content operations — ideally managing high\-volume, multi\-channel YouTube portfolios.
* Deep working knowledge of YouTube Studio, Content ID, copyright claims management, and the YouTube Partner Program monetisation ecosystem.
* Strong grasp of YouTube's discovery mechanics — metadata, SEO, thumbnails, titles, and retention drivers — with a track record of measurable channel growth.
* Experience managing publishing and scheduling operations across multiple channels at volume.
* Comfortable using YouTube Analytics and BI tools to track performance and inform programming decisions.
* Comfortable working cross\-functionally with content, marketing, legal/rights, and tech teams.
* Uses AI tools to summarise data, draft documents, and explore process improvements — and knows how to verify and correct AI outputs.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with copyright dispute resolution or MCN\-style multi\-channel network operations.
* Familiarity with live\-streaming setup and management on YouTube.
* Experience running paid YouTube promotion or Google Ads campaigns.
* Comfort with SQL or similar tools for cross\-channel analytics and reporting.
* Familiarity with the Bengali entertainment and OTT content landscape.

Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait**.


We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

 **Job Description** **Job Summary**

Your key focus will be on establishing and nurturing relationships with key opinion leaders, monitoring competitor information, and understanding prescription trends within the pharmaceutical industry. Additionally, you will be responsible for organizing and managing Continuing Medical Education (CME) events and other initiatives to bolster the company's brand image.  

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**  

* You will be responsible for the promotion of the new product. You will be executing the Product Management Team’s marketing strategy, analysing market trends, consulting with doctors on new product potential, and relaying feedback to the Product Management Team. Additionally, responsibilities include identifying key opinion leaders, monitoring product availability, and implementing brand strategies to facilitate a successful product launch.
* You will be responsible for monitoring primary and secondary sales through regular visits to stockists and pharmacies, ensuring the accomplishment of doctor and product\-specific sales objectives. Active participation in monthly review meetings to assess coverage, adherence to SOPs, and expense management, all aimed at achieving area\-level, product\-level, and overall sales targets.
* You will be responsible for focusing on customer relationship management, the role entails establishing strong connections and addressing queries promptly using Infoginip. It also involves customer classification based on potential, determining meeting frequency accordingly, and tracking return on investment per customer to foster a loyal customer base for the company.
* You will responsible to meet Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Key business leader (KEL) frequently and pursue them to conduct CME with the company; Collect interest areas of key customers and hospitals and conduct CMEs on those topics.
* You will responsible to prepare product matrix depending upon doctor's potential \& preference and decide which product will fit doctor's need. Update data on chemist, doctors and Retail Chemist Prescription Audit (RCPA) through palm top to Unnati portal in order to ensure all stakeholders' access to latest information.
 **Qualifications** **Educational qualification\-** Graduate with science background.  

  

**Minimum work experience\-** 6 months of experience in pharmaceutical sales.  

  

**Skills \& attributes**  

**Technical Skills**  

* Basic understanding of pharmaceutical products and marketing
* Experience in implementing and analysing sales and marketing strategies.
* Basic knowledge of Computers.


  

**Behavioural Skills**  

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good at building and leveraging relationship.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong Decision making skills.
 **Additional Information** **About the Department**  

**Global Generics India**  

Global Generics India business journey began in 1986\. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022\). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast\-growing organisation with double\-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti\-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.  

  

**Benefits Offered**  

At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.  

The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining \& relocation support, family support (Maternity \& Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.  

  

**Our Work Culture**  

Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.

description:
**What's Ditto?** 




 At Ditto, we help people understand insurance well enough to make well\-informed decisions — from expert advice to smooth policy purchases to dedicated claim support, backed by our industry\-first no\-spam commitment. Over 700,000 users have trusted us with their insurance decisions, and we hold a 4\.9 rating with 30,000\+ reviews on Google.
 



 Ditto is backed by Zerodha, India's largest stockbroker.
 



  





**The Context** 




 Ditto is scaling fast. Our advisory team alone hires at high volume, and we're opening up roles across marketing, ops, tech, and specialised regional and multilingual hiring.
 



 The bottleneck at this scale isn't screening candidates. It's finding them — reaching the right people in markets where the obvious channels don't work, and building pipelines that consistently deliver on tough briefs.
 



 That's what this role owns.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You'll own sourcing across multiple positions — advisory bulk hiring at scale, non\-advisory specialised hiring, regional and multilingual pipelines. You'll report into the HR team and work closely with hiring managers across departments.
 



 Some examples of what you might own:
 


* **Bulk regional pipelines —** 
 build the sourcing engine for Tamil\-, Telugu\-, or Kannada\-speaking advisor hires — where LinkedIn and Naukri don't get you all the way, and you need to find channels that do.
* **Specialised non\-advisory hiring —** 
 source for niche roles in marketing, ops, or tech where the candidate pool is small and passive engagement matters more than volume.
* **Agency management —** 
 onboard and manage recruitment agencies as an extension of the sourcing function — with real accountability on quality, not just volume.
* **Talent mapping —** 
 build competitor and market maps for recurring and strategic hires, so we're not sourcing cold every time.



 Whatever the role, you own the sourcing end\-to\-end — from strategy to first response.
 



  





**How This Role Evolves** 




 Excel at sourcing and other TA roles open up over time — TA Lead, specialised ownership of bulk\-hiring or non\-advisory hiring, lateral moves as the function grows. That's not the point of the role, it's what tends to happen when the craft is real. If your plan is to escape sourcing as fast as possible, this isn't the right role.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 4–6 years of hands\-on sourcing, with real ownership of bulk or high\-volume mandates.
* Strong craft : Boolean, X\-ray, LinkedIn advanced search, passive candidate outreach. The sourcing toolkit at working depth, not surface\-familiar.
* Experience sourcing across channels beyond LinkedIn and Naukri — regional portals, communities, referrals, agencies. You know where different candidate profiles actually live.
* Comfort managing recruitment agencies as an extension of your own sourcing. You communicate the spec, hold partners to quality, and know when to push back.
* Enough analytical range to read funnel data and diagnose what's not converting.
* Bias toward finding talent where others can't. That's the muscle we're hiring for.



  





**A note on what this role is not** 




 This is not a coordination or scheduling role. If you want to run interview logistics and calendar management, this will frustrate you. It's not a role where you hand mandates to agencies and wait for callbacks — you're doing the sourcing yourself, at scale. And it's not for someone whose plan is to get out of sourcing as fast as possible. The craft is the job. If you do it well, other TA roles open up — but only because you were great at sourcing first.
 



  





**Why Join Ditto** 



* Real ownership of a sourcing function at a company scaling hiring significantly.
* A TA team that's building forward, not maintaining what exists.
* Direct visibility into how a growing company gets built — you're the first conversation many joiners have with Ditto.
* Craft compounds. Great sourcing here sets you up for the TA roles that open up as we scale.
* A company where the mission is genuinely lived — a 4\.9 Google rating from 30,000\+ users tells its own story.



  





**Perks** 



* Comprehensive health and term insurance.
* Compensation as per industry standards.
* Learning allowances and growth opportunities.



  





**Our Interview Process** 




 We want to respect your time. There are 4 rounds, and we aim to complete all of them within 3 weeks.
 



  





**The schedule:** 



1. 1\. Introductory call with HR
2. 2\. Task / Assignment (3 business days from receipt)
3. 3\. Task presentation \+ Case discussion with the Hiring Manager
4. 4\. Founders round



  





**This is an in\-office role. Our address is: Fortuna\-1, No 680, 15th Cross, J.P Nagar 2nd Phase, J P Nagar, Bangalore South – 560078, Karnataka, India.** 




  





*Please Note: Beware of recruitment scams. Ditto does not charge any fees at any stage of the hiring process. If you receive any suspicious message claiming to be from Ditto, please verify through our official channels.*

Who Are We?
   

  

 RZR is an AI\-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full\-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose\-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.
   

  

 We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.
   

  

 RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M\&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 As Sr. HR Business Partner (People Business Partner) at RZR, you will serve as the primary strategic People partner for our teams in India, working directly with regional leadership to align people strategy with business goals. This role is critical to enabling planned growth by building strong people practices, driving performance, ensuring compliance, and improving day\-to\-day organizational effectiveness in\-region.
   

  

 This is a highly embedded, hands\-on role. You will work alongside GMs and functional leaders to manage employee relations, run performance cycles, build retention programs, and shape how the organization scales — with a clear mandate to make people decisions that move the business forward.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings deep HRBP experience, strong commercial instincts, and the confidence to influence and challenge senior leaders. This role offers high visibility and direct impact on how a key international market grows and performs.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 People Partnership
   

  

* Serve as the primary People Partner for the India region, partnering closely with regional leadership to align people strategy with business goals and planned growth
* Drive retention and reduce attrition by proactively identifying talent risks and implementing data\-informed interventions
* Own and execute the end\-to\-end performance management lifecycle, including goal setting, 90\-day reviews, performance cycles, and talent planning
* Establish and reinforce a high\-performance culture with clear expectations, accountability, and differentiation across teams
* Act as a trusted advisor and coach to managers and senior leaders, providing candid guidance on performance, organizational design, and employee engagement
* Lead and manage complex employee relations matters, ensuring timely resolution, risk mitigation, and compliance with local labor laws and regulations
* Operate as a hands\-on partner across the full employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, and day\-to\-day employee support
* Maintain HRIS data integrity, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely updates to support reporting, compliance, and decision\-making
* Identify opportunities to improve and scale People Operations processes, driving efficiency, consistency, and impact
* Leverage HR systems and data to generate insights, inform decision\-making, and enhance overall people practices
* Partner cross\-functionally to ensure alignment and execution of people initiatives across regions


**Required Skills And Experience**
 Must\-Have
   

  

* 7\+ years of experience in a People Partner or Senior People Partner role, preferably in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments (ad tech, gaming, tech, or similar)
* Strong experience supporting international teams, with direct experience in India strongly preferred
* Proven track record managing core HRBP responsibilities including performance management, talent planning, and complex employee relations within local regulatory frameworks
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a hands\-on individual contributor, balancing strategic partnership with day\-to\-day execution
* Experience coaching and influencing senior leaders, with the ability to provide direct, candid feedback and drive decision\-making
* Strong knowledge of local labor laws and employment practices, with the ability to navigate compliance and mitigate risk effectively
* Experience driving process improvements and scaling people programs in growing organizations
* Proficiency with HR systems and tools such as BambooHR, Lattice, or CultureAmp, and comfort using data to inform people decisions
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience


 Nice\-to\-Have
   

  

* Experience in ad tech, programmatic advertising, gaming, or platform technology environments
* Exposure to scaling a People function from early\-stage to structured operations
* Experience supporting teams across multiple Indian cities or geographies


 Why Join RZR?
   

  

* High\-impact, embedded ownership — not a shared services role — you will be the sole Sr. HR Business Partner for the India region, with a direct line to regional leadership and a real mandate to shape how the business runs from a people perspective.
* Own the full HRBP scope — performance management, employee relations, retention, organizational design, talent planning, and manager capability are all yours to own and build, not manage from a distance.
* Autonomy to build from scratch — you will have the freedom to design programs, improve processes, and create structure where none exists today, with the visibility to influence decisions at leadership level.
* True strategic partnership in a performance\-driven environment — without the politics of a large HR function. Your work has direct bearing on how the India region grows and performs.
* A function that keeps growing — as the region scales, this role becomes the foundation for a broader People team, with a clear path toward leading it.


 RZR Behaviors
   

  

 RZR operates by eight core behaviors: Extreme Ownership
   

  

* Move Fast
* Drive for Excellence
* Proactive Communication
* Courage
* Curiosity
* Deliver Results
* Manage Ambiguity

title: Associate Program Manager - Partnerships
description:
**Associate — Global Strategic Partnerships** 




 You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform.
 



 Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real\-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world\-class supply partnerships fueling the machine.
 



 That's where you come in.
 



  





**The Role — In Plain English** 




 You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets.
 



 This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week.
 



 Your week might look like this:
 


* **Monday:** 
 Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates.
* **Tuesday:** 
 Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides.
* **Wednesday:** 
 Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high\-value partner launch.
* **Thursday:** 
 Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week.
* **Friday:** 
 Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy\-in. Start executing.



 You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role.
 



  





**What Makes This Different** 




 Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two.
 



 You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams.
 



 Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done.
 



  





**You Might Be Right For This If...** 



* You have 1–4 years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client\-facing roles — ideally in SaaS, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising
* You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number.
* You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed
* You can context\-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum
* Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to.
* You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you



  





**What You'll Get** 



* **Real ownership:** 
 Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one
* **Leadership exposure:** 
 Work directly with CXOs and cross\-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success
* **Growth trajectory:** 
 Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem
* **Compensation:** 
 Among the most competitive in India, including stock options
* **Global scope:** 
 Partners and markets that span continents — not a single\-geography desk job



  





**If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk.** 




 Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

title: SAP S4 Hana FI/CO Functional Analyst
Asset Management IV
description:
**Role Overview**
 The Asset Lifecycle Analyst III is the senior subject\-matter expert for the end\-to\-end lifecycle of the client's physical and digital IT assets — from part\-number creation and assignment through moves, reassignments and retirement. The role owns the accuracy and integrity of asset and master\-data records so that asset, procurement and finance systems stay reconciled, and it keeps the downstream receiving, deployment and invoicing work Astreya performs running on clean, trustworthy data. Errors in asset records ripple straight into fulfilment, three\-way matching and financial reporting, so this is a high\-trust, high\-accuracy remit.
   

  

 As a Level III role, the analyst operates with a high degree of autonomy and acts as the asset\-data escalation point for procurement, catalogue, supplier\-management and finance teams. The role reports to the Procurement \& Asset Team Lead and partners closely with Supplier \& Vendor Management, the Catalogue function and the SAM team. As the incumbent, Astreya can build on established asset records, part\-number conventions and system configurations to drive data quality, cycle\-time and cost outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Global Asset Lifecycle Operations
* Manage the asset lifecycle end to end — creating part numbers, assigning assets and keeping records updated through moves, reassignments and retirements.
* Coordinate manufacturer part number (MPN) and asset reassignments in the database backend to transfer assets cleanly from source MIDs to target MIDs.
* Perform bulk data updates (including MAC addresses, serial numbers, locations and project codes) to maintain hardware master\-data integrity within the database.
* Manage Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) workflows with suppliers to resolve damaged or incorrect deliveries and keep asset records accurate.
* Asset Master\-Data Integrity
* Maintain accurate asset and master\-data records so that asset, procurement and finance systems stay reconciled at all times.
* Coordinate part\-number creation, submit trade\-classification requests (HTS/ECCN) and secure customs valuations to keep assets transaction\- and shipment\-ready.
* Coordinate regional catalog rollouts and Base\-and\-Variant MID hierarchies so new and variant assets are enabled correctly across regions.
* Run periodic reconciliation and data\-quality checks, resolving discrepancies and removing duplicate or stale asset records.
* Asset Administration \& Cost Reallocation
* Administer entries in the asset administration system — creating, editing and activating or deactivating offerings — so the available asset catalog stays current and correct.
* Validate prepayment terms against threshold criteria and coordinate internal cost\-reallocation (chargeback) ledgers.
* Process inter\-departmental chargeback requests by validating mandatory corporate fields (requester, cost centers, location, task numbers), entering verified data into reallocation templates and coordinating with invoicing teams.
* Support New Product Introduction (NPI) by creating the system IDs needed to transact and track new assets.
* Governance, Reporting \& Continuous Improvement
* Act as the asset\-data escalation point and design authority for asset lifecycle SOPs, tolerances and approval thresholds.
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation of asset changes, reassignments, classifications and chargebacks.
* Identify and drive automation and process improvements across asset lifecycle, bulk\-update and reconciliation workflows.
* Coach junior analysts on asset\-data methodology, data quality and system procedures.


**PERFORMANCE \& SERVICE LEVELS**
 Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured by location per service line.
   

  

* Asset Data Accuracy: maintain ≥99% accuracy across reviewed asset and master\-data records, since asset data drives fulfilment, matching and financial reporting.
* Reconciliation Timeliness: complete periodic asset\-to\-finance reconciliation cycles on schedule for 100% of in\-scope records.
* Lifecycle Turnaround: process asset creations, reassignments and retirements within the agreed SLA for ≥95% of requests.
* Discrepancy Resolution: resolve escalated asset\-data and three\-way\-match holds within the priority\-based target window for ≥95% of cases.
* Chargeback Accuracy: process inter\-departmental chargebacks with 100% of mandatory fields validated and correctly reallocated.
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT): sustain a CSAT score of ≥95% (≥4\.0–4\.5 on a 5\-point scale) across surveyed interactions, reflecting accuracy, responsiveness and professionalism.
* Ticket Quality: ensure ≥95–97% of completed requests pass quality\-assurance checks, with complete documentation, correct categorization and full adherence to the approved SOP.


**TOOLS \& SYSTEMS**
* ERP \& Procurement Systems: SAP (Materials Management, Procure\-to\-Pay and master\-data uploading consoles) alongside corporate guided buying platforms
* Asset \& Product Systems: asset administration consoles, database backends and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools
* Data Management Tools: bulk data loaders, master\-data validation utilities and collaborative spreadsheet logs
* Ticketing \& Collaboration Tools: advanced ITSM issue\-tracking platforms


**Required Skills \& Experience**
 Mandatory
   

  

* 5–8\+ years of experience in IT asset management, master\-data management or procurement operations, with demonstrated seniority.
* Advanced asset and master\-data management, including part\-number creation, MID/MPN reassignments and bulk uploads with data\-integrity controls.
* Hands\-on experience keeping asset, procurement and finance systems reconciled, and resolving downstream matching/fulfilment issues.
* Sound attention to detail and process discipline, with the ability to sustain ≥99% data accuracy at volume.
* Strong English communication and stakeholder management, including with procurement, finance and supplier teams.


**Preferred**
* Experience with SAP Materials Management, asset administration systems and master\-data upload consoles.
* Exposure to trade classification (HTS/ECCN), customs valuation and part\-compliance processes.
* Familiarity with NPI, Base\-and\-Variant MID hierarchies, RMA workflows and chargeback/cost\-reallocation mechanics.
* Experience coaching or leading junior analysts and owning asset lifecycle SOPs and governance.


**LEVELS \& PROGRESSION (I – III)**
 This role sits at Level III, the senior tier of the Asset Lifecycle Analyst profile. One job profile spans the levels; seniority (and compensation) is differentiated by scope, autonomy and ownership, and the JD is common across levels.
   

  

* Level I — performs asset data entry, bulk updates and record maintenance under SOP and close supervision.
* Level II — owns day\-to\-day lifecycle operations, reassignments and reconciliation with limited supervision, and resolves data discrepancies.
* Level III (this role) — is the asset\-data SME and line lead — owning data\-quality standards, reconciliation, classification and chargeback governance, escalations, continuous improvement and coaching of junior analysts.

description:
* Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
* Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands\-on experience?
* Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?


 If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Modulr is the payments automation platform that streamlines money movement with accuracy, control and reliability — built to scale. We process more than 200m transactions and over £180bn in payment value on an annualised basis, and we’re trusted by over 6,000 businesses from fast\-growing SMEs to global enterprises.
   

  

 We automate how money moves into and out of a business — payroll, supplier payments, spend management and payment collection — through a single platform, connected to the accounting and payroll systems finance teams already use and underpinned by principal memberships of Visa and Mastercard and direct access to central bank infrastructure.
   

  

 As a regulated payments provider with over a decade of experience, we’re the platform finance teams trust to run mission\-critical operations. Modulr is backed by PayPal, FIS, General Atlantic, Blenheim Chalcot, Frog Capital and Highland Europe, with over 400 employees across London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the Role**
 The FP\&A Manager is a senior member of the FP\&A team, responsible for owning significant areas of planning, forecasting, performance management and decision support.
   

  

 This is a broad, hands\-on role for someone who can take complex or loosely defined financial problems, turn them into structured workstreams and deliver high\-quality solutions with limited oversight.
   

  

 A key measure of success will be taking end\-to\-end ownership of important FP\&A projects, models and processes, materially reducing the need for the Director of FP\&A to remain involved in their design, build and day\-to\-day operation. The role has no direct reports, but is expected to provide technical leadership, coaching and mentoring across the FP\&A team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Planning and forecasting
   

  

* Jointly lead significant elements of the annual budget and planning process alongside the Director of FP\&A.
* Own and improve forecasting methodology, models and processes across FP\&A.
* Challenge assumptions and hold FP\&A and business stakeholders accountable for forecast quality and agreed actions.


 Financial modelling and analysis
   

  

* Build and own complex financial models across revenue, costs, headcount and other business drivers.
* Translate complex business questions into clear financial analysis and decision support.
* Ensure models are robust, scalable, well controlled and capable of being operated by others.


 Business partnering and decision support
   

  

* Act as a proactive Finance partner to LT\-1 leaders and their teams.
* Ensure spend managers are aware of their budget responsibilities and approval processes.
* Consistently and relentlessly enforce spending discipline across the business.


 FP\&A transformation
   

  

* Take end\-to\-end ownership of significant FP\&A projects.
* Lead the use of automation, AI and improved data processes.
* Build solutions that become embedded in normal business activity and free the FP\&A team capacity for high\-value work.


 Performance management
   

  

* Own and improve key elements of FP\&A management information.
* Focus reporting and analysis on underlying drivers of performance, risks and opportunities.
* Ensure senior stakeholders understand what has happened, why it has happened and what action is required.


 Team leadership and development
   

  

* Guide and mentor junior colleagues through complex financial and analytical work.
* Delegate elements of projects, review outputs and help raise standards across the team.
* Share knowledge and build repeatable approaches that increase overall FP\&A capability.


**Person Specification**
**Essential**
* Operate independently, seeking guidance only on the most significant issues.
* Take ownership of outcomes.
* Build scalable solutions.
* Grip ambiguous problems by developing clear plans and recommendations.
* Lead complex projects involving multiple contributors and stakeholders.
* Influence decisions beyond the immediate FP\&A team.
* Strong financial modelling capability.
* Deep understanding of budgeting/forecasting, variance analysis, performance management.
* Demonstrable experience independently owning complex financial models and business processes.
* Ability to communicate complex financial information clearly and concisely.


 Desirable
   

  

* Qualified (or close to qualification) as an ACA, ACCA or CIMA accountant.
* Experience within financial services.
* Experience using AI to improve Finance processes.
* Knowledge of the payments industry.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Senior business leaders see FP\&A as a stronger and more valuable partner in decision\-making.
* Significant FP\&A projects, models and processes are independently owned without requiring close involvement from the Director of FP\&A.
* Forecasting, analysis, and financial challenge become more disciplined and decision\-useful.
* Manual FP\&A activity is reduced through better processes, automation and AI.
* The wider FP\&A team becomes more capable through coaching, delegation and stronger ways of working.


**ModInclusion**

We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds as we believe it’s the right thing for our people, our business, and the community we operate in.

title: Design Operations & Client Delivery Lead
description:
Role Overview We are seeking a mature, commercially aware leader to help management run design operations, strengthen delivery discipline and serve as a trusted client contact. The candidate will coordinate people, projects and priorities while remaining capable of hands-on publication or graphic-design work when needed. 
 This is broader than a conventional Art Director position, combining client ownership, project management, people leadership, reporting, quality control and hands-on production expertise. 
 Core Responsibilities 1. Lead Design Operations and the Team Partner with management to plan, prioritize and run the full design-production workload across publication and non-publication accounts. Allocate work intelligently based on capability, capacity, urgency and client context, and track assignments through completion. Lead through credibility and sound judgment, earning the confidence of existing senior and experienced designers on the team. Coach newer team members, provide actionable feedback, raise quality standards and help individuals strengthen their technical and client-service skills. Anticipate capacity constraints, arrange backup coverage and resolve bottlenecks before they affect delivery. 
 2. Own Client Relationships and Delivery Act as a dependable client-facing representative for assigned design and publication accounts. Lead discovery conversations, clarify business needs, scope and specifications, and translate them into clear internal briefs. Coordinate team execution, review work before delivery and remain accountable for quality, timeliness and follow-through. Build client confidence through clear communication, realistic commitments and timely written updates. Apply commercial judgment to feasibility, timelines, revisions and scope, and identify additional support opportunities without overpromising. Own issues through resolution and protect the client relationship when requirements change or delivery risks emerge. 
 3. Manage Publication and Letter-Production Programs Oversee publication-setup workflows for long-established U.S. community publishers, including publications serving Amish readerships in Pennsylvania and the East Coast. Manage high-volume handwritten-letter programs that may exceed 1,200 letters per week across one or more publications. Coordinate the complete workflow: file intake and logging; AI/OCR-assisted transcription; human proofreading and correction; typesetting into Word or other required formats; client review; and release for print. Maintain accurate status tracking, naming conventions, version control, quality checkpoints and deadline visibility across every stage. Plan for volume spikes, weekend intake and urgent exceptions while protecting accuracy, confidentiality and deadlines. 
 4. Provide Hands-on Design and Production Support Create, revise and quality-check magazine advertisements, classifieds, newspaper ads, publication layouts and other print or digital collateral. Work proficiently in Adobe InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop, using other tools when appropriate to the assignment. Prepare print-ready files with correct dimensions, bleeds, trim, resolution, color profiles, fonts, links and export settings. Apply strong typography, hierarchy, layout, design thinking and brand judgment, and step into priority work or coaching reviews when needed. 
 5. Improve Processes, Controls and Automation Document and improve workflows, SOPs, checklists, templates, handoffs and quality-control standards. Use automation and AI to improve throughput without weakening human review, accountability or data protection. Investigate recurring errors or delays, determine root causes and implement measurable corrective actions. Use delivery, quality and workload data to recommend better processes, staffing decisions and client solutions. 
 Reporting and Management Visibility This position reports directly to the Head of Business Operations and must provide disciplined, proactive updates. Management should have a reliable view of client health, delivery performance, team conditions and emerging risks without having to chase for information. Immediate reporting: Raise client concerns, deadline threats, quality failures, staffing constraints and other material risks as soon as they become known. Weekly operating update: Report on client relationships, projects, deadlines, delivery confidence, workload, quality, employee feedback, coaching, decisions required and next-week priorities. Monthly management review: Summarize trends in client health, delivery performance, team development, process improvement, risks, opportunities and recommended actions. Meeting and escalation discipline: Schedule important discussions, capture decisions and owners, communicate early, propose solutions and close the loop on agreed actions. 
 Required Experience and Capabilities Typically 8+ years of progressive design or production experience with responsibility for projects, people or client delivery. Strong leadership evidence may offset fewer years. Advanced proficiency in Adobe InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop; InDesign is mandatory. Strong publication-layout, print-production, prepress, typography and quality-assurance knowledge. Ability to manage concurrent projects and stringent deadlines through clear tracking and escalation. Evidence of coaching designers, giving performance feedback and coordinating experienced professionals. Confident English communication and experience working with U.S. clients. Ability to work traditional U.S. daytime hours, corresponding to a night shift in India. A strong publication, print and graphic-design portfolio. 
 Preferred Experience Newspaper, magazine, classified-advertising or high-volume production experience. Strong CorelDRAW or QuarkXPress experience is advantageous; neither is mandatory. Experience with Word production, OCR/transcription, AI-enabled workflows, project tools or operational dashboards is advantageous but not required. Direct client ownership or measurable process-improvement experience. 
 Leadership Qualities We Will Evaluate Judgment and maturity: Reads situations accurately and makes proportionate decisions. Ownership and problem solving: Takes responsibility and brings solutions, not only problems. Business acumen: Understands client priorities and the impact of commitments. Communication discipline: Responds promptly and keeps stakeholders appropriately informed. Influence and composure: Earns trust across experience levels and remains constructive under pressure. 
 How Success Will Be Measured Delivery: Deadlines are met and risks are surfaced early. Quality: Accuracy improves and preventable rework declines. Client confidence: Clients receive responsive communication and dependable ownership. Team effectiveness: Work is allocated sensibly and feedback improves capability. Operational improvement: Reporting is useful and process changes produce measurable gains. 
 What We Offer An in-house leadership role with exposure to U.S. clients and management. The opportunity to shape design operations, team development and delivery standards. Varied work, growth potential and competitive compensation aligned with role fit. 
 Practical evidence matters more than job titles alone. Responsibilities may evolve with business and client needs.

Key Skills: Team Management,Design Operation,U.S. Client Communication,Project Management,Print Production,Artwork,Publication Design,Client Relationship Management

Associate Business Development Manager
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW The Associate Client Engagement Manager works alongside the senior Client Engagement Manager to drive Celebal's commercial and client engagement activity across the GCC primarily Saudi Arabia and the UAE — with a clear path to owning accounts and transactions outright. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role, but it is not a coordination role. You will be expected to hold your own in a first conversation with a Microsoft solution specialist or a client stakeholder without a technical colleague on the call, to explain what Celebal does differently in a specific solution area, and to build and defend a commercial estimate. Pre-sales, delivery and practice teams support you; they do not substitute for you. Read this before applying: the interview includes a live technical and commercial assessment. Candidates who position themselves as functional or relationship-only sellers, and who require pre-sales support for every solution conversation, are not a fit for this role — regardless of years of experience or account pedigree. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Pipeline Ownership & Deal Progression Own and progress a defined slice of the GCC opportunity pipeline — from qualification through proposal submission, negotiation support and closure — with the senior CEM as escalation point rather than as approver of every step. Run RFP, RFI and tender responses end to end: interpret requirements, decompose the scope, own the response plan and timeline, drive contributions from pre-sales and practice leads, and assemble a submission that is compliant and commercially sound. Manage Microsoft and partner co-sell motions directly — deal registration, co-sell submissions, MCI/ECIF and pre-sales funding nominations, and joint account planning with Microsoft SSPs, ATUs and partner leads (Crayon and others). Maintain CRM hygiene, forecast accuracy and pipeline reporting to a standard that leadership can act on without rework. Schedule and lead client meetings, demos and technical presentations; author the meeting narrative and the follow-up MOM, not just the logistics. 2. Client Engagement & Account Ownership Act as a named point of contact for assigned accounts, holding day-to-day commercial and delivery-liaison conversations independently. Produce client-facing material — proposals, BoQ and BoM summaries, executive briefings, project status narratives — in a form that goes to the client with light review, not heavy rewriting. Track milestone status with delivery, trigger milestone-linked commercial actions, and own invoicing follow-up, collections escalation and revenue realisation for your accounts. Maintain complete, auditable engagement documentation: MSAs, SOWs, Change Requests, LOIs, correspondence and approval trails. 3. Solution Positioning & Differentiation Articulate what Celebal does differently in specific solution areas — Microsoft Fabric and Databricks-based data platform modernisation, migration accelerators, GenAI and agentic use cases, sovereign cloud and security — and why that beats an incumbent system integrator. This is a core competency of the role, not a marketing hand-off. Maintain and actively use the GCC solution narrative: capability decks, reference architectures, case studies, industry-specific use-case libraries and competitive positioning. Translate a client problem statement into an indicative solution shape and commercial envelope in the room, then validate it with pre-sales — rather than deferring the entire conversation. 4. Proposal, Estimation & Commercial Construction Author the executive summary, scope of work, assumptions, exclusions and commercial sections of proposals; source tech stack, effort estimates and delivery timelines from pre-sales and delivery and integrate them coherently. Build and adjust Azure consumption estimates independently using the Azure pricing calculator — storage, compute, capacity SKUs and licensing — and understand how those choices move the client's total cost. Draft quotations, SOW summaries and Change Request documentation; understand the difference between T&M, fixed-price, managed-capacity and outcome-based structures and when each is appropriate. 5. Internal Coordination & Governance Liaise with delivery, legal, finance and HR on engagement onboarding, commercial issue resolution and contract execution. Prepare internal briefing notes, commercial summaries, deal review packs and escalation memos of a standard suitable for regional leadership review. Contribute to WBS updates, revenue forecasting and weekly/monthly business reviews. Ensure clean account handovers with full context and documentation captured. 
 QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE Essential — screened against, no exceptions GCC market experience. 4–6 years in B2B technology sales, client engagement, pre-sales or account management, including demonstrable UAE and/or KSA market experience — in-market work history, or documented ownership of GCC-based client relationships. Regional exposure gained purely through remote channel coordination does not meet this requirement. Microsoft partner ecosystem depth. Hands-on experience with co-sell motions, deal registration, and pre-sales or partner funding mechanisms (MCI, ECIF or equivalent), including working relationships with Microsoft field roles (SSP, ATU, partner development). Data & AI portfolio literacy. Working knowledge of the Microsoft data and AI stack — Azure data services, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Power BI, GenAI/Copilot patterns — sufficient to scope a data platform, migration or AI use-case conversation unaided. Cloud and security fundamentals. Practical fluency in Azure architecture basics, M365/O365, and Microsoft security and compliance (Sentinel, Defender, identity). Certification at fundamentals level or above (AZ-900, MS-900, SC-900, DP-900 or higher) is expected; equivalent demonstrated knowledge is acceptable. Estimation capability. Able to build and defend an Azure consumption estimate on the Azure pricing calculator without pre-sales assistance. This is tested live during interview. RFP and tender ownership. Direct experience running or substantially owning RFP, RFI or government tender responses, including compliance and commercial sections. Services-commercial exposure. Familiarity with MSAs, SOWs and Change Requests, and with authoring scope and commercial terms for services engagements — as distinct from licensing or product resale. Deal scale. Experience on engagements where individual proof-of-concept values reach USD 150K or above and multi-year programmes exceed USD 1M. Celebal proof-of-concept engagements alone routinely run USD 200K–250K. Applied AI fluency. Uses AI tooling deliberately in the sales craft — research, account intelligence, first-draft proposal and RFP response construction, competitive analysis — with judgement about what must still be authored and verified by a human. Communication. Clear, professional written and spoken English; able to produce client-ready correspondence and documents with minimal supervision. Education. Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field. MBA or a technical postgraduate qualification is an advantage. Mobility. Based in or willing to relocate to Dubai, with a valid ability to travel across KSA and the GCC. Preferred Arabic language capability. Prior employment with a Microsoft partner, system integrator or technology consulting firm serving enterprise clients in the region. Account experience in logistics, government or public sector, FMCG, or financial services in the GCC. Exposure to sovereign cloud, data residency or regional compliance requirements (SDAIA, NDMO, UAE data protection). Experience with CRM and revenue tooling — Dynamics 365, Salesforce, HubSpot, Clari. Familiarity with government procurement portals and tender platforms in KSA or the UAE. 
 COMPETENCIES Technical credibility. Can hold a solution conversation with an architect or Microsoft specialist and be taken seriously. This is the single most important competency in the role. Commercial judgement. Understands deal structures, pricing models, margin implications and revenue recognition well enough to shape a deal, not just document it. Independent ownership. Moves an opportunity forward without waiting to be told the next step; escalates with a recommendation attached. Competitive framing. Can explain why Celebal, in a specific solution area, against a specific incumbent, in under two minutes. Organisational rigour. Manages concurrent engagements with accurate documentation, clean CRM and reliable follow-through. Stakeholder navigation. Comfortable across pre-sales, delivery, legal and finance internally, and across client procurement, IT and business stakeholders externally. Cross-cultural effectiveness. Operates credibly in GCC business culture and with distributed India-based delivery teams. Adaptability. Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth regional business with evolving priorities. 
 SELECTION PROCESS Candidates should expect a structured assessment rather than a conversational interview. The process comprises an HR screening, a technical and commercial round with sales leadership, and a regional fit discussion. What we assess 
 How Solution positioning 
 You will be asked to pitch Celebal cold to a Microsoft SSP covering a named industry, and to answer why a client should move work to us from an incumbent SI. Generic value statements do not clear this stage. Commercial sizing 
 You will be asked to open the Azure pricing calculator on screen and build or adjust a simple estimate — storage, compute, capacity SKU — without pre-sales support. Solution depth 
 You will be asked to walk through the most technically complex engagement you have sold, including data sources, integration approach and platform choices, in your own words. Commercial structure 
 You will be asked how a proposal is assembled — which sections you author, which you source from pre-sales and delivery, and how pricing model and timelines are arrived at. 
 CAREER PATH This role is a structured route into a full Client Engagement Manager position. Candidates who demonstrate technical credibility, commercial judgement and independent account ownership will be considered for progression within 18–24 months. Progression is assessed on independent deal ownership and solution credibility, not tenure. 
 WHAT WE OFFER Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives. Direct exposure to marquee enterprise and government accounts across the GCC. Close collaboration with Microsoft field and product teams, including global initiative and sovereign cloud programmes. Structured mentorship from experienced regional sales leadership. Funded certification pathways across Azure, Data & AI, and Security. Fast-track growth in a priority geography, within a global team spanning the Americas, EMEA, India, APJ, Australia and Japan. 
 To apply or for queries, please contact: chaity.mukherjee@celebaltech.com

title: Finance Analyst - Pricing & Financial Modeling
description:
J
 **ob Description** 




 This role is primarily focused on FP\&A, pricing analysis, financial modeling, and scenario/what\-if analysis. The Finance Analyst will build and maintain robust, decision\-ready financial models, run scenario\-based analyses to support pricing and business decisions, and provide the analytical backbone for FP\&A reporting. Advanced Excel modeling skills are essential to this role. The candidate will partner closely with Finance, Solutions, Operations, and leadership to translate business questions into structured financial models and scenarios.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Pricing, Modeling \& Scenario Analysis (Core Focus)** 




 ● Own end\-to\-end financial model development and maintenance, including integrated revenue, expense, and
 



 headcount models.
 



 ● Build and maintain pricing models, including deal\-level and customer\-level pricing analysis.
 



 ● Design and run scenario\-based / what\-if models to evaluate the financial impact of pricing changes, cost
 



 structures, and business decisions.
 



 ● Perform sensitivity analysis on key business drivers (volume, price, cost, mix) to support leadership
 



 decision\-making.
 



 ● Support ad hoc initiatives including pricing strategy, deal evaluation, and acquisition\-related financial
 



 modeling and scenario analysis.
 



 ● Develop and automate dashboards, KPI reporting, and streamlined data flows to support modeling and
 



 scenario work across systems.
 



  





**FP\&A, Reporting \& Planning Support** 




 ● Prepare project\-level cost reporting and insights.
 



 ● Prepare COGS and operating expense (Opex) variance analysis reports.
 



 ● Prepare customer\- and vertical\-level margin reporting.
 



 ● Deliver performance insights and executive\-level reporting, including variance analysis.
 



 ● Manage monthly and quarterly forecasting cycles with cross\-functional alignment.
 



 ● Drive the annual budgeting process in coordination with internal and outsourced accounting teams.
 



 ● Partner across teams to improve data quality, governance, and system integration.
 



  





**Requirements** 




 ● Very strong, hands\-on Excel skills are essential — advanced financial modeling, scenario\-based modeling,
 



 and what\-if analysis (sensitivity tables, data tables, scenario manager, dynamic driver\-based models).
 



 ● Demonstrated experience building pricing models and conducting pricing analysis.

description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 Couchbase Database Administrator. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for the architecture, deployment, management, and optimization of our critical Couchbase database environments. You will play a key role in ensuring the high availability, performance, and scalability of our data infrastructure, with a particular focus on deployments within Kubernetes.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Design, deploy, and manage highly available, scalable, and performant Couchbase clusters on Kubernetes clusters/Container platforms in production and non\-production environments.
* Perform database installation, configuration, patching, and upgrades.
* Implement and manage robust backup and recovery strategies for Couchbase.
* Monitor Couchbase health, performance, and capacity, proactively identifying and resolving issues.
* Conduct performance tuning, query optimization, and capacity planning for Couchbase.
* Experience with monitoring tools (e. g., Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk) for database metrics.
* Manage user access, security, and data encryption for Couchbase.
* Troubleshoot complex Couchbase\-related incidents, performing root cause analysis.
* Lead Life Cycle Management for Couchbase DB product.
* Plan, design, execution, monitoring, and control, drive the closure, articulate project stages, resolve dependencies, etc.


**The skills you bring:**
* OCP 11g \& 12c Oracle Certified Professional along with IT Graduation/Master’s degree.
* Design, deploy, and manage highly available, scalable, and performant Couchbase clusters on Kubernetes clusters/Container platforms in production and non\-production environments.
* Oracle 10g, 11g, 12c, 18C, 19C versions (18 \& 19 Additional benefits)
* Performance tuning (Optimizing Queries, Instance Tuning)
* Upgrade knowledge on oracle database upgrade from 12c to 19c and 11g to 12c.
* Installation, configuration and upgrading of Oracle server software and related products (clients, RAC 2 nodes, stand Along)
* Good Understanding of RAC (2 nodes or 3 nodes) and its services
* Understanding Active/Passive, Active\-Active (ASM and Veritas Cluster)
* A good knowledge of the physical database design
* A good understanding of the underlying operating system (windows, unix, linux, solaris \& AIX)
* Different OS few important commands to check the server load (top, topas sar ,vmstat
* Partitioning (Partition Tables and it’s type understanding Range, Hash etc) and partition pruning.
* Indexing (Local and Global Index, its benefits and drawbacks)
* Worked on Heavy databases 100\+ TB (Filesystem and ASM)
* Adding Disk in ASM and Adding datafiles in RAC, tempfiles etc.
* Establish and maintain sound backup and recovery policies and procedures (RMAN backup, Level0, level1 , level2 \& Logical Backup Exports)
* Different backup and recovery scenarios understanding through RMAN
* Restoration backup (point in time recovery, controlfile restoration, datafile restoration)
* Implement and maintain Database security (create and maintain users and roles, assign privileges)
* Perform database tuning and performance monitoring – Plan changing understanding, how to fix plan
* Perform application tuning and performance monitoring
* Work as part of a team and provide 24x7 support when required (Weekend supports, Shifting working)MOS SR raising , TFA generation Logs checking Cluster, ASM , scan listener etc.
* Patch Management (Patching single node and RAC two node, Three nodes).
* “All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.”


**Why join Ericsson?** 
 At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. Area(s) of responsibility
   

  

 Position Title: Senior Network Tech Lead
   

  

 Experience Required: 10\+ years
   

  

 Location: India (Preferred Bangalore, Pune or Noida, but flexible for, Hyderabad, Chennai)
   

  

 Department: Network Practice Delivery
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Network Tech Lead for implementation, troubleshooting and operations of large\-scale enterprise Campus, WAN, and Data Center networks for our customers. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in network implementation \& support, SDN/SD\-WAN platforms (including Velo\-cloud SD\-WAN, Palo Alto, firewalls, Aruba ClearPass, Prima access), and cloud networking (Azure, AWS). The role requires proven project leadership, customer engagement, technical team management, and a strong track record in delivering successful network solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the implementation \& support of robust LAN, WAN, Data Centre, and SDN/SD\-WAN solutions.
* Support Low\-Level Designs (LLD), and technical solution proposals to customers.
* Engage directly with customers to understand requirements and manage technical calls.
* Support project delivery, ensuring successful implementation, issue resolution, and customer satisfaction.
* Implement or migrate the defined design into the production and ensure the smooth cut over or installation of the network.
* Guide and mentor a team of Junior network engineers, driving technical excellence and team development.
* Serve as the technical escalation point (L2/L3\) for complex network issues and critical incidents.
* Define and enforce network documentation standards, maintaining a comprehensive engineering document library.
* Collaborate with OEMs, vendors, and cross\-functional teams for, implementation, integration \& support.
* Execute or Support network migration, integration, and transformation projects, including service recovery and improvement initiatives.
* Document and hand over the implementation, support hyper care.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in network implementation, support, and operations.
* Proven experience leading projects and operations for customer environments.
* Strong fundamentals in Routing \& Switching (OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, STP, RSTP, MSTP, VTP, EtherChannel, HSRP, VRRP, VSS, VPC, VDC, FEX, Fabric Path).
* Hands\-on experience architecting and delivering solutions on:
* Primary Skills


  Strong base of Routing \& Switching
   

  

  Velo\-Cloud SDWAN
   

  

  Aruba ClearPass
   

  

  Cisco ISE, DNAC
   

  

* Secondary Skills


  SDN/SD\-WAN platforms (Cisco SD\-WAN)
   

  

  SolarWinds Orion
   

  

* Experience with network security platforms (Palo Alto, Cisco ASA) and network access control.
* Cloud networking expertise: Good to have worked on Azure networking (Vnet, Virtual Network Gateways, Site\-to\-Site IPsec connections, Network Security Group, Virtual network Gateway, Local Network Gateway, Route Tables \& management, etc.). AWS Networking (VPC, Transit gateway, Direct\-connect, CloudWatch, IGW, NAT GW, Security Groups, ALB, NLB, GLB Certificate manager, R53, Multi\-cloud Integrations.
* Certification Requirements:
* CCNA, CCNP or equivalent certification is mandatory.
* Azure AZ\-700, AWS ANS\-C01 or equivalent certification is good to have.
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams, mentor junior engineers, and manage project delivery.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and customer engagement skills.
* Strong documentation capabilities and process awareness.
* Experience working with vendors and partners on solution implementation support \& troubleshoot.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

description:
**Content Writer \& Impact Storyteller**  

**Company:** iDream Education (iPrep)**Location:** Sector\-32, Gurgaon**Role type:** Full\-time, Work from Office (field visits as required for work)**Band:** Senior Executive / Specialist**Experience:** 2 \- 4 Years of **Direct \& Relevant** experience with growth ownership**Industry Preference:** EdTech, Education SaaS, or an Education focused NGO, CSR or the Development sector **The Role Overview**
We are looking to onboard a Content Writer and Impact Storyteller — someone who owns the full content engine for iDream Education, not just a slice of it. This is a role for someone who can move fluidly between writing a donor\-facing case study, tightening a website's SEO, briefing a video team, and defending the brand's tone of voice across every channel it shows up on.
You will be the editorial authority for everything iDream publishes — website, social, email, and agency\-produced material alike. You will keep our websites current and discoverable, keep our content calendar running across formats, keep our social and PR presence active and credible, and keep a growing bank of field stories and data flowing from the ground up into everything we write. As iPrep's direct\-to\-consumer channel grows, you will also shape the content and growth strategy behind it.
You are inspired by the vision of taking the best of digital learning to every corner of rural Bharat, and you understand the nuances of content\-led growth built on social proof, trust, and consistent execution. **About iDream Education****Vision:** Unlimited Learning. Unlimited Growth. For Everyone.**Belief:** We believe that access to learning and growth is a fundamental right, and that learning in its truest sense is the joyful unfolding of a being’s fullest potential — in all dimensions of life.**Mission:** To deliver solutions and experiences that facilitate access to learning and growth for everyone, irrespective of their languages, geographies, abilities, curricula, age groups, learning styles, and socio\-economic status.
iPrep by iDream Education is a Learning Platform that runs both offline \& online, is bilingual and works on all major hardware devices and operating systems. iPrep delivers curriculum\-aligned digital learning for classes 1st to 12th in English, Hindi, and Regional language mediums for universal reach and learning use as:* iPrep Digital Class for Smart Classrooms
* iPrep Digital Library for Tablets/Notebooks based Smart ICT Labs
* iPrep PAL for Personalised Adaptive Learning
* iPrep Tablets for Preloaded Learning Devices with Monitoring
* iPrep App for a one\-stop learning platform across Android, iOS, and Web


Through iPrep, iDream Education empowers teachers and students, both in schools and at home to **Learn Unlimited.**
Company website: **http://idreameducation.org**
iPrep website: http://iprep.in **Core Responsibilities****1\. Website Content \& SEO:** Keep the iDream and iPrep websites current, SEO\-optimised, and compelling. Own on\-page optimisation, keyword coverage, content refresh, and technical health (broken links, crawl errors, meta tags) using AI\-assisted workflows. Apply structured content practices that help pages perform in AI\-generated search results and answer engines, and pursue backlink\-building opportunities as part of ongoing SEO health.**2\. Content Production:** Run a consistent content engine across newsletters, blogs, and multi\-format assets (case studies, carousels, infographics, email narratives, social posts) that positions iDream as a thought leader with government, NGO, and CSR audiences. Brief and manage the Video team so video output stays aligned with the broader content calendar.**3\. PR \& Social Media:** Own iDream's social presence — keeping key channels consistently active, on\-brand, and audience\-calibrated, and engaging with the community that follows them. Build and maintain a network of local journalists and reporters, and secure press coverage and article placements for key implementations.**4\.** **Editorial Ownership, Content Standards \& Audits:** Act as the final editorial authority across every channel — website, social, email, and agency\-produced material — ensuring nothing off\-topic, off\-tone, or off\-brand goes live. Own and evolve the Content Guidelines, onboard new contributors (internal or agency) to them, and run periodic content audits with clear, prioritised follow\-through.**5\.** **Impact Story Extraction \& Field Liaison:** Be the primary link between the Implementation Teams and the content pipeline — proactively coordinating with field teams to extract human stories, data points, and field updates, and filing them in a reusable format (context, emotional hook, data proof, visuals, stakeholder quotes).**6\.** **Data Bank \& Content Intelligence:** Maintain a centralised, structured repository of field data, research, impact stories, and content inputs, so every content brief is grounded in evidence and no asset is lost or duplicated.**7\.** **D2C Growth \& Content\-Led Marketing:** Lead the content and growth strategy for iPrep's direct\-to\-consumer channel — working across SEO, social, email, and community to drive awareness, acquisition, and retention among learners. **Requirements \& Qualifications*** **Experience:** 2–4 years in mass communication, social\-sector content writing, social impact storytelling, or high\-volume content roles.
* **Sector Context:** Experience in the NGO, EdTech, or Development sector is a major plus. An understanding of the nuances of Bharat (rural/semi\-urban India) and the dignity of the communities we serve is essential.
* **Interviews \& Field Work:** Proven ability to interview stakeholders (students, teachers, government officials) and find the emotional hook within a dry field report — telling stories of struggle without being pity\-driven.
* **SEO \& Web Fluency:** Comfortable with on\-page SEO fundamentals, Google Search Console, and a working understanding of technical SEO (site structure, crawl health, Core Web Vitals) — enough to be a complete owner of the website content and SEO function.
* **Linguistic Agility:** High\-level command of English (for corporate/donor\-facing content) and fluency in Hindi (for field interviews); ability to communicate with field staff in Hindi/regional languages.
* **Tech Stack:** Proficient in Canva/infographic tools, GA4, and social media management.
* **AI\-Augmented Productivity:** Fluent in using LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) and tools like NotebookLM to turn raw field notes and transcripts into structured drafts, and to systematise SEO and content workflows — using AI to compound output, not just assist it.

 **What Makes You a Great Fit?**
You are not just a writer; you are a storyteller who also thinks like an owner — comfortable holding SEO, editorial standards, PR, and field storytelling as one connected system rather than separate tasks. You are obsessed with social proof and trust, and you know how to build both without losing the human core of a story. **Why Join iDream Education?**
We are on a mission to facilitate universal access to learning and empower the last\-mile learner. At iDream, you will have the autonomy to build and own a content function that shapes how teachers, students, partners, and policymakers perceive and trust one of India's most purpose\-driven EdTech platforms.

SRE is also an engineering approach to building and running production systems \- we engineer solutions to operational problems. Our SREs are responsible for overall system operation and we use a breadth of tools and approaches to solve a broad set of problems. Practices such as limiting time spent on operational work, blameless postmortems, proactive identification, and prevention of potential outages. Our SRE culture of diversity, intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big, and take risks in a blame\-free environment.  We are seeking a highly experienced Senior AI Cloud \& Security (Multi\-Cloud) to serve as the Architectural Deployment Lead for our high\-stakes AI Professional Services delivery. The role involves leading the end\-to\-end deployment strategy for complex AI stacks across Multi\-Cloud (AWS, GCP), Hybrid, and strictly On\-Prem environments. You will act as the Security \& Compliance Authority, enforcing hardening standards, Zero\-Trust network access, and global compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2\) for our AI deliveries. As a technical leader, you will bridge the gap between AI development and customer environment integration, overseeing critical implementations such as AI SOC, OpenShift AI, and Cybersecurity AI Agents.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architectural Leadership: Lead the deployment strategy and execution for Enterprise AI Infrastructure, including AI SOC, OpenShift AI, and AI\-based Cybersecurity Log Optimization services.

* Implement cloud cost\-governance guardrails specifically for AI services (e.g., managing high\-cost GPU instances, Bedrock/Azure OpenAI token usage monitoring) to prevent 'bill shock' during scaling.
* Establish CI/CD/CD (Continuous Deployment \& Continuous Diligence) pipelines for Cybersecurity AI Agents, ensuring model updates don't break security hardening or network routing.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field
* 8 \- 12 years of experience in Cloud Architecture, DevOps, or Network Security, with a focus on large\-scale infrastructure deployment.
* Multi\-Cloud \& On\-Prem Expertise: Deep hands\-on experience deploying complex stacks across AWS, Azure, GCP, and strictly air\-gapped On\-Prem environments.
* Container Orchestration: Expert\-level knowledge of Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes, specifically for AI workloads and complex storage/networking integrations.
* Proven experience with Zero\-Trust Network Access (ZTNA), security hardening, and compliance implementation (SOC2, GDPR).
* Automation Skills: Advanced proficiency in "Infrastructure as Code" (IaC) using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools to automate deployments.
* Networking Knowledge: Strong understanding of SDN, complex routing, tenant isolation, and secure network architecture for MSSPs.
* Problem Solving: Exceptional ability to troubleshoot high\-stakes production issues and performance bottlenecks in AI infrastructure.
* Hands\-on experience with Service Mesh (Istio/Linkerd) for mTLS\-based communication between AI microservices and vector databases.
* Experience deploying and securing vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate) in high availability, clustered configurations.
* Proficiency in setting up observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to monitor not just system health, but also model latency and inference drift.
* Familiarity with securing MCP servers against prompt injection and unauthorized tool execution at the infrastructure level.
* Compliance Experience: Direct experience auditing or implementing HIPAA/SOC2 controls in a technical environment.
* Certifications: AWS/GCP Solution Architect, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, AWS/GCP Certified DevOps Engineer.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), AWS Certified AI Practitioner.
* AI Infrastructure: Experience with AI SOC rollouts, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or AI\-based security agents.


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Our mission is simple: to make really high quality essentials for really low prices, produced fairly and sustainably. Quince is a direct\-to\-consumer (DTC) model that cuts out middlemen and leverages just\-in\-time manufacturing to minimize waste and maximize value.
