title: Senior UX Engineer
description:
**About The opportunity** 




 Demandbase is building toward an AI\-first future, where intelligent, agentic experiences help customers understand what matters, make decisions, and take action faster.
 



 We are looking for a Senior UX Engineer to help make that future real.
 



 This is a UX role with deep engineering capability, not a traditional frontend engineering role. You will start with the customer problem and use design, code, and AI to turn ideas into exceptional production experiences.
 



 You will sit at the intersection of Design, Product, AI, and Engineering, helping us move from concept to high\-quality implementation faster. Beyond building experiences yourself, you will create the workflows, patterns, tools, and guardrails that help our Design organization get better experiences into the product with greater speed and fidelity.
 



 You will also help establish UX Engineering as a new function at Demandbase, bringing UX culture and the voice of the customer closer to our India Product and Engineering teams while partnering deeply with our US\-based Design organization.
 



**What you'll do** 



* Build polished, production\-ready Demandbase AI experiences from concept through launch.
* Start with customer needs and translate design intent into thoughtful, high\-quality working experiences.
* Partner closely with Design, Product, AI, and Engineering to explore and ship new agentic interaction patterns.
* Create workflows that help designers move from ideas and prototypes into production more effectively.
* Close gaps between design intent and implementation through hands\-on development and structured pre\- and post\-launch reviews.
* Identify experience\-quality issues earlier and help teams prioritize improvements faster.
* Use AI\-assisted development extensively to accelerate exploration, implementation, testing, and iteration.
* Create reusable components, patterns, tools, and guardrails that improve quality across teams.
* Bring strong UX craft and customer advocacy into the India Product and Engineering organization.
* Teach and mentor designers and engineers, helping establish durable AI\-enabled ways of working.
* Help define what great UX Engineering looks like at Demandbase.



**What we're looking for** 



* Exceptional UX and product judgment, with a strong understanding of customer workflows and needs.
* Strong frontend engineering skills and experience shipping complex web applications to production.
* Ability to move fluidly between design thinking, interaction design, prototyping, and production code.
* Deep experience with modern frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript.
* Highly proficient with AI\-assisted development tools and comfortable using AI throughout the development lifecycle.
* A builder mindset: curious, resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated to make ideas real.
* Experience creating reusable systems and patterns, not only one\-off implementations.
* Strong attention to usability, accessibility, performance, interaction details, and product quality.
* Strong communication and influence across Design, Product, and Engineering.
* Experience working effectively across distributed and global teams.
* A desire to help other designers and engineers become more effective builders.



**What will make you stand out** 



* You have built AI\-native, conversational, or agentic product experiences.
* You can show work where understanding the customer changed what you ultimately built.
* You have personally taken an experience from concept or Figma into production code.
* You have helped establish a UX Engineering, Design Engineering, or Design Systems practice.
* You actively experiment with AI development workflows and can explain where AI helps, where it fails, and how you validate its output.
* You have created tools or workflows that made an entire design or engineering team more effective.
* You care as much about the shipped customer experience as the original design.



**What success looks like** 




**You will help Demandbase:** 



* Ship AI experiences faster with a higher quality bar.
* Catch gaps between design intent and implementation earlier.
* Build reusable interaction patterns for emerging AI experiences.
* Give designers better ways to get their work into production.
* Strengthen the partnership between Design, Product, and Engineering across the US and India.
* Bring a stronger voice of the customer into the India organization.



 Most importantly, you will help ensure that as Demandbase becomes more AI\-first, the experience becomes more useful, understandable, trustworthy, and human.

**About the job** 
 At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." As a User Experience Researcher (UXR), you make this possible. You will join our multi\-disciplinary UX team, collaborating with Engineering and Product Management, to gather insights and create industry\-leading products.
   

  

 You’ll play a critical role in helping your team understand user needs and will drive impact at all stages of product development, ensuring products are useful, usable, and helpful. You will explore user behaviors and motivations by conducting primary research, including: field studies, interviews, diary studies, ethnography, surveys, usability testing, and logs analysis. You will also grow within a supportive UXR community offering mentorship, regular meetups, and exclusive internal tools.
   

  

 In this role you will collaborate closely with Program Managers, Engineers, UX Researchers, Data Science, Marketing and other cross\-functional teams to drive multiple projects in a fluid environment.  As the Team Manager for Technical Writing at Epiroc, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the delivery of high\-quality technical documentation that supports the safe operation and maintenance of our advanced mining, earthmoving, and drilling equipment. Your leadership will be instrumental in driving the development of instruction manuals and standard operating procedures (SOPs) that are precise, user\-friendly, and aligned with product requirements.
   

  

 You will collaborate cross\-functionally with project offices, R\&D, and service operations teams to gather, refine, and incorporate critical product information. Using advanced Content Management Systems and Technical Information platforms, you will ensure the efficient publishing and timely communication of technical documents to our customers and stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the creation and maintenance of comprehensive technical manuals and SOPs for a broad range of equipment including drill rigs, loaders, and trucks, ensuring technical accuracy and compliance with engineering standards.
* Collaborate closely with internal teams such as R\&D, project offices, and field service to acquire and validate content for publication.
* Manage and optimize the use of content management systems and technology tools like Adobe InDesign, XMetaL, Oxygen, Teamcenter, and Schema ST4 to enable modular content creation and single\-sourcing for maximum reuse and consistency.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to innovate technical communication methods, reduce translation costs, simplify content complexity, and enhance overall documentation quality and customer experience.
* Regularly engage with customers to collect feedback on documentation usability and implement improvements that strengthen client relationships and satisfaction.
* Recruit, develop, and retain a skilled technical writing team by nurturing a motivated, collaborative, and high\-performance culture.
* Provide ongoing coaching, mentoring, and performance evaluations, fostering professional growth aligned with evolving business and technology trends.
* Define, implement, and refine internal standards, workflows, and best practices to enhance operational efficiency and deliverables quality.
* Monitor team performance through metrics and reporting tools, ensuring objectives related to quality, delivery timelines, and resource management are met consistently.
* Promote Epiroc’s core values including integrity, inclusivity, and open communication within your team and broader corporate community.


**Required Qualifications And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automobile Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Minimum of 12 years of industrial experience specifically within mining, earthmoving, drilling equipment, or off\-road vehicle sectors.
* Extensive experience in structured authoring, modular content development, and enterprise\-level Content Management Systems delivering single\-source publishing solutions.
* Proven expertise in technical documentation methodologies including topic\-based authoring, minimalism in communication, DITA standards, and XML authoring tools such as XMetaL or Oxygen.
* Familiarity with Simplified Technical English to ensure clarity and global usability of documentation.
* Strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign), Teamcenter, and Schema ST4 for document management and production.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills to translate complex technical and customer requirements into clear, actionable tasks.
* Demonstrated effective communication and leadership capabilities with experience managing multi\-disciplinary teams in dynamic, results\-driven environments.


**Desired Behaviors and Competencies**
* Highly enthusiastic and responsible with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to excel in a fast\-paced, pressure\-driven environment.
* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to foster collaboration across diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills combined with a goal\-oriented and self\-motivated mindset.
* Adaptable, open\-minded, and receptive to new ideas, technologies, and working methods.
* Committed to continuous learning and professional development for oneself and the team.


**Why Join Us?**
 This role offers a unique opportunity to take full ownership of the technical documentation lifecycle within a leading company in the mining industry. You will lead a talented team and be empowered to innovate documentation processes and technologies, contributing directly to product safety, usability, and customer satisfaction. Epiroc fosters an inclusive, values\-driven culture where integrity, collaboration, and respect are paramount. Additionally, this position provides substantial opportunities for professional growth and skill enhancement aligned with industry advancements.
   

  

**About Epiroc**
 Epiroc is a global leader in mining and infrastructure equipment, dedicated to sustainable productivity and innovation. Our commitment to safety, ethics, and diversity creates a dynamic workplace where employees thrive and contribute to impactful projects that shape the future of mining technologies.
   

  

 Join us and be part of a culture that values your unique talents and supports your career journey.
   

  

**It all starts with people.** 
 The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.
   

  

 All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future.  Learn more at www.epiroc.com

title: Senior Associate, Federal Grants
description:
**Why Ryan?**
* Global Award\-Winning Culture
* Flexible Work Environment
* Generous Paid Time Off
* World\-Class Benefits and Compensation
* Rapid Growth Opportunities
* Company Sponsored Two\-Way Transportation
* Exponential Career Growth


 The Senior Associate, Federal Grants will work directly with Ryan team members and Ryan clients/companies to support the development of government funding applications and proposals by playing a key role in researching requirements and writing and editing application and proposal content as a member of a grant writing team. They may also support Ryan in post\-award compliance activities and provide other grant\-related support requested by clients. In addition, the Senior Associate will lead research on U.S. government grants, loans, and contracts and related legislation to ensure the firm's grants knowledge is continually updated. The position will demand high attention to detail and the ability to multi\-task in constantly changing environments. The position requires strong writing, critical thinking, decision\-making, and analysis skills as well as an ability to comprehend and synthesize complex concepts and communicate clearly with stakeholders. The position requires the ability to effectively use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to enhance workflow efficiency while exercising independent judgment and critical thinking when evaluating information and making decisions.
   

  

 The position involves significant project management skills to research and support the development and writing of grant and loan applications and contract proposals that are anticipated to range from $100,000 to $100,000,000\+ in size. These funding applications are positioned to assist our clients’ businesses with their unique projects and could cover a wide array of industries included, but not limited to: energy, agriculture, health, manufacturing, industry, education, and research and development.
   

  

**Duties and responsibilities, as they align to Ryan’s Key Results**
**People**
* Overall Team Support: Our team works together to support multiple clients and priorities simultaneously. The Senior Associate will be communicating, collaborating, and working directly with Ryan Managers and Consultants and third party stakeholders.
* Project Management: This role involves leading and writing multiple, concurrent projects and managing them effectively to ensure the final products meet internal and client standards.
* Administrative Duties: Recordkeeping and reporting to senior management, including use of Ryan’s internal file and client management systems.
* Internal Meetings: Meeting preparation and facilitation for internal weekly Grant team meetings. (The primary Grants team members are currently located in Washington, DC on Eastern Time so the Senior Associate shall assume that the weekly meetings, and any client support meetings, will occur in line with Eastern Time zone.)
* Other: The Senior Associate will be called on to support special projects, high\-priority items, new/existing funding program research, review of existing materials, and updates and enhancements to team products and marketing materials, etc.


**Client**
* Funding Strategizing and Project Scoping: The Senior Associate will be responsible for researching specific funding opportunities for Ryan clients and as such will need to develop a strong understanding of our clients’ projects and areas of investment. The Senior Associate will gather/synthesize project information, identify possible grants and funding opportunities of potential relevance, and prepare reports and materials to summarize the scoped opportunities for review by Ryan staff and ultimate presentation and sharing with clients.
* Information Gathering and Analysis: Support client engagements, company and project information gathering, project scoping and strategizing, and communicating program and project details to Ryan staff and clients, if/as requested.
* Client Relationship Management: The Senior Associate may be invited to client meetings and as such will be required to manage client requests and expectations effectively. They will develop strong working relationships with Ryan staff and clients to ensure project completion and successful submission of requested deliverables.


**Value**
* Conduct Ongoing Grants Research (30%): Support with ongoing grant program research to ensure the Firm’s knowledge is up to date. This involves researching through a variety of online sources, including current U.S. Federal appropriation and legislative materials, reviewing client data and publicly available reports and information on grant and funding vehicles.
* Support Application and Proposal Research, Preparation, Writing, and Reviewing (30%): Either on their own or with a Ryan team member, work on the preparation and submission of funding applications and proposals for clients. This includes synthesizing project information gathered from research, client meetings, notes from the sales team or Manager, and previous funding proposals. They will evaluate and interpret quantitative and qualitative information from credible sources; identify supporting evidence and trends, and incorporate properly cited data into applications. The Senior Consultant will be asked to develop narrative content, budget materials, and graphically rich appendices and executive summary materials. An Engagement Manager, Director, or Senior Consultant will review work and provide feedback for changes or improvement before submitting.
* Support Systemization and Document Management (20%): As documentation for a project comes in, the Senior Associate will be responsible for filing and storing the documents appropriately on our system and ensuring they can be located for later use. The Senior Associate is responsible for maintaining the integrity and consistency of our file management system. The Senior Associate may be asked to analyze qualitative and quantitative data to identify trends, measure effectiveness, and provide data\-driven recommendations.
* Provide Sales and Marketing Support (20%): The Senior Associate will support, and sometimes lead, the development of marketing materials and sales tools and other thought leadership documentation to assist in the marketing and sales process for the U.S. federal grants sub\-practice.


**Education And Experience**
 A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Business/Administration, English or Communications/Journalism, or a related discipline is required. Prior experience in Grants, familiarity with U.S. government programs, and broad business experience and business plan writing would be strong assets.
   

  

**Qualifications Required**
* 2\-3 years of experience in industry with progressive responsibility
* Strong proficiency in Salesforce CRM
* Excellent writing skills and experience presenting written submissions C level executives
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* High comfort level working independently and in a team environment
* Strong decision\-making skills: ability to work with limited information
* Strong research skills
* Ability to work confidently under pressure with tight timelines
* Experience working in a client facing role
* English fluency, both oral and written


**Qualifications Preferred**
* Experience writing grant or contract proposal narratives
* Expertise leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support research and content development
* Experience reporting to, or working with, clients and business leaders
* Strong ability to manage client expectations
* Industry experience in roles that include strategic planning, project management, or similar

* Experience supporting commissioning and qualification activities for manufacturing systems, packaging equipment, or facilities and utilities.

* Strong understanding of GMP commissioning, qualification, and validation practices within regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology environments.

* Knowledge of GMP documentation practices, data integrity expectations, and inspection readiness principles.
* Experience collaborating across Engineering, Validation, Quality, Manufacturing, Facilities, and Project Management teams.

**Good\-to\-Have Skills:**
* Experience working within a Commissioning \& Qualification Center of Excellence (CoE) model.

About ZeroFootprint

ZeroFootprint is a fast\-growing EV charging solutions company based in Powai, Mumbai. We design, manufacture, and supply innovative EV charging infrastructure, including AC Chargers, DC Chargers, Portable Chargers, and DC Mobile Charging Solutions for electric two\-wheelers, three\-wheelers, and four\-wheelers.

In addition to manufacturing EV chargers, we provide intelligent software solutions for charger management, helping businesses and individuals adopt sustainable mobility with ease.

Founded by alumni of the **University of Southern California (USC)** and **IIM Calcutta**, ZeroFootprint is committed to accelerating India's transition to electric mobility through reliable, innovative, and customer\-focused charging solutions.

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic **Inside Sales Executive** to join our growing team.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for generating and qualifying leads, connecting with prospective customers over phone, WhatsApp, email, and other digital channels, understanding their EV charging requirements, and converting enquiries into sales.

This role is ideal for candidates who enjoy speaking with customers, following up consistently, achieving targets, and building a rewarding career in one of India's fastest\-growing industries.

* Build strong relationships with customers and generate repeat business and referrals.

* Graduate or Diploma holder in any discipline.

* Self\-motivated, target\-oriented, and able to work independently.

description:

 Texas Instruments (TI) is out front and ready for the next big challenge. Our innovations are at the core of nearly every electronics product in use today. And it doesn't stop there. We're developing breakthrough technology to power the world's future innovations as well. TI is committed to building a better future — from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities. Put your talent to work with us.
   

  

 Our business has very high growth in TI and is in a segment where the market is fast growing. We are looking for an application engineer who has the passion and excitement to grow, innovate, take an active role in solving controller \& Power stage technical challenges, create novel reference material for various CPU/ASIC power solutions, provide top\-notch applications support to customers for various applications, defining next Gen multiphase controller \& Power stage for Enterprise Computing/Datacenter market. This is a fast paced, results driven environment that requires broad knowledge, creativity and excellent interpersonal skills on a daily basis. They then collaborate with the full IC development team (design, test, product engineers) to deliver products to the market which are compelling, competitive, cost\-conscious, manufacturable, and importantly, successful in growing TI's business
   

  

 In this role, you will be part of a strong and fast\-moving team with opportunities to:
   

  

* Design and build evaluation modules for Multiphase Controller \& Power stage
* Deeply involvement in the new product development with cutting edge of new Gen CPU/AI server power architecture.
* Actively participate in hiring, developing and evaluating new hires / interns to develop their leadership skills
* Collaborate with design, marketing and product teams to provide high value to customers
* Provide technical support to assist customers to design with TI's Multiphase Controller \& Power stage Power solutions
* Write technical documents such as Datasheets, Application notes, etc.
* Contribute to the next generation Multiphase Controller \& Power stage specs definition by engaging with leading CPU solution vendors. Assess IC development tradeoff with design team and creating competition benchmarking.


**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Answer customer questions and support design\-in activities for released products by:
+ Debug of customer problems by re\-creating issues in our evaluation boards and/or customer boards
+ On\-site support for customer boards as required
+ Schematic and Layout Review of customer application
+ Forum and email questions from customers

* Closed work with CPU vendors to qualify the parts to PASS various AVL evaluation.
* Generate SIMPLIS or PSPICE Models for the Multiphase Controller \& Power stage products

+ Provide product recommendations, competitive position and analysis for customers

* Participate in datasheet reviews to ensure completeness of datasheets in development by Systems Engineers
* Design EVM and internal evaluation boards to support correlation and evaluation activities of new products
* Train/Maintain the FAE's team knowledge of Multiphase Controller \& Power stage in order to provide local timely support.


 Write application notes and training collateral that explain different use cases, implementation and/or flexibility of multi\-phase controller \& Power Stage products
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Minimum requirements**
* Masters/PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, ECE
* 1\+ years of application/system experience
* Experience in applications support of power products
* Strong technical background, with the ability to produce high quality technical documentation


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Hands\-on experience working on multi\-phase controller \& Power Stage product and solid understanding of power topology, such as DCAP\+
* Ability to create schematics using OrCAD or Altium; experience in developing PCB design with parasitic analysis a plus
* Demonstrated strong modeling skill
* Software skills in any major programming language (e.g. Python, C\#, LabView, etc.)
* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, ECE or related field
* Demonstrated strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
* Strong time management skills that enable on\-time project delivery
* Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
* Ability to take the initiative and drive for results


**About Us**
**Why TI?**
* Engineer your future. We empower our employees to truly own their career and development. Come collaborate with some of the smartest people in the world to shape the future of electronics.
* We're different by design. Diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what push innovation forward and what make TI stronger. We value each and every voice, and look forward to hearing yours. Meet the people of TI
* Benefits that benefit you. We offer competitive pay and benefits designed to help you and your family live your best life. Your well\-being is important to us. Please find our country\-specific benefits here


**About Texas Instruments**
 Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. **Job Description**
* We are looking for an experienced Oracle EPM Solution Architect to lead the architecture and design of complex, enterprise\-scale EPM solutions. The ideal candidate will have architect\-level expertise in Oracle Enterprise Planning/EPBCS or FCCS, along with a strong understanding of the broader Oracle EPM Cloud ecosystem.
* You will work closely with Finance and IT stakeholders to understand business needs, define end\-to\-end solution architecture, and guide customers toward scalable, high\-performing, and maintainable solutions. This role requires a strong combination of functional Finance knowledge and technical EPM expertise, including application design, integrations, automation, performance, and workload management.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
**About You** 
 :
   

  

* Experienced Oracle EPM Solution Architect with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex, enterprise\-scale EPM solutions.
* Architect\-level expertise in at least one of Oracle Enterprise Planning/EPBCS or FCCS, with a strong understanding of the broader Oracle EPM Cloud landscape.
* Strong functional and technical knowledge, with the ability to translate Finance requirements into scalable, high\-performing, and maintainable solutions.
* Good understanding of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, Workforce and Capex Planning, Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, and financial consolidation and close processes.
* Strong understanding of the end\-to\-end EPM ecosystem, including ERP/HCM source systems, data and metadata flows, integrations, reporting, security, automation, and downstream systems.

* Understand EPM workload and performance management, including application and dimensional design, calculations, data loads, integrations, job scheduling, concurrency, and reporting workloads.
* Able to lead architecture workshops, establish solution standards, review complex designs, and provide technical direction to implementation teams.
* Stay current with Oracle EPM Cloud capabilities, quarterly updates, and recommended architecture and implementation practices.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* BE, BTech, MCA, MBA in Finance, or equivalent relevant education and experience.
* 10\+ years of EPM experience, with significant experience implementing Oracle EPM Cloud solutions.
* Demonstrated experience as an EPM Solution Architect, Application Architect, or equivalent design authority on complex implementations.
* Architect\-level expertise in Oracle Enterprise Planning/EPBCS or FCCS, with working knowledge of other EPM capabilities such as ARCS, EDMCS, EPCM/PCMCS, and Narrative Reporting.
* Experience with at least three end\-to\-end EPM implementations, including architecture/design, build, integration, testing, deployment, and production transition.
* Strong functional knowledge of Finance processes, including planning, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and/or financial consolidation and close.
* Strong understanding of EPM application architecture, including dimensions, hierarchies, cubes, calculations, Groovy, security, reporting, and performance considerations.
* Strong knowledge of EPM integration and automation, including Data Integration, Integration Agent, Pipelines, REST APIs, EPM Automate, Groovy, and integration with Oracle Fusion and other enterprise systems.
* Hands\-on understanding of scripting technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Shell, or Batch.
* Ability to evaluate solution options and clearly communicate architecture decisions, trade\-offs, risks, performance implications, and maintainability.
* Strong troubleshooting, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to lead technical teams and work effectively with Finance, IT, enterprise architecture, integration, and customer leadership teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience architecting multi\-application Oracle EPM Cloud landscapes and integrations with Oracle Fusion ERP/HCM and other enterprise platforms.
* Knowledge of EDMCS, OAC, Essbase 19c/21c, Hybrid BSO/ASO, and multidimensional database concepts.
* Experience with large\-scale EPM implementations involving complex data volumes, organizational structures, currencies, and business processes.
* Experience conducting architecture assessments, performance reviews, health checks, and solution modernization.
* Experience leading architecture workshops, design reviews, Proofs of Concept (PoCs), and mentoring EPM consultants and developers.
* Understanding of EPM Cloud operations, migrations, quarterly updates, production support, SRs, RFCs, and My Oracle Support.
* Relevant Oracle EPM Cloud certifications are preferred.
* Excellent communication and consulting skills, with the ability to influence customer decisions and confidently recommend the right solution.

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all.  Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want \- low prices, vast selection, and convenience – Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world\-class e\-commerce platform. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.

 Account Management \- Brand Specialist

 AVS team is looking for a bright, customer centric, driven, and creative candidate to join our team. You will interface internally with leaders from our Retail and Vendor Services teams and will be responsible for all aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. You will engage directly with multiple internal teams to optimize the product line for key manufacturers (vendors) on Amazon.
   

  

 You will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as site merchandising, buying, inventory management, finance, operations and online marketing, to drive the performance of strategic vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on operational aspects of managing the customer relationships with our vendors.
   

  

 You will conceive, create and analyze a wide range of marketing activities/campaigns to grow the vendor’s traffic, brand awareness, customer conversion, and revenue on Amazon. Also, you will look into operational aspects of vendor’s business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities affecting business.
   

  

 Timings will be as per EU shift, 12:00 pm IST to 9:00 pm IST
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Establish long term partnerships with key vendor partners for the group of vendors handled.
* Partnering with the Retail Category Team and build successful communication channels at all levels, set proper expectations, provide clear status communications, and manage towards a growth plan for the vendors.
* Build and execute on a joint business plan that delivers on key business opportunities and relevant KPIs for the vendors and Amazon.
* Conduct deep dive analysis on vendor issues and publish recommendations and action plans based on data to improve vendor experience.
* Success will be measured by the performance of your vendors on input metrics and impact on creating a great customer experience for buying consumers.
* Conduct regular WBRs, MBRs with the vendors, highlight business metric performance and building action plans.

* Italian language certification: Minimum B2/B2\.2\.

**Leading at Cognizant**
 This is a Leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. Cognizant leaders at every level:
 **Drive our business strategy** 
 and inspire teams around our future.
 **Live the leadership behaviors** 
 , leading themselves, others and the business.
 **Uphold our Values** 
 , role modeling them in every action and decision.
 **Nurture our people and culture** 
 , creating a workplace where all can thrive.
   

  

 At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. We empower our leaders at every level to drive business strategy, inspire teams, uphold our values, and foster an inclusive culture.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Director \- Marketing \& Communications** 
 , you will make an impact by shaping and amplifying the market narrative for Cognizant’s Intuitive Operations and Automation (IOA) practice across marketing, executive communications, and people communications. You will be a valued member of the IOA team and work collaboratively with IOA business leaders, global corporate marketing and communications teams, sales, solutioning, delivery, client\-facing teams, analysts, agencies, and regional stakeholders.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Define and own the end\-to\-end IOA messaging and positioning strategy, including differentiated AI, automation, and agentic AI narratives for clients, analysts, employees, and internal stakeholders.
* Drive an always\-on, multi\-channel marketing presence across the IOA website, social media, practice decks, campaigns, events, digital platforms, and sales enablement assets.
* Build a robust case study and proof\-point library by partnering with delivery teams, client partners, and service line specialists to translate client impact into compelling market\-facing stories.
* Partner with sales and solutioning teams on strategic pursuits by developing bespoke narratives, tailored presentations, credentials decks, competitive battlecards, capability briefs, and RFP content.
* Lead IOA’s annual marketing strategy, roadmap, performance rhythm, analyst recognition communications, regional marketing support, executive communications, and people communications.
* Consistently demonstrate the Cognizant Way to Lead, which means operating with Personal Leadership (building trust, collaboration, and inclusion), Organizational Leadership (driving vision and purpose, demonstrating a strategic and enterprise mindset, and creating and communicating a bold direction that inspires purpose), and Business Leadership (exemplifying client focus, managing ambiguity with accountability and results, and operating with financial acumen).


**What You Need To Have To Be Considered**
* 15\+ years of progressive experience in marketing and/or communications, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Deep understanding of technology, particularly AI, automation, and digital transformation in the BPS, IT services, or professional services industry.
* Proven track record of building and leading integrated marketing and communications functions within a global services or technology organization.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with strong storytelling capability for C\-suite audiences, employees, clients, analysts, and internal stakeholders.
* Strong executive presence and stakeholder influence, with the ability to counsel senior leaders and operate effectively in a complex, matrixed global environment.
* Experience leading and developing high\-performing, cross\-functional teams while managing multiple priorities with strong project management discipline.
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent advanced degree is strongly preferred.
* Embodiment of the Cognizant Way to Lead: Leading Self, Leading Others, \& Leading the Business.
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The Right Thing, \& Own It.


**These will help you succeed**
* Experience in the BPS industry, especially within AI\-powered operations, business process automation, or digital transformation services.
* Experience working with analyst firms such as Everest, HFS, Gartner, or IDC to support market visibility and recognition initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to build scalable editorial workflows, case study engines, reusable sales enablement assets, and thought leadership programs.
* Experience adapting global marketing strategies for regional markets while maintaining brand consistency and local relevance.
* Ability to work with creative, digital, design, and agency partners to produce high\-quality visuals, multimedia, video, interactive content, and digital experiences.


**Work model**
 We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3\-4 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in India. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.
   

  

 The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations
   

  

 We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

HRPs work backwards from the voice of the manager to deliver personalized experiences and drive large\-scale initiatives using technology and simplified processes that match the speed and agility of our business. They operate independently as subject matter experts with deep knowledge of regional programs and policies, collaborating extensively with PXT teams including HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, Legal, and others to provide integrated people solutions. As established practitioners, they mentor junior team members and shape best practices across the region.

 Managers and senior managers collaborate with Senior HR Partners to support sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. The Sr. HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes at the country or regional level. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, Sr. HRPs are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders. Sr. HRPs are also expected to partner on complex global and regional strategic priorities and process improvement initiatives. As a subject matter expert, Sr. HRPs mentor and guide junior team members.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Performance Management: Partner with managers on complex and nuanced performance management cases including performance improvement plans and assessments. Guide managers in implementing performance management processes and tools effectively. Partner with managers to ensure bias\-free evaluations and effective coaching approaches across teams. * Employee Relations: Handle complex and nuanced employee relations cases and investigations following established processes and policies. Partner with Legal and Employee Relations teams to resolve sensitive cases while ensuring compliance and risk mitigation. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Drive implementation of employee programs and lead improvements in manager experience. Partner with HR Business Partners and central teams on complex change initiatives across countries. Use data and insights to advocate for and influence process improvements. Design and execute change management strategies to ensure effective adoption across diverse employee groups.

title: Sales Operations Leader, Amazon Business
description:
**Description**
 Come be a part of a rapidly expanding $60 billion global business serving over 11 million organizations worldwide. At Amazon Business, we set out every day to innovate and disrupt the status quo. We stand at the intersection of tech and retail in the B2B space, developing innovative purchasing and procurement solutions to help businesses and organizations reimagine buying. Bring your insight, imagination, and a healthy disregard for the impossible. Join us in building and celebrating the value of Amazon Business to buyers and sellers of all sizes, unlocking our potential worldwide.
   

  

 This role is part of the Amazon Business India. Our mission is to scale Amazon Business as the trusted procurement partner for Mid \& Large Enterprise customers, by enabling them to leverage data\-driven insights and enhancing sales programs \& processes. We are looking for a Sales Operations Leader who will own the end\-to\-end operational backbone supporting our India Enterprise sales teams.
   

  

 You will be responsible for strategic planning, funnel management, sales automation, customer data governance, reporting, and Salesforce administration — ensuring our sales teams are equipped with the right data, tools, and processes to deliver exceptional customer outcomes at scale. You will drive improvements in planning accuracy, system capabilities, sales productivity, and enable effective execution — ultimately contributing to sustainable business growth through operational excellence.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Strategic Planning: Design customer segmentation across SMB\-Mid\-Large\-Strat cohorts, set quotas for sales teams, plan territories balancing capacity and potential, drive annual business planning with Finance and Category teams, lead the Kingpin goals for Sales \& Operational excellence.
* Funnel Management: Own Spend pipeline hygiene, enforce stage progression standards, drive forecast accuracy through deal inspection cadences, partner with cross\-orgs or cross\-geos for complex account partnerships, and support AEs on SFDC opportunity management.
* Sales Automation: Leverage analytics team bandwidth to launch and drive adoption of Go\-To\-Market\-Operations AI tools, track Productivity Hours Saved metrics, and prototype lightweight AI workflows for India\-specific use cases.
* Customer Data: Own CPS customer data, SFDC lifecycle stage hygiene, industry penetration, manage channel assignment logic, and enforce data governance standards across SFDC.
* Reporting: Partner with BI to produce quality WBRs, AE performance dashboards, quota tracking with variance analysis, and ad\-hoc deep dive requests.
* Centre of Excellence: Act as the trusted, strategic advisor for AB country leader on matters of Sales pipeline hygiene, effectiveness and efficiency


 A day in the life
   

  

 No two days look the same. In a given week, you might kick off Monday by reviewing WBR data and briefing AB Country Leadership on pipeline variances. By mid\-morning, you are deep in a territory rebalancing exercise to scale new CPS customer segment with the BI team. After lunch, you lead a training session on the latest GTMO AI tool release, walking AEs through use cases that save 2\+ hours per week. On Wednesday, you partner with the WW SFDC team to deploy a new workflow automation that eliminates a manual deal\-stage update. Thursday brings a deep dive to align new SFDC lifecycle stage process. By Friday, you have shipped a refreshed Account Executive performance dashboard, and drafted a proposal for expanding AVA coverage to a new customer segment — all while keeping the operational engine running seamlessly in the background.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The India Sales Operations team is a high\-impact group embedded at the intersection of sales strategy and execution. You will report to the India Amazon Business Director and collaborate daily with CPS Sales \& Product professionals, as well as cross\-functional partners in Category, Technology, BI, Finance, and WW Sales Ops counterparts in the US, JP, EU.
   

  

 You will partner directly with Sales leadership to build and scale the programs, tools, and processes that drive customer performance. We move fast, operate with high ownership, and believe that the best operational work is invisible to the people it serves — because it simply works.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of Microsoft Excel experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience developing and implementing systems/tools utilized for CRM, variable compensation, revenue reporting, forecasting, Salesforce automation, etc.
* Experience defining, refining and implementing sales processes, procedures and policies or equivalent
* Experience conducting sophisticated and creative analysis of complex data and translate the results into actionable deliverables, messages, and presentations
* 6\+ years of quota\-carrying field sales role experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience using Salesforce (or other CRM tool) or BI tools
* Experience presenting to senior leadership
* Experience in sales operations or equivalent
* Experience using analytical, sales, and productivity tools including Oracle Business Intelligence, SalesForce, Microsoft OneNote, and Microsoft SharePoint

**Key Accountabilities**
* Lead and manage a team of 8\-15 Customer Operations Specialists, ensuring adherence to customer order process standards and delivery of customer initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**
* 10–12 years of related experience, particularly in supply chain planning and execution, logistics, manufacturing, or customer operations.
* Advanced degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* Experience with SAP implementation or upgrades, relevant SAP modules, and training team members on SAP best practices.
* Experience with quality management systems or continuous improvement methods such as ISO or Six Sigma, including process audits and assessments.
* Experience leading diverse and cross\-functional teams, using customer satisfaction metrics and feedback to improve operations, and managing end\-to\-end supply chain risks and bottlenecks.

 Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Deputy Manager - Building Management Systems (BMS)
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group** 
 : Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Adani Airports Holding Limited** 
 : Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state\-of\-the\-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world\-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 Executive \- Building Management Systems (BMS) is responsible for overseeing the engineering, maintenance, and operational management of all BMS systems within the airport. This includes ensuring the proper functioning, reliability, and performance of systems such as HVAC, lighting, fire alarm systems, access control, and other integrated mechanical, electrical, and civil systems that are controlled through BMS. The role ensures preventive and corrective maintenance, and manage troubleshooting for BMS\-related issues across airport facilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**BMS System Engineering \& Maintenance:**
 Lead the engineering, installation, commissioning, and maintenance of BMS systems, ensuring that they operate efficiently, reliably, and in compliance with airport standards.
   

  

 Oversee the day\-to\-day operation of BMS infrastructure, including HVAC, lighting, electrical systems, fire alarm systems, and access controls, ensuring their seamless integration with other airport systems.
   

  

 Ensure continuous monitoring, testing, and updating of BMS systems to maintain optimal performance levels across all facilities.
   

  

 Develop and execute maintenance schedules for BMS systems, ensuring proper preventive maintenance and minimal downtime.
   

  

**Troubleshooting And Fault Resolution**
 Lead troubleshooting efforts in case of system failures, quickly diagnosing faults within BMS\-related systems and resolving issues with minimal disruption to airport operations.
   

  

 Coordinate with engineering teams to repair or replace faulty components of BMS systems, ensuring efficient and timely resolutions.
   

  

 Implement diagnostic tools and technologies to identify potential issues before they impact the operations of the airport.
   

  

**Energy Efficiency And Sustainability**
 Monitor and optimize energy consumption across airport facilities by utilizing BMS for HVAC systems, lighting, and electrical load management.
   

  

 Implement energy\-saving initiatives through BMS systems, ensuring energy optimization and contributing to the airport’s sustainability goals.
   

  

 Evaluate the performance of BMS systems in managing energy usage, recommending improvements for greater cost savings and environmental benefits.
   

  

**Safety And Regulatory Compliance**
 Ensure that all BMS systems comply with airport\-specific safety standards, industry regulations, and local environmental health and safety guidelines.
   

  

 Conduct regular safety audits and inspections on BMS\-related systems, ensuring proper documentation and compliance with safety standards such as fire safety, electrical safety, and hazard control.
   

  

 Assist in the development and updating of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for BMS operation and maintenance to ensure a safe environment for all stakeholders.
   

  

**Budget Planning \& Forecasting**
 Develop and manage the annual budget for BMS operations, including system maintenance, upgrades, energy\-saving initiatives, and staffing.
   

  

 Prepare detailed budget forecasts, considering historical data, upcoming projects, and planned system enhancements to ensure adequate financial planning.
   

  

**BMS Performance Monitoring**
 Lead the monitoring of BMS data for system performance, energy usage, and operational efficiency, utilizing system dashboards and reports.
   

  

 Analyze system data to detect performance trends and inefficiencies, implementing corrective measures as necessary.
   

  

 Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to BMS system uptime, reliability, and energy consumption to ensure continuous improvement.
   

  

**Vendor And Contractor Management**
 Oversee relationships with third\-party vendors and contractors responsible for BMS system components or services, ensuring high\-quality service delivery and compliance with contractual obligations.
   

  

 Coordinate with vendors for the timely procurement of equipment, materials, and parts required for the maintenance and repair of BMS systems.
   

  

 Manage vendor service level agreements (SLAs) and ensure that maintenance and repair activities are performed within specified time frames and quality standards.
   

  

**Team Leadership And Development**
 Lead and supervise the BMS engineering and maintenance team, providing guidance, training, and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
   

  

 Develop and implement training programs to improve the technical skills and knowledge of the BMS team.
   

  

 Ensure proper documentation of maintenance activities and work orders, ensuring that team members follow industry best practices and safety guidelines.
   

  

**Project Management And System Upgrades**
 Lead BMS system upgrade projects, including design, installation, and commissioning, ensuring alignment with airport’s engineering objectives and timelines.
   

  

 Plan and manage engineering projects related to BMS integration with other airport systems, ensuring minimal disruption to ongoing operations during implementation.
   

  

 Assist in evaluating and selecting new BMS technologies and tools to enhance operational capabilities.
   

  

**Reporting And Documentation**
 Provide regular reports on the status and performance of BMS systems, including energy usage, maintenance activities, and system health.
   

  

 Maintain detailed records of system configurations, maintenance logs, troubleshooting reports, and compliance audits to ensure transparency and accountability.
   

  

 Document system updates, troubleshooting efforts, and any changes to BMS configurations, ensuring all data is current and easily accessible for future reference.
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 Head \- Engineering Services
   

  

 Maintenance Team
   

  

 Facility Management Team
   

  

 Operations Team
   

  

 Procurement Team
   

  

 Safety and Compliance Team
   

  

 Project Management Team
   

  

 IT Support Team
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 Clients/Building Owners
   

  

 Contractors and Subcontractors
   

  

 Equipment Vendors and Suppliers
   

  

 Regulatory Authorities
   

  

 Third\-Party Auditors
   

  

 Consultants and Design Engineers
   

  

 Service Providers for System Upgrades and Maintenance
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualifications:**
 Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
   

  

 Certification in Building Management Systems (BMS) or similar, such as from the Building Controls Industry Association (BCIA) or equivalent
   

  

 Additional certifications in HVAC, electrical systems, or energy management are a plus
   

  

 Professional engineering license (depending on the country/region)
   

  

**Work Experience**
 10\+ years of experience working with BMS systems, including hands\-on installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting
   

  

 Proven experience in managing teams and leading projects within the BMS or building automation industry
   

  

 Strong background in working with control systems, HVAC, lighting, and energy management solutions
   

  

 Experience collaborating with contractors, clients, and other engineering teams on large\-scale building projects
   

  

 Familiarity with industry regulations, safety standards, and energy efficiency guidelines

description:
**Position Summary**
 Deloitte USI Consulting Services is looking for Workday Finance \& Supply Chain functional professionals with proven hands\-on experience in at least one full ERP implementation project.
   

  

****Summary****
 As a Workday practitioner at Deloitte USI Consulting Services, you will design, configure, and deploy enterprise\-scale Workday solutions, collaborating with cross\-functional and global teams to translate client business requirements into effective functional designs and deliverables. You will independently manage your workstream responsibilities while guiding and mentoring junior team members, bringing structure and expertise to every stage of the engagement. Your role spans the full project lifecycle — from estimation and planning through execution and post go\-live support — ensuring high\-quality, timely delivery of solutions that meet client needs and project standards.
   

  

**Work You’ll do**
 You will play a key role in ensuring the successful implementation of Workday Finance \& Supply Chain Management project, engaging across all project stages — requirements gathering, solution design through post go\-live support. In this role, you will analyze client business requirements and translate them into scalable Workday solution designs, configuring and validating Workday Financial and SCM business processes to ensure solutions are accurately built and aligned to client needs. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional and technical teams on design, testing, and integration activities, supporting seamless and effective end\-to\-end delivery.
   

  

****Qualifications****
* 6\+ years of consulting or relevant industry experience in Workday Financials, SCM or related ERP functional roles with good understanding of accounting and business knowledge.
* Hands\-on experience in at least one end\-to\-end ERP implementation project in a functional role; multiple full lifecycle implementations are preferred and expected for more experienced resources.
* Prior to Workday if the candidate has experience in other ERP packages such as Oracle Cloud, Oracle EBS, PeopleSoft and SAP FICO with demonstrated ability to transition into newer technologies will also be considered for this opportunity.
* Functional proficiency in one or more Finance or Supply Chain Management areas, as outlined below. Proficiency across multiple functional areas is expected for more senior resources.
+ Finance — Financial Accounting, Business Assets, Banking \& Cash Management, Expense Management, Customer Accounts, Customer Contracts, Project Billing, Capital Projects, Grants and Gifts
+ Supply Chain Management — Procurement, Accounts Payable, Inventory, and Strategic Sourcing

* Strong understanding of financial accounting and its application within ERP systems, including close processes.
* Ability to gather and analyze business requirements, translate them into functional design solutions, and configure or validate system setups in line with client needs. Senior resources should be able to lead the discussions in design sessions with the client stakeholders.
* Experience in conducting and supporting system testing cycles including SIT and UAT, resolving functional defects, and ensuring solutions meet business requirements.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to team capability building; more senior resources are expected to lead functional workstreams and be accountable for overall delivery.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills with sound judgment and a structured approach to resolving functional challenges


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

****Benefits To Help You Thrive****
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**

description:
**LiveRamp is the data collaboration platform of choice for the world’s most innovative companies. A groundbreaking leader in consumer privacy, data ethics, and foundational identity, LiveRamp is setting the new standard for building a connected customer view with unmatched clarity and context while protecting precious brand and consumer trust. LiveRamp offers complete flexibility to collaborate wherever data lives to support the widest range of data collaboration use cases—within organizations, between brands, and across its premier global network of top\-quality partners.**
**Hundreds of global innovators, from iconic consumer brands and tech giants to banks, retailers, and healthcare leaders turn to LiveRamp to build enduring brand and business value by deepening customer engagement and loyalty, activating new partnerships, and maximizing the value of their first\-party data while staying on the forefront of rapidly evolving compliance and privacy requirements.**
**About The Role**
 The Commercial FP\&A team is seeking a detail\-oriented Financial Analyst who will focus on expense management for the broader Commercial organization. They will provide analytical support to an FP\&A Manager to support data\-driven decision making. We are looking for candidates with strong financial acumen, excellent communication skills, and the ability to deliver actionable insights that inform strategic business decisions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintain financial models to analyze sales and services productivity, supporting both short\- and long\-term planning
* Prepare executive\-level financial reports, including monthly forecast variance analysis and commentary
* Support headcount planning by tracking hiring needs, workforce expenses, and collaborating with HR and business leaders
* Identify and recommend cost\-saving opportunities, evaluating their impact on revenue and business objectives
* Track, analyze, and report on key metrics, including headcount costs, travel \& entertainment, and Professional Services expenses
* Automate and continuously improve recurring processes related to expense tracking and reporting
* Reconcile revenue and expense data across multiple financial systems, ensuring data accuracy and consistency
* Provide ad\-hoc financial analysis and insights to support strategic and operational decision\-making
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather data, understand business needs, and help drive accountability


**Qualifications**
* BA/BS in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 1\+ years of experience in FP\&A, budgeting, or related analytical roles, preferably in SaaS or technology
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience working with large datasets
* Experience with financial planning tools (e.g. Adaptive, Anaplan, OneStream)
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment
* Proactive mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Understanding of SaaS business models, forecasting, and commission planning
* Experience partnering with non\-finance stakeholders to drive business results
* Background in AdTech, headcount planning, or commission forecasting


 Why Join Us? At LiveRamp, you’ll work in a dynamic FP\&A team, influencing strategic decisions while gaining exposure to revenue and expense management in a fast\-paced SaaS business. If you thrive on financial analysis and strategy, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

**Benefits**
* Flexible paid time off, paid holidays, options for working from home, and paid parental leave.
* Comprehensive Benefits Package: LiveRamp offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to help you be your best self in your personal and professional lives. Our benefits package offers medical, dental, vision, accident, life and disability, an employee assistance program, voluntary benefits as well as perks programs for your healthy lifestyle, career growth, and more. Your medical benefits extend to your dependents including parents.


**More About Us**
*LiveRamp’s mission is to connect data in ways that matter, and doing so starts with our people. We know that inspired teams enlist people from a blend of backgrounds and experiences. And we know that individuals do their best when they not only bring their full selves to work but feel like they truly belong. Connecting LiveRampers to new ideas and one another is one of our guiding principles—one that informs how we hire, train, and grow our global team across nine countries and four continents. Click* 
*here* 
*to learn more about Diversity, Inclusion, \& Belonging (DIB) at LiveRamp.*

If you require an accommodation or believe that the use of an ADS may create a barrier to your application or participation in the hiring process due to a disability or other protected characteristic, please let us know. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations and ensuring an equitable hiring experience for all candidates.

title: Principal Accountant
description:
Blackbaud is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Principal to join our Technical Accounting team. This role will report directly to the Manager, Technical Accounting and partner closely with leaders across Revenue Accounting, SEC Reporting, Operational Accounting, FP\&A, Corporate Development, Product Management, and Legal.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess strong U.S. GAAP expertise and strong analytical skills. This role will support technical accounting, complex revenue accounting matters, implementation of new accounting standards, and quarterly and annual financial reporting activities.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Research, analyze, and document accounting conclusions for new and / or complex transactions in accordance with U.S. GAAP.
* Prepare technical accounting analyses, memos and position papers supporting key accounting judgments and conclusions.
* Assist with accounting analyses related to revenue recognition, acquisitions, divestitures, segments, software development costs, leases, stock\-based compensation, contingencies, restructuring activities, impairment analyses, and other complex accounting matters.
* Review significant customer contracts, new products, new go\-to\-market activities, strategic initiatives, and business model changes to determine appropriate accounting treatment under ASC 606 and other applicable guidance.
* Partner with the Revenue Accounting team to evaluate complex customer arrangements, revenue recognition matters, principal versus agent assessments, contract modifications, commissions accounting, and other non\-routine transactions.
* Monitor and assess the impact of newly issued accounting standards and lead or support implementation projects.
* Prepare and update disclosures included in quarterly and annual SEC filings.
* Support internal and external audit activities, including preparation of audit support, responding to auditor inquiries, and serving as a key liaison with internal and external auditors regarding technical accounting matters.
* Maintain and periodically update accounting policies, procedures, and technical documentation.
* Evaluate business initiatives, system changes, and process improvements for accounting, financial reporting, and SOX implications.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams, including Product, Engineering, Finance, and Business Systems, to identify opportunities to streamline accounting processes and implement automation solutions.
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders across Accounting, FP\&A, Product, Legal, Treasury, Tax, and Corporate Development to ensure accounting considerations are identified and addressed early in project lifecycles.
* Leverage technology and AI\-enabled tools to improve the efficiency, consistency, and quality of technical accounting analyses and documentation.
* Perform other special projects and responsibilities as assigned.


**Work Location \& Schedule**
**Work Location:** 
 Sky tech, Financial District, Hyderabad, India
   

  

**Work Schedule**
* This role supports customers and stakeholders primarily during U.S. business hours.
* Expected working hours are 11:00 AM to 08:00 PM IST, with occasional flexibility required to support collaboration with U.S.\-based teams and business needs.
* Participation in after\-hours support rotations and select holiday coverage may be required based on product, region, or business needs.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Active CPA license or equivalent professional accounting certification (CA, ACCA, CPA) required.
* 5\+ years of relevant public accounting experience and/or industry experience; Big 4 audit experience preferred.
* Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial reporting requirements.
* Experience performing technical accounting research and preparing accounting position memos/papers supporting complex accounting conclusions.
* Experience with ASC 606 revenue recognition guidance strongly preferred, including evaluating complex contracts and commercial arrangements.
* Experience evaluating accounting implications of business or asset acquisitions, debt arrangements, stock\-based compensation, leases, and impairment analyses preferred.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly communicate complex accounting concepts to both finance and non\-finance audiences.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to high\-quality work product.
* Experience working with ERP and financial reporting systems; Workday, BlackLine, and Hyperion experience preferred.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills required.
* Experience supporting SOX\-compliant environments and public company reporting processes preferred.
* Self\-motivated team player with a continuous improvement mindset and a willingness to take ownership of complex accounting matters.


 Stay up to date on everything Blackbaud, follow us on Linkedin, X, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube

 *Intelligence for Good®* 
 vision, we’re building a culture where innovation, trust, and human expertise come together to help organizations make a greater difference in the world.

title: UK -Senior Associate
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in providing advice and guidance to clients on tax planning, compliance, and strategy within our Tax practice. You will help businesses navigate complex tax regulations and optimize their tax positions. As a Senior Associate, you will leverage your skills to analyze complex problems, mentor others, and maintain professional standards. You will focus on building client relationships and developing a deeper understanding of the business context. You are building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. Navigating increasingly complex situations, you are growing your personal brand, deepening technical skills, and enhancing your awareness of strengths.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will review and analyze financial data, prepare and file tax returns, and assist businesses in meeting their tax obligations while minimizing risks of non\-compliance. This opportunity allows you to work closely with clients, anticipate their needs, and deliver quality solutions. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, using these moments as opportunities to grow.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Reviewing and analyzing financial data to prepare and file accurate tax returns
* Validating clients' compliance with tax laws and regulations to minimize risks of non\-compliance
* Assisting businesses in meeting their tax obligations through strategic tax planning and compliance
* Drafting and preparing tax documents to support corporate tax planning initiatives
* Monitoring and analyzing financial trends to provide insights for tax strategy optimization
* Conducting financial statement analysis to identify potential tax savings opportunities
* Collaborating with clients to address complex tax regulations and optimize tax positions
* Utilizing analytical thinking to solve tax\-related challenges and improve client outcomes
* Engaging in regulatory compliance consulting to support clients in navigating tax regulations
* Leading project management efforts to streamline tax compliance processes and enhance efficiency


 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree in the following field of study: Accounting or Master's in Commerce
* 2\-4 years relevant experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Demonstrating analytical thinking in tax compliance
* Utilizing corporate tax planning strategies
* Preparing tax documents with precision
* Monitoring and analyzing financial trends effectively
* Drafting tax documents with attention to detail
* Embracing change in regulatory compliance consulting
* Developing self\-awareness and learning agility
