title: Associate, Production Finance - India
description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.
   

  

 Behind every great story is a team of people enabling creators to do their best work. Our Production Finance team partners with filmmakers and production partners to bring Netflix Originals to life while ensuring financial excellence, operational rigor, and responsible stewardship of production investments.
   

  

 If you're passionate about storytelling, love solving complex business problems, and thrive in fast\-paced, collaborative environments, we'd love to meet you.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 As an Associate – Production Finance, you'll be a key business partner supporting Netflix's growing slate of original productions in India.
   

  

 This is much more than a finance role. You'll work at the intersection of finance, production, and strategy—partnering with internal teams and production companies to help productions make informed financial decisions from development through delivery.
   

  

 You'll gain exposure to every stage of the production lifecycle while helping ensure our productions are financially sound, operationally efficient, and positioned for success.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

**Partner with Productions**
* Work closely with production companies, line producers, production accountants, production auditors and internal Netflix teams throughout the lifecycle of a production.
* Build trusted relationships with creative, production, legal, business affairs, tax, accounts payable, and external stakeholders to ensure smooth financial operations.
* Support production partners by providing guidance on Netflix's financial policies, reporting expectations, and production finance processes.


**Drive Financial Excellence**
* Review and analyze production budgets, cost reports, cash flows, and forecasts.
* Monitor production spend against approved budgets and identify financial risks, trends, and opportunities early.
* Partner with productions to develop accurate Estimates to Complete (ETCs) and final cost projections.
* Perform variance analysis and communicate meaningful insights that support business decisions.
* Review invoices, funding requests, and production payments for accuracy and compliance.


**Deliver Meaningful Insights**
* Go beyond validating numbers by identifying cost optimization opportunities and operational efficiencies.
* Analyze production schedules, resource utilization, and spending patterns to proactively highlight financial risks and recommendations.
* Prepare concise financial summaries and presentations for internal stakeholders to support investment decisions.


**Strengthen Financial Operations**
* Map production costs to Netflix's Chart of Accounts and maintain accurate financial records.
* Update production data across Netflix's internal systems and reporting tools.
* Partner with auditors and production accountants to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant financial reporting.
* Help improve reporting processes, financial controls, and operational efficiencies across productions.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

 We're looking for someone who enjoys working with people just as much as they enjoy working with numbers. You are someone who is naturally curious, asks thoughtful questions, and isn't satisfied with simply reconciling numbers—you want to understand the story behind them.
   

  

**You'll Be Successful In This Role If You Have**
* 7\+ years of experience in Production Finance, Production Accounting, Production Management, or a similar role within the film, television, or media industry.
* Strong understanding of production budgeting, cost reporting, forecasting, and production accounting.
* Experience working with production companies, studios, line producers, or production accountants.
* Excellent financial analysis and problem\-solving skills with strong business judgment.
* Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in Google Workspace; experience with production accounting software is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of Tally or similar accounting systems is preferred.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple teams.
* Exceptional attention to detail while maintaining the ability to see the bigger picture.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related discipline. CA or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You thrive in fast\-moving environments and enjoy solving new challenges every day.
* You are proactive, resourceful, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.
* You build strong relationships and enjoy partnering with diverse teams.
* You balance analytical thinking with practical decision\-making.
* You have high standards, strong integrity, and a commitment to excellence.
* You're passionate about entertainment and excited to help bring incredible stories to audiences around the world.


 Why Netflix?
   

  

 At Netflix, you'll have the opportunity to work on some of the most exciting productions in the industry while partnering with exceptionally talented people across creative, production, and business teams.
   

  

 You'll be trusted with meaningful responsibility from day one, encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, and empowered to make an impact on how world\-class stories are produced.
   

  

 If you're excited by the idea of combining finance, strategy, and storytelling, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.
   

  

 We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

title: Financial Planning Analyst
description:
**About the company:** 




 BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. Its a leading service provider for the mid\-markets with client service at its heart.
 



  





 BDO India Services Private Limited (or BDO India) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory \& assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300\+ Partners \& Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3\-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi\-fold.
 



  





**About the role:** 




 The FP\&A Assistant Manager will play a key role in driving financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and performance reporting. The role will partner closely with business and cross\-functional stakeholders to provide meaningful financial insights, strengthen financial discipline, and support informed decision\-making. The position will also contribute to identifying cost optimization opportunities, improving reporting and forecasting processes, and driving continuous improvements across FP\&A activities.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Assist in preparing annual budgets, forecasts, and business plans.
* Monitor budget utilization and analyse variances against plans.
* Track and control operational, project, and departmental costs.
* Conduct profitability, cost, and performance analysis.
* Ensure compliance with financial controls, policies, and procedures.

 The Market Risk Stress Testing Reporting Lead is part of Citi’s Risk Management community. Within Risk Management the role sits within the Data, Analytics, Reporting and Technology (DART) function. DART is responsible for (i) supporting intelligent risk decisions and proactive management of Citi’s risks across the enterprise, (ii) delivering risk information and analysis to help risk managers, the business, and senior management navigate complex risks and regulatory landscape, (iii) providing deep expertise in risk data and dimensions in the development and production of reports and analytics, (iv) designing policies, defining leading practices and innovative technological tooling in performance of risk data governance and strategy roles.
   

  

 The role will lead the team responsible for Market Risk Stress Testing Reporting including both Internal and Regulatory required processes. The team works with Risk Managers, Business, Finance, Technology, and the Capital Planning teams to establish reporting requirements, develop the tools and analysis necessary to proactively identify and manage risk with respect to portfolios and products while continuously updating the process to reflect the current business structure.
   

  

 The candidate will also play a prominent role in the transformation of the Global Market Risk Reporting Process and will be supporting critical organizational programs helping drive innovation and the migration to modern reporting platforms and business intelligence.

description:
**About Payoneer**
 Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
   

  

 By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi\-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
   

  

**The Role**
 Make every Payoneer capability accessible programmatically — through self\-serve APIs and AI\-native MCP interfaces — so customers and their AI agents can work with Payoneer wherever they operate, without opening the app.
   

  

 This is a new, high\-ownership area with no prior product owner — strategy, vision, and roadmap are yours to define. Payoneer already exposes hundreds of APIs, but only a fraction of customers can reach them and onboarding still takes weeks, capping adoption and the retention upside of integrated customers. As Senior Product Manager, Platform Integrations, you’ll own the strategy to close that gap, turn API access into a growth and retention lever, and take our MCP / AI\-native layer from proof\-of\-concept to production. You’ll work across Product, R\&D, Risk, Security, Legal, and GTM, and report into the Platform Product leadership team.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Take the MCP to production. Take Payoneer’s MCP work from proof\-of\-concept to production – exposing capabilities such as balance, transactions, payouts, and FX as tools that AI agents (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude) can call. Partner with Account Security and Core Foundations on auth, governance, and a secure read\-first rollout.
* Turn API access into a growth lever. Payoneer exposes hundreds of APIs, but only a fraction of customers can reach them and onboarding still takes weeks — capping adoption and the retention upside of integrated customers. Own the strategy to close that gap end\-to\-end, with self\-serve onboarding, developer experience, and API governance as the execution threads.
* Turn demand into a roadmap. Synthesize signals from CSM, Sales, and regional GTM teams (EMEA, LATAM, APAC) into a prioritized, evidence\-backed roadmap, and prove the business case – including the retention impact of API\-integrated customers.
* Lead cross\-functionally. Coordinate Risk (eligibility), Security (MCP/API risk model), Legal (data sharing and LLM integrations), Pricing, and Engineering to unblock launches and land outcomes, not just features.


**Who You Are**
* 6\+ years in product management, including significant experience owning API, platform, developer\-facing, or integration products.
* Strong technical fluency: comfortable discussing REST APIs, webhooks/events, authentication (OAuth), SDKs, and integration architecture directly with engineers.
* Proven ability to take an ambiguous, unowned area and create clarity – strategy, roadmap, and shipped product – with a high degree of independence.
* Track record of building self\-serve or developer experiences, and of driving measurable adoption and time\-to\-value improvements.
* Excellent cross\-functional leadership: you align Risk, Security, Legal, GTM, and Engineering around shared outcomes and keep them moving.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; you frame decisions with data and are comfortable defining metrics where none exist.
* Fluent English, written and verbal. Based in India with the ability to work in a hybrid model and collaborate across global time zones.


**What Could Set You Apart**
* Hands\-on exposure to AI\-native interfaces – Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent tooling, or LLM integrations – and a point of view on where agent\-driven finance is heading.
* Experience in fintech, payments, or another regulated environment, and fluency working within compliance, risk, and security constraints.
* Familiarity with API aggregators and ERP/accounting ecosystems (e.g. Codat, Rutter, Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite).
* Experience productizing an existing internal API surface – governance, standardization, and developer adoption at scale.
* A builder’s bias: you’ve turned a first customer or first use case into a repeatable, scalable product.


**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
**Build Each Other Up**
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
 If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. description:
About Leaping Frog Solutions 
 Leaping Frog Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (LFSPL) is an IT and ERP consulting company specializing in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and ERP solutions . The company works with clients on ERP implementation, consulting and technology solutions. 
 We are looking for a skilled Senior Account Executive to join our Accounts & Finance team and manage accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, reporting and financial operations in a growing IT/ERP environment. 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Account Executive Accounts & Finance to manage day-to-day accounting operations, statutory compliances, reconciliations, MIS reporting, taxation, audit coordination and month-end/year-end closing activities. 
 The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Accounts & Finance, GST, TDS, statutory compliance, banking, reconciliations and MIS reporting , along with experience working on Microsoft Dynamics NAV (Navision) and strong MS Excel skills. 
 Key Responsibilities Maintain books of accounts and accurately record financial transactions. Handle purchase, sales, expense, journal, cash and bank accounting entries. Manage Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable activities. Generate invoices, debit notes, credit notes and e-invoices. Monitor customer outstanding and follow up for payment collections. Handle vendor invoice verification, payments and vendor reconciliations. Perform daily Bank Reconciliation (BRS) and cash reconciliation. Manage petty cash and employee reimbursement/expense claims. Handle GST 2B reconciliation and vendor GST mismatch follow-ups. Assist with GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and annual GST reconciliation. Prepare TDS workings and assist with TDS return filing, including 24Q/26Q. Perform 26AS reconciliation and coordinate TDS challan payments. Handle/verify PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, MLWF and other statutory compliances. Support gratuity workings and coordinate with external consultants. Assist internal and statutory auditors with schedules, reconciliations and supporting documents. Support month-end and year-end closing activities. Prepare MIS reports and Balance Sheet schedules. Maintain Fixed Asset Register and depreciation accounting. Handle advance and prepaid expense accounting. Assist in annual budgeting and prepare Budget vs. Actual reports. Support cash flow management and management reporting. Coordinate with CA, CS, bankers, auditors and government authorities. Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation. Maintain confidentiality and ensure compliance with internal policies and SOPs. 
 Required Skills Minimum 5 years of experience in Accounts & Finance . Strong knowledge of accounting principles and bookkeeping. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV (Navision) is mandatory. Experience working in an IT Software / ERP environment will be preferred. Excellent knowledge of MS Excel , including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables and formulas. Strong understanding of GST, TDS, Income Tax and statutory compliance . Practical experience in GST return preparation and reconciliation. Experience in TDS return filing and 26AS reconciliation. Working knowledge of PF, ESIC, PT and LWF. Strong analytical and numerical skills. Good English communication skills. High attention to detail, accuracy and professional integrity. Ability to work independently and meet statutory deadlines. Good coordination and stakeholder management skills. Knowledge of AI-powered tools for finance/accounting processes will be an added advantage. 
 Candidate Profile Candidates with experience in IT Software / ERP Software companies will be preferred, particularly those who have worked with Microsoft Dynamics NAV (Navision) or in a Microsoft Dynamics Partner environment . 
 Candidates residing in Navi Mumbai, Thane or Panvel may be preferred for commute convenience. Email your resume to CAREERS@LFSPL.COM

Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As our new Controller, you will be part of a skilled, dedicated, and ambitious team, that is dedicated to managing the performance of our global Support functions. As a company we are on a globalization journey busy reporting team, which is overall responsible for the controlling of more than 35 countries and covering a revenue of approx. DKK 14 billion and 100 reporting companies. You will join cost management team, a part of Ramboll’s global finance organization and your work location will be at our offices in
 **Noida, India.**
 As the Controller, you will serve as a trusted advisor to the support organization, focusing on cost management, financial analysis, budgeting, business planning, and performance management. Your role is crucial to ensure transparency and accuracy in financial reporting while providing strategic business partnering support.
   

  

**Your key tasks and responsibilities will be:**
* As a controller and trusted finance partner, you are the custodian of the performance within cost management area.
* Overall responsibility of financial results and financial planning.
* Drive a continuous cost improvement mindset and proactively identifies opportunities to optimize costs by utilizing data driven spend.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and the rest of finance.
* Defining, tracking, and maintaining the sets of KPI’s that are used to steer the function.
* Work closely with the Global head of Finance, functional Director, and local country leadership team.
* Organizing financial reviews together with functional head and head of cost management.
* Being the one for analyses, trends, calculations, and simulations. Support complex business cases.
* Focus on detailed analysis of cost, allocations \& postings, and cost trends.
* Coordinating with local Finance \& accounting controllers. Sparring with them


**Qualifications**
**Your starting point:**
 From the moment you join Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you grow with the company:
   

  

  

* B.Com and MBA (Finance) or equivalent degree in Finance.
* We are looking for people with a strong analytical mindset that can handle multiple tasks and challenges at hand, while maintaining a good sense of urgency.
* You have 7\+ years of work experience within financial planning \& analysis, and/or experience as a controller or Finance business partner.
* You thrive of challenging the status que and can put together and execute a plan for change.
* You have a positive attitude and have outspoken collaboration skills and work well with stakeholders at all levels.

description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Software Engineer(React js Developer)
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart and accessible.
   

  

 Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 A unified internal platform that enables Mastercard teams to design, build, govern, and distribute consistent, accessible, and analytics enabled UI experiences across channels using reusable frameworks, automation, and embedded governance.
   

  

 Do you like to be part of a team that creates and executes strategic initiatives centered around consistent user experiences?
   

  

 Do you look forward to developing and engaging with high performant diverse teams around the globe?
   

  

 Would you like to be part of a highly visible, strategically important global engineering organization?
   

  

**The Role**
 What’s it all about and what we expect you to do day to day?
   

  

 Own software delivery tasks (code development, test, deployment, release, configuration and documentation) at an application/software component level
   

  

 Able to troubleshoot and refactor existing code for exceptional code quality.
   

  

 Adopt new languages and architecture patterns needed for the work.
   

  

 Participate and contribute to team’s agile process and decisions. Understand and contribute to Prioritization.
   

  

 Pull from backlog and deliver work after seeking guidance from experienced team members and in partnership with full scrum team.
   

  

 Automate build, operate, and run aspects of software.
   

  

 Drive code/design/process trade\-off discussions within their team when required.
   

  

 Drive integration of services focusing on customer journey and experience.
   

  

 Perform demos/acceptance discussions in interacting with Product owners.
   

  

 Understands operational and engineering experience, actively works to improve experience and metrics in ownership area.
   

  

 Develop complete understanding of end\-to\-end technical architecture and dependency systems.
   

  

 Drive adoption of technology standards and opinionated frameworks, and review coding, test, and automation work of team members.
   

  

 Mentor and guide new and less\-experienced team members.
   

  

 Identify opportunities to improve an overall process and trim waste.
   

  

 Share and seek knowledge within their Guild/Program to drive reuse of patterns/libraries/practices and enhance productivity.
   

  

**All About You And What You Need To Bring**
 Has ability to write secure code in three or more languages (e.g., Java, JavaScript, Typescript,SQL)
   

  

 Familiar with secure coding standards (e.g., OWASP, CWE, SEI CERT) and vulnerability management
   

  

 Infrastructure as code and cloud first software development knowledge experience preferred.
   

  

 Understands and implements standard branching (e.g., Gitflow) and peer review practices. Move the team towards trunk based development
   

  

 Apply tools (e.g., Sonar, Zally, Checkmarx ) and techniques to scan and measure code quality and anti\-patterns as part of development activity
   

  

 Has skills in test driven and behavior driven development (TDD and BDD) to build just enough code and collaborate on the desired functionality. Ability to keep the full testing pyramid healthy \- Has skills to author test code with lots of smaller tests followed by few contract tests at service level and fewer journey tests at the integration level
   

  

 Understands the use of basic design patterns (e.g., factory, adaptor, singleton, composite, observer, strategy, inversion of control)
   

  

 Understands use cases for advanced design patterns (e.g., service\-to\-worker, MVC, API gateway, intercepting filter, dependency injection, lazy loading, all from the gang of four) to implement efficient code
   

  

 Understands and implements Application Programming Interface (API) standards and cataloging to drive API/service adoption and commercialization and effort estimation
   

  

 Experienced in agile and modern SDLC practices (Scrum/Kanban/Continuous Delivery/DevOps/Quality engineering) and the delivery situations they are used for
   

  

 Has skills to elaborate and estimate non\-functional requirements, including security (e.g., data protection, authentication, authorization), regulatory, and performance (SLAs, throughput, transactions per second)
   

  

 Has skills to orchestrate release workflows and pipelines, and apply standardized pipelines via APIs to achieve CI and CD using industry standard tools (e.g., Jenkins, AWS/Azure pipelines, XL Release, others).
   

  

 Familiar with different application patterns to implement different types of business processes (e.g., APIs, event\-driven\-services, batch\-services, web\-applications, big data)
   

  

 Experience in Continuous Integration (CI) and Delivery (CD) concepts, and capabilities to support automation, pipelines, virtualization, and containerization
   

  

 Able to perform debugging and troubleshooting to analyze core, heap, thread dumps and remove coding errors
   

  

 Has skills to conduct product demos and co\-ordinate with product owners to drive product acceptance signoffs
   

  

 Has skills to Understands customer journeys and ensure a Mastercard good experience by continuously reducing Mean time to mitigate (MTTM) for incidents and ensuring high availability (99\.95% as a starting point)
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Lead Software Engineer - .Net
description:
**Lead Software Engineer – Data Management Service – Change Management**
**What Makes Us, Us**
 Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
   

  

 At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
   

  

 If you like
   

  

**what we’re saying, keep reading!**
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
 The DMS Change team is part of the SimCorp Managed Business Services Team. The team works directly with Data Management Service Business Operations using Data Management Platform, which is a single instance, software as a service (SaaS) based product. It provides Reference Data Management and Valuation solutions for many of the world's leading and most innovative financial institutions, including regional and global banks and asset management firms.
   

  

 The Lead Software Engineer in the DMS Change Team owns the technical direction for the customer layer of the product, drives design and architecture decisions, and leads a group of developers responsible for building, testing, and ensuring compatibility with the broader enterprise and solutions architecture through modern development technologies.
   

  

 The Lead Software Engineer will also define and drive new capabilities that support Data Management Service Business Operations, set technical standards across the team, and engage with multiple development teams sitting in different service stacks to align delivery and design.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
* Own the technical design and architecture for assigned areas of the platform, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of DMS Change developers — providing technical guidance, conducting design/code reviews, and setting engineering best practices.
* Grasp the concepts of the system via design documents and drive the team to speed on ongoing SaaS efforts; act as the technical escalation point for the team.
* Support and guide Data Advisory, DMS Operations and QA team members in understanding platform capabilities and constraints, acting as the primary technical point of contact across multiple stacks.
* Communicate priorities, negotiate trade\-offs, and align work items assigned to the team with business and program objectives.
* Drive advanced debugging and root\-cause analysis to resolve complex issues in SIT, UAT and PROD environments, and coach others in doing the same.
* Champion the creation of tools and automation that reduce effort and time spent on repeated activities, and showcase these to a wider audience across teams.
* Bring enterprise\-level software leadership experience to the table, driving optimizations, streamlining, and modernization of processes and systems.
* Own the team's testing strategy in partnership with QA — ensuring strong test coverage, promoting TDD/BDD practices, and supporting testers on technical queries.
* Lead RCA and retrospective meetings with a strong sense of ownership, drive continuous improvement actions to closure, and foster a culture open to feedback.
* Contribute to hiring, onboarding, and performance feedback for team members.


**What We Value**
 The expectations of a lead software test engineer's behavioural skills are centred around an agile mindset of leading and working in teams. Business knowledge requirements vary across business units but are overall within the financial sector. In SimCorp, we use several coding languages and technical domains, so the concrete skills here also vary across the organization.
   

  

**Must have**
* 10\+ years of experience using .NET technologies with an emphasis on C\#, Microsoft .NET Framework including WPF, WWF, and WCF.
* Demonstrated experience leading or mentoring a team of developers, including code/design reviews and technical decision\-making.
* Experience with multi\-threaded / performance intensive applications.
* Deep understanding and experience with Object\-Oriented design and development.
* Strong Analysis, Design, and Development skills with the ability to set technical direction for others.
* Familiarity with source control systems (Git/TFS) and continuous build/CI practices.
* Strong experience in RDBMS (Oracle/MSSQL).
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to represent the team in cross\-functional and stakeholder discussions.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with a track record of resolving complex, ambiguous technical issues.
* Solid knowledge of Web API, .NET Core, Microservices, Docker, or container\-based applications.
* Experience with cloud\-based applications.
* Experience driving Agile methodologies within a team.
* Working knowledge of TDD/BDD, with experience championing adoption across a team.
* Experience in the Capital Markets domain is a plus — preferably with buy\-side firms.


**Good to have**
* AI Certifications
* Capital Markets domain knowledge, preferably with BUY SIDE firms and experience.
* Experience working with Reference Data Management setup and understanding of various asset classes (Equity, Derivatives, and Fixed Income, etc.) and Market data feeds (Reuters, Bloomberg, MarkIT, etc.).


 Prior formal people\-management or team\-lead experience.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Global hybrid work policy \- We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Growth and innovation \- Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
* Self\-Direction \- High degree of self\-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture
* Work\-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes


**NEXT STEPS**
 Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually
 **. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** 
 At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
   

  

 If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
   

  

 We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
   

  

**WHO WE ARE?**
 For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
   

  

 SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.
   

  

 SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

**Job Description**
 The End User Services Core Computing Technology Manager is responsible for engineering and advancing the core endpoint computing experience across the Windows endpoint ecosystem. This role manages modern endpoint management practices to deliver secure, compliant, and stable releases across Windows Physical and Virtual PCs, firmware, drivers, operating systems, and enterprise browsers, while driving a consistent and high\-quality user experience across the enterprise.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Mange Windows endpoint engineering across laptops, desktops, virtual pcs leveraging Microsoft Intune, Autopatch, and other 3rd party products including (Patch My PC, WorkSpaceDNA)
* Design, implement, and continuously improve modern endpoint management practices using Microsoft Intune to support secure configuration, policy deployment, compliance enforcement, and scalable device management.
* Own endpoint release readiness and lifecycle governance to ensure compliant deployments, stable platform performance, and a consistent end\-user experience across enterprise computing environments.
* Lead the strategy and execution for end\-user device delivery through cloud\-based provisioning zero\-touch deployment including autopilot.
* Use Digital Employee Experience and telemetry platforms such as Nexthink and Endpoint Analytics in Intune to monitor device health, performance trends, user experience, and opportunities for proactive improvement.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex endpoint issues across endpoint management, endpoint security, operating system, browser, application, and device layers, applying structured root cause analysis and durable remediation.
* Develop PowerShell\-based automations, scripts, and remediations to streamline engineering workflows, reduce manual effort, improve compliance, and accelerate issue resolution.
* Drive process and innovation in core validation in regards to operating system updates, patches, drivers, security baselines, configuration profiles leveraging GenAI and Computer Use Agents (CUA’s).
* Partner closely with Productivity and Collaboration (P\&C), Information Security Risk Management (ISRM), and other cross\-functional technology teams to align endpoint solutions with business, security, and compliance requirements.
* Establish and maintain engineering standards, technical documentation, operational procedures, and deployment guidance to support sustainable service delivery and consistent execution.
* Evaluate new tools, platform capabilities, and engineering patterns that strengthen endpoint reliability, automation, observability, and user experience.
* Independently analyze problems, assess risk, make sound technical decisions, and drive issues to resolution with limited oversight in a complex enterprise environment.
* Lead and mentor highly technical engineers/analysts responsible for endpoint and application\-lifecycle management through your expertise and experience.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum of 10\+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, endpoint management, or end user computing roles.
* Minimum of 6\+ years of experience working in a large\-scale enterprise environment.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Windows endpoint engineering, including PC hardware, firmware, drivers, and operating system patching.
* Experience managing modern endpoints with Microsoft Intune, PatchMyPC, and Workspace DNA, including device configuration, compliance, application deployment, reporting, and remediation.
* Familiarity with enterprise browser management for Microsoft Edge and Google Chrome.
* Experience with DEX and endpoint analytics platforms such Endpoint Analytics in Intune.
* Knowledge of application packaging, packaging automation, and software deployment practices for enterprise endpoints.
* Experience diagnosing issues across endpoint management tools, endpoint security controls, and device operating environments.
* Strong PowerShell scripting skills with the ability to create automations, remediations, and operational tooling.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across infrastructure, security, productivity, and risk management teams.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and independent problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for diverse stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting regulated, compliance\-driven, or highly controlled enterprise environments.
* Experience with proactive remediation, endpoint baselines, update rings, and automation\-first service operations.
* Ability to lead technical initiatives, influence standards, and mentor peers across endpoint engineering practices.
